it.name: Stick War: Legacy
it.d:
One of the most popular and highest rated web games of all time now comes to mobile!

Play the game Stick War, one of the biggest, most fun, challenging and addicting stick figure games. Control your army in formations or play each unit, you have total control of every stickman. Build units, mine gold, learn the way of the Sword, Spear, Archer, Mage, and even Giant. Destroy the enemy statue, and capture all Territories!

New Features:
● Missions Mode: New levels released every Friday! - Keeping Order won’t be easy.
● Saga style map with multiple rewards.
● Unlock Crowns for each difficulty level, Normal, Hard, and Insane!
● A multitude of new game types await - Win before sunset, Triple barricaded gold, Deathmatch, Forward Statue, vs Mini Bosses and many more!
● Arrows now stick into all units, plus new improved blood effects and taking damage animations.
● Improved unit formations and Archidon bow aim.

Main Features:
● Classic Campaign - The Order Empire is Born. Now with 6 bonus levels.
● Endless Deads zombie survival mode! How many nights can you last?
● Tournament mode! Battle your way through dozens of Ai challengers to win the "Crown of Inamorta!"
● Skins are now available for all characters! Unlock powerful weapons and armor, each with their own unique perks!

In a world called Inamorta, you're surrounded by discriminate nations devoted to their individual nations technology and struggle for dominance. Each nation has developed its own unique way to defend and attack. Proud of their unique craft they have become obsessed to the point of worship, turning weapons to religion. Each believes that their way of life is the only way, and are dedicated to teaching their policies to all other nations through what their leaders claim as divine intervention, or as you will know it... war.

The others are known as: "Archidons", "Swordwrath",  "Magikill" , and "Speartons".

You are the leader of the nation called "Order", your way is of peace and knowledge, your people do not worship their weapons as gods. This makes you a mark for infiltration by the surrounding nations. Your only chance to defend is to attack first, and obtain the technologies from each nation along the way.

Real-Time Multiplayer Strategy
PVP Matches.
• Take control of any unit at any time!
• No “Pay for Power”!

Team up with friends!
• 2v2 Matches
• Add your friends and battle it out!

Single Player Modes:
• Huge ever expanding campaign!
• Practice your strategies vs AI’s

Custom Armies
Build your own Battle Decks
• Collect and unlock from a growing selection of Army types.
• Add Upgrades to your deck and research powerful army bonuses.
• Enhancements such as the “Rune of Reanimation”:  will cause any poisoned enemy units to respawn as Zombies! Or as you will know them “Deads!”.
• Choose from spells such as a giant bubble that blocks incoming projectiles, or “Snow Squall” to freeze entire legions!

Customize your Battlefield
• Custom your troops with unique Skins!
• Custom Statues! Shiny Gold!
• Custom voice-lines and Emotes.

Live Replays
• Watch and share games.
• Pause, rewind, fast forward replays.

Massive Growing Campaign *In Development for release early 2022*

• Fully animated comic book,  music video style cut scenes.

Huge Storylines and in-depth world:
• The Order Empire led by King Zarek and brother, Zilaros the Royal Hand,  have finally defeated the Chaos Empire. Together you discover Medusa has been slain. What lay hidden in the depths of her keep will set you on the adventure of a lifetime. Your reward: strategy, and war!

In a world called Inamorta where weapons are religion the struggle for dominance continues.  The classic cast of nations still thrive.  The Swordwrath, Speartons, Archidons, Magikill, and the Giants are joined by many other nations, each with their own unique fighting style such as the “Sicklewrath", from simple farmers to deadly splash damage warriors. The Chaos Empires, ranged unit  “Eclipsors” are flying bat-like creatures raining arrows from above.  “Shadowrath”  are ninja assassins and these are only a small taste.

it.name: Township
it.d:
BUILD YOUR DREAM TOWN!

Welcome to Township, a thrilling city-building and farming game where you become the mayor of your own town!
Build houses, factories, and community buildings, grow crops on your farm, and decorate your town just the way you like. Take part in limited-time events, compete in exciting regattas, and earn exclusive prizes!

Need a break from city planning? Jump into relaxing match-3 puzzles to earn rewards, speed up your progress, and unlock even more fun - all available offline!
Township - the perfect blend of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!

GAME FEATURES:
● Unlimited creativity: Design and build the metropolis of your dreams!
● Engaging match-3 puzzles: Complete fun levels to earn rewards and boost your progress!
● Exciting competitions: Test your skills against players from around the world in regular competitions - win prizes and make unforgettable memories!
● Exclusive collections: Gather valuable artifacts, rare antiquities, and colorful profile pictures to showcase your achievements!
● Offline play: Enjoy Township anytime, anywhere - even without an internet connection!
● Vibrant community: Meet friendly characters with unique personalities!
● Social connections: Play with your Facebook and Game Center friends or make new friends in the Township community!

Why You'll Love Township:
● A unique mix of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and charming animations
● Regular updates with fresh content and special events
● Personalize your town with a wide variety of decorations

Township is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to take advantage of this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.

A Wi-Fi or internet connection is not required to play.
*An internet connection is required to access competitions and additional features.

Experience a unique simulation packed with realistic graphics, detailed city modeling, and officially licensed buses. Take the wheel of industry giants like Mercedes-Benz, Temsa, Setra, Scania and Marcopolo deliver top-tier passenger service across long distances.

Drive through day and night, rain or shine. Every stop, every turn, and every moment is yours to control. Grow your own bus company while enjoying the thrill and challenge of intercity transport.

Ready to start the engine and turn on the headlights? Your journey begins now!

Can you become the greatest bus company ever?
Establish your bus company and become the largest bus corporation in the world.

United States, United Kingdom, China, Canada, Russia, Germany, Italy, France, Spain, Netherlands, Türkiye, South Korea, Japan, Brazil, Azerbaijan, Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Dominican Republic, Indonesia, Philippines, South Africa, India, Hong Kong, Ireland, Israel, Qatar, Malaysia, Thailand, Taiwan and more Realistic city maps and bus stations. 


BUS SIMULATOR GAME FEATURES

- Free Multiplayer Game (Ultimate League)
- You will be able to have offices in many places around the world.
- Over 20 thousand cities and counties.
- Passenger System will provide Social and Realistic Reactions.
- Manage your own business
- Hire employees and manage your company for maximum profit
- 32 Amazing Coach Bus
- More than 300+ original terminals.
- Used Buses Market
- Detailed Cockpits
- Passengers might review you.
- 250+ radio stations
- Highway Toll roads
- Realistic traffic system
- Realistic weather > Rain, snow and many more.
- Realistic Bus sound effects
- Realistic host service.
- Easy controls (Tilt, Buttons or steering wheel)
- More than 25 language support

Completely realistic Coach Bus Simulator. 

HOW TO PLAY
- Start your Bus by using Start / Stop button.
- On the right side of your screen, bring the shift to “D” position.
- Control your Bus by using break and acceleration buttons.

Attention: Drive safely and follow traffic rules in real life.

it.d:
Explore a world full of delicious match-3 puzzles and endless fun! Blast through thousands of challenging levels in this timeless puzzle game from King. Match candies, conquer jelly, toffees, and jam, and uncover sweet surprises in every puzzle.

Classic Match-3 Gameplay with Fresh Twists

- Discover unique game modes like Gummy Dragons and Bubblegum Pop. 
- Match and blast your way through matching levels full of sugar-coated fun.
- Master tricky puzzles and create explosive combos to clear the board!

Brain-Boosting Challenges & Special Events

- Daily Rewards: Log in every day to claim free boosters and extra lives.
- Time-Limited Events: Compete in themed challenges and win exclusive prizes.
- Tournaments & Leaderboards: Crush more candies than your friends and rise to the top to become the ultimate match-3 master!

Bonbon Blitz Your Way Through Extra Sticky Levels

- Use powerful boosters like Bonbon Blitz, Lollipop Hammer, and Jelly Fish to solve puzzles and boost your score.
- Stuck on a level? Boosters and extra moves will help you blast through any obstacle.

Play Offline or Online, Anytime and Anywhere

- No internet, no problem: Enjoy offline gameplay and keep the fun going wherever you are.
- Ad-free fun means uninterrupted candy-matching bliss!

Connect with Friends & Join the Candy Kingdom

- Share lives, compare scores, and see who’s the match-3 master in your friends circle.
- Connect your game to Facebook to sync progress, compete with friends, and unlock exclusive rewards!

Discover more from King

Looking for more brain-teasing fun? Try Candy Crush Soda Saga or Farm Heroes Saga for fresh twists on classic match-3 puzzles. Or dive into sweet solitaire action with the new Candy Crush Solitaire!

it.d:
CONTRA GUNS - A THRILLING FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER
In Contra Guns, every victory counts. Choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with a distinctive look to match your style. Unlock over 30 types of modern weapons from rifles and pistols to smart bombs and turrets. Customize and upgrade your gear and climb the leaderboards. Daily missions and login rewards offer constant progression, giving you goals to conquer every day.

KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE
- Over 30 weapons: assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, sniper rifles, melee weapons, and more.
- Multiple game modes: team deathmatch, free for all, point capture, and more.
- Customizable characters: skins, hats, and backpacks.
- Customizable loadouts: weapons, armor, lethal and tactical grenades, medkits, killstreaks, and more to fit your strategy.
- Daily rewards: bonuses for logging in and completing missions.
- Beautiful maps: crafted for intense first-person shooting action.
- Immersive audio: feel the battle with powerful sound design.
- Smooth controls: optimized for mobile devices, fully adjustable.
- Regular updates: new content, events, and seasonal challenges.
- Global multiplayer: meet players worldwide and form teams.

DISCOVER MAPS, MODES, AND CUSTOMIZATIONS
Uncover a wide variety of beautifully crafted maps and immersive environments designed for dynamic first-person combat. Join fast-paced 5v5 team battles and thrilling free-for-all fights. Personalize your heroes with diverse skins and weapon modifications. Experiment with setups to find new tactical advantages and fresh ways to experience the battlefield.

CONNECT, TEAM UP, AND LEAD
Form alliances, build squads, and join clans with players from around the world. Whether teaming up with friends or new allies, your success depends on your teamwork and strategy. Participate in global battles, work together to achieve victory, and celebrate your triumphs with your squad.

CRUSH OPPONENTS WITH FIREPOWER
Jump into fast-paced online battles and unleash your full combat potential. Feel the thrill of intense battles and dominate the arena in 5v5 team fights. Master a massive arsenal and crush your enemies with precision shots, tactical grenades, and powerful weapons. Choose your weapon, define your style: aggressive assault or calculated defense, and dominate the battlefield.

JOIN THE ACTION
Download Contra Guns today and experience a world of endless gunfights, tactical combat, and unstoppable excitement. Whether you're a lone wolf or a team player, the battlefield is waiting. Equip your hero, load your weapon, and jump into the action — your prime battle begins now!

SUPPORT: Have questions? Contact us at info@edkongames.com

NOTE: An active internet connection is required for all features.

it.name: Glory Ages - Samurais
it.d:
Glory Ages - Samurais will transport you to medieval Japan. In the game you get tactical Samurai sword battles, intelligent opponents, all kinds of equipment, numerous locations and even endless mode.

Special features

1. Artificial intelligence.
We worked a long time to make the enemies intelligent.
They can side-step you, circle, counterattack and block your blows during the fight. They react to the death of their soldiers and also gesticulate in various ways during the battle.

2. Numerous characters and weapons. Numerous realistic medieval Japanese weapons, many kinds of Japanese swords, huge arsenal of katanas and all kinds of characters with their own characteristics.

3. Large-scale tactical battles.
You have to think about how to beat your enemies, when to block their blows and when to attack. The fury that can save your life at a critical moment, instantly destroying large numbers of the enemy, accumulates during the fight. You can level up your battle experience or improve your character’s equipment.

4. Graphics and sound.
An incredible level of graphics and sound accompaniment. A dynamic environment in the background combined with thematic music.

5. Atmospheric environment.
Ten different locations under different weather conditions from winter cities to rainy swamps.

it.d:
STEP INTO THE DARKNESS

• Explore a Dark and Mysterious World
Step into the Plaguelands – a cursed realm where death is never far. Every forest hides a threat, every ruin breathes with old magic, and no path is truly safe. Discover long-abandoned castles, forbidden temples, and ancient altars buried in shadow.

• Enter the Challenging Dungeons
Beneath the surface lie ever-changing dungeons filled with traps, cursed guardians, and powerful relics. Each descent is a risk – few return, and none return unchanged.

• Follow Quests and Uncover Secrets
Ravens bring whispers of danger and reward. Track forgotten letters and torn scrolls to uncover the truth behind the Gray Decay – but beware, some truths are guarded for a reason.


SURVIVE AND BUILD

• Survive and Craft

Launch into the action today and prove yourself in the greatest fighting tournament in all of the realms!

MASSIVE CHARACTER ROSTER
The roster is stacked with over 150 Mortal Kombat fighters spanning from the arcade days to the New Era of Mortal Kombat 1. Kollect the klassic fighters from MK3, legendary kombatants from MKX and MK11, and even reimagined fighters like Shang Tsung from MK1! The roster also features mobile exclusive variants like the Kombat Cup Team, as well as notorious guest fighters like Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, and the Terminator.

BRUTAL 3v3 KOMBAT
Assemble your own team of versatile Mortal Kombat fighters and lead them into battle to earn experience, level up your attacks, and knock out the kompetition in Faction Wars. Each fighter has a set of unique attacks, like Sindel’s Banshee Scream, and Kabal’s Dash and Hook. EPIC FRIENDSHIPS & BRUTALITIES

Earn a variety of rewards including Souls, Dragon Krystals, and more by completing specific game objectives. Ascend featured Gold fighters like Warlock Quan Chi and Aftershock Tremor to instantly make them stronger and unlock their ability to perform a Brutality!

FEATS OF STRENGTH
Unlock unique Mortal Kombat profile and victory kustomizations by completing certain character objectives! Design your War Banner to show off in Faction War fights and gain Kombat stat bonuses by unlocking certain Feats of Strength.

Download this groundbreaking, free fighting game TODAY and unleash your power!

No Limit Drag Racing 2 is a car racing game that brings the thrill of real driving simulation to your fingertips. 

Immerse yourself in a hyper-real drag racing game with a physics engine built on real drag racing. No Limit Drag Racing 2 offers an unparalleled mobile car racing game experience that’s as close as you can get to the real thing without actually heading out on the track.

Join millions of players and engage in intense head-to-head competitions, showcasing your racing and drifting skills in one of the most exciting high-speed car games.

DOMINATE THE RACING GAMES SCENE
- Full car customization: Paint, wraps, decals, and more!
- Advanced tuning: Gearing, suspension, timing, and dyno testing.
- Leaderboards: Compete globally and rise to the top!
- Multiplayer: Battle in car  racing games against real players worldwide.
- Try drifting in Free Roam mode games to earn bonus points and coins.
- Membership perks: Exclusive badges, discounts, gold bonuses, and more.

COLLECT UNIQUE CARS
- Collect high-end & classic cars, import tuners, trucks, dragsters, bikes, and more. 
- See your dream cars shine in high-octane car racing games.
- Compete using the cars your drag racing heroes drive.

FULL CAR CUSTOMIZATION
Design your dream ride to use in racing car games:
- Custom paint, wraps, decals, wheels, and body kits.
- Millions of combinations for a one-of-a-kind ride.
- Give yourself an edge in racing & drifting games with custom tuning

LEADERBOARDS
- Prove you’re the best by climbing global leaderboards.
- Compete in car racing games with the fastest drivers and earn your place at the top!

CAR SHOWS
- Show off your car in games and competitions. 
- Win prizes and earn the respect of racers worldwide.
- Compete for the chance to be featured on the podium - showcased worldwide.

CAR RACING GAME MODES
- Challenge players from around the globe in thrilling head-to-head multiplayer car racing games.
- Race to the top in single-player career mode.
- Test & Tune: Use tester tracks to dial in your beast. Optimize your car for different racing surfaces and know your numbers before every game.
- Free Ride: Build custom drives for your custom car.
- Quickplay: Jump into head-to-head races with players around the world. Try drifting in game for bonus points.
- Start a winning streak… and try your best to hold on to it.

ADVANCED TUNING OPTIONS
Customize every performance detail:
- Adjust gearing, suspension, timing, fuel delivery, boost, and more.
- Test and tweak your car on the in-game dyno.

UPGRADES & MODIFICATIONS
- Stock cars won’t cut it! Upgrade engine blocks, intakes, tires, and more to maximize performance. Stay competitive by constantly fine-tuning your setup.

Completely Free to Download!

No Limit Drag Racing 2.0 is free to play and ad-supported. Unlock premium perks with our membership options.

Found a bug?
We’re dedicated to delivering the best experience. Please reach out before leaving a negative review.

it.name: Picoboom Color Hunt & Imposter
it.d:
Who's the Imposter? One secret word. One faker. Total chaos.

Forget boring party games. Picoboom is the vibe check your group needs: chaotic, hilarious, and completely unhinged. And now it's home to the game your group won't stop playing: hunt down the Imposter before they fool the whole room.

Color Hunt: the mode everyone's filming
Picoboom shows a color, the countdown starts, and everyone scatters to find something that matches. Snap your find in the app, Picoboom scores how close the color is, and the closest match takes the win. Fast, chaotic, and made for a crowd.

Imposter, two ways to play
- Imposter Online: create a room, share the code, and play with friends from anywhere, each on their own phone (3 to 20 players)
- Pass and play: one phone, passed around the room (3+ players)
Everyone gets the same secret word, except the Imposter. Drop one-word clues, spot the faker, and vote them out, or bluff your way to victory.

Plus the OG Picoboom modes
The chaos that started it all is still here:
- Pass the Bomb: beat the timer, and whoever's holding the phone when it explodes takes the penalty (customize them for maximum chaos)
- Name 3 Things, Act It Out, and more
2 people work, but a whole crowd works better.

Get ready to
- Bluff, accuse, and roast your friends like never before
- Act it out, sing, or make up raps
- Yell the first curse word that pops into your head
- Make fast rhymes and wild guesses
- Jump, laugh, and maybe even cartwheel across the room

Perfect for
- Parties, sleepovers, road trips, dorms, and family gatherings
- Friends who love to compete, lie, and call each other out

Loved by over 1 million players. From the creators of Truth or Dare and Never Have I Ever.

Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you: https://www.vanilla.nl/contact/

You can subscribe to Premium for unlimited access to all games, regular new content, and no ads. The subscription period is 1 week and includes a 3-day free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled.

The third official part of the amazing RPG series survival games, which received tens of thousands of positive reviews throughout the post-Soviet space and was enjoyed by an incredible number of gamers! A survival Post-Apocalyptic game, which is a kind of prequel to the previous part of the series - Pocket Survivor 1 and Pocket Survivor 2!

 Finally, fans of the series will be Let's Survive able to find out the reason for the outbreak of the Great Nuclear War & Standoff Doomsday, after which the remnants of the Earth's population, among the war and horrors of people had to wage a fierce struggle for the right survival to exist in the post-apocalyptic world!

Will you be the best stalker able to be survival in a home country where there was a nuclear explosion, leaving the whole area in the form of a nuclear wasteland for survival and the country itself has been torn to pieces by a bloody Great Civil War for Survival of the best part of civilians for several years now? Your goal is to survive in a small Russian southern city, which, by the will of the Fate & Standoff of this world, turned out to be a countdown point. After which the Last Day on Earth will come. And only you having a very small chance of survival in such difficult conditions of the Nuclear Desolation of the Future to try to somehow change history and save this world and claim the title of Lone Survivor! But it is not exactly. But I believe in your standoff among the ruins dying Civilization!


Features of the game:

 Advanced editor to create your own unique Surviving Hero!

 Large detailed city Wasteland Maps with dozens of unique locations

 A hardcore real-life survival simulator inspired by the Fallout and Stalker series

 Interesting random text events, the outcome of which depends not only on your choice but also on external survival factors

 Sophisticated and well-thought-out loot system, and over a hundred random interesting events of the Survivors while searching among the ruins

 Over 100 different types of weapons, armor, helmets, backpacks, and costumes, including legendary and mythical items help in a standoff with enemies!

 If you are a fan of games such as STALKER Shadow of Chernobyl, Call of Pripyat, Clear Sky, Metro 2033, Fallout, Exodus, then this game is definitely for you!

 Personal shelter bunker that can be improved and developed over time & will give shelter and a warm bed among the falling radioactive fallout

 Real post-apocalyptic radio in the spirit of the previous parts!

 Nice and well thought out system of crafting items for better survival in the Wastelands of the Nuclear City

 Real survival simulation. You need to eat, drink, rest, sleep, and heal injuries and illnesses. Fight among the scary zombies, military, stalkers, survivors, tagged, vagabonds, and terrible mutants of the new world

 A clear pumping system and combat system will not be difficult for a beginner, but they have hidden depth! 

 War of factions and the opportunity to join one of 5 warring factions, which are constantly fighting and survival for control of the city.

 Lack of a direct, linear plot, and the ability to study the world on your own by indirect events.

 If you stay among the Apostles of Sin for a long time, you can become their henchman or turn into a living Zombie. Remember the Zombies among us! Beware of the radioactive fallout that has turned pets into terrible and bloodthirsty critters

Play as a resident of Russia who finds himself in a post-apocalyptic and help him survive in a world that is unfit for existence!

The game is under development and the work is done by one person. If you find bugs or errors, then write me on the email in contacts. I will be very grateful.

Good luck Best Survival!

*Make sure to check if your device is supported before playing Subnautica!*

Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet. A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you!

Descend into the depths, craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive. Unravel the mystery of this world teeming with creatures, both friendly and hostile, scattered with clues from a previous time.

Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 

FEATURES
• SURVIVE - After crash landing on a vast underwater planet, the clock is ticking to find water, food, and to develop the equipment you need to explore.
• EXPLORE - Manage your hunger, thirst, and oxygen supply as you dive into towering kelp forests, sunlit plateaus, bio-luminescent reefs, and winding cave systems.
• SCAVENGE - Collect resources from the ocean around you. Venture deeper and further to find rarer resources, allowing you to craft more advanced items.
• CRAFT - Build bases to shelter in, vehicles to pilot, tools for survival to aid you in navigating and adapting to this subaquatic landscape. 
• DISCOVER - What happened to this planet? What caused you to crash? Can you find a way to make it off the planet alive?
• CUSTOMIZE - Play in Survival mode to experience the original challenge, or switch to Freedom or Creative mode to discover this oceanic planet without the pressures of thirst, hunger, or oxygen. 

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
• Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
• Game Center achievements
• Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
• Compatible with MFi controllers
• iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)

it.name: Swamp Attack 2
it.d:
Our friend Slow Joe is just sittin’ on his porch, minding his own business, when a swarm of mutant ‘gators attack! Good job he’s got access to firearms, but he’s going to need a whole lot of help and a whole lot of ammo this time around...

DEFEND JOE’S SWAMP!

These monsters mean business and they’re racing straight towards Joe’s cabin in this awesome tower defense game. First they’re coming for the swamp, then the entire world, so show no mercy and kick them OFF your private property!

SHOOT THE MONSTERS!

Evil crocs, grizzly gators, bloodthirsty beavers and rabid rats. Are they mutants? Zombies? All we know is they’re deadly! And they’ll do more than destroy the plants if they get close, so load up your gun and get shooting!

CHOOSE YOUR WEAPONS

Shotguns, rayguns, rockets, bombs, grenades… practice your aim and your archery skills with an extensive range of weapons. Some guns are effective on small, quick monsters while others are better on big, slow beasts! Upgrade your guns as you go to kick up a monster storm.

MEET JOE’S FAMILY

Slow Joe ain’t the sharpest tack in the box and he’s going to need help defending his swamp! Meet flamethrowing cousin Welder, armed and dangerous Uncle Hairy and the not-so-sweet Grandma Mau. Combine lethal weapons with lethal family members for the best attack.

EXPLORE NEW LEVELS & WORLDS

Start off in the Deep South and play levels to progress to the Siberian swamps of China and Russia. Different monsters lurk in different regions, and you’ll need strong tactics to defeat some of these zombies, so get ready to fight in this tower defense game!

Swamp Attack 2 is an action-packed attack and defense game filled with guns, monsters and zombies. Players who like shooting games, gun games, archery games, monster games, tower defense games, racing games, funny games and crazy characters will enjoy this game, too!

it.name: Terraria
it.d:
The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Terraria offers more than ever - including the brand new 1.4.5 Bigger and Boulder Content! 

Presenting an impressive catalogue of 5,000+ items, 25+ NPCs, and 400+ enemies and blending elements of classic action games with sandbox-style creativity, Terraria is truly a unique adventure!

The latest content update includes: 

NEW 1.4.5 CONTENT:
- Dead Cells crossover content – new weapons, combat accessories and more!
- Iconic Pals from Palworld have arrived in Terraria!
- Fifteen new furniture sets. 
- Five new types of boulders — watch your step!
- Four new transformation mounts.
- New whips and Summoner prefixes. 
- New Kites, critters, and decorative features. 
- And so much more to discover! 


NEW WORLD SEEDS TO DISCOVER:
- A new Skyblock world seed.
- A new world creation menu allowing you to mix and match special seeds.
- Improvements to existing seeds!

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Reworks and balance improvements to weapons. 
- Visual updates to many classic sprites.
- And so many more improvements!

• MULTIPLAYER – Play with up to 7 friends on Local Wifi or Online via device-device Wifi hosted games or through the Mobile Terraria Dedicated Server for PC (available for free on Terraria.org)
• TERRARIA REIMAGINED FOR MOBILE – Fully customizable controls and User Interface provide a level of polish and capability not previously possible!
• Gamepad support – including fully-remappable buttons - Play with your Bluetooth connected gamepad where supported.
• Full array of World sizes – Small/Medium/Large...the same size as on Terraria for PC!  Now includes random world name generator and the ability to use World Seeds (including some hidden easter egg worlds)
• Over 400 enemies to combat, defeat, and plunder for loot
• Over 20 Biomes and Mini-Biomes to explore, both above and underground – from lush forests to barren deserts to dungeons, the underworld, and even the terrifying Corruption await!
• Updated crafting with multiple added item options
• Over 20 NPCs to discover, each providing their own benefits and unique style
• More than 1000 new items to discover – bringing the total item count to more than 5000!
• In-depth building options that are easy to learn but allow for amazing feats of architecture in the hands of a master.
• And much, much more!

In short, every pixel of Terraria has been reimagined and hand crafted for the BEST possible mobile experience!

it.name: Zen Color - Color By Number
it.d:
Experience real tranquility with Zen Color, the first coloring game inspired by Zen. Our team is dedicated to providing you with the ultimate relaxing and fulfilling gaming experience. Let go of your worries, forget your stress, and finally put your mind at ease by immersing yourself in the world of Zen coloring.

Escape from the daily grind and chaos of life. Open up Zen Color anytime, anywhere, and transport yourself to a place where you can:

* Imagine sipping a cup of coffee in the morning, the birds chirping just outside the window, watching golden sunbeams filtering through the trees.
* Enjoy a tranquil tea break on the perfect afternoon, where everything feels peaceful and just right.
* Transport yourself to a Japanese Zen courtyard, feeling as one with everything around you as you watch the steaming teapot by your side.
…
Zen Color invites you to breathe life into these realistic pictures and rediscover the long-lost peace and beauty in your heart. With every tap of the color number, Zen Color brings tranquility and relaxation to your fingertips.

ZEN COLOR FEATURES

INCREDIBLE CALM & RELAXATION

* Explore unique Zen-inspired pictures that help clear the fog and focus your mind while giving you a boost of positive energy.
* Find your groove and get into the flow while coloring by numbers with relaxing 60bpm background music.
* Immerse yourself in the beauty and tranquility of nature, leaving your worries behind to let you unwind.
* Sooth anxieties and have fun with the Flow Experience during the coloring process, which includes categories like Calm, Focus, Zen, Affection, Happiness, and more.

A LARGE SELECTION of MASTERFUL PAINTINGS

* Each picture is carefully crafted by highly talented artists hailing from all corneres of the globe, ensuring content consisting of only the best quality.
* Choose from a vast selection of pictures so you can find the perfect painting to suit your style.
* Discover scenes such as brilliant natural landscapes, animals of all shapes and sizes, cozy lifestyles, your favorite pets, and more in Zen Color.
* Mandalas and geometric patterns can help you find inner peace and harmony, sating your artistic appetite while allowing you to stay focused and spiritually fulfilled.

ALSO FEATURING

* A distinctive eye-friendly dark mode designed for comfortable coloring at night.
* Outstanding app stability, excellent data security, and a user-friendly interface for an exceptional user experience.

Zen Color offers everyone’s inner artist a relaxing and peaceful coloring experience in this fast-paced and noisy world. If you're looking to take a break and find inner peace by doing some coloring, look no further than Zen Color. It's the perfect choice when you want to unwind and take some time for yourself. This amazing coloring game can help you reclaim those quiet moments in life for yourself once and for all!

Take a 10-minute break to discover inner peace, fulfillment, love, and happiness. It's time to embark on a calm and relaxed journey with Zen Color.

Can you rebuild civilization after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’.

Decades after the Necroa Virus ravaged humanity, a few survivors emerge. Build a settlement, explore, scavenge resources and expand as you shape your post-apocalyptic society. The world is green and beautiful but danger lurks in the ruins!

After Inc. is the brand new game from the creator of ‘Plague Inc.’ - one of the most popular games ever with over 190 million players. Brilliantly executed with beautiful graphics and critically acclaimed gameplay - After Inc. is engaging and easy to learn. Build multiple settlements and gain abilities in a persistent campaign to lead humanity out of the darkness.

Public Service Announcement: Unlike our other games, I’m pleased to say that After Inc. is not based on any real world situation. No need to start worrying about a real life zombie apocalypse yet… 

◈◈◈ What happens after Plague Inc.? ◈◈◈

Features:
● Make difficult decisions - Are children an unaffordable luxury? Are dogs pets or a food source? Democracy or Authoritarianism?
● Explore a beautiful post-apocalyptic United Kingdom
● Exploit the ruins of the past to scavenge / harvest resources
● Expand your Settlement with housing, farms, lumberyards and much more
● Exterminate zombie infestations and defend humanity
● Uncover old technologies and research new ones
● Shape your society and provide services to keep your people happy
● Build multiple settlements in a persistent campaign and level up abilities
● Ultra realistic modelling of Zombie behaviour based on real life studies… :P
● Sophisticated narrative algorithms shaped by your decisions
● 5 unique leaders with radically different abilities
● Internet connectivity not required
● No ‘consumable microtransactions. Expansion Packs are ‘buy once, play forever’
●Will be updated for years to come.

Special sale price to celebrate the launch of the game!


◈◈◈


I’ve got lots of plans for updates! Get in touch and let me know what you want to see.

James (the designer)

it.name: AdventureQuest 3D MMORPG
it.d:
AdventureQuest 3D MMORPG – Battle, Build, and Become a Legend

Enter a living, growing multiplayer fantasy world where you can fight dragons, build anything, and explore epic storylines — all alongside friends!
AQ3D is the cross-platform MMORPG with weekly updates, wild customization, no pay-to-win, and endless ways to play.

NEW: SANDBOX HOUSING IS HERE

Build anything you can imagine. Sandbox housing lets you:

• Place, rotate, scale, and stack items freely
• Build castles, obstacle courses, theme parks — even flying sofas
• Create personal hangouts or insane parkour challenges for friends
• It’s chaotic, creative, and completely physics-free

No blueprints. No limits. Just imagination (and probably dragons).

CREATE YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY

• Customize your character’s look and gear with over 7,000 items
• Equip any item for power or style (transmog included)
• Change classes anytime: warrior, mage, rogue, ninja, necromancer & more
• Morph into 200+ travel forms: dragons, ghosts, birds, wolves, even bushes
• Ride on our newest Mounts for fast-travel and fierce looks

Be yourself. Or something much weirder. No judgement!

FIGHT, RAID, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER

• 5-player dungeons and 20-player raids
• Open-world bosses and seasonal scaled maps
• 5v5 PvP battlegrounds and challenge fights
• Epic loot, legendary weapons, and fashionably questionable outfits await

Whether soloing in the shadows, leading your guild into battle, or climbing the ranks in PvP, there’s always a fight to win… or flee from heroically.

TRULY CROSS-PLATFORM

• One account, one world — all devices log into the same universe
• Cloud save, real-time co-op, and zero platform restrictions
• Doesn’t hog space (download size under 250MB)

Take the full MMO experience from phone to desktop and back again without missing a beat.

WEEKLY EVENTS & FREE CONTENT

We never stop updating. Expect:

• New quests, items, and gear every week
• Special events and rotating challenge content
• Player suggested updates, weird experiments, and community surprises

From Trobblemania to Mogloween, there’s always something weird happening in AQ3D.

OLD SCHOOL SOUL. MODERN DAY CHAOS.

From the creators of AdventureQuest, DragonFable, and AQWorlds comes a full 3D reimagining of the browser MMOs you loved growing up.

• Return to iconic zones like Battleon, Darkovia, Ashfall, and Doomwood
• Meet familiar NPCs (Artix, Cysero, Warlic, etc.)
• Battle classic monsters like Zards, Slimes, and dragons too big to fit on the screen
• Experience all-new story arcs built around community feedback

This is the game you would’ve skipped homework for — now rebuilt with better graphics, more memes, and way more explosives.

FAIR, FUN, AND FREE

• No pay-to-win, ever
• Free to play, forever
• Optional cosmetics, travel forms, mounts, and supporter packs
• Earn gear the old school way: by playing — not paying

We believe in rewarding effort, not credit cards.

CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE

Play how you want:

• Story-driven main quests 
• Sandbox housing chaos
• Team up or try to solo everything
• Fish, dance, roleplay, craft, build, or just explore
• Scaled seasonal content makes things fun for any level

Whether you’re a casual player or hardcore gamer, AQ3D adapts to your pace.

Over 10 million heroes created. 100% dragon-approved.

Download AdventureQuest 3D now and start your next great MMO adventure – for FREE.

Battle on!

www.AQ3D.com

Board Battles – Strategy Meets Action in This Tactical Idle PvP Experience!
Board Battles is a thrilling 3D strategy game where your tactical skills and team-building instincts are put to the ultimate test. Merge, equip, and position your heroes wisely to dominate enemies in epic idle PvP battles. Whether you're a fan of auto chess, team management, or grid-based combat, this game offers a fresh and rewarding twist on strategic gameplay.

Core Gameplay
Start your expedition by assembling a powerful squad of heroes. Engage in tactical battles against real player boards recorded from past games, test your formation, and adapt your strategy. Conquer each expedition, unlock valuable rewards, and upgrade your heroes to prepare for even tougher battles ahead.

Strategic Features
Merge Heroes: Combine two heroes of the same level and type to create stronger versions and dominate the battlefield.

Equip Items: Drag and drop items onto heroes to boost their stats and gain the edge in battle.

Positional Synergy: Strategic placement is key! Position your heroes to activate powerful positional buffs and gain tactical advantages.

Idle PvP Battles: Face off against real player teams—even while you're offline. Battle pre-recorded boards and prove your strategy is superior.

Chest Rewards: Complete expeditions to open chests filled with new heroes, upgrade materials, and rare items.

Progress and Customize
Build your roster from a growing list of unique heroes. Each expedition brings chances to unlock new characters and level up your favorites. Mix and match heroes, gear, and formations to discover unbeatable combinations.

Stylized 3D Visuals
Enjoy a clean and vibrant low poly cartoon aesthetic that keeps gameplay readable, fun, and visually engaging—perfect for players who love casual yet deep tactical experiences.

Who’s It For?
Fans of auto chess and tactical RPGs.

Players who love team management and upgrade systems.

Gamers looking for a strategy-rich, bite-sized experience they can return to throughout the day.

What Makes Board Battles Unique?
Unlike other strategy games, Board Battles fuses strategic placement mechanics with item-based stat building, allowing for deeply customized team builds. Every move—from who you merge, where you place them, and what gear you assign—can make the difference between victory and defeat.

Quick Play Guide

- Start Simple: Tap a car to collect it, and match three cars of the same color in your holder to clear them from the board.
- Think Ahead: Collect cars only if they have at least one open side. Plan to avoid filling your holder and strategically match the cars.
- Embrace Complexity: With each level, matching and collecting cars require more thought. Every move is crucial.
- Utilize Boosters: Stuck? Use 'Undo' to reverse moves, 'Shuffle' to rearrange the cars, 'Super Undo' to save cars for later, or 'Magnet' to make matching easier.

- Exciting Levels: Each stage brings a fresh challenge of car matching and fun.
- Powerful Boosters: Boosters make your car-matching quest smoother and more enjoyable.
- Vivid Graphics: Bright and colorful cars make every move a delight, turning matching into a visual treat.
- Rewards & Surprises: Earn rewards and discover surprises to power through puzzles, adding a layer of strategy to your matching.
- Challenging Obstacles: Overcome tunnels, boxes, walls, and elevators for an extra thrill.

Why Play Car Match?

- Sharpen Your Mind: Each puzzle is a fun test of strategy and wit, blending elements of car matching into each challenge.
- Relaxing Fun: Dive into a soothing, colorful escape, where matching cars provides a relaxing experience.
- Adventure at Every Turn: New challenges and surprises make every level an exciting adventure in car matching and puzzle-solving.

A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a debt simulator!

Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.

P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

it.name: Dead Cells
it.d:
Death is not the end.

Play as a failed alchemic experiment and explore the sprawling, ever-changing castle to find out what happened on this gloomy island…! 
That is, assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers.

Dead Cells is a roguevania action platformer that will require you to master frantic 2D combat with a wide variety of weapons and skills against merciless minions and boss.

Kill. Die. Learn. Repeat.

First available on PC and consoles, the indie hit Dead Cells is now slaying foes on mobile!

Main Features
• Roguevania: The progressive exploration of an interconnected world, with the replayability of a rogue-lite and the adrenaline-pumping threat of permadeath

• Frantic and Dynamic 2D Action: Learn your enemies’ patterns to stay alive, or prepare to be sent back to your cell before you can say “baguette”

• Nonlinear Progression: Unlock new levels with every death, opt for the path that suits your current build, your playstyle or just your mood. 
Surely, the ramparts can’t be as bad as the sewers, right?

• Play at your own pace: Will you explore every nook and cranny of the castle, or rush to the end?

*Latest updates are available: Clean Cut & The End is Near*

RETURN TO CASTLEVANIA DLC
Time for some vampire slaying
• New storyline - overcome the Ruler of Darkness alongside Alucard and Richter Belmont,
• 2 new biomes - Explore Dracula's Castle and its outskirts
• 9 new monsters - Werewolves, haunted armors, and medusas are waiting for you
• 14 new weapons - wield the Vampire Killer or the Holy Water to defeat creatures of the night,
• 3 new bosses - go fangs to fangs against Death and Dracula himself
• 20 new outfits - dress as your favorite Castlevania characters such as Simon and Richter Belmont or Alucard
• Alternative soundtracks - play along 51 Castlevania original tracks and 12 tunes reimagined in the style of Dead Cells

THE BAD SEED DLC
You reap what you sow
• New levels to lose your head in the not-so-peaceful Dilapidated Arboretum and the noxious Morass of the Banished
• New monsters to rip to pieces: get to know the locals, such as the Jerkshroom and the Yeeter
• New weapons to play with: trim sticking-out heads with the Scythe Claw, or make them dance to the sound of the Rhythm n' Bouzouki
• New boss to fight against: Mama Tick is dying to meet you

FATAL FALLS DLC
Ready for a leap of faith?
• 3 new biomes - Get some fresh air at the Fractured Shrines, splash around at the Undying Shores and take a picture at the Mausoleum
• 8 new monsters - The Cold Blooded Guardians and their friends would love to teach you about their culture. ... Wait, aren't those relatives of yours in the Undying Shores...?
• 7 new weapons - Lil' Serenade is perfect for breaking the ice with the locals, although the Snake Fangs would make for a perfect souvenir...
• 1 new boss - The Scarecrow is very proud of his gardening skills and won't hesitate to show off


QUEEN AND THE SEA  DLC
Take it to the sea!
• 2 new biomes - Battle your way through a rotten shipwreck, or scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet.
• 9 new weapons, including a throwable shark, a trident and a pirate hook hand (eyepatch not included). 
• 2 new bosses - Don't lose your head before you meet the Queen!

This DLC also gives you the usual extras: 
- A not-so-cute pet. 
- Loads of new outfits. 
- New enemies to bash.

WARNING: Devices with less than 2 Gb of RAM may not be able to run this content correctly. We recommend not to take this DLC if your device is under 2gb of RAM.


Carefully redesigned for mobile with a revamped interface
• Two game modes available: Original & Auto-Hit

• Custom controls & More touch controls options available: Change the buttons’ position and size to your liking, swipe to dodge…

• MFi external controller support

• No ads, no F2P mechanics!

If you run into a problem, please contact us at support@playdigious.mail.helpshift.com
 with as much information as possible on the issue.

it.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links
it.d:
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is available on-the-go as a mobile app!


Become the best Duelist in the world!
Anywhere, anytime! Prepare yourself for some sweet Duels!

[ABOUT "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links"]
-Easy to learn rules and simple controls for beginners!
-Don't worry if you are not sure how to use your cards. The game will indicate when you can activate your cards!
-Among 3 million players who have participated in the past World Championships, even Duelists with only 3-6 months of Duel Links experience have also became a champion.
Duel online and aim for the top of "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links"!

[FEATURES]
・Supporting features for beginners
-Even beginners can hone their skill by completing the in-game missions.
-You can learn the basics of cards and Duel techniques from various features.

・Beginner's Guide
-Duel Quizzes: You can learn the basic rules from quizzes and you can even receive Gems by completing them!
-Auto-Build Deck: Don't worry even if you have no idea how to build a Deck. Include cards you want to use, and the rest of the Deck will be built to synergize with those cards!
-Auto-Duel: Use this feature if you are not sure how to play with your Deck.
-Ranked Duels: This is a PvP mode, but don't worry! You will get matched with Duelists who are close to you in skill!
-Tons of Rewards: You can get a lot of Gems and Card Exchange Tickets in the early stage of the game!

・Offline Battles
-Duel with your favorite characters from the Yu-Gi-Oh! World
-Complete Stage missions to get various items
-Shop for cards in the game store!

・Various "Yu-Gi-Oh!" characters and monsters from the series
-Duel as Yami Yugi, Seto Kaiba, Jaden Yuki, Yusei Fudo, Yuma Tsukumo, Yuya Sakaki, Playmaker, Yuga Ohdo, Yudias Velgear and many more, from the whole canon!
-Featuring voicework from cast members of the original shows!
-You can play as them by completing certain missions!
-Epic 3D cutscenes when ace monsters are Summoned!
-Build your Deck to become the most powerful Dueling Master, with monsters like "Dark Magician" and "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"


・Online Multiplayer Battles
-Battle other Duelists and their special battle Decks
-PVP battles pit you against players from around the world! 


・Editing a Deck
-Collect cards and form the most powerful Deck for battle! Stay tuned for future card additions!
-Use the cards that you collect in-game to build and edit your trusty Deck to take on opponents!


・Characters
-"Yu-Gi-Oh!": Yami Yugi, Seto Kaiba, Joey Wheeler, Yami Marik, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! THE DARK SIDE OF DIMENSIONS": Aigami, Sera, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! GX": Jaden Yuki, Chazz Princeton, Zane Truesdale, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's": Yusei Fudo, Jack Atlas, Kalin Kessler, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL": Yuma Tsukumo and Astral, Tori Meadows, Bronk Stone, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V": Yuya Sakaki, Zuzu Boyle, Gong Strong, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS": Playmaker and Ai, Soulburner, The Gore, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS": Yuga Ohdo, Lucidien "Luke" Kallister, Gavin Sogetsu, Romin Kassidy, and so on
-"Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!!": Yudias Velgear, Ohdo Yuhi, Ohdo Yuamu, and so on

[ABOUT "Yu-Gi-Oh!"]
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that has been serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on the "Yu-Gi-Oh!" anime series created from the original manga, that are enjoyed around the world.

- Build a team strategy and conquer the Guild Dungeon together!

it.name: Furry Evo
it.d:
How to Play Furry Evo

- Run and collect: Dash through dynamic maps as you collect fellow furry warriors to join your team. The more allies you gather, the stronger you become!
- Get Reward: Earn coins, power-ups, and mystical artifacts as you play. These treasures help you level up your characters and unlock new features.
- Upgrade and Evolve: Strengthen your furry hero by upgrading abilities, unlocking gear, and customizing your look. Boost your power to face tougher challenges ahead.
- Choose Your Weapon: Select different arms to help you clear obstacles.
- Break Through to Victory: Dodge traps, break through barriers, and open the legendary golden door at the end of each level to claim your victory and advance to the next magical realm.

What Makes Furry Evo Special

Furry Evo stands out with a mix of colorful design, smooth gameplay, and immersive soundscapes that make every run feel epic!

- A Stunning Cast of Creatures: Each world introduces a new lineup of beautifully designed furry characters. From fluffy foxes to watery turtle warriors, every creature has its own charm and personality.
- Immersive Sound Design: Satisfying sound effects and vibrant background music accompany you on every level, adding to the immersive experience. Each world comes with its own custom soundtrack to match the mood and environment.
- Progressive Difficulty: As you move through the magical lands, the game grows more challenging. Quick reflexes and clever thinking become more important the farther you go. Are you up for the challenge?

Explore the Magical Lands

The world of Furry Evo is vast and filled with wonder. Each realm has its own unique theme, hazards, and surprises waiting around every corner:

- Fire Land – Step into a scorched, volcanic world bursting with lava flows, burning bridges, and fierce enemies. It’s hot, dangerous, and full of mythical power.
- Electric Land – Enter a dazzling, high-voltage environment where glowing lights and buzzing energy surround you.
- Grass Land – A peaceful yet tricky jungle. Don’t let the beauty fool you—nature can be wild!
- Water Land – Dive into an underwater world full of shimmering blues and mysterious sea creatures.
And Many More! – Discover secret realms as you progress. Each new land introduces different mechanics and exciting new visuals that keep the gameplay fresh and unpredictable.

Fun for Everyone

Furry Evo is designed for players of all ages and skill levels. Whether you're playing solo during a quick break or challenging your friends to beat your high score, the game is accessible, engaging, and endlessly replayable.

Ready to Run?

The adventure of a lifetime is just a tap away. Lace up your shoes, rally your furry troops, and start your journey through dazzling lands and daring challenges. With every golden door you open, new surprises, stronger enemies, and cooler upgrades await.

Whether you’re collecting coins, dodging traps, or unlocking rare companions, Furry Evo delivers nonstop action and magical fun in every level.

So what are you waiting for?  
Join the adventure. Run to win. And show the world what you're made of in Furry Evo!

it.name: Grand Mountain Adventure 2
it.d:
Best Mobile Game of the Year - Swedish Game Awards 2025
Best Sports Game of the Year - Pocket Gamer Awards 2025

Strap in and drop in. Grab your skis or snowboard and explore massive open-world mountains. With no ads, and no microtransactions. The ultimate skiing and snowboarding adventure, from a series played by over 30 million players worldwide.

MASSIVE EXTREME SPORT PLAYGROUND
Explore non-linear ski resorts with busy slopes, deep forests, steep cliffs, untouched backcountry, and lively Après-Skis. Follow the pistes, ride the lifts, hit the snow park, or freeride down a steep chute. The choice is yours in this winter sports paradise. 

HUNDREDS OF CHALLENGES
Slalom, big air, slopestyle, downhill racing, freeride, ski jumping, and much more. The skill-based challenges are easy to pick up, but hard to master, with the legendary Double-Diamond difficulty waiting for true pros.

GO BIG. GET CREATIVE.
Snowparks, massive kickers, and off-piste cliffs are your freestyle playground. Chain tricks and combos off trees, rails, and boxes. Throw corks and rodeos. Nail nose and tail presses for massive multipliers and climb the global leaderboard.

MORE THAN JUST SKIING
Take a breather and try paragliding, ziplining, longboarding, wakeboarding, speed skiing, or Après-Ski dancing (obviously). Some trials even transform the game into a 2D platformer or a top-down ski adventure.

REALISTIC SKIING SIMULATOR
Ride through deep powder, brave avalanches, and dodge rock falls. The dynamic conditions keep the mountains alive and immersive.

ZEN MODE
Want to just... ski? Turn on Zen Mode for a crowd-free, challenge-free, purely peaceful ride. Just you and the mountain.

UPGRADE YOUR GEAR
Unlock new skis, snowboards, and outfits as you progress. Look great shredding, or at the Après Ski.

FAIR PLAY
No ads. No microtransactions.
Your first mountain is free, then a single purchase to unlock everything. Play it online or fully offline. Full controller support, intuitive touch controls, minimal loading times and zero distractions keep the skiing experience clean and seamless.

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
Compete in the global leaderboards, challenge your friends via Game Center, or join our friendly Discord to find weekly challenges, post your best runs and get tips.

ABOUT TOPPLUVA
Grand Mountain Adventure is made by three snowboarding brothers from Stockholm, Sweden. Built with a genuine love for the mountains, and a relentless drive to make the most fun winter sports game ever. Praise the pow!

Race against friends in the premier multiplayer car game! Drive across treacherous hills, deserts, and snowfields while unlocking powerful racing cars, monster trucks, and bikes. Upgrade your engine, tune performance systems, and master realistic physics in one of the world's top online car racing games.

Multiplayer Car Racing & Online PvP
Challenge players globally in real-time multiplayer car races. Climb Trophy Road, compete in ranked cups, join a racing team, and dominate global leaderboards in high-speed multiplayer racing events.

Unlock, Upgrade & Customize Racing Cars
Build your garage with top-tier racing cars, off-road 4x4s, and sports cars:

Create & Share Custom Racing Tracks

Design custom tracks using the built-in Track Editor. Build extreme obstacles, crazy stunt jumps, and unique car racing challenges, then share your tracks with a global multiplayer car game community of millions.

Classic Offroad Car Driving & Adventure Mode

Experience the legendary endless car driving mode that made the original Hill Climb Racing famous! Navigate extreme offroad terrain, perform gravity-defying stunts, collect coins, and master physics-based car driving.

Live Racing Events & Weekly Car Challenges

Participate in competitive multiplayer racing events, seasonal activities, and weekly car racing challenges. Win exclusive rewards, rare vehicle blueprints, and custom car customization parts.

Core Game Features

* Physics-Based Car Racing — Master realistic, chaotic, and hilarious car driving physics.
* Online Multiplayer Racing — Battle players worldwide in multiplayer car races.
* Car Upgrades & Customization — Deep performance tuning, cosmetic skins, Vehicle Mastery, and Mythic Tuning Parts for all racing cars.
* Track Editor & Community Content — Build, share, and play community-created car racing tracks.
* Team Events & Leaderboards — Team up with friends and climb competitive online racing leaderboards.
* Regular Game Updates — New racing cars, maps, cups, and online car game events added regularly.

Download Hill Climb Racing 2 today to join millions of players in the ultimate multiplayer car racing game!

Lava Survival – Strategy Base-Building in a Burning World
Welcome to Lava Survival, the next-gen strategy survival game where fire, lava, and chaos have replaced the ice and cold. After the earth is consumed by volcanic eruptions and molten rivers, only the smartest and strongest leaders will survive. Build your base, train your troops, and fight for dominance in a world scorched by fire.

A powerful alternative to games like other Survival games, Lava Survival challenges you to adapt, expand, and conquer — not in the snow, but in a lava-covered post-apocalyptic world.

Build and Protect Your Lava Base:
Survival base building game set in a fiery wasteland
Construct shelters, lava barriers, watchtowers, and tech centers
Upgrade buildings to produce more resources and defend against enemies
Unlock advanced lava-resistant structures and gear

Real-Time Strategy (RTS) Meets Survival:
RTS gameplay with tactical decision-making and resource management
Train heroes and troops with fireproof abilities and elite gear
Launch real-time attacks on enemy bases and defend your territory
Battle for scarce resources and claim lava zones before rivals do

Survive the Burning Earth:
Unlike snow survival games, heat is your biggest enemy
Handle temperature management, firestorms, volcanic tremors, and lava floods
Collect fire-resistant materials and fuel to keep your base running
Maintain your population’s morale, energy, and hydration in extreme conditions

PvP, Alliances, and Global Strategy:
Multiplayer survival warfare with live PvP raids and base defense
Join powerful alliances to conquer the lava map together
Participate in large-scale alliance wars and seasonal events
Chat, trade, and cooperate with real players from around the world

Deep Tech Tree and Customization:
Research lava energy, fire weapons, advanced machinery, and more
Customize your heroes with rare equipment and upgrade skills
Adapt your playstyle with strategic tech builds and troop combinations

Why Lava Survival?
If you enjoy mobile strategy games, base-building survival, and PvP battle games Lava Survival offers a unique twist with its lava-themed survival setting, aggressive warfare, and high replayability.

Can You Lead in the Heat?
The ice has melted. The world is burning.
Only the most strategic survivors will thrive.

Download Lava Survival now and dominate the fire age!

it.name: Mindustry

Mindustry is a factory-building game with tower defense and RTS elements. Create elaborate supply chains to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and construct units. Command units to capture enemy bases, and expand your production. Defend your core from waves of enemies.

- Defend your structures from waves of enemies
- Play with your friends in cross-platform multiplayer co-op games, or challenge them in team-based PvP matches
- Distribute liquids and fight constant challenges, like outbreaks of fire or enemy flier raids
- Get the most out of your production by supplying optional coolant and lubricant
- Produce a wide variety of units for automatic management of your base or assault on enemy bases
- Set up assembly lines to construct armies of mechanized units
- Use your units to square up against fully functional enemy bases


Campaign:

- Conquer the planets Serpulo and Erekir as you advance through 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedurally generated sectors
- Capture territory and set up factories to produce resources while you play other sectors
- Defend your sectors from periodic invasions
- Coordinate resource distribution between sectors via launch pads
- Research new blocks to fuel progress
- Invite your friends to complete missions together
- 250+ technology blocks to master
- 50+ different types of drones, mechs and ships


Custom Games & Cross-Platform Multiplayer:

- 16+ built in maps for custom games, in addition to two entire campaigns
- Play co-op, PvP or sandbox
- Join a public dedicated server, or invite friends to your own private session
- Customizable game rules: Change block costs, enemy stats, starting items, wave timing and more
- Full functional map editor with scripting support

Step into Mini Kitchen Chef, the ultimate casual cooking simulation game featuring frying, baking, and sushi making. Perfect for cooking game enthusiasts, this addictive time-management game offers engaging gameplay with intuitive cooking mechanics, restaurant management challenges, and immersive casual simulation elements.

Master Your Cooking Skills
Begin your culinary journey by slicing tomatoes, frying meat, boiling pasta, and quickly progress to advanced tasks. Expand your restaurant empire by unlocking diverse kitchen types, including a fully equipped Sushi Kitchen. Prepare authentic sushi dishes using premium ingredients like salmon, tuna, avocado, seaweed, rice, and more. Become a culinary master by experimenting with cooking techniques such as grilling, baking, boiling, frying, and crafting visually appealing dishes.

Cook Delicious Recipes
Combine a vast array of ingredients to fulfill customer orders. Bake savory dishes, fry crispy snacks, and roll perfect sushi. Manage your inventory wisely to meet the demands of hungry customers. Unlock many recipes to enhance customer satisfaction and showcase your culinary creativity.

Engaging Mini-Games & Cooking Challenges

These minigames provide extra opportunities to earn rewards to upgrade your kitchen and keep your gameplay experience fresh and engaging.

Fast-Paced Time Management Gameplay
Efficiently manage your cooking tasks, ingredient preparation, and restaurant management to quickly fulfill customer orders. Keep your customers satisfied by preventing food from burning and serving meals promptly. Progress through increasingly challenging levels, each designed to test your time-management abilities, strategic planning, and quick thinking.

Why Play Mini Kitchen Chef?

-Addictive casual gameplay perfect for fans of cooking and restaurant games.

-Colorful, vibrant 2D graphics appealing to players of all ages.

Earn stars by successfully completing levels and invest them in kitchen upgrades. Unlock powerful kitchen equipment, new utensils, fresh ingredients, and tasty recipes. Customize and expand your cooking spaces to optimize your kitchen’s efficiency and become the ultimate chef in your virtual restaurant.

Monster Legends is a free-to-play monster collection and strategy RPG where you breed, evolve, and battle with over 900 unique monsters. 

Build your own monster island, grow your roster with new species every week, and compete against players from around the world in real-time PvP battles. 

Monster Legends is the monster collection and strategy RPG for players who love building the perfect team, mastering deep progression systems, and competing at the highest level. 

Monster Legends offers one of the deepest and most rewarding experiences in the genre with a constantly expanding universe and a thriving competitive scene.

Pick your monsters, master their elements, and build a team capable of taking on anything. Every monster has a unique set of skills, elemental strengths, and strategic role, attacker, tank, or control, making team composition as important as individual power. 

The more you play, the deeper the strategy gets.

MONSTER LEGENDS FEATURES:

== Collect & Breed Monsters ==

• Collect over 900 monsters across multiple elements and rarities, from common creatures to ultra-rare mythic legends with game-changing abilities 
• Breed monsters of different elements and rarities to create entirely new species that only exist in your collection 
• New monsters are released every week through limited-time events, seasonal content, and special collaborations, the roster never stops growing 
• Hunt for exclusive legendary monsters through dungeons, PvP rewards, and time-limited events that keep every week feeling different

== Deep RPG Progression & Strategy ==
• Evolve your monsters through multiple tiers and rank them up in the Monster Lab to unlock their full combat potential 
• Fine-tune your team's power with Runes, Relics, Beasts, and Talents — a layered progression system that rewards strategic thinking and long-term planning 
• Build battle teams around attacker, tank, and control roles, and master elemental strengths and weaknesses to counter any opponent 
• With hundreds of possible team combinations, no two Monster Masters play exactly the same way

== Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Battles ==
• Challenge real players in Live Duels, fast-paced, real-time PvP battles that put your strategy and team composition to the ultimate test 
• Climb through competitive Leagues in Multiplayer Mode, earning trophies and exclusive high-tier rewards as you rise through the global rankings 
• Fight through the Era Saga Dungeons to uncover the full lore and story of Monster Legends and its legendary inhabitants

== Build & Expand Your Monster Island ==
• Design and expand your own monster island with Habitats, Farms, a Breeding Mountain, and key facilities like the Monster Lab and the Library 
• Each habitat is tied to a specific monster element, build and organize your island around your collection and battle strategy

== Team Up & Dominate Together ==
• Join a Team to unlock exclusive cooperative events including Wars and Marathons, where coordinated strategy makes all the difference 
• Use the Team Chat to plan battle formations, share monster builds, and build a competitive edge with your teammates
• The most dedicated Monster Masters climb global leaderboards and earn rewards that solo players simply can't access

Are you skillful enough to become the #1 Monster Master in the world?

it.name: My Perfect Hotel
it.d:
► A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED

Ever dreamed of running your own hotel? Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication to hospitality. Show your skills as a hotel manager, invest wisely in staff and property improvements, and work your socks off to become a hospitality tycoon in this addictive and entertaining casual simulator.

► FIRST-CLASS SERVICE

• Climb to the top: Start the game as a simple bellhop single-handedly cleaning rooms, greeting guests at reception, collecting payments and tips, and keeping the bathroom stocked with toilet paper. As your bank balance expands, upgrade rooms and facilities, and employ new staff to help keep up with the growing demand at your hotel. Your guests may be sleeping comfortably, but there’s no time to rest for a determined hotel tycoon.

• Build an empire: There are several hotels to explore and expand, each with dozens of different unique upgrades to make before you reach five-star perfection. Demonstrate your competence as a manager in each location, then get promoted to get a new and bigger property, and continue your path to becoming a true hotel tycoon. Each hotel has its own style and atmosphere too.

• Keep going: If you want success in this high-stakes industry, you can’t just stroll around your property at a leisurely pace. Upgrade your and your employees’ movement speed to work faster and provide your guests with all the services they need ASAP — it’ll boost your revenue too.

• Amenities are the answer: Maximise profits and get more funds to invest in this fun simulator by ensuring your hotels have all available amenities. Bathrooms are the first step, but work hard and you’ll soon have the opportunity to add vending machines, restaurants, parking lots, and swimming pools to your properties. Guests will pay extra for each facility, boosting your revenue. Though remember each facility also needs staffing, so get hiring or you’ll soon run off your feet with angry guests left standing in line for each amenity.

• Grand designs: Upgrade accommodation to improve guests’ experience of your property and choose from a range of different room designs in each location. In this engaging simulator, you’re not just a manager, you’re an interior designer too!

► FIVE-STAR FUN

Looking for a time-management game that’s original and simple to play and provides endless hours of entertainment? Dive straight into the fast-paced world of hospitality provision and develop your skills as a manager, investor, and designer. Download Hotel Master now and get to work building an accommodation empire.

it.name: Papa's Cluckeria To Go!
it.d:
Craft tasty chicken sandwiches and swirled slushes in Papa's Cluckeria To Go!

-- ABOUT THE GAME --

The Chicken Sandwich Wars have begun!  When Papa Louie opens the first chicken sandwich restaurant in Oilseed Springs, rival chefs suddenly appear in town to give Papa Louie some competition!  You'll be in charge of running Papa's Cluckeria, where you'll bread, batter, and fry foods to craft a variety of different sandwiches.  Pile the sandwiches high with toppings and sauces, and create refreshing swirled slushes to serve your picky customers.  Work your way through the holidays as you serve seasonal sandwiches and slushes, unlock new ingredients, and earn Daily Specials with delicious sandwich recipes -- and try to outlast your competition!

-- GAME FEATURES --

BREAD, BATTER, AND FRY - Coat the chicken with a variety of breading and batter options, then drop the chicken into the fryer to cook it to perfection!  Papa Louie needs to get an edge on his competition, so over time he may start introducing other foods to fry besides chicken!

STACKING SANDWICHES - Choose from an assortment of buns, and craft a delicious sandwich piled high with fried meats, cheeses, toppings, and sauces.

SWIRLED SLUSHES - Customers will order a refreshing swirled slush to drink along with their sandwich.  Add the ice and flavor syrups to the cup, and wait for the Slush Machine to blend the flavors together for a vibrant and tasty treat!

HOLIDAY FLAVORS - As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in Oilseed Springs will change, and your customers will start ordering holiday-themed meals!  You'll unlock new slush flavors, buns, toppings, and sauces for each holiday of the year, and your customers will love trying these new festive flavors!

SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Cluckeria!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each special to earn a special prize!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKERS - Play as Wylan B or Olivia, or create your own custom character to work in the restaurant!  You can also show off your holiday spirit with a massive variety of holiday outfits and clothing for your workers.  Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!

SPECIAL DELIVERY - Some customers don't want to travel all the way to Oilseed Springs for their sandwiches.  When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their order, and you'll hire a Driver to help take and deliver orders to their homes instead!

FOOD TRUCK FUN - After you hire a Driver, you can send them out in a Food Truck between days to serve whatever you like!  Use your imagination to create your own unique sandwiches, then serve them from the Food Truck and see who shows up to try them.  You can even mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for creative combinations!

COLLECT STICKERS - Complete a variety of tasks and achievements while playing to earn colorful Stickers for your collection.  Each customer has a set of three favorite Stickers: Earn all three and you'll be rewarded with a brand-new outfit to give to that customer!

AND MUCH MORE - Decorate the lobby with themed holiday furniture, send coupons to your customers to persuade them to visit the restaurant, and play Foodini's Mini-Games after each workday to earn new furniture and clothing!

-- MORE FEATURES --

- Hands-on chicken sandwich shop in the Papa Louie universe
- Multi-task between frying foods, stacking sandwiches, and crafting slushes
- Custom chefs and drivers
- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients
- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes
- 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks
- 141 customers to serve with unique orders
- Use Stickers to unlock new outfits for your customers
- 149 ingredients to unlock
