it.name: Papa's Donuteria To Go!
it.d:
Fry and serve delicious donuts in Papa's Donuteria To Go!

-- ABOUT THE GAME --

You just got a new job at Papa's Donuteria in the whimsical town of Powder Point!  The pay and benefits are nice, but you took the job for that coveted Line-Jump Pass for the amusement park right outside the shop.  It's not all fun and games though: Now you also have to cook delicious donuts every day for all of the crazy customers in this carnival-like town.

You'll need to prepare donuts using a variety of doughs and shapes, then toss them in the fryer and cook both sides until they're just right.  Finish the delicious donuts with tasty fillings, icing, and toppings before serving them to your hungry customers.  First-time visitors may just order one donut to try, but repeat customers can't get enough and will start ordering more donuts when they visit!  Powder Point also celebrates different holidays year-round, so get ready to unlock new festive ingredients as you play through the holidays!

-- GAME FEATURES --

NEW FEATURES - All of your favorite features from other versions of Papa's restaurants are now available in this "To Go" game, redesigned and reimagined for smaller screens!

HOLIDAY FLAVORS - Celebrate the seasons in Powder Point with delicious holiday flavors!  Your customers will order donuts with a dizzying array of seasonal ingredients.  You'll unlock new donut shapes, fillings, icing, drizzles, and toppings for each holiday of the year, and your customers will love trying new tasty flavors.

SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Donuteria!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each special to earn a special prize!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKERS - Play as Tony or Scooter, or create your own custom character to work in the donut shop!  You can also show off your holiday spirit with a massive variety of holiday outfits and clothing for your workers.  Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!

SPECIAL DELIVERY - Some customers don't want to come all the way to the amusement park to get their donut fix!  When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their donut order, and you'll hire a Driver to help take and deliver orders to their homes instead!

COLLECT STICKERS - Complete a variety of tasks and achievements while playing to earn colorful Stickers for your collection.  Each customer has a set of three favorite Stickers: Earn all three and you'll be rewarded with a brand-new outfit to give to that customer!

DECORATE THE SHOP - Customize the Donuteria lobby with themed furniture and decorations for each holiday of the year!  Mix and match your favorite styles, or add items that match the current holiday so customers won't mind waiting longer for their food.

CLIPPING COUPONS - Missing your favorite customer?  Send them a coupon with the help of your friendly mailman, Vincent!  Customers love a good deal, and will promptly arrive to order another meal.  Coupons are great for completing quests for Stickers and for strategically leveling up customers!

DAILY MINI-GAMES - Play Foodini's famous Mini-Games after each workday to earn new furniture for your lobby and new clothing for your workers.

-- MORE FEATURES --

- Hands-on donut shop in the Papa Louie universe
- All new controls and gameplay features designed for touchscreens
- Multi-task between preparing, frying, filling, and topping
- Custom chefs and drivers
- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients
- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes
- 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks
- 121 customers to serve with unique orders
- Use Stickers to unlock new outfits for your customers
- 117 ingredients to unlock

it.name: Papa's Pancakeria To Go!
it.d:
Serve breakfast on the go in Papa's Pancakeria To Go!

-- ABOUT THE GAME --

While hunting for your lost pet, you suddenly get a call from Papa Louie with some good news:  Your pet was found at Papa's Pancakeria in Maple Mountain, and since your pet likes the restaurant so much, Papa Louie decided to let you run the Pancakeria while he's away!  

You'll be busy multitasking as your customers order fluffy pancakes, golden waffles, warm french toast, and delicious drinks through all seasons of the year.  Pour batter onto the griddle, add mixables to the batter, and keep checking back to flip the flapjacks halfway through.  Stack their plates high with pancakes, syrups, and toppings that change with each holiday.  Add a hot mug of coffee or a refreshing glass of juice to complete the breakfast, and serve the food to your hungry customers.  Customers can also place orders by phone, so hire a driver to deliver a hot breakfast right to their doors!

NEW FEATURES - All of your favorite features from other versions of Papa's restaurants are now available in this "To Go" game, redesigned and reimagined for smaller screens!

HOLIDAY FLAVORS - Celebrate the seasons with new holiday flavors!  As the seasons change in Maple Mountain, your customers will order their pancakes, waffles, and french toast with new seasonal ingredients.  You'll unlock new syrups, toppings, and drinks for each holiday of the year, and your customers will love trying new flavors for a festive breakfast.

SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Pancakeria!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each special to earn a special prize!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKERS AND PET - Play as Cooper hunting for his lost cat Cookie, or Prudence with her lovable dog Pickle -- or create your own custom character along with your own pet!  You can also show off your holiday spirit with a massive variety of holiday outfits and clothing for your workers.  Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!

SPECIAL DELIVERY - When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their breakfast order, and you'll hire a Driver to help you take and deliver orders to their homes!

COLLECT STICKERS - Complete a variety of tasks and achievements while playing to earn colorful Stickers for your collection.  Each customer has a set of three favorite Stickers: Earn all three and you'll be rewarded with a brand-new outfit to give to that customer!

DECORATE THE SHOP - Customize the Pancakeria lobby with themed furniture and decorations for each holiday of the year!  Mix and match your favorite styles, or add items that match the current holiday so customers won't mind waiting longer for their food.

CLIPPING COUPONS - Missing your favorite customer?  Send them a coupon with the help of your friendly mailman, Vincent!  Customers love a good deal, and will promptly arrive to order another meal.  Coupons are great for completing quests for Stickers and for strategically leveling up customers!

DAILY MINI-GAMES - Play Foodini's famous Mini-Games after each workday to earn new furniture for your lobby and new clothing for your workers.

-- MORE FEATURES --

Hands-on pancake shop in the Papa Louie universe
All new controls and gameplay features designed for smaller screens
Multi-task between cooking, building, and serving drinks
Custom chefs, drivers, and PETS!
12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients
Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes
90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks
117 customers to serve with unique orders
Use Stickers to unlock new outfits for your customers
Over 75 ingredients to unlock

** NOTE FOR iPAD USERS **

Papa's Pancakeria To Go is designed especially for smaller screens, look for Papa's Pancakeria HD for tablets!

it.name: Papa's Pizzeria To Go!
it.d:
Things get messy when you’re stuck running a wildly popular pizza parlor in Papa’s Pizzeria To Go! Top, bake, and serve pizzas in this award-winning game that’s reimagined for iPhone and iPod Touch.

You'll need to multitask between each area of the pizzeria, with new controls designed to work just right in the palm of your hand.  Head to the Order Station to watch for customers waiting in the lobby.  Switch to the Topping Station to add a variety of toppings to each pizza.  Move to the Bake Station to cook the pizzas in the oven until they're baked just right.  Jump to the Cutting Station to cut the pizza into perfect slices.  Each station is a hands-on experience, where you'll need to drag, swipe, and tap your way through the pizza-building process.

Keep your customers happy to earn more points and level up.  As your level rises, you'll unlock new toppings in the shop, and new customers will start visiting the Pizzeria!  A well-crafted pizza also earns you tips, which you can spend on upgrades and decorations for the lobby!

** NEW FOR PAPA'S PIZZERIA TO GO **

Papa's Pizzeria To Go is redesigned and reimagined for smaller screens, so your fingers don't get in the way of the action!

CONTROL WITH YOUR THUMBS - You'll switch stations using buttons in the corners of the screen, perfect for your thumbs.  You can also use buttons in the top corners to quickly switch Order Tickets, and you can view all of your Order Tickets in a zoomed-in mode for easy reading.

TOPPING STATION - We've completely redesigned the Topping Station for smaller screens.  Bins of toppings can be scrolled with your thumb, which allows us to have many more toppings than in the original game.  Tap on a bin to select that topping, then tap multiple times on the pizza to add items directly onto the pizza.  You don't need to drag individual toppings onto the pizza, so you can top faster than ever!  A quick swipe on the pizza will send it off the to the Bake Station.

BAKE STATION - Papa Louie's coal-fired oven gets an upgrade!  You can buy new Oven Alarms in the Shop to help you keep track of pizzas in the oven.  Simply drag an alarm onto one of the oven timers, and you'll hear an alert when that pizza is cooked just right.  Buy new Oven Boosters to cook your pizzas even faster than before!

CUTTING STATION - When it's time to cut pizzas, simply touch and drag a line across the pizza to decide where to cut.  If you want even more control to fine-tune your slices, you can also cut using multi-touch!  Use two fingers or thumbs to move each end of the line at the same time, and release to slice your pizza.  If you're having trouble cutting pizzas at the right angle, buy a variety of Cutting Guides in the Shop to cut that perfect slice!

NEW INGREDIENTS - We've added a ton of new ingredients which can't be found in the original Papa's Pizzeria.  As you play the game, you'll unlock 26 unique ingredients to serve your customers!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR LOBBY - You can spend your hard-earned tips in the Shop, where you can find a variety of posters, furniture, and wallpaper styles for your lobby!  Use the brand-new Lobby tool to add items to your restaurant, and move and arrange them however you like!  Choose from over 140 customization items, and every item you add to the lobby will improve your Waiting Score for your customers!

UPDATED FEATURES - Serve picky closers at the end of the day, earn paychecks as you play, and try to please the finicky Food Critic to earn a Blue Ribbon!

**GAME FEATURES**

Hands-on pizza shop in the Papa Louie universe
All new controls and gameplay designed for smaller screens
Multi-task between topping, baking, and cutting
Shop to buy upgrades, furniture, and posters using your in-game tips
New Lobby Editor to customize and decorate your shop
90 customers to unlock with unique orders
Challenging Closers and Food Critic
75 in-game achievements to earn

**NOTE FOR iPAD USERS**

Papa's Pizzeria To Go is designed especially for smaller screens.

it.name: Prince of Persia: Escape 2
it.d:
It is time for a new action-packed mobile Prince of Persia adventure!

Perform death-defying jumps, avoid challenging obstacles, slay your enemies, and defeat gigantic bosses as the Prince of Persia in this energetic endless runner.

PRINCE OF PERSIA
Starring none other than the famous Prince of Persia, brace yourself for a colorful endless running saga. How far will you go? 


GRACEFUL PLATFORMING 
Jump over spike traps, slide down curtains and perform the iconic wall-run as you progress through the levels.
Explore the acrobatic skills of the Prince right at your fingertips. 


WONDERFUL WORLDS 
The Prince new adventure takes you from colorful palaces to dark caves, both on your smartphone and your tablet. 


EPIC BOSSES 
Adding to the challenge of collapsing bridges and traps, you will face off against various deadly foes blocking your path: from soldiers to gigantic, mythical bosses. 


TIME POWER 
Did you make a wrong turn or meet the pointy end of a trap? Wield the power of time and rewind it to get another run at an obstacle. 


MULTIPLE CHARACTERS 
Run and jump through this adventure using your favorite character from the Prince of Persia universe and unlock additional customization items throughout your journey. 

PLEASE NOTE Prince of PersiaTM: Escape 2 is free to play. 
Some optional in-game items can only be purchased for real money.
You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.


Subscription Terms:

The Emperor Access offers a weekly subscription, you will have a 3-days FREE trial period, after this period you will be charged $4.99. After buying this subscription, you will unlock the Legendary Dark Prince Skin, the exclusives Horn Helmet and the Mighty Sword, a free multiplier at the end of every levels and removes ads. This is an Auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal as well. The prices are established for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may change and actual charges may be converted to your local currency.

End of trial and subscription renewal: 
• The payment is charged to your account after a confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hour before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the cost of the weekly subscription. 
• The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal have to be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase in the Store.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

Canceling a trial or a subscription: 
• If you want to cancel a subscription during its free trial, you have to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT202039

THE BEST DOWN ‘N DIRTY RACER YOU EVER SAW! Made to maximize the Retina Display, the state-of-the-art visuals will make your eyes bug out as you skid, slip, and slide in traditional top-down racing style. Challenge your buddies in online multiplayer, and get ready to go. It’s the dirt-road racing game y’all been waiting for on iPhone, iPod touch & iPad!

Embark on a majestic journey with King William in "Royal Adventure," a captivating 3-Match game that takes you beyond the ordinary! Join the King in his quest to travel and explore enchanting cities while enjoying the thrill of match-three puzzles.

King William's Royal Expedition: 
Follow the charismatic King William as he travels through various cities on a quest for treasures and challenges. Explore iconic landmarks, solve puzzles, and unveil the secrets of each location in this adventure.

Match-Three Excitement: 
Immerse yourself in the classic match-three gameplay with a royal twist! Swap, match, and crush items to solve challenging puzzles. As you progress through an extensive range of levels, reaching the impressive max level of 1800+, unlock new cities and discover hidden stories across the world. At the same time, more and more levels will be added to the game.

Discover Majestic Cities: 
Visit splendid cities with King William, each offering a unique set of funny stories. From the bustling streets of Paris to the serene landscapes of Kyoto, experience the beauty and diversity of different cultures on your match-three quest.

Global Leaderboard: 
Compete with players worldwide! Climb the global leaderboard and showcase your match-three skills. Challenge friends or make new ones as you progress through the game.

Royal Rewards and Achievements: 
Earn royal rewards and unlock achievements as you successfully complete levels and explore new cities. With an extensive level, the journey is bound to be filled with royal surprises.

Play Anywhere, Anytime: 
"Royal Adventure" offers an immersive gaming experience that you can enjoy on the go. Play offline and sync your progress when connected, ensuring your royal adventure is always at your fingertips.

Embark on a regal journey with King William in "Royal Adventure" – download now and start your match-three adventure filled with puzzles, exploration, and royal charm! It's time to match and travel like royalty!

it.name: Shadow Fight 3 - RPG Fighting
it.d:
Legend has it that a hero will come to end the fight for shadow energy. He will have to learn three fighting styles, collect the best weapons and challenge the strongest warriors.
 
The world is on the edge of an epic war. The mighty force unleashed by the Gates of Shadows many years ago has turned into a weapon, and now three war clans are fighting to decide the future of this force.
 
The Legion warriors want to destroy the dangerous energy. The people of the Dynasty want to use it for their own benefit. While the mysterious ninjas of the Heralds clan explore the darkest secrets of the shadow power.
 
Three clans, three world views, and three fighting styles. Which side will you join?
 
Shadow Fight 3 - is an online RPG fighting game that continues the story of the Shadow Fight universe with new characters in 3D. Get ready for action, cool brawls with powerful fighters, and an exciting adventure around the world, where mystical forces reign.

CREATE AN EPIC HERO
Ninja, knight, or samurai? Only you can choose who your hero will be. Win unique skins in battles and customize your equipment colors to create a unique look.
 
WIN BATTLES
Explore the fighting styles of each of the 3 clans to create your personal combat style. Your hero can fight like a cunning ninja or a mighty knight. Harness shadow energy to deliver powerful and impressive blows that can change the course of the battle.
 
COMPLETE THE STORY
Warriors around the world await the appearance of a hero who will end the struggle for the power of the shadows. Influence the storyline by choosing your clan. Defeat powerful bosses to challenge your nemesis, and then explore other worlds and travel back in time to learn new details of the story.

SHOW OFF YOUR SKILL
Even when the main story battle is over, the action continues. Win duels by fighting other players' heroes controlled by AI. Brawl with the strongest warriors to take a place at the TOP-100 leaderboard and become a legend of your region!
 
COLLECT SETS
Collect your personal arsenal of weapons and armor to experiment in battles and look cool in duels. After collecting a full set of equipment, you get unique abilities to make it easier to win in a brawl.
 
PARTICIPATE IN EVENTS
Fight in regular themed events where you can win rare skins, colors, weapons, and armor. In these battles, you will face new heroes and learn a lot of interesting details about the world of Shadow Fight.
 
ENJOY THE GRAPHICS
Colorful scenery and realistic combat animations can rival the best console games.
 
JOIN THE COMMUNITY 
Follow us on social media to learn the tricks and secrets of the game from fellow players! Share the stories of your adventure, get updates and participate in competitions to win great prizes!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/shadowfightgames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ShadowFight_3
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/c/ShadowFightGames
 
KEEP FIGHTING! 
 
Note:
* Shadow Fight 3 is an online game and requires a stable internet connection
Requires iOS 11.0 or later
Compatible with iPhone 6, iPod touch 6th gen, iPad Air 2, iPad Mini 4, iPad Pro or higher

it.name: Sonic Dash Run
it.d:
Speed through epic endless runner action in Sonic Dash! Run, jump, spin, and race across stunning 3D courses with Sonic the Hedgehog and friends in SEGA’s hit fast-paced runner game. Dash through iconic zones, dodge obstacles, collect rings, and defeat powerful bosses in an adrenaline-fueled adventure packed with nonstop action, lightning-fast gameplay, and exciting events!

Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, Amy, Blaze, Silver, and many more legendary Sonic characters. Unlock new runners, upgrade your abilities, and build the ultimate team as you compete in thrilling endless races and special limited-time challenges.

Feel the rush of high-speed runner gameplay with easy controls, explosive boosts, and cinematic environments inspired by the Sonic universe. Whether you love arcade games, offline runner games, racing games, or action-packed adventures, Sonic Dash delivers endless fun for players of all ages.

Race through iconic Sonic worlds including Green Hill Zone, Sky Sanctuary, Beach Zone, and more. Sprint across high-speed tracks, dodge traps, and blast through Badniks with Sonic’s signature Spin Dash attack.

Take on epic boss battles against Dr. Eggman, Zazz, and other powerful enemies. Dodge attacks, react fast, and unleash powerful moves to earn huge rewards and dominate the leaderboards.

Join fast-paced Blitz events and special seasonal challenges to unlock exclusive characters, rewards, and powerful upgrades. Compete in daily missions, complete exciting objectives, and discover new adventures every week.

SONIC DASH FEATURES:

EPIC ENDLESS RUNNER ACTION
•	Run, race, jump, and dash at incredible speed
•	Experience smooth and fast-paced endless runner gameplay
•	Easy-to-use controls designed for quick reflexes and nonstop action
•	Collect rings, power-ups, boosters, and rewards

PLAY AS YOUR FAVORITE SONIC CHARACTERS
•	Unlock Sonic, Shadow, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, Amy, Rouge, Blaze, Silver, and more
•	Upgrade characters with unique powers and abilities
•	Discover new costumes, special variants, and rare event characters

FAST-PACED BLITZ EVENTS
•	Compete in limited-time blitz events and special challenges
•	Unlock exclusive rewards, characters, and collectibles
•	Climb leaderboards and complete daily missions

ICONIC SONIC WORLDS IN 3D
•	Race through Green Hill Zone, Sky Sanctuary, Beach Zone, and more
•	Enjoy visually stunning 3D runner environments
•	Dash through loops, corkscrews, underwater paths, and high-speed tracks

EPIC BOSS BATTLES
•	Battle Dr. Eggman, Zazz, and dangerous enemies
•	Dodge attacks and strike back with powerful Spin Dash moves
•	Earn massive rewards and high scores

MORE THAN AN ENDLESS RUNNER
•	Rescue animal friends and explore the Sonic universe
•	Customize and upgrade your experience
•	Discover fresh content, events, and surprises regularly

If you love endless runner games, racing games, fast arcade action, and Sonic adventures, Sonic Dash is the ultimate speed experience. Download now and start running!

The legendary turn-based strategy RPG with immersive storytelling — loved by over 300 million Summoners worldwide!

and build your own strategy to claim victory.

Fire, Water, Wind, Light, and Dark!

it.d:
”Submit to me, mortal. And I shall grant you power beyond belief!”



The Demonized is an action adventure idle RPG where you play as a hero, who embraces the devil's power to fight the evil forces that are threatening the world. Equip powerful gears, trade with the demons to unlock souls that grant monstrous power, fight challenging bosses, manage resources through Dominion, and take down terrifying bosses on your own or join forces with others in this great battle to save the world from demonic monsters.



■ Embark on a Grand Adventure in High Quality Pixel Art
Journey into the vast world where you'll explore and battle through forests, abandoned cities, snowy fields, underground mines, and demonic fortresses rendered in captivating pixel art graphics.



■ Unleash the Devil’s Power with Unique Builds
Choose from over 30 skills and passive traits and trade with demons to obtain incredibly powerful Souls to create your own build that unleashes the full might of the devil.



■ Experience Unlimited Growth with Tons of Content
Manage Dominion to collect growth resources, command powerful minions, unlock Helpers and Mercenaries, equip and upgrade gear and accessories, obtain Mystical Power, and take on challenging promotion battles to grow beyond your imagination.



■ Fight Epic Bosses to Grow Even Stronger
Battle bosses in various challenge modes, ascend through Tower of Trials where formidable bosses await, and defeat bosses in the Battlefield with your Raid team to get items and rewards that will aid you in your journey.



■ No Rest for the Demonized
Your character will continue fighting even when you are away. You can log in whenever you want to get your AFK rewards and collect the items you need to continue with your journey.

The fate of humanity now rests on your shoulders.
Unleash the devil’s power to purge the demons in this daring quest to save the world.
Download now to become the Demonized.

it.name: Titan Quest HD
it.d:
One of the best hack-and-slash games of all time now fits in your pocket!

Originally released on PC in 2006, Titan Quest is an action RPG set against a mythological backdrop. The Titans have escaped from prison and are hell-bent on destroying the Earth. The Gods alone can’t stop them -- a hero is needed to lead this epic struggle. Victory or defeat will determine humanity’s fate and that of the Olympians.

You are that hero! Create your character, explore ancient civilizations like Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China, and fight against hordes of legendary creatures! Master the arts of archery, swordsmanship or magic and upgrade your character to unlock awesome powers! Discover special items to help you complete your quest: legendary swords, devastating thunderbolts, enchanted bows, and much more!

Specially adapted for mobile devices, this new version offers numerous new features:

● A new touch-friendly interface 
● Completely redesigned touch-friendly gameplay 
● High-quality graphics
● A huge, open world to explore
● Full day/night cycle
● 80 different mythological creatures: Minotaurs, Cyclopses, Gorgons, and many more
● 1200+ items to discover
● 30 different character classes 
● 150 different character skills
● Colossal playtime of more than 60 hours 
● Scalable difficulty modes:  weapons and enemies match your skill level 
● Dozens of unlockable achievements to discover
● No ads, no microtransactions. 

Mixing ancient mythology with non-stop action, Titan Quest is a classic hack-and-slash offering energizing gameplay with a fast, intense rhythm. Overcome thrilling challenges and vanquish the greatest enemies ever to invade the mobile world!

DLCs available as in-app purchase: 
● IMMORTAL THRONE - Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx to conquer this dark new adventure.
● RAGNARÖK - In the uncharted lands of northern Europe, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods!
● ATLANTIS - Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. Including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles!
● ETERNAL EMBERS - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain.

it.name: Vampire Survivors
it.d:
Vampire Survivors is a roguelite time survival RPG game with minimalistic gameplay.

The supernatural indie phenomenon that lets you be the bullet hell has arrived on mobile!

The whole game is also playable in 1-4 player couch co-op in landscape.

Hell is empty, the devils are here, and there's no place to run or hide. Survive as long as you can until death inevitably puts an end to your struggles. Gather gold in each run to buy upgrades and help the next survivor.

Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with roguelite and roguelike elements. Your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you.

Test your mettle against the legions of hell using your touchscreen. This wave survival will bring you the edge!

Stand against hordes of enemies, exterminate monsters and finish the game as a lone survivor! There is no way to defeat an enemy army without a collection of great weapons. This roguelike game has it all. Cross, garlic, king bible or magic wand? The choice is yours.

Upgrade your skills and become a warrior with unlimited potential. Take the most out of this hero survival - battle evil and dangerous hell creatures without mercy!

Starting Tips for the best attack survival:

- Take your time to grab gems and items, they won't disappear.
- Get two or three offensive weapons at first, but focus on leveling them up one at a time.
- Armour and Luck are good starting power-ups to spend money on.
- Refund power-ups often, it's free, and try new upgrade paths.

Waves of undead legions are all around, have you thought it’s going to be easy? The challenge is what makes this one of the best horde survival games. It’s time to enjoy an exciting rouge survival adventure.

Explore different stages and learn how to slay enemies anywhere, whether that is library, dairy plant, or old capella. Roguelite skill experience will help you collect bonuses and find treasure. You don’t want to be the last survivor with an empty pocket, do you?

Select your favorite character and begin the best adventure roguelike game of your life.

Join the fans of this roguelike RPG game on Twitter and TikTok:

https://twitter.com/poncle_vampire
https://www.tiktok.com/@poncle_games

We’re only just getting started. Expect improvements and enhancements as we continue to refine the mobile experience in Vampire Survivors roguelite role playing game.

it.name: World Conqueror 4
it.d:
Realtime WW2 Simulator. Commanders! You can rewrite your own battlefield legend!

Commanders! Experience the intensity of World War II like never before with World Conqueror 4, a real-time strategy game that offers an unparalleled blend of depth, realism, and historical accuracy. This offline, turn-based strategy game plunges you into the heart of the most significant conflicts of the 20th century. Whether you're a seasoned strategy game veteran or a newcomer looking to experience the thrill of battle, this game offers an immersive and deeply satisfying strategic WWII experience. Let your battlefield legend begin at this moment!

[Scenario]
- Embark on 100+ WW2 campaigns, each steeped in historical significance. 
- Relive epoch-making events such as the Battle of Dunkirk, the fierce Battle of Stalingrad, the strategic North Africa campaign, and the pivotal Battle of Midway Islands. 
- Take the helm and lead your army to achieve strategic objectives, all within a time frame dictated by the unfolding scenario.

[Conquest]
- Immerse yourself in the riveting epochs of WW2-1939, WW2-1943, Cold War 1950 and Modern War 1980. 
- Choose any nation on the globe, fine-tune your diplomatic strategies, extend support to allies, and boldly declare war against other countries. 
- Tailor your strategic objectives to the dynamics of the battlefield, construct thriving cities, advance in science and technology, and muster formidable military units. 
- Aim for top scores by swiftly occupying the most territories, and see your achievements ranked alongside other players on Google Game.
- The Conquest Challenge has been added! It's time to experience the new gameplay with different buffs of your enemy. To rule the world, you must be powerful enough!

[Legion]
- Train your troops in the HQ. 
- Unleash your military might on the field, be it for a tactical exercise or a full-fledged legion battle. 
- Victory hinges on the strategic placement of troops and the astute utilization of your generals. 
- Test your command skills with challenging operations. 
- Elite forces stand ready to heed your call! Enlist renowned troops such as the Alpini, Combat Medic, T-44, King Tiger, IS-3 Heavy Tank, and USS Enterprise from your arsenal. Let these powerful units aid you in dominating the entire battlefield.

[Domination]
- Select distinguished generals to fight for you in battle, elevate their ranks, and equip them with best skills.
- Adorn your generals with hard-earned medals to enhance their prowess. 
- Accomplish specific tasks within the city and engage in resource trading with merchants. 
- Construct awe-inspiring wonders of the world and unveil a myriad of iconic landmarks. 
- Delve into cutting-edge technologies to bolster the combat efficiency of all your units.

[Features]
- Traverse through 50 diverse nations, command 230 renowned generals, marshal 216 distinct military units, master 42 unique skills, and earn 16 prestigious medals. 
- Engage in over 100 riveting campaigns, 120 legion battles, and 40 challenging battles, among others. 
- Harness the power of 175 advanced technologies spanning the army, navy, air force, missile systems, nuclear weaponry, and space weapons. 
- Ascend the ranks in Conquest mode, supported by Google Game. 
- The Generals Biography offers a window into the famous wars of your favorite generals. Gain an extra edge for them and lead your troops with unparalleled skills.
- If you're new to strategy games or haven't tried EasyTech games yet, we've got you covered with an intuitive starter handbook designed to guide you through the game. Once you've successfully completed all the starter missions, you'll be navigating our war game like an actual pro gamer!

Follow EasyTech’s social media account to get latest update news from our team, or meet more friends in the community!

it.name: Age of Magic: Turn Based RPG
it.d:
Age of Magic is a mobile turn based RPG strategy about legions of epic heroes fighting on the remnants of an ancient world. Here war and magic interwine with raid heroes and skill based fights.

Welcome to the fantastic RPG strategy game and era of mages, knights and dragons! Form your own squad of 5 heroes and discover their magic stories in Campaign mode, defeat other players in PvP battles to reach the top of the Arena or Tournament, and prove your skills in the infamous Tomb of Horrors: a grim lair easy to enter, but hard to leave alive!

Immerse yourself into the epic world of this game. Age of Magic is your way into the world full of heroism, war, rush, treachery, wizardry, and experience of untold wonder. Enter this magic arena and start your hero adventure! 

Collect and level-up legendary heroes to fight fast-paced battles in grand arenas. Take your pick from dozens of characters among Kobolds, Elves, Demons, Druids, Changelings, Dragonkin, Ra’Archnes, and more. Use individual RPG tactics and win!

Darkness descends upon the ruined remnants of a world floating in the void. Each night another light beam in the sky fades, devoured by the unstoppable demons of the Legion. Yet there is still hope. The Dragon Prophecy foretells of a True Mage that enters the Dark Tower to determine the fate of the universe. Might you be the chosen one?

Age of Magic Gameplay:

STORY CAMPAIGNS
Explore the vast Age of Magic world pierced through with the powers of light and darkness. Meet legendary heroes and fight epic raid battles with terrifying enemies. Follow the story of Roland the True Mage and his quest for the Dark Tower. Step into darkness and meet changeling assassin Sharazar, who will stop at nothing to get what he came for.

PVP & RPG
Build the ultimate party of heroes and challenge other players in the PvP Arena daily. We choose competitive MMO PvP over PvE but that’s not all! Prove yourself in the 24-hour Tournament every week. Fight your way to the top to win glory and epic rewards! To the most valiant fighter go the spoils!

LEGENDARY HEROES
Collect over 60+ epic heroes, level them up and gear them out with powerful weapons and armour, and upgrade their abilities and rarity. Use different strategies and form your dream team of heroes to build the strongest party in the world!

FAST-PACED BATTLES
Lead your party into quick but tactical turn-based battles in grand arenas!

LOTS OF OTHER MODES
The Tomb of Horrors and Valley of Treasures will test your limits as you battle powerful enemies guarding unique rewards. Join events to face tricky characters with even trickier abilities, and test your strength no matter what the challenge!

Join the community of RPG multiplayer fans and dive into Age of Magic hero lore: find out who inhabits their world, read their stories, learn more about their classes and factions, and explore how to use items, skills and so much more!

it.name: Airport Simulator: Plane City
it.d:
Your airport. Your rules. Start with a single runway and build it into a hub that never sleeps.

Airport Simulator: Plane City puts you in the manager's seat. Every takeoff, every gate, every passenger is your call. Join over 15 million players worldwide!

BUILD IT YOUR WAY

- Design terminals, runways, gates and cafés from the ground up. Decorate inside and out, place custom buildables, and shape a layout that runs clean and looks like nobody else's.

RUN IT AROUND THE CLOCK

- Plan flight schedules, coordinate plane rotations and assign aircraft to gates. Watch the peaks build across your 24-hour day, open extra stands and keep every departure on time. Short-haul, long-haul, everything connected.

KEEP PASSENGERS MOVING

- Speed up check-in, widen your security lanes, cut the queues. Add the services travelers actually want and design a journey that flows from arrival to takeoff. Happier passengers, busier airport.

GROW YOUR FLEET

- Collect detailed 3D aircraft and give them custom liveries. Assign them to routes, fulfil contracts and unlock bigger, more advanced planes as your network expands. Then watch them taxi, rotate and land.

PARTNER WITH AIRLINES

- Negotiate deals, welcome new carriers and grow your roster, then fly for them. Progress through the Wings of Trust Pass, a relationship-powered system that turns loyalty into exclusive unlocks. In addition, every flight you operate for an airline earns XP on its own Airline Pass, and each tier unlocks new rewards. The more you fly for a carrier, the more it gives back.

EARN YOUR WAY TO MADEIRA

- Madeira (FNC) is the one every aviation fan knows, where the runway meets the cliffs and the ocean, one of the most spectacular approaches in the world. It unlocks last, and only once you have proved yourself. Start with the quiet hub of Faro (FAO), grow through Beauvais (BVA) and take on FNC.

ENJOY AND WATCH YOUR PLANES

- This is more than a management game. Aircraft rolling up to the stand, ground crews at work, terminals filling, a departure lifting off the runway as the next one lines up. Plan your expansion, then sit back and let it run.

ABOUT US

- We are Playrion, a French studio in Paris, making free-to-play mobile games born out of a real obsession with aviation. Our office is full of plane models, including a Concorde built out of LEGO.

If you love planes, airports, or just watching a busy terminal come alive : welcome aboard.

Join the community: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/airport-simulator/about

desc: Alliance At War IPA is the iOS installation package of the real-time strategy combat game built for iPhone

it.name: Alliance At War
it.d:
Enter Ahzeriah, a world of magic, steel, and endless war.
Reborn in full 3D, Alliance at War brings together classic SLG strategy, real RTS troop control, and Warcraft style campaign missions into one epic fantasy experience.

For the past five years, we have focused on making strategy battles more fair, more creative, and more rewarding. The 3D remake now expands these foundations with new real time mechanics and classic fantasy style combat.

Below are the core features loved by players and newly upgraded for the remake:

(1) Real RTS Battlefield Control
In addition to traditional SLG battles, you can now control units directly on real terrain.
Drag, flank, kite, split, cast skills manually, and outsmart your enemies with true real time micro operations.

(2) Warcraft Style Campaign Chapters
Challenge classic story driven missions with elite units and powerful heroes.
Each stage features unique mechanics, boss encounters, and puzzle like objectives that test strategy and skill timing.

(3) Troop Protection System
You can switch to Defense Mode anytime to avoid being forced into battles.
This lets you sleep safely without shields and plan strategy at your own pace.

(4) Low Battle Loss and Multiple Recovery Systems
Larger hospital capacity and reduced system battle damage help you grow faster.
Zero loss events such as Rogue like exploration, Cross server War, Crusade Against Demons, and team challenges give constant progression with minimal risk.
Support systems such as Angel of Salvation and Gate of Rebirth further reduce losses and keep gameplay enjoyable.

(5) Deep Hero Combinations and Gorgeous Skill Effects
Each hero has unique skills, roles, and animations, including:
The Sorceress with explosive magic,
The Dwarf King with stun and petrification,
The Oracle who reverses time to revive soldiers endlessly.
Six ancient guardians such as Giant Ape, Phoenix, Fire Dragon, and Cerberus create countless strategic combinations.

(6) Regular Cross server Wars and Large Scale Events
Enjoy alliance based Stronghold occupation, rally boss fights, point battles, and massive kingdom conflicts with rich rewards.

(7) Widely Praised Special Modes
The Uncharted Glade
Daily Rogue like exploration that challenges troop strength and item strategy.

Stronghold Fighting Day
Weekly alliance competition to capture towers and control rare strongholds.

Ancient Artifacts
Obtain seven powerful artifacts through quests or plundering.

Alliance Fights Against Demons

Pack your bags and get ready to roll the dice! In Backpacker® Go!, you’re not just playing a board game – you’re exploring the world! it.name: Baker Business 3
it.d:
Love baking games? In Baker Business 3 you’ll get the experience of running your very own bakery! By purchasing ingredients, baking a large variety of unlockable recipes, upgrading your bakery, and serving your freshly baked baked goods to your various customers! All the while leveling up to unlock more surprise recipes and items for your bakery at an enjoyable pace all for free!

So Many Baked Goods!
Bake and sell a wide variety of bakery items including: cake, cookies, muffins, doughnuts, cupcakes, bread, coffee, soda pop, parfaits, juice, and more!

Unlock, Bake and Sell What You Love!
As you level up you’ll be able to choose what recipe category you’d like research and decide what type of bakery you’ll have. Love doughnuts and cookies? Fantastic! Keep discovering new recipes in those categories. Want to go “traditional bakery style” and unlock bread and cake? You can do that! Do you want to sell as many types of baked goods as possible? Then research all the categories and unlock every baking recipe possible. Sell what you desire to serve in your bakery and to your customers!

Bake With Real Baking Ingredients!
Each recipe calls for a specified quantity of different real-life baking ingredients you’ll be able to stock and bake with! As you level up you’ll be able to purchase ingredients in higher quantities, or bulk, to keep up with your baking demand.

Keep Your Customers On Their Toes!
Your customers are always on the lookout for new items in your bakery, so don’t forget to bake and stock any and all new food items you unlock at each level! Your customers will thank you!

Upgrade And Expand Your Bakery!
Your bakery will be able to expand with you as you level up from baking by unlocking and purchasing more baking ovens, item display cases, bread shelves, and more!

Baker Business 3 Features:
- Unlock over 90+ different bakeable recipes!
- Bake with over 40+ real-life baking ingredients!
- Unlock various bakery upgrades from a tip jar to snack fridge and much more!
- Fulfill your customer’s various orders by quickly serving them what they're asking for. 
- Enjoy the relaxing roleplay bakery gameplay at an enjoyable pace.
- Discover various secret interactable items in your bakery.
- Easy-to-play and suitable for all ages!

# Bounce Defense – A Physics-Powered Tower Defense by Voodoo!

**Every bounce is a blast!**
Step into the most addictive physics-based **tower defense strategy game** where every ricochet matters. In **Bounce Defense**, you’ll drop into a world of chaotic fun, clever positioning, and explosive chain reactions. Built by **Voodoo**, this game delivers the perfect blend of **easy-to-learn gameplay** and **deep tactical challenge** that fans love.

## Think Fast. Bounce Smarter.

Enemies are coming in endless waves—and your only weapon is a bouncing ball that unleashes destruction wherever it goes. Place bouncers and weapons on a **tactical grid** to guide your ball, **trigger attacks**, and build unstoppable defenses. It’s **tower defense meets pinball** in the most satisfying way possible.

## Game Features

**Physics-Based Strategy**
Use bounce mechanics to chain together hits, ricochet around defenses, and take out entire waves with a single move.

**Grid-Based Defense Building**
Place bouncer blocks, turrets, lasers, and explosive weapons to craft the perfect path of destruction.

**Satisfying Chain Reactions**
Trigger smart combos—each weapon has unique cooldowns, effects, and timing. Master your setup for maximum mayhem.

**Upgrade Everything**
Unlock new weapons, improve damage, tweak bounce patterns, and push your strategy to the limit.

**Endless Enemy Waves**
Face off against increasingly tough enemy hordes. The longer you survive, the more intense the action becomes!

**Neon Visuals + Explosive FX**
Bright, stylized visuals with screen-shaking blasts and smooth, satisfying destruction that feels amazing every time.

## Built for Voodoo Fans

If you love **Voodoo’s signature games**—fast, fun, and deeply addictive—**Bounce Defense** is your next obsession. Whether you’re into **idle shooters**, **physics puzzles**, or **tower defense strategy**, this game hits all the right notes.

## Why You’ll Love It

Easy to pick up, hard to master
Offline-friendly gameplay
Quick sessions with deep replayability
Great for fans of **Ball Blast**, **Pinball Tower Defense**, and **bounce puzzle games**
New content, upgrades, and weapons added regularly!

# Download Bounce Defense Now!

Start bouncing, blasting, and building your way through **bounce-fueled chaos**!
Only the smartest survivors will build the perfect battlefield and hold off the endless swarm.

**Ready to bounce your way to victory?** Tap install and join the action now!

it.name: Castle Busters
it.d:
SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.

Build your defenses, choose your crew, and smash your opponent's hard work to pieces in Castle Busters, a turn-based online PvP battle game.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target.

In fast 1v1 battles, every shot changes what happens next. Blast through walls to open new angles and collapse towers to expose enemy heroes. Win by taking out their entire crew or turning their castle into rubble.

With physics-based artillery and a battlefield that falls apart, you'll need to think on your feet. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

YOUR CASTLE. YOUR DESIGN.

Build a castle worth showing off, then roll it into battle. Yes, it's on wheels.

Fortify your walls, position your heroes, and choose gadgets that suit your strategy. Test your setup in battle. Putting your plan together is almost as satisfying as watching theirs fall apart.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your heroes and unlock new faces for your crew. Each new arrival brings a different ability to play with and another reason to rethink your lineup.

Earn rewards from the Forge as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

CLIMB THE RANKS

Earn trophies and progress through the arenas on Trophy Road. Unlock Ranked mode and compete on the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

Welcome to the ultimate dragon fantasy world. In City of Dragons: Epic Battle, you are the master of your own destiny. Embark on a legendary journey to build a powerful kingdom, raise a diverse army of dragons, and dominate the battlefield in intense strategic combat.

Forge Your Legacy
The path to victory begins with a single egg. In this immersive strategy game, you must collect rare dragon species and nurture them from hatchlings to massive beasts. Every dragon possesses unique elemental powers and abilities. Your success depends on your ability to combine these strengths to create the most formidable team ever seen.

Evolve and Power Up
Evolution is the key to survival. Use resources to upgrade your dragons, unlocking new forms and devastating skills. As they grow, your dragons become stronger, faster, and more resilient. Explore a Vast Fantasy World
Journey through diverse landscapes, from scorched volcanic mountains to lush enchanted forests. Discover hidden treasures, encounter mythical creatures, and uncover the ancient secrets of the dragon world. The world is filled with challenges and opportunities for those brave enough to explore it.

Strategic Deep Gameplay
Success in City of Dragons: Epic Battle requires more than just brute force. You must manage your resources wisely, research new technologies, and build a base that can withstand any assault. Every decision you make impacts your progress and your standing in the world.

Are you ready to claim your throne? Download City of Dragons: Epic Battle today and begin your adventure. Evolve your team, train your beasts, and conquer the world.

Hey there, chef! Welcome to Cook & Chill, an ultimate chill & cozy game that makes cooking as relaxing as a satisfying Sunday morning. This is all about slowing down, having fun, and creating delicious dishes step by step. You’ll go from chopping potatoes to plating masterpieces, all while soaking in those soothing chill vibes.

Step-by-Step Cooking Fun:
Each recipe is broken into small, satisfying mini-games that let you focus on one step at a time:
Chop & Dice: Gently slice veggies, herbs, or even fancy garnishes. The soft sounds of your knife hitting the cutting board? Chef’s kiss! 
Mix & Stir: Combine ingredients with satisfying swirls as batter or soup comes together before your eyes. Watch the colors blend—it’s like food ASMR.
Cook to Perfection: Flip pancakes, sauté veggies, or grill meats just right. Mistime it? No problem—there’s always room for a laugh and another try!
Plating Masterpieces: Carefully arrange your dishes to look as tasty as they are. Add a sprinkle of herbs or drizzle a sauce for that perfect finishing touch.

Dishes to Warm Your Soul
From comforting classics to creative fusion dishes, there’s always something delicious to make:

A steaming bowl of miso ramen with all the toppings 
Stacks of fluffy pancakes drizzled with syrup 
A colorful charcuterie board full of cute snacks 
Warm chocolate lava cake oozing with goodness 
With each completed dish, you’ll unlock more recipes, ingredients, and fun tools to play with.

Make Your Kitchen a Cozy Haven
Cooking feels better in a space you love, so customize your kitchen to match your vibes:

Add cozy touches like twinkling fairy lights, potted plants, or rustic wooden shelves.
Upgrade your tools, from colorful cutting boards to adorable whisks shaped like cats.
Dress your chef in comfy aprons, fuzzy slippers, or even themed outfits for each recipe!

Why You’ll Love It
It's Your Cozy Culinary Escape: No stress, no timers, just the relaxing joy of creating beautiful food.
Sounds You Can Feel: The crunch of slicing veggies, the gentle simmer of soup, the tap-tap-tap of seasoning… it’s like a warm blanket for your ears.
Your Kitchen, Your Style: Decorate your space with cute plants, fairy lights, or even a cat clock that says “meow” when you finish a dish.
Adorable Chef Fits: Rock a bunny apron, fuzzy slippers, or a sweater that screams “I make soup and it’s amazing.”
Relaxing Vibes for Every Playthrough: With soft lo-fi beats, soothing sound effects, and dreamy visuals, the game feels like wrapping yourself in a warm blanket while sipping hot cocoa. Take your time, enjoy the journey, and let your inner chef shine.

Ready to Cook & Chill?
Whether you’re winding down after a long day or just want to chill with some virtual pancakes, Cook & Chill is here for you. Take your time, enjoy every step, and let the cozy vibes do the rest.
Cook & Chill is the ultimate cozy cooking escape. Whether you’re here to unwind, get inspired, or simply enjoy making food step-by-step, you’ll leave every session feeling refreshed and satisfied. So grab your spatula—it’s time to cook up some chill vibes! 

So, what are you waiting for? Download now and turn your screen into the cutest little kitchen where cooking made cozy stories. It’s time to cook, relax, and chill.

From the beginnings of the world to the modern age, you’ll need to fight for dominance and secure your empire’s safety. Bring your army to life in real-time strategy games that pit you against your foes across every age of history.

Empires begin as an early settlement that grows through the ages, from the dawn of history to the modern era. Develop, craft and master strategies at the University. Study under history’s greats or explore the new University Hall to enhance your approach to world domination. Build Wonders of the World and dominate battles with high-tech fighter jets from the modern era. Build your base and strengthen your defenses with the Council with new Councilors and Artifacts to give your army the edge in battle.

REAL TIME STRATEGY GAMES INTERTWINED WITH WORLD HISTORY
• Strategy games with fun limited-time goals based on actual events from history.
• Collect rare rewards to help your Nation advance so they can conquer the world!

BUILD AN EMPIRE & LEAD AN ARMY
• Build a base, starting with a small civilization and grow it into a thriving metropolis.

• Upgrade your base as you advance through history, tackling historic battle campaigns to collect important resources.

• Level up through scientific discovery.
• Reinforce your troops with better equipment, upgrade your buildings and town center with modern materials.
• The path to victory is your own. Collect special cosmetic weaponry, armor and color schemes to customize your own Commanders, with a brand new customization system. Showcase your style and strike fear in your enemies.

PVP BATTLES IN STRATEGIC WAR GAMES
• PVP combat awaits. Take on foes one-on-one in battles for greatness.

desc: Dragonfist Limitless on iOS Dragonfist Limitless on iOS delivers a fluid and engaging action RPG built around high-intensity combat, dee

it.name: Dragonfist Limitless
it.d:
Laugh and grind through very slow but weirdly rewarding martial arts training! You may start off weak and hardly feel your progress, but this game is uniquely designed to stimulate *delayed gratification* instead of the easy, instant rewards and handholding most modern games lavish on you. Luckily, your extremely sassy (and possibly a little bit evil??) Sensei will keep you motivated.

With gradually unfurling layers of complexity, Dragonfist Limitless is an epic training montage lovingly crafted by a single person, in which you must raise your Power Level and master new fighting techniques, all so you can get revenge on Emperor Axemetal and his Five Generals of Beatdown...



Now, cram in an incremental prestige loop with loads of leveling up and big numbers and stuff to spend gold on, constant bad jokes, overpowered shonen tropes, bizarre subplots, online chat and weekly leaderboards, and you get... whatever on earth this is!



**RICH STORY** 
With over 40,000 words of pitch black comedy and lovable characters

** NO GREED OR PAY 2 WIN!** 
You can make purchases to support the game, but they're not required to play competitively.

**FIGHT** 
to get gold and finally buy some pants! Fight strategically, or don't--you can also just get strong and bludgeon your way through blocking enemies

**LEVEL UP** 
by boxing, lifting weights, balancing, unlocking your ki and MUCH more to exponentially increase your Power Level

**UPGRADE** 
your exp gains with loads of stacking multipliers like Scrolls, Tomes, Achievements, clothing, advanced lessons and literally also the souls of your enemies

**COLLECT**
rare items that boost your gold and exp so numbers get bigger, and bigger, and bigger!

**COMPETE** 
online in the weekly leaderboard to have the highest Power Level in the multiverse

**STUDY** 
under various masters to earn powerful moves like Energy Beams, Thousand Fang Stance, and the infamous Gut Blender attack! Every move is uniquely balanced with its own strategic importance, for example Wave Fist Style is a defensive move that exhausts an already weakened opponent

**SECRETS** 
galore! There are lots of powerful ways to min-max your gains for the most efficiency, but only if you're on the ball...



Dragonfist Limitless plays like a weird fusion of an old-school side-scrolling beat-'em-up and a clicker/tapping game with satisfying incremental progression (meaning the game is about chasing bigger and bigger numbers). It's a unique reimagining of the idle/incremental schtick, with more emphasis on ACTIVE PLAY and only very light idle features (which are unlocked a little further into the game). 



Strap in for the long haul and get ready to train hard!



Please note: Dragonfist Limitless is an online-only game with chat and competitive leaderboards and thus requires an active Internet connection in order to play.

desc: Driving Zone: Offroad Lite Overview on iOS Driving Zone: Offroad Lite is an offroad driving simulation game that focuses on realism, ter

it.name: Driving Zone: Offroad Lite
it.d:
Introducing our new off-road driving story game. You play as a courier who has to deliver parcels to the most remote corners of the island. At the beginning of the game, you get a little money to buy a car, but with each completed task your capital will grow and you will be able to afford cooler cars.

The game is a simulator, so do not forget to monitor the fuel level and plan a route through the gas stations, otherwise you will run out of fuel, the car will stall and you will be forced to call a tow truck to deliver the car to the gas station. For planning routes, we made a convenient map with navigation, which displays all available and active tasks. You will often have to drive off the road, but are you ready for it, right?

Cars differ from each other in power, cross-country ability, fuel consumption and, of course, the capacity of the trunk. Pay attention to the requirements for the vehicle in the mission, so that there is enough space in the trunk of the vehicle in which you will carry out the mission for the entire load.

The island is divided into zones: snow-capped mountains and icy road, arid deserts and a forest with lakes and singing birds, where you will also have to drive cars through the mud. Quests are closely intertwined with the types of regions, this will add atmosphere to the gameplay. Each driver will appreciate that depending on the location of the game, off-road riding changes and gives a unique feeling. As in our other driving games, the new one has realistic car handling and the suspension looks and works like in real cars.

Upon reaching a certain level, you will have the opportunity to participate in off-road races. Each race will give you a generous reward for tuning cars or buying new ones at the car dealership. First of all, the game is about cars, so the game has a tuning of cars, it is available in a car service, where you can also change the color of the car. And the city also has your personal garage where all the cars you bought are kept.

Many original missions include those in which you'll save a forest from a fire, help kids on a school bus caught in a blizzard, deliver water to arid regions, and transport fish from the port to shops.

Explore the island carefully and you will find hidden treasures that you can use to pay for various services or spend on a special off-road vehicle.

Features of the game Driving Zone: Offroad Lite
• Open world
• Customizable driver and car tuning
• Consumable fuel by cars and petrol stations on the map
• Unique tasks
• View from the salon
• Car dealership for the sale of cars, car service and personal garage
• Off-road racing in 4x4 cars
• Free driving possibility
• Dynamic change of day and night
• Ability to play offline

Run through dream worlds. Build a fortress that fights back. Master six elements — and turn every tap into raw power.

A new breed of mobile action RPG: runner speed meets arena strategy, and every choice on your base reshapes the battlefield.

WHY PLAYERS STAY


6 ELEMENTS. YOUR BUILD.

ENDLESS PROGRESSION

Download free. Build your legend. Rule the elements.

Slay foes, conquer bosses, and forge your legend as an Elven warrior!

Build your cities. Train your troops. Expand your empire. Be the king of 7 kingdoms!

Unique gameplay features:
◆ Challenge a variety of Survivor Levels
◆ Move, shoot, evolve weapons

it.name: Fable Town: Merge Island magic
it.d:
Welcome to Fable Town! Merge, renovate, and solve the mystery of this magical place.
Follow Ginny, Merlin's granddaughter and a talented sorceress in her own right, as she comes back home to Fable Town. Help her to uncover the truth behind the enchanted fog and find true love. 
You will master merge magic, renovate unique buildings, and bring magical creatures back to Fable Town.
HOW TO PLAY: 
- Combine 3+ identical objects to get an upgraded one as a result of this fusion.
- Merge artifacts to disenchant wizards.
- Grow plants and trade fruits and vegetables for magic wands. 
- Use magic wands to restore Fable Town.
FABLE TOWN FEATURES:
ENDLESS MERGE 
Merge anything, from rocks and plants to magic wands and unique artifacts. Out of resources? There's not one, not two, but three bottomless mines where you can get building materials and plants for your garden.
CAPTIVATING STORY 
Mysteries and investigation, love and betrayal, friendship and family conflict - you will experience it all. Reveal the secret behind the enchanted fog and find her way out of the love triangle.
CHARISMATIC CHARACTERS 
Disenchant and get to know residents of Fable Town and learn their stories. Find out who's your true friend and who's the wolf in sheep's clothing.
DIVERSE LOCATIONS 
Every corner of Fable Town is different. Explore sandy beaches and mystical swamps, snowy valleys and forest lakes. Renovate unique buildings and give the town a complete makeover to see it glow in its full beauty!
MAGICAL CREATURES 
Bring dragons and unicorns back to Fable Town! Meet dozens of legendary creatures and help them settle in cozy habitats around the town. Evolve the creatures and grow your collection!
EXCITING EVENTS 
Participate in weekly events that bring new challenges and test your merging skills. Will you be fast and crafty enough to get a unique creature? Let's find out!
AMAZING REWARDS 
Test your luck in Energy Lottery, catch cute little sunflies and rummage through treasure chests full of gold and gems!
Want to ditch worries and escape your everyday life? Dive into the charming world of Fable Town and work your merge magic! 
In-App purchases may include random items.

it.name: Fallout Shelter
it.d:
Create a brighter future…underground! Take on your role as Overseer in this base-building and post-apocalyptic simulation game from the Fallout franchise. Build the perfect vault under 2,000 feet of bedrock. Manage your Dwellers, explore the hostile Wasteland, and defend your base against radioactive threats.

Lead Dwellers on the quest to true happiness as you expand your vault. Outfit your Dwellers with specialized gear, help them find ideal jobs, and train them to improve S.P.E.C.I.A.L. abilities. Play matchmaker to repopulate your underground fortress. Protect your Dwellers from the dangers of the Wasteland as you oversee your thriving community.

Send Dwellers above ground on quests to explore the blasted surface that was left behind. Find adventure, search for life above, and collect survival loot to take back to your vault. 

Unlock new shelter Seasons featuring limited-time vaults. Craft experimental underground vaults, separate from your main vault, for a chance to win Season-specific, in-game rewards.

Download today to take control of your vault and start your underground adventure.

FALLOUT SHELTER FEATURES

BUILD YOUR PERFECT VAULT
- Build a brighter future…underground! You’re in control of a state-of-the-art Vault from Vault-Tec.
- Select from a variety of modern-day rooms to turn an excavation beneath 2,000 feet of bedrock into the very picture of underground Vault Life.
- Build a Radio Room to recruit new Dwellers or play matchmaker to expand the population.

OVERSEE A THRIVING UNDERGROUND COMMUNITY
- Get to know your Dwellers and lead them to happiness.
- Find their ideal jobs and watch them flourish.
- Provide Dwellers with outfits, weapons, and training to improve S.P.E.C.I.A.L. abilities.
- Customize the look of any Dweller in the Barbershop.
- Prepare your Dwellers to protect against threats from the outside…and within.

EXPLORE THE WASTELAND WITH A VARIETY OF QUESTS
- Send Dwellers on quests above ground to explore the blasted surface left behind.
- Find new armor and weapons, gain experience, and earn Caps.
- Encounter new Dwellers to bring back to your vault.
- Complete missions to earn handy survival loot, or fail and meet unspeakable death...
- Open lunchboxes for a chance to collect Legendary Dwellers, including Lucy MacLean, Sarah Lyons, and Abraham Washington.

Vault-Tec has provided the tools, but the rest is up to you. What are you waiting for? Get started building your Vault today for FREE.

*** App Store Best of 2015 ***
Mobile Game of the Year - 2016 DICE Awards
Winner 2015 Golden Joystick Best Handheld/Mobile Game

“Bethesda's first entry into iOS gaming is awesome. Game of the Week" - TouchArcade 
"Probably the best game of E3 2015” – Gizmodo 
"Fallout Shelter is simple to play and addictive as hell." - GameZone

** Requires iOS 10 or later. Requires at least an iPhone 6S Plus, iPad Air 2, or iPad mini 4 **

This app offers in-app purchases. Please note that you may disable in-app purchasing directly from your device. For more information, visit http://support.apple.com/kb/HT4213.

===Final Outpost 2.0 is available now!===

Top-100 strategy game in 140+ countries worldwide!

Build your Outpost • Manage your citizens • Survive the zombie apocalypse
​
As the leader of one of the last remnants of civilization, you must manage your citizens, use resources to expand your outpost, and protect your citizens from both starvation and zombies.
​
In the face of this great challenge, you are given control over the construction of new buildings for your citizens to live and work in. Striking the right balance of building types is critical to maintaining the resource stockpiles so valuable to your citizens. Equip your workforce with the right tools for the job as the needs of your Outpost are shaped by its growth. Craft weapons to protect and defend your Outpost from zombies that wander too close...
 
--------------------

==BUILD==
Improve your base over time to shelter your citizens from the outside world, and stockpile resources to save as many lives as possible.

==UPGRADE==
Upgrade the capabilities of your citizens with the skill tree. Earn skill points by killing zombies and ensure the survival of your citizens by guiding them from novice to warrior as you play.

==MANAGE==
Lead your citizens into a new age of prosperity by assigning them the right jobs, including farmers and guards.

==CRAFT==
Give your citizens the tools they need to survive. Build a workshop to unlock advanced crafting and create weaponry to fend off the dead.

==SURVIVE==
Combat famine and the dead by perfecting your long-term strategic balance of management, research, building and crafting.
 
GAME FEATURES
• Assign your citizens to scavenge, hunt, farm, mine and more
• Craft tools and manage your resources
• Construct and upgrade 12+ building types
• Defend your walls from 5+ zombie types
• Feed your hungry citizens as your Outpost expands
• Simulated weather, seasons and day/night cycle
• Upgrade your citizens with the skill tree
 
--------------------
 
Send your feedback and bug reports to support@exabytegames.com

it.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
it.d:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food as far as the eye can see! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

From your small office you must watch the security cameras carefully. You have a very limited amount of electricity that you're allowed to use per night (corporate budget cuts, you know). That means when you run out of power for the night- no more security doors and no more lights! If something isn't right- namely if Freddybear or his friends aren't in their proper places, you must find them on the monitors and protect yourself if needed!

Can you survive five nights at Freddy's?

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

desc: Great Conqueror 2 Shogun MOD is ⁤a captivating strategy game available on iOS devices that transports players to ‌the ⁤tumultuous sengok

it.name: Great Conqueror 2: Shogun
it.d:
【Game Introduction】
As the Ashikaga Shogunate wanes, warlords arise and the fog of warfare engulfs the era of Sengoku. In this era, a host of generals and daimyos compete for power, overthrowing higher positions, and the wielding of swords and blades. Numerous legendary figures such as Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Takeda Shingen ascend onto the stage. Amidst the background where the flames of war rise all around, you will witness the rise and fall of various factions in the Sengoku period in the game.

【Game Characteristics】
▲ Relive real historical events in hundreds of campaign
* Explore 16 chapters with over 200 well-known ancient military battles, including historical events such as the “Battle of Okehazam”, "Mino Campaign" and "Armed Unification". To recreate the tumultuous time of the Sengoku period.

▲ Experience the battles of wits and courage between different Powers in the Sengoku period
Including conquest scenarios such as "Turmoil in Owari", "Armed Unification" and "Encirclement of Nobunaga", allow you to experience both open strife and the veiled struggle between daimyos and different factions. Elements such as retainers group, subordinate states, prestige, personality, and attitude will affect the tides of war, bringing you a new gameplay experience with unlimited potential. The occurrence of historical events will impact the state of the battlefield, and completing missions will reward you with battlefield bonuses. By employing different diplomatic strategies such as gifts, agreements, and war declarations, you will gain deeper insights into the diplomatic situation and attitude between daimyos. Thereby enabling you to make flexible strategies and tactics to advance steadily between conquest and diplomacy!

▲ Begin with one castle, unify the whole region
Take Osaka Castle as your main castle, gradually conquer neighboring Powers, embarking on a journey to dominate, to achieve the ambition of "unifying the entire country" and become the "Tenkabito".
Princesses, expeditions, special forces... more interactive gameplay, with more item rewards. 
In the "Tenkabito" mode, different choices will unlock different history! Fight for your country or open a different path—it is all decided by your wisdom. Write your history and create exceptional glory for the empire!

▲ Legendary generals and extraordinary troops await your command
* Become legendary figures such as Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Takeda Shingen. The spirit of the samurai awakens at this very moment! 
* Infantry, cavalry, archer, musketeer, war gear, ship... a wide variety of unit types allow you to strategize within the command tent and achieve victory a thousand miles apart! There are also special troops with exceptional combat abilities, such as ninjas, sword masters, and Horoshū, ready to be dispatched at any time. Hone your troops on the battlefield as they will gain level upgrades, potentially altering the state of the battlefield!

▲ Conquer the Chaotic era with the assistance of divine artifact suit
Wakizashi, naginata, muramasa, armor... a variety of ancient military equipment and traditional Japanese items will aid you to rise in the Sengoku period. A single exclusive equipment general is no longer your only choice! The powerful suit system and comprehensive forging system allow you to have an abundance of equipment combinations to choose from!

Commander! The Roman Republic is on the march and many powerful nations oppose the expansion of our empire. War is imminent.
Rome needs the might of all talented warriors! Great generals like Caesar, Pompey, Antony, Octavian and Spartacus will fight with you. Let us witness the birth of a great conqueror!

【Campaign Mode】
Become the glorious commander of the legions in hundreds of historical battles and locations of Roman history. Witness Rome develop into a great empire spanning Africa, Europe and Asia.
** Take on the role of a general in the Punic Wars, the Spartacus Uprising, the Conquest of Gaul, Caesar's Civil War, Antony's Civil War, the Conquest of the East, the Conquest of Germania and witness the rise of Rome.
** Build cities, recruit soldiers, manufacture war equipment, build powerful fleets. Everything is under your control.
** Change sides and help Rome's surrounding nations and tribes stand up to the mighty Roman army. Stand against the expansion of this world empire and rewrite the history of the defeated!
** New technologies bring new visions. Researching technologies opens up new possibilities and accelerates your expansion.

【Conquest Mode】
From the Mediterranean to the British Isles, Rome, Egypt, Carthage, the Gallic tribes, the Germanic peoples and many others struggle for supremacy. Will Rome conquer the world or will the victor himself become the vanquished and an entirely new empire be established?
** Experience hundreds of years of history, from the Punic Wars during the Roman Republic, through the time of the Triumvirates to the era of the Roman Empire.
** Be friend or foe, declare wars or make alliances and support allies against powerful opponents. Choose the foreign policy that is in the best interest of your country. All roads lead to Rome!
** The tide of war is unstoppable. Expand cities, recruit legions, use strategies, research technologies and lead your empire to ultimate victory.
** Command the armies of countless countries and conquer the ancient world. Change their future and lead them to unimagined greatness.

【Expedition Mode】
Lead your legions on an expedition and use strategies and tactics skillfully. Play your commander skills to the full with a limited number of units and defeat powerful foreign enemies!
** New challenge mode that gives you a new kind of gaming experience.
** Each step of the expedition involves many difficulties and dangers. Keep adjusting your battle plans and achieve ultimate victory.
** Collect the best war trophies and get special conqueror uniforms as proof of your glory.

【The Senate】
Rome was not built in a day. Build the Arc de Triomphe, the Colosseum, the Pantheon and restore the glory of the past!
** Complete the tasks set by the Senate and win rich rewards.
** Train infantry, cavalry, archers and navy to improve their skills in battle.

Hammer & Steel isn’t just another store game—it’s an epic adventure where your crafting prowess and strategic acumen forge the path to glory.
