it.name: House Flipper Home Design
it.d:
Have you ever dreamed about running your own renovation company?
House Flipper is the best free one-man makeover crew on the market. Become an interior designer and start your very own business. Carry out orders, renovate, decorate houses, and sell them with profit afterwards! Get new skins for your tools.

Main features waiting for you:
- awesome, realistic 3D graphics
- smooth intuitive gameplay (60 FPS gameplay)
- different interesting tasks
- buying, renovating and selling houses as well as interior decoration.
- Over 500 decoration items to unlock

COMPLETE ORDERS

A great adventure awaits you in the House Flipper simulator - the world of renovations! Perform interesting orders that will make you feel like a real house flipper. Meet colorful characters such as Eleonor Moore and her artistically gifted animals (whose activities will be followed by cleaning). Renovate the art connoisseur's museum, Giuseppe Clavier, and help the squat residents renovate their ruined house. House Flipper offers you various locations equipped with characteristic items.

DECORATE INTERIORS

Become an interior designer and arrange interiors according to your own ideas, using available items and a wide range of paints. Most of the items available in the game have from several to over a dozen variants, which you will unlock as you progress in the game. Learn not only their purpose but also the story behind them (background). What does a cat have to do with haiku writing? Why are the Babylonian invaders buying souvenirs there? You will find answers to more strange questions in the descriptions of over 500 items available in the game. All this in realistic 3D graphics!

GAIN EXPERIENCE

As you progress in House Flipper, you'll level up and improve your tools. Advance to the next levels to complete the tasks (quests) faster. Why hurt your hands when you can have gloves made of hardened smurf leather? Using unlocked items, you can arrange the interior of your office according to your own design. It can be stylish, but also ... A cat tree in the middle of the room? Why not? It's your idea after all!

BUY, RENEW, DECOR, SELL

You can unlock new items, buy various, though not always beautiful houses with cash and flipcoins acquired during orders. Renovate your new house and turn it into your office, or negotiate a convenient sale price at real estate agency. It doesn't matter if you clean the Trash in M5 or polish the Crimson Corner. Each of them can become your haven on the path of developing your own career in the house flipping industry or a source of additional profit.

it.name: Hungry Hours
it.d:
Welcome to Hungry Hours – Where Every Minute Feels Like Mealtime Magic!

Step into your warm and bustling restaurant, where the grill is always sizzling, the kitchen is perfectly organized, and the sound of burgers and pizza cooking creates a relaxing ASMR vibe. Hungry Hours is one of those good cooking games that instantly makes you smile. You’re not just cooking — you’re running the coziest fast-food spot in town, serving hungry customers and spreading joy, one juicy burger at a time.

This isn’t just another simulation game. It’s a comfort-food playground made for every foodie out there — especially players who love perfect tidy gameplay and oddly satisfying ASMR cooking. From towering cheeseburgers dripping with melty cheese to crispy fried chicken, golden fries lined up neatly, stretchy cheesy nachos, creamy milkshakes, and hot pizza slices — every action feels clean, smooth, and satisfying.

WHAT MAKE HUNGRY HOURS SO DELICIOUSLY FUN 

- Burger Bliss – Flip, stack, and serve mouth-watering burgers with perfect precision
- Pizza Party – Slice, bake, and serve pizza like a true pizza maker 
- Beyond the Bun – Fries, hot dogs, nuggets, desserts, and more
- Speed & Skill – Cook fast, stay tidy, and earn big tips
- Kitchen Upgrades – Unlock new tools, toppings, and cozy, perfect tidy décor
- Charming Customers – Quirky guests with funny reactions and personalities
- Endless Challenges – Improve timing, memory, and multitasking

HOW TO PLAY

- Take the order – Listen carefully and enjoy the calm, focused flow
- Prepare the meal – Grill, fry, bake pizza, and arrange everything neatly
- Serve it hot – Deliver clean, perfect orders before time runs out
- Earn rewards – Collect coins, unlock ingredients, and expand your menu

WHY YOU'LL LOVE HUNGRY HOURS

Whether you’re into relaxing pizza games, casual burger cooking, cozy pizza simulation, or soothing ASMR gameplay, Hungry Hours is made for you. Easy to learn, deeply satisfying to play, and perfect for short chill sessions or long, stress-free cooking time.

Feel the gentle rush of lunch hours, enjoy the satisfying sounds of cooking, experiment with fun burger and pizza combos, and watch your small shop grow into a beloved fast-food empire.

It’s Hungry Hours — all day, every day.
Put on your apron, cook with love, keep everything perfectly tidy, and prove you can run the happiest restaurant in town.

HUGE OPEN WORLDS

MANIC MISSIONS & BADASS BOSSES

11th Class Advancement: ‘Dark Heavenly Demon Emperor’ Descends.
The absolute ruler of the Heavenly Demon Cult dominates the battlefield with dark demonic energy and the power of destruction.

Embark on an epic journey in one of the most thrilling idle RPG games, where strategy, action, and progression come together in an immersive experience! 
Hunter Raid offers a perfect blend of fast-paced action and AFK progression, making it an exciting choice for fans of idle RPG games and battle games alike.

Idle RPG Game Features:

Explore Cool Dungeons with Diverse Worlds:
- Venture through various realms such as Past, Present, Wulin, and Otherworld with stunning visuals, smooth animations, and spectacular battle effects.
- This idle RPG game immerses you in its captivating worlds, letting you experience the thrill of adventure without the grind.

Unique Job Advancement System:
- Progress through the Building of Trials, where you defeat characters from other dimensions, absorb their power, and grow stronger.
- Discover diverse skill sets from classes like Berserker, Kensei, Swordmaster, and Dimension Knight - each offering new layers of strategy and depth.

Idle Play, AFK Rewards, and Fast Growth:
- As a true idle RPG game, enjoy AFK progression where you continue to grow and collect rewards even when offline.
- Upgrade your characters effortlessly, gathering resources in your sleep and improving your stats every day!

- Join forces with others in the Hunter Union, where you’ll form guilds to conquer battles together. The multiplayer games element ensures there’s always a way to collaborate and compete with friends.

Intriguing Storyline - Hunter Story Chapter 1:
A mysterious red portal has brought devastating monsters to Earth, wiping out 90% of the human population. As monsters continue to pour through these gateways, humanity’s last hope lies in the hands of the Hunters. name: Ice Fishing Derby 2
desc: Ice Fishing Derby 2 for iPhone – A Deep and Relaxing Fishing Simulation Experience Ice Fishing Derby 2 is a mobile fishing simulation ga

it.name: Ice Fishing Derby 2
it.d:
Plan your day on the ice, pick your gear, and try to out-fish the field in Ice Fishing Derby 2, a 3D ice fishing game that mixes realistic tactics with fast, gamified fishing. Manage your money, equipment, and body heat across multi-day derbies or relax in free fishing mode and explore frozen lakes at your own pace.

Three ways to hit the ice:
•	Free Fishing – Keep your equipment from trip to trip, pick a lake, and fish without a weigh-in timer. Catch fish to earn gems and unlock better free-fishing gear over time.
•	Open Derbies – Everyone starts each 5-day event with limited shop credit and basic gear. Choose what to buy, find productive spots, and try to build up to trophy-class fish before the derby ends.
•	Pro Derbies – Unlock Pro and head to more lakes and fish for more species of fish. Start with more credit, access higher-end equipment, and drive a snowmobile to manually explore the lake and choose your own spots.

Plan, adapt, and stay warm
Before each derby day you’ll start in Kate’s bait shop with a small budget and a wall of tempting gear. Decide what matters most today: a stronger rod, a bigger auger, electronics, or extra bait and cocoa for the cold. Some items go on sale, so the “right” choice can change from day to day.



Out on the ice you can:
•	Drill holes and set up your shanty to cut the wind
•	Jig your bait or lures to attract fish without spooking them
•	Use sonar or an underwater camera (when you can afford them) to read the water and find the best depth and species
•	Move to new spots when the bite slows, trading precious time for a chance at better fish

You’ll get warnings as your character cools down, and you can drink cocoa, use heaters, or move around to warm up. Ignore the cold for too long and your day – or your derby – can end in a darkly comic way.

Lifelike fish and 3D lakes
Fish behave differently by species, size, and depth. Perch and walleye hug the bottom, crappie and trout suspend higher, and predators like pike or muskies may cruise through looking for a meal. Stronger rods and larger holes are required for bigger fish, and careful control of line tension makes the fight feel more like the real thing.
•	3D lakes with varied shorelines and structure
•	Dynamic weather with falling snow and colder, windier days as derbies progress
•	Multiple lakes and species including panfish, perch, walleye, pike, bass, trout and more on different waters
•	NPC anglers and on-ice events – Other anglers may walk up with trade offers, new spots, and other surprises that can help or hurt your plans

Fair competition & progression
Derbies are designed so everyone earns their gear for that event. You start with shop credit, not a lifetime collection of items, so experienced players don’t bring years of upgrades into a new derby. The challenge is how quickly you can turn early-day catches into better equipment and, eventually, the biggest and most valuable fish.
•	Compete against results from other players under the same lake and weather conditions
•	Gem payouts for each fish in Free Fishing and for Derby results
•	Track your performance across multiple derbies and lakes

Free to play with optional upgrades
Ice Fishing Derby 2 is free to download and play.
•	Lake Pass unlocks all 22 lakes for free fishing and free exploration on foot
•	Derby Pro unlocks everything in the Lake Pass, plus Pro Derbies, plus snowmobile exploration for Pro Derbies and Free Fishing
•	Gems can be earned by playing or purchased, and are used to unlock lasting free-fishing equipment

Whether you want a thoughtful fishing sim with real decisions or a quick session trying to squeeze one more trophy walleye in before the clock hits zero, Ice Fishing Derby 2 brings the feel of tournament ice fishing to your phone or tablet.

Defend Against the Undead: Fortify your defenses and repel relentless waves of infected mutants. Deploy defensive structures, hunt down horrific mutant monsters outside the settlement, and protect your people from the endless horrors hungry for flesh.

name: Kain Cobra
desc: Enter the World of Kain Cobra Kain Cobra immerses iOS players in a high-octane action universe where precision, strategy, and fast refle

it.name: Kain Cobra
it.d:
Kain Cobra: Autogun Blaster is a 2D platformer roguelite shooter that mixes kawaii charm, 80s cyberpunk and a lazy anti-hero.

In the year 20XX, the two most powerful protectors of Planet Blue have been taken to a trial by the Intergalactic Federation for mismanagement, as 97% of the population lives in misery. The federation sent an Alien invasion to reset the Planet button and, Kain Cobra, the son of Buxios the darkest force protector, has the mission to save them, save the planet, and maintain the New New World Order in balance, yes... the New New World Order.

Thanks to Kain’s father, Buxios- the master of dark energy-, and his rival, Yaroth—the master of light—, 97% of the population lives in misery on Planet Blue. Now both are on trial by the Intergalactic Federation, which has sent an alien invasion to hit the reset button. Against his will, Kain steps up. His true motivation? Save everyone to keep things as it is while he chills in his penthouse and avoids doing actual work.

Kain Cobra is an intergalactic journey full of neon colors, kawaii charm, sarcastic humor, and of course, guns. In this chaotic adventure, you’ll join Kain Cobra, a lazy anti-hero more interested in cracking jokes than saving lives. But hey, someone’s gotta deal with the alien invasion, and guess who is the least busy.

Kain Cobra is a Casual Roguelite 2D Shooter Platformer, designed for Mobile and PC, blending simple controls with deep gameplay. 
Imagine Archero’s addictive progression system, Mega Man X’s control and beauty visuals, and Contra’s intense action—then add a protagonist that what he does best is sleep.

The controls? So simple, even Kain himself approves: move with a joystick, jump, dash, and let auto-shooting do the work. Oh, and there’s the Mojo Bullet Time Shield, activated with his sassy vibe.

Dynamic levels are packed with platforms and enemies that test your reflexes. As you progress, earn XP, choose between 3 perks, and hope for the best. Outside the chaos, customize Kain’s blaster with collectible stickers for unique power-ups and merge them for better ones. You’ll also have a Talent System with 12 skills to unlock.

The Creative Direction is as wild as Kain’s personality:
- 80s nostalgia (you know, neon makes everything cooler).
- Oddly Kawaii characters
and
- Esotericism?! (better don’t ask).

All wrapped in the Pixtor Art Style, a unique blend of pixel and vector art with vibrant gradients—created by our Art Director to look as eccentric as it sounds.

The interface has halftone and Memphis patterns with big buttons so even ET couldn’t get lost.

The sound makes you feel you’re in an 80s arcade with retro wave music and modern retro effects.

Now, the story: Universe 777, Planet Blue. It’s a mess. Thanks to Kain’s father, Buxios- the master of dark energy-, and his rival, Yaroth—the master of light—, 97% of the population lives in misery. Now both are on trial by the Intergalactic Federation, which has sent an alien invasion to hit the reset button. Against his will, Kain steps up. His true motivation? Save everyone to keep things as it is while he chills in his penthouse and avoids doing actual work.

So, let’s save the world... with guns. Lots of guns.

it.d:
تحتوي كمِّلنا على أقوى لعبة بلوت و جاكارو على الإطلاق، وهي من أشهر ألعاب الورق في العالم العربي.

بإمكانك اللعب بكل سهولة وبساطة مع لعبة كملنا بلوت و جاكارو، كما يمكنك التمتع بأكثر من ذلك مع تجربة فريدة من خلال العديد من المزايا التي نقدمها لك.

تُتيح لك كملنا فرصة لعب البلوت و جاكارو بكل سهولة مع لاعبين من جميع أنحاء العالم، والدخول في منافسة معهم
بشكل واقعي وسريع. اللعب في كملنا يتيح لك مزايا كثيرة، من ضمنها :

- تواجد اللاعبين في كل الأوقات :
تتيح لك لعبة بلوت و جاكارو في كملنا الفرصة للتنافس مع العديد من اللاعبين في أي وقت، حيث يتواجد آلاف المستخدمين خلال الـ 24 ساعة باليوم.
تجربة لعب سلسة وسريعة :
تتميز تجربة المستخدم في كملنا بكونها سلسة وسريعة، حيث يمكنك اللعب مباشرة من خلال زر "العب الآن" بدون خطوات أخرى، مايجعل وقتك في التطبيق أكثر متعة

- إضافة الأصدقاء واللعب معهم :
يمكنك إضافة أصدقاءك في كملنا ودعوتهم إلى جلستك الخاصة والإستمتاع باللعب والدردشة في تجربة استثنائية وممتعة

المنافسة مع أفضل وأقوى اللاعبين :
 مجتمع كملنا يحتوي على نسبة كبيرة جدًا من اللاعبين المحترفين ذو المستويات العالية مايزيد من حدّة التنافس ويرفع مستوى التحدي

 - ذكاء اصطناعي مميز :
تماما كما هو الحال مع تجربة اللعب مع لاعبين أذكياء، فالنظام مصمم لينافس بذكاء للقيام بالحركات اللازمة للفوز باللعبة.

- اللعب المشترك على جميع المنصات:
فرصة مناسبة للتنافس مع أصدقائك بأي شكل كان، حيث تتيح لك اللعبة فرصة مشاركة اللعب بين منصات تطبيقات الهاتف وموقع اللعبة.

 دعم فني سريع جدا:
إرضاء اللاعبين هو هدفنا لذلك نقدم لكم دعم فني خلال الـ 24 ساعة، كما نستمع إلى اقتراحاتكم لتطوير اللعب لمنح تجربة أفضل للاعبين.

 
ومن المزايا الخاصة التي تميز لعبة البلوت في كملنا:
ـ إمكانية القطع والقيد:
لعبة البلوت في كملنا هي اللعبة الأكثر واقعية والتي تعطيك إمكانية القطع والتقييد أثناء اللعب، تماما كما في البلوت الحقيقي.
 
 
تمتع بالمزايا الإضافية عند الاشتراك والحصول على كامل الإضافات التالية بشكل مستمر :
•         إنشاء وإدارة جلسات اللعب.
•         اللعب الحر و اتاحة القطع والقيد أثناء اللعب.
•         خاصية السوا.
•         ارسال التعابير.
•         الحصول على تذكرتين يوميا لكأس كملنا.
•         تجربة خالية من الإعلانات.
•         إضافة الأصدقاء.
•         الدردشة الخاصة مع الاصدقاء.
•         إمكانية تغيير اسم المستخدم.

it.name: Land Builder
it.d:
Land Builder is a puzzle game that lets you dream, a relaxing game that lets you expand your horizons, an adventure game that lets you build the world you want to see.

► AN ENGAGINGLY SIMPLE PUZZLE

A simulator game where you build a whole world piece-by-piece, Land Builder is designed around a simple principle – just place the hexagonal pieces next to any other piece on the board and expand your world the way you want to – but offers hours and hours of construction simulator fun and relaxing entertainment.

•  Place the next piece on the board and rotate it to match the pieces next to it in the way you want, defining the coastlines and urban boundaries on your map.

•  Each piece you place earns you stars, and the as the number of stars increases, you unlock new world-building features such as factories, farms, oil rigs, monuments, leisure facilities and other infrastructure that add further variety to your ever-growing world. 

•  You also earn improvements to different elements of the visual aspects of Land Builder, making the details of towns, countryside and the sea richer, clearer and even more attractive.

► A WORLD-BUILDING MEDITATION

The horizon is endless in Land Builder, and the simple simulator system is designed specifically to make this puzzle adventure relaxing rather than frustrating. 

•  Soothing music, gentle sound effects and attractive graphics all contribute to the game’s anti-stress properties, making playing the game more like a satisfying and absorbing meditation than a challenging and enervating puzzle.

•  There are no wrong answers or false moves in the game, and you can always undo your last move.

•  Whenever you have a few minutes free and just want to relax, you can dive into your own little world and enjoy the serenity and creative satisfaction of Land Builder.

► A PERFECTLY RELAXING ADVENTURE

Land Builder opens up a whole world of possibility that can fire your imagination and boost your creative impulses.

•  Combine elements of countryside, town and sea in any way that you want, building a world of little villages, a series of picturesque islands or a bustling seaside city – it’s entirely up to you how the landscape develops.

•  As you advance through the game and build out the world of your dreams, you also earn bonuses that increase your opportunities to alter and adapt the lands you have already constructed, allowing you to redesign the world you’re building or just smooth out any imperfections.

•  Zoom out to see the whole expanse of the world you’ve constructed or zoom in to see the beauty of each little piece up close.

Looking for a casual puzzle game that’s engaging, relaxing and creative? Download and play Land Builder now and get ready to expand your horizons.

it.name: League of Dreamers - My Story
it.d:
League of Dreamers is a collection of visual novels that allows you to choose the fate of your hero.

Immerse yourself in the incredible world of romantic stories we have created and feel like a full-fledged participant in them: the choices you make dramatically affect the development of the novel, allowing you to decide the fate of the hero of the interactive story.

Do you dream of making your own decisions in a romantic story? In our game you can:
 - Choose the appearance of your character from a variety of outfits and hairstyles in a fashionable wardrobe
 - Develop love relationships and go on dates with other characters
 - Make decisions that affect your destiny
 - Choose your favorite genre: fantasy, romance, dystopia, detective story, adventure and more!

New interesting romantic stories and short stories are constantly being added to the game and the existing ones are being updated:

SILENCE OF THE SEA:
The young Princess of the Sea goes on a dangerous journey to land to save the perishing Underwater Kingdom.


BLOOMING GARDEN
The life of young Miyamoto-san is like a fairy tale: loving and wealthy parents, studying at a prestigious metropolitan university and the prospect of a dizzying career in the orchestra. But what if one accidentally overheard conversation destroys the fragile idyll? Will the heroine be able to save herself when the whole world around is built on lies, intrigues and deceit?

GATE OF SAMAIN
A young and ambitious journalist travels to the distant Irish outback to make a report about Samhain, the Celtic holiday, the progenitor of Halloween. She longs to unravel the mysteries of ancient rituals and is ready to overcome any difficulties. However, on a night when the boundaries of the worlds are erased and spirits roam among mortals, she will face something that cannot be prepared for.

CHRONICLES OF ARC DRYDEN
Hard life in a world destroyed by man-made disasters, cruel rules and poverty - that's what the inhabitants of Ark Dryden see every day. The young hunter is a part of this system from birth and does not even imagine that very soon, one chance meeting will turn her life upside down and change the fate of Ark Dryden. She will face a stark choice: let the system continue to oppress the people, or try to bring tyrants to clean water, risking her life.

Immerse yourself in new worlds where you will become the main character! You are free to make your own choices and decide how your romantic story will turn out. Love, be inspired and dream with the League of Dreamers!

it.name: Lost Prison - Shelter Survival
it.d:
► WALKING IN A WASTELAND WONDERLAND

That’s how the song goes, right? Well, now it does, seeing as how the apocalypse has come and gone and the last remaining survivors, yourself included, are left to rebuild society, starting with the local jail! Unexpected, yes, but just because the world got laid to waste doesn’t mean that all crime stopped. Craft, build, and defend your prison hub as you rehabilitate inmates while also building a shelter and trying to survive in this idle prison RPG.
 
► THEY’RE IN THE JAILHOUSE NOW

This game combines all the fun of idle games, where you’ll craft buildings, workbenches, and more that will collect resources for you in the background, with the fun of RPGs as you work to clean up the area, manage and expand the prison, and become an all-around jail tycoon. Along the way you’ll also have a chance to help rebuild your world, one reformed criminal and beautified spot at a time. Don’t go soft yet through: you’ve still got to defend your territory and survive!

We think you’ll love:

● Crafting: Simple items can turn into deadly tools and crazy weapons in your hands, all it takes is a bit of skill and a touch of forward thinking. Collect all manner of items as you clean up the last dregs of chaos, and then use these to help build new prison wings, weapons, and gear. Your survival depends on it!

● Upgrading: Once you have your base items, don’t sit back on your laurels! Upgrade them to the max so no matter what the wasteland throws at your shelter you’ll be prepared. In addition to weapons and gear you’ll also need to ensure your survival by constructing buildings and then setting up defenses and protecting them. Who knows what’s out there!

● Exploring: As your need for resources grows, you’ll have to travel further and further afield to collect items to keep your prison running and ensure your survival. Enjoy the opportunity to see a whole new world post-apocalypse and explore all manner of mysterious places as you roam. Don’t be afraid of a little danger though, that’s usually where  you’ll find the best loot stashed.

● Growing: Grow your jail, your world, and even your character! The more you progress, the more skills will be unlocked, thus boosting your little guy and helping you survive.

● Playing: Your survival might be on the line, but this is still a game! You can enjoy this idle wasteland exploration game anytime, anywhere, as no internet connection is required. Squeeze in a little world building and jail building no matter what the situation.
 
► SURVIVAL OF THE SMARTEST

Test your post-apocalypse survival skills now in this fun and exciting idle game, where as one of the last survivors you’ll need to build a prison to rehabilitate the bad guys, maintain it, and make the world a little better in the process. Along the way build both your world and your character, explore exciting new landscapes, and move from surviving, to thriving. 

Download Lost Prison today to show that you’ve got what it takes!

it.name: Margonem Adventures
it.d:
Margonem Adventures is a unique pixel-art roguelike RPG that blends strategic deck-building with tactical combat. Explore handcrafted dungeons, battle fearsome enemies, and collect powerful loot as you build your ultimate hero. Every encounter requires careful planning, resource management, and skillful decision-making to survive.

Gameplay
In Margonem Adventures, players must construct and refine their deck of ability cards, which play a crucial role in battles. Every fight demands smart card usage, tactical positioning, and mastery of your wand, the only permanent weapon in your arsenal. Players can draw, play, and combine different cards to execute powerful attacks, defensive maneuvers, and unique effects.

Dungeons are not procedurally generated, meaning that each level is carefully designed to provide challenging and balanced encounters. Players must adapt to their surroundings, study enemy patterns, and use their deck strategically to progress.

Deck-Building and Combat
The game revolves around deck management, where players can unlock, upgrade, and modify their selection of cards. Each dungeon run requires choosing the right combination of attack, defense, and utility cards to counter enemies efficiently. With every battle, you refine your strategy, adjust your deck, and discover new synergies between cards.

Enemies come in different ranks—from standard foes to Veterans, Elites, and Champions, each presenting distinct attack patterns and abilities. Boss battles push your tactical skills to the limit, requiring precise card usage and adaptive strategies to emerge victorious.

Key Features
Deck-Building Strategy – Construct and optimize your deck to overcome increasingly powerful enemies.
Turn-Based Combat – Every move counts in this deeply tactical battle system.
Skill-Based Progression – Unlock new cards, refine your strategy, and build the ultimate deck.
Handcrafted Dungeons – Explore carefully designed levels, each offering unique challenges.
Unique Wand Mechanic – Your wand is your only permanent weapon, complemented by a variety of ability cards.
Varied Enemy Types – Face monsters of different ranks and strengths, requiring distinct strategies.
Equipment and Loot – Find and upgrade powerful items to enhance your abilities.
No Two Runs Are the Same – Experiment with different decks and approaches to master each dungeon.
A Fresh Take on the Margonem Universe
Set in the world of Margonem, this game brings a new perspective to the beloved MMORPG. While it retains the familiar fantasy setting, Margonem Adventures introduces a card-based combat system and deep strategic elements, making it a fresh yet recognizable experience for fans and newcomers alike.

Will You Master the Dungeons?
Victory depends not only on strength but also on strategy. Build your deck, refine your tactics, and conquer the ever-growing challenges that await.

Download Margonem Adventures now and begin your adventure!

Discover a magical world where every object hides a secret and every merge brings you one step closer to saving it. 

The vale of Dragonia was once a thriving magical realm until the evil Zomblins cast a curse of fog and darkness across the land. Now it's up to you to heal the world by merging everything around you: dragon eggs, ancient trees, fallen stars, mythical creatures, magical flowers, and countless treasures. Merge dragon eggs to hatch loyal companions, evolve them into mighty ancient dragons, and watch them roam your camp harvesting resources while you plan your next move.

MERGE DRAGONS! FEATURES: 

== Merge & Evolve Objects == 

• Merge 3 identical objects to evolve them into something rarer and more powerful then keep chaining, because the combinations go deeper than you'd expect 
• Explore 500+ unique objects across 81 challenges: dragon eggs, magical plants, ancient relics, fallen stars, coins, treasures, mythical creatures, and so much more
• Merge Life Essence to unleash healing energy and restore Dragonia's cursed lands piece by piece 
• Find hidden Gaia statues in each level and merge them to solve the puzzle and breathe new life into the world 
• Discover over 1,600 object combinations.

== Collect & Evolve Dragon Breeds ==

• Meet unique dragon breeds, each with their own look, personality, and special abilities 
• Evolve every dragon through growth stages, from a tiny hatchling all the way to a legendary ancient dragon 
• Unlike most merge games, your dragons are active companions: hatch them in your camp and they'll roam freely, automatically harvesting objects for you while you focus on merging 
• New limited-edition dragon breeds arrive with every bi-weekly themed event, the collection never stops growing

== Puzzles & Quests ==

• Over 180 hand-crafted puzzle levels, each with unique layouts, hidden secrets, and satisfying challenges that test your merge strategy 
• Nearly 900 quests to keep you busy and rewarded — complete them to earn rare items, dragon eggs, and valuable camp upgrades 
• Daily quests with Kala keep every session feeling fresh, with new goals and rewards every day 
• Hidden levels are scattered across Dragonia some players never manage to find them all

== Build Your Dragon Camp ==

• Your camp is your home base in Dragonia: build it up, decorate it, and expand it as you heal more of the land 
• Earn Dragon Power by merging objects and completing puzzle levels to push back the evil fog consuming your camp 
• Collect and restore magical structures, buildings, and decorations as you reclaim the land from the Zomblins
• The more dragons you hatch and evolve, the more your camp truly comes alive

== Play with Friends ==

• Visit your friends' camps, discover new strategies, and send gifts
• Join a Den, the game's guild system to play alongside a community of dragon defenders 
• Chat in real time, trade tips, and band together to tackle group challenges and earn exclusive Den rewards 
• Fresh bi-weekly themed events give your whole community something new to explore and collect

Nightfall: Kingdom Frontier TD is an adventure strategy tower defense game. It's a game about building a kingdom during the day and defending it from waves of attackers at night. You can ride out on your horse and lead the battle, and you can also rely on arrows from your arrow towers, and troops, which are created at any barracks you build, and which can then be led around and placed in useful spots with a few simple button presses. At night you defend, and every morning you get a shower of coins from any economy buildings you have and any coin-bearing monsters you've defeated, and you spend these coins on making your kingdom bigger. 

Build up your base during the day, defend it til your last breath at night. Build your kingdom during the day, strategically placing walls, towers, and barracks. Upgrade your defenses and train your troops to withstand the relentless attacks of darkness. When night falls, the battle begins. Take direct control of your forces, wielding powerful abilities to fend off hordes of menacing creatures. Fight bravely, for the fate of your kingdom rests in your hands. - Prove your strategic prowess and become the ultimate ruler.

With its simple yet addictive gameplay, stunning visuals, and endless replayability, Nightfall offers a unique and exhilarating experience for strategy fans.

- Dynamic Day and Night Cycle: Build and strategize during the day, then defend your realm against relentless attacks at night.   
- Intense Combat: Engage in thrilling, fast-paced battles with hordes of enemies.

Can you manage to balance building your economy and strengthening your defenses? Do you need more archers, sturdier walls or another mill? Will you hold off the enemies with your longbow or charge at them on horseback? The night ahead will be challenging, but there's nothing like watching the sunrise over your kingdom and surviving for another day.

desc: Introduction OnceWorld IPA is an immersive iOS game that invites players into a thoughtfully designed universe filled with exploration,

it.name: OnceWorld
it.d:
OnceWorld is a simple and casual 2D solo-play RPG.
Relive the charm of classic MMOs from the good old days — now reimagined for mobile with easy controls and deep progression!
Level up, reincarnate, raise pets, awaken equipment, collect materials, and battle in the arena — all in one nostalgic adventure.

It’s an RPG that brings the essence of those mid-2000s MMORPGs to your smartphone, blending nostalgia with modern convenience.

▼ Stat Distribution

Distribute points into seven basic stats to develop your character.
Points are earned as your hero levels up.
To reset your distribution, you’ll need a special item.

Stat meanings:

VIT – Increases HP

SPD – Attack speed & number of strikes

ATK – Physical attack power

INT – Magic attack power & SP capacity

DEF – Mainly physical defense power

M.DEF – Mainly magical defense power

LUK – Evasion & Physical Critical

▼ Weapons & Armor

Equip one weapon and five armor pieces.
Wearing all five pieces of a matching set grants a set bonus.
Use the heart icon at the top-left to toggle your favorite gear display.

▼ Equipment Enhancement

Use materials obtained during your adventures to enhance your gear.
Each enhancement attempt has a success rate — failure consumes the materials, but the item itself will never break.
Some special items can increase success rates.

▼ Accessories

Accessories grant special effects when equipped.
Defeating enemies while an accessory is equipped will level it up, enhancing its effects over time.

▼ Magic

Spend SP to cast powerful spells.
Magic attacks cannot be evaded and there are no critical hits.

Certain rare materials may further amplify spell power.



▼ Monsters & Pets

By carrying a special material, you’ll gain the ability to capture monsters.
Captured monsters become pets that grow stronger as they fight alongside you.
Some monsters learn skills as they level up.
These skills can activate even without being summoned, as long as the monster is accompanying you.

Pet switching can only be done at the Pet Keeper in your hometown.
Feeding specific materials will raise a pet’s stats.

▼ Monster Encyclopedia

Once defeated, monsters are added to the encyclopedia where their stats can be viewed.
Captured monsters will display a “Caught” mark.

▼ Materials

Materials are divided into three categories:

Normal Materials
　Used for equipment enhancement and trading.

Effect Materials
　Provide passive bonuses simply by owning them.
　Have a smaller carrying limit.

Key Items
　Only one can be held.
　Cannot be dropped or sold.

▼ Items

Items that grant various benefits during adventures.
You can assign them to shortcut slots for quick use in the field.
Swap registered items using the arrow icon beside the item list.

▼ Reincarnation

When your hero reaches the level cap, you can reincarnate.
Reincarnation resets your level but increases your level cap and available stat points, allowing for further growth.

▼ Abyss Corridor

A ranked mode that can be played a limited number of times per day.
Clear each floor by defeating all monsters as fast as possible — faster times rank higher.
Treasure chests appear as rewards on each floor.
Only Save Slot 1 is eligible for ranking participation.

▼ Arena

Watch monster battles.
Watch monster battles held several times a day.
Choose the strongest team from three teams and watch the battle.

Earn Arena Coins if your favorite team wins.
Try exchanging them for valuable materials at the Arena Shop.

▼ About the Kin-Slayer Rite ▼

The Kin-Slayer Rite
is a ceremony in which the target pet’s kin-bond, level,
and accumulated experience are all returned to zero
in exchange for enhancing its base stats.

A monster that undergoes this rite will gain experience
at a slower rate thereafter.

it.name: Papa's Freezeria To Go!
it.d:
Build and serve sundaes on the go with this brand-new version of Papa's Freezeria, with gameplay and controls reimagined for iPhone and iPod Touch!

You've just started a relaxing summer job at an oceanfront ice cream shop, but things get hectic when all of Papa Louie's customers arrive on the island!  You'll need to whip up delicious Freezer sundaes by pouring ice cream, adding mixables and syrups, blending sundaes, adding whipped cream and toppings, and don't forget the cherry on top for a perfect summertime treat!

You'll need to multitask between each area of the restaurant, with new controls designed to work just right in the palm of your hand.  Head to the Order Station to watch for customers waiting in the lobby.  Switch to the Build Station to combine ice cream and mixables for each sundae.  Jump to the Mix Station to mix sundaes until they're blended just right.  Hop to the Top Station to pour whipped cream and toppings before serving the sundae to your picky customers.  Each Station is a hands-on experience, where you'll need to drag, swipe, and tap your way through the sundae-building process.

Keep your customers happy to earn points and level up.  As your level rises, you'll unlock new toppings for the shop, and new customers will start to visit the Freezeria!  A well-crafted sundae also earns you tips, which you can spend on upgrades and decorations for the lobby!

** NEW FOR PAPA'S FREEZERIA TO GO**

Papa's Freezeria To Go is redesigned and reimagined for smaller screens, so your fingers won't get in the way of the action!

CONTROL WITH YOUR THUMBS - You'll switch stations using buttons in the corners of the screen, perfect for your thumbs.  You can also use buttons in the top corners to quickly switch Order Tickets, and you can view all of your Order Tickets in a zoomed-in mode for easy reading.

BUILD STATION - We've completely redesigned the Build Station for smaller screens.  The Pour Button and Bonus Meter are moved to the side and sized just right for your thumb, so you can watch the meter and tap at the right time without any fingers blocking your view.  When it's time to choose a mixable or a syrup, the entire screen is filled with large buttons so you can easily tap the correct item.

MIX STATION - We've fine-tuned the Mix Station upgrades to work even better on small touch screens.  Once you purchase the Blend Alarm upgrades, you can drag these large alarms and snap them onto any blender.  Booster Buttons are also large and easy to press, and you can even use multi-touch to boost multiple blenders at once!

TOP STATION - The Topping Bin carousel from "Papa's Burgeria To Go!" is back, which lets you top sundaes in a brand-new way!  Swipe the carousel of Topping Bins to choose the item you want to use, then grab the sundae cup to start pouring toppings evenly across the sundae.  You can also tap a button to switch to placeable items like cherries and cookies.  And with full multi-touch support, you can keep one finger sliding the bins and another tapping on the cup below, so you'll have those sundaes finished in no time!

NEW INGREDIENTS - We've added a ton of new ingredients that can't be found in the classic or HD versions of the game, including mixables, syrups, whipped cream flavors, and other toppings that you'll unlock as you play the game.  There's over 70 unique ingredients for you to discover!

**GAME FEATURES**

- Hands-on ice cream shop in the Papa Louie universe
- All new controls and gameplay designed for smaller screens
- Multi-task between building, mixing, and topping
- Shop to buy upgrades using your in-game tips
- 85 customers to unlock with unique orders
- Challenging Closers and Food Critic
- 120 in-game achievements to earn

**NOTE FOR iPAD USERS**

Papa's Freezeria To Go is designed especially for smaller screens.  If you're looking for large-screen gameplay, check out "Papa's Freezeria HD" for iPad!

it.name: Papa's Hot Doggeria To Go!
it.d:
Serve seasonal stadium favorites on the go in this new version of Papa's Hot Doggeria, with gameplay and controls reimagined for iPhone and iPod Touch!

You'll need to multitask between four areas of the hot dog stand, with new controls designed to work just right in the palm of your hand.  Head to the Order Station to take orders from your hungry customers in the lobby.  Switch to the Grill Station to cook and flip juicy hot dogs and sausages.  Move to the Build Station to add a variety of tasty condiments to your hot dogs.  Jump to the Pop Station to pour delicious drinks and pop some fresh popcorn to complete the meal.  Each station is a hands-on experience, where you'll need to drag, swipe, and tap your way through the hot dog crafting process.

Keep your customers happy to earn more points and level up.  As your level rises, you'll unlock new toppings for the shop, and new customers will start visiting the hot dog stand!  Well-crafted hot dogs will also earn you tips to spend in the Shop, and Mini-Game Tickets to use in the daily Mini-Game!

**NEW FOR PAPA'S HOT DOGGERIA TO GO**

SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special at Griller Stadium!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each recipe to earn a special prize!

NOW WITH HOLIDAYS - You'll be serving seasonal hot dogs throughout the year in Papa's Hot Doggeria To Go!  As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in the game will change, unlocking holiday-themed buns, sauces, toppings, drinks, and popcorn.  And don't worry when the air gets chilly and the baseball season comes to an end -- Griller Stadium also hosts hockey games during the fall and winter for year-round excitement!

NEW INGREDIENTS - The hot dog stand gets a ton of new ingredients for the holidays, including some new holiday ingredients that haven't been available in other versions!

CONTROL WITH YOUR THUMBS - You'll switch stations using buttons in the corners of the screen, perfect for your thumbs.  You can also use buttons in the top corners to quickly switch Order Tickets, and you can view all of your Order Tickets in a zoomed-in mode for easy reading.

COMPLETE YOUR COOKBOOK - All of your Special Recipes will be collected in the Cookbook, which has been redesigned for smaller screens.  Browse through each of your recipes, choose your daily special, and switch tabs in the cookbook to view a list of the ingredients you've unlocked so far!

PLAY MINI-GAMES - Foodini's mini-games have returned for Papa's Hot Doggeria, including the baseball favorites Strike-Out and Home Run Derby!  Earn Mini-Game tickets as you serve customers, and spend those tickets in the daily Mini-Game available after each workday.  Earn prizes in each Mini-Game which you can use to decorate your lobby, and keep playing Mini-Games to unlock Rare Prizes!

**GAME FEATURES**

- Hands-on hot dog shop in the Papa Louie universe
- All new controls and gameplay designed for smaller screens
- Multi-task between grilling, topping, drinks and popcorn
- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes
- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with their own ingredients
- Buy upgrades, furniture, and posters using your in-game tips
- Play 7 different Mini-Games using your earned tickets to win prizes
- Decorate your shop in the Lobby Editor
- 112 customers to unlock with unique orders
- 108 in-game achievements

** NOTE FOR iPAD USERS**

Papa's Hot Doggeria To Go is designed especially for smaller screens, look for Papa's Hot Doggeria HD for tablets!

it.name: Papa's Scooperia To Go!
it.d:
Serve delicious cookie sundaes on the go in Papa's Scooperia To Go!

-- ABOUT THE GAME --

You've lost your money and belongings while on a sightseeing trip to the big city, but Papa Louie is here to help:  He's just offered you a job at his brand-new ice cream shop in Oniontown!  You'll need to make and bake warm, gooey cookies, add scoops of delicious ice cream, and finish sundaes with syrups and toppings before serving them to your hungry customers.

-- GAME FEATURES --

NEW FEATURES - All of your favorite features from other versions of Papa's restaurants are now available in this "To Go" game, redesigned and reimagined for smaller screens!

SCOOPING SUNDAES - Use gestures to scoop dough for cookies and scoop ice cream for sundaes!  Slide your finger across a bin of cookie dough to make the perfect dough ball, and tap to dip your dough into delicious cookie mixables.  After baking, drag your finger in a circle to make scoops of ice cream to add on top of your cookie sundaes.

ORDER EVOLUTION - When customers like your sundaes and level up, they'll start ordering larger sundaes with two cookies and scoops!  Keep impressing your customers until they order giant three-scoop sundaes.  Some customers like picky Closers will even start out ordering larger sundaes.

CELEBRATE HOLIDAYS - As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays change in Oniontown, and your customers will order sundaes with new seasonal ingredients.  You'll unlock new mixables, ice cream, syrups, and toppings for each holiday of the year, and your customers will love trying new flavors!
 
SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Scooperia!  Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe.  Master each special to earn a special prize!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKERS - Play as Carlo Romano or Koilee, or create your own custom character to run the shop!  You can also show off your holiday spirit with a massive variety of holiday outfits and clothing for your workers.  Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!

SPECIAL DELIVERY - When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their order, and you'll hire a Driver to help you take and deliver orders to their homes!

COLLECT STICKERS - Complete a variety of tasks and achievements while playing to earn colorful Stickers for your collection.  Each customer has a set of three favorite Stickers: Earn all three and you'll be rewarded with a brand-new outfit to give to that customer!

DECORATE THE SHOP - Customize the Scooperia lobby with themed furniture and decorations for each holiday of the year!  Mix and match your favorite styles, or add items that match the current holiday so customers won't mind waiting longer for their food.

CLIPPING COUPONS - Missing your favorite customer?  Send them a coupon with the help of your friendly mailman, Vincent!  Customers love a good deal, and will promptly arrive to order another sundae.  Coupons are great for completing quests for Stickers and for strategically leveling up customers!

DAILY MINI-GAMES - Play Foodini's famous Mini-Games after each workday to earn new furniture for your lobby and new clothing for your workers.

-- MORE FEATURES --

Hands-on sundae shop in the Papa Louie universe
All new controls and gameplay features designed for smaller screens
Multi-task between making cookies, baking, scooping ice cream, and adding toppings
12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients
90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks
Tons of furniture and clothing to decorate your shop and workers
116 customers to serve with unique orders
Use Stickers to unlock new outfits for your customers
Over 120 ingredients to unlock

** NOTE FOR iPAD USERS **

Papa's Scooperia To Go is designed especially for smaller screens, look for Papa's Scooperia HD for tablets!

it.name: Parking Master Multiplayer 2
it.d:
Parking Master Multiplayer 2 takes the world of car parking to unprecedented heights!

Dive into an open-world adventure where car driving meets real car parking in a multiplayer experience like no other. Parking Master Multiplayer 2 isn't just another car parking game; it's a comprehensive car parking multiplayer adventure designed to fulfill your desires for real car driving and real car parking.

HUGE MAP, DIVERSE LOCATIONS
Navigate your car through cities, highways, and mountains. Each area offers unique car driving challenges, from drifting through tight corners to drag racing on the highways. The open-world of Parking Master Multiplayer 2 invites you to explore and master car parking in every environment.

OPEN-WORLD MULTIPLAYER
More than just car parking, this game is a car parking multiplayer extravaganza. Team up with friends or compete in drifting, drag, and race events. Show off your car driving skills in a dynamic open-world.

NEXT-GEN REAL GRAPHICS
Parking Master Multiplayer 2 pushes the boundaries of mobile gaming with next-gen graphics that bring your car driving and real car parking experience to life. Engage with real car driving physics and detailed interiors, making every parking, drift, and race feel like you're behind the wheel for real.

VARIETY OF CARS AND VEHICLES
Choose from over 120 vehicles, including bus, truck, police car, taxi, school bus, ambulance, fire truck alongside 4x4 offroad cars, classics, supersports, JDM cars and more. Whether you're drifting in a sports car or navigating car parking challenges in a truck, there's a vehicle to suit every car driving style.

CUSTOMIZATION, TUNING, AND UPGRADES
Elevate your car with endless customization options. Drag racing, drifting, and real car parking performance can all be enhanced with upgrades to the engine, brakes, exhaust, nitro, turbo and more. Tuning your car not only improves your driving experience but also prepares you for the competitive edge in car parking multiplayer events.

PARKING MISSIONS
Master car parking with over 250 levels designed to hone your parking skills. Each mission in Parking Master Multiplayer 2 challenges you to utilize your car driving knowledge, making you a true parking master.

CAR TRADING
Parking Master Multiplayer 2 introduces an exciting car trading feature within the multiplayer mode, allowing you to buy and sell cars among players.

RACING AND ROLE-PLAYING
Engage in thrilling race events or immerse yourself in the open-world with role-playing elements. Each aspect of Parking Master Multiplayer 2 is designed to offer a comprehensive car driving and parking experience.

EVENTS
Participate in Time Trial, Drift, and Parkour events in single-player mode. Explore the open-world of Parking Master Multiplayer 2 to discover secret chests and rewards.

Experience the ultimate car parking and car driving adventure with Parking Master Multiplayer 2 – a game that redefines real car parking in a dynamic open-world multiplayer setting. Completely free and designed for enthusiasts of drifting, drag, and race events.

it.name: Pascal's Wager
it.d:
August 19th, 2022
Newest add-on content, Dance of the Throne, is now available!
The Soul of Obsession carrying the will of all Demiurges has been summoned to Solas again, and it's here for revenge!
The leader of Demiurge, Elena, will be arriving as a playable character in this mode. Dance in a flurry of dual blades and experience a completely new challenge in Solas.

20th Aug 2020
"The Tides of Oblivion" DLC is available!
New story, maps and playable character.
Adventure with Jerold to explore the cursed Ichthyosauria!

■ Devices support:

- System run iOS 9 and above

- iPhone 6s and above

- iPad models with 2G RAM or more


■ Description

Pascal's Wager is an action role playing game with the style of dark fantasy. The game provides its players with top-notch picture quality and a feast for the senses that the mobile platform has never had before. In the game, the world is shrouded by dark mist, where light is dim and mysterious. People there become lunatic, and nobody knows the secrets behind that.
 
Players can play multiple characters to experience the strong storyline and reveal various hidden areas of the map. Along the way, they will fight unbelievable enemies, confront epic bosses, and embrace overwhelming death and truth. All the while, they'll be engrossed by a magnificent soundtrack performed by a world-class orchestra.


■ Features

- An incredibly Rich and Deep story, 20 or more hours of content

- Four operable characters, with different combat modes and skill trees

- Dozens of different enemies, bringing extensive experience of hectic battles

- Diversified NPCs, responding to independent subplots

- Three-dimensional map with multiple layers

- Cinematic performance and storytelling, fully voiced dialog

- Powerfully attractive soundtracks, performed by a world-famous symphony orchestra

- Full controller support to ensure the best possible gameplay experience

- Substantial post-launch DLC adding to the story and characters


■ Story

In ancient times, a natural disaster brought the Sun from high in the Sky to the depths of the Ocean, allowing a mysterious dark fog to blanket the World. 
 
Simultaneously, Colossi, beings that were revered by descendants, roamed the lands for the very first time. 
 
These Colossi, which emit the sparks of light that disperse the black fog, bring the only hope to mankind. 
 
Thousands of years later, humanity has long grown accustomed to following in the footsteps of these revered beings as they travel through the black fog. 
 
However, just as how the Sun was mysteriously brought down from the Sky, these Colossi have also began to fall mysteriously...
 
Terrence, a courier whom was expelled by the Church, has learned that his long estranged wife Teresa, may have some connection to the recent fall of the Colossi. 
 
Setting forth on a journey filled with anguish, deception and possible redemption, Terrence seeks to find his wife and the truth behind their World.

it.name: Pizza Ready!
it.d:
Pizza Ready! – Build a Restaurant Empire!

Welcome to Pizza Ready, a pizza game where you cook, serve, manage, and build a growing restaurant business. Start with one shop, take every customer order, and turn a small kitchen into a busy business empire. If you love food, idle, simulator, and tycoon gameplay, this game is for you.

Cook, Serve, and Grow

Prepare fresh pizza for every customer and keep the restaurant moving fast. Take each order, complete each order, cook food in the kitchen, add tasty topping, and serve a delicious meal before the line gets too long. Every order gives you money, profit, and a chance to upgrade your shop.

As owner and manager, you control the restaurant from counter to kitchen. Manage each station, improve every recipe, master the flow, and serve more customers. The better you manage your business, the faster your restaurant can expand.

Upgrade Kitchen, Equipment, and Staff

Build a stronger kitchen with better equipment, ovens, appliances, and stations. Each upgrade helps you prepare more meals, complete more orders, and make your restaurant more efficient. Upgrade equipment, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade each dish, and create delicious food that every customer will enjoy.

Hire chef and cashier staff to keep the shop running. Train your staff, increase order speed, and help every customer faster. Great staff, better equipment, and smart management help your business earn income, even while you are offline.

Become a Pizza Tycoon

Pizza Ready combines idle simulator gameplay with restaurant management and business growth. Collect money, boost profit, and unlock each level as your restaurant becomes bigger. Expand your store, design a better shop layout, and build an empire across new locations.

Every level brings a new challenge. Open another restaurant, upgrade every station, serve more customers, and become the ultimate pizza tycoon. Whether you enjoy a relaxing idle game, restaurant simulator game, clicker progress, or tapping game fun, Pizza Ready gives you a satisfying business journey.

Features

Build and manage your pizza restaurant, cook food, serve every customer, complete each order, earn money, upgrade kitchen equipment, grow business profit, hire staff, expand your shop, and enjoy idle progress online or offline.

Download Pizza Ready. Cook delicious pizza, manage every order, upgrade your kitchen, expand your business, and become the greatest pizza tycoon!

desc: Planescape: Torment on iOS brings one of the most narrative-focused role-playing games ever created to iPhone, offering a unique experie

it.name: Planescape: Torment
it.d:
Reviewers say:
"Planescape: Torment is a wonderful game, and its Enhanced Edition is a splendid, unobtrusive, beautifying update."
-Geek & Sundry

"Planescape: Torment still stands tall as a landmark masterpiece that can continue to age gracefully, now on your phone or tablet"
-Touch Arcade

"Planescape: Torment is a timeless classic, the Enhanced Edition just makes it better" 
-Bleeding Cool

Uncover secrets of past lives in this story-rich, tactical roleplaying game set in Sigil, a dark fantasy city at the heart of the Dungeons & Dragons multiverse. Explore the planes, survive combat alongside a party of bizarre companions, and solve puzzles unlike any ever seen in the genre.

The original Planescape: Torment was released in 1999 to widespread critical acclaim. It won RPG of the Year from multiple outlets for its unconventional story, characters, and amazing soundtrack. Since then, millions of Planescape: Torment fans have enjoyed exploring the strange and dangerous city of Sigil and surrounding planes.

Discover an incredibly rich story and a unique setting unlike anything else in fantasy. Defeat strange and alien creatures, engage in rich dialogue, and explore the dark and dangerous Planescape setting in this 50+ hour RPG classic.

This is Planescape: Torment like you’ve never seen before.

Story:
"What can change the nature of a man?" 

You are The Nameless One, a hulking figure covered in scars and tattoos collected over the course of countless lives—none of which you can remember, but are now coming back to haunt you. You are prodded awake by Morte, a floating skull and keeper of secrets, to embark on an adventure taking the Nameless One from the dirty streets of Sigil into the mysterious Outer Planes and even into the depths of Hell itself.

In your search for answers, you'll find companions matching the bizarre nature of the planes: a chaste succubus who can kill with a kiss, a confused crossbow-wielding cube, a suit of armor animated by a spirit demanding JUSTICE, and more. With these companions and others at The Nameless One’s side, you will explore worlds in search of answers, all to discover that some destinies cannot be escaped and some memories cost more than an immortal should be willing to pay.

Beamdog’s Enhanced Edition titles are designed for 7 inch and larger tablets. We recommend this title to iPhone players using the iPhone 7 or iPhone 7 Plus.

Features
-Enhanced Planescape: Chris Avellone, Lead Designer on Planescape Torment, has partnered with Beamdog to curate gameplay updates, bug fixes, and enhancements to best capture his original vision for the game.
-The Planes Await: Planescape is a setting you've never experienced before, filled with strange magics, bizarre adversaries, and Dungeons & Dragons locations from across the multiverse.
-Conversations to Remember: Encounter personable items, philosophic undead, and rat hiveminds while walking the planes with the strangest collection of allies ever seen in an RPG.
-Pick Your Path: Character creation is just the beginning. The Nameless One can change his class, alignment, and even gain new abilities based on your choices.
-Remastered Music: The full Planescape: Torment soundtrack has been remastered in-game to add more depth to Sigil and the multiverse.
-New Tablet Interface, Same Planescape Feel: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition has been designed with tablets in mind. Open and close side menus with a touch, select dialog options with handy conversation buttons, and make tactical decisions with a brand-new action indicator.
-A Planescape For Today: Modern features such as tab highlighting, area zooming, combat log, quickloot, and more!
-Play It Your Way: Enable Enhanced Edition features as you desire or turn them off to experience Planescape: Torment in its original glory.
- Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition is available in English, French, Polish, German, and Korean. Note: Korean translations are text only. Voice-overs are played in English.

Play as a young girl accompagnied by her loyal animal companion on a rescue mission accross beautiful landscapes filled of mysteries.
Solve puzzles, evade machines and navigate strange environments full of dangerous creatures, all in a beautiful sci-fi hand-painted universe.
A planet that used to be a place of undisturbed balance between human, nature, and animal has now become something else entirely.
The disharmony that had been in the making for hundreds of years has finally arrived in the form of a faceless army. But this is not a story about war. This is a story about a vibrant, beautiful planet –and the journey to keep it that way.

- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)

it.name: Project Entropy
it.d:
Commander,
       This universe is a wild frontier filled with danger, mystery, and rare resources critical to humanity's survival and expansion among the stars.
       You'll discover planets torn apart by savage sandstorms and prowled by colossal dreadwyrms… frozen blue oceans locked in eternal ice… crimson worlds bubbling with lava and ash… and lush green jungles teeming with towering alien flora and strange, elusive creatures. And beyond these lie countless uncharted planets, just waiting for you to conquer. Assemble your fleet. The unknown awaits.

Commander,
         Out here, you build your fleet your way. Recruit terrifying alien lifeforms, unleash ruthless machines, or blend the two into a force no one dares to challenge. There are no rules, only victory.
        In this vast galaxy, you'll clash with alien empires, forge alliances with powerful factions, and survive sudden ambushes from rival fleets. The universe is chaotic and unforgiving, but we believe in you.
       Out here, legends are born. This is your moment to crush your enemies, conquer new worlds, and rise to rule the stars. Now go, Commander. Your conquest begins.


PROJECT ENTROPY FEATURES:

ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW: As an Interstellar Trial Commander, you'll encounter and recruit incredible species from across the universe, harnessing their unique technologies to fortify your forces. Carve your own path through the stars.

JOIN A FLEET COMMAND: You have the freedom to create a team that perfectly suits your playstyle and strategy, and upgrade them with powerful weapons to build the best fleet command to increase attack and defense. Customize your vehicles and weapons.

CUSTOMIZE EPIC HEROES: Uncover the stories of war heroes as your epic journey unfolds. Recruit heroes to your team for a united front and upgrade their skills.

DEEP AND DYNAMIC COMBAT: Prepare for the Grod! These alien beasts have been roused. As an Interstellar Trial Commander, you'll need to harness advanced technology and cunning strategies to quell the threat.

VERSATILE WARFARE: Command powerful tanks and aircraft, each with their own unique tactical advantages. Whether you're facing Grod swarms or enemy forces, your strategic choices will define your legacy.

ADVANCED ARMAMENTS: Choose from a vast array of high-tech weaponry, including patrolling tanks and combat mechs. Shape your armory to suit your gameplay style.

REAL-TIME BATTLE STRATEGY: Engage in real-time multiplayer combat. Battle against other alliances on the region map for control of territories and resources, and encounter a wide variety of environments, creatures, and technologies throughout the game.

ALLIANCE WARFARE SYSTEM: In times of crisis, allies are invaluable. Join an alliance and fight for the glory of your comrades-in-arms.

GLOBAL INTERACTION: Converse with players from around the world, breaking down language barriers with our powerful real-time translation system.

In Project Entropy, you can command your troops and recruit the best crew of heroes in this sci-fi and RPG legends game. Navigate through the galaxy by engaging in epic space battles, discovering new civilizations, and completing challenging missions. Join the fleet; the cosmos is calling. A myriad of planets await your conquest. Seize your opportunity to become a legend among the stars.

Rise of Hexpires: New Age – Real-Time Strategy Designed for Mobile

Rise of Hexpires: New Age brings classic RTS gameplay to mobile with fast, accessible controls. Build your town, gather resources, train an army, explore the map, and conquer enemy factions on a hex-based world.

REAL-TIME STRATEGY MADE SIMPLE AND SATISFYING
• Start with a Town Center and limited resources.
• Build Lumber Camps, Mines, and Farms on suitable tiles.
• Workers automatically gather resources.

EXPLORE AND EXPAND
• Construct Outposts to reveal new parts of the map.
• Every new building lights up nearby tiles.
• Discover treasures, ruins, enemy camps, and more.

TRAIN YOUR ARMY AND FIGHT
• Build military structures to unlock new unit types.
• Train soldiers and command them to attack marked tiles.
• Battles switch to auto-combat; win to capture the tile and earn bonus rewards.

DEFEND AGAINST ENEMY WAVES
• Enemy attacks happen at regular intervals.
• All your available soldiers defend automatically.
• If your army falls, the map resets—but your long-term progress remains.

PERMANENT PROGRESSION
• Earn Research Points (RP) through exploration and victories.
• Unlock permanent tech upgrades that stay with you even after losing a map.
• Access new buildings, units, and resource types as you grow stronger.

MAP-TO-MAP CAMPAIGN
• Defeat the enemy faction on each map to move forward.
• Face new enemies, new resource layouts, and fresh strategic challenges.

Build, expand, conquer, and grow stronger with every attempt.
Experience a streamlined mobile RTS with long-term progression and endless strategic choices.

it.name: Shadow Knight Ninja Games RPG
it.d:
Challenge your skill with new mode & new boss!!!

Harmonia used to be a bright world of all races, where Human, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man and Elf live in peace together. One day, when deep desires arose, the dark forces ascended from hell, invading the world, that tragedy struck every Harmonia citizen and made everything sink to the depths of despair.

Play the role of Noah - a Shadow Knight, you need to make your way through the hell gate, fight evil enemies, defeat the immortals of Darkness and bring back the light to Harmonia. You will find Ashley and Lucius - your companions on the journey saving Harmonia!

Download and Join the fight now!

GAME FEATURES:

▶ The True Feeling of an Action RPG Game
Experience the action RPG game feeling with hack and slash gameplay in the dark fantasy world setting. There are 10 maps from The Stream City, Shadow Forest to Capitals of The Mortals, and they are still updated. 

▶ Watch out the monsters and bosses!
With the absence of light, evil reveals its true form. 
Monsters in each place have different shapes, skills, and stories behind them. Sometimes you have to take them down even when you're the weaker. Beware of skeletons, elves that can control your body and your mind, be sure to use skills with the right combo, dodge their attack wisely. 

Bosses have their stories as well. They are giant Kings of the dark lands with sturdy physique, robust strength, and particular abilities. Facing them requires more than just powerful stats. 

▶ Fight with multiple choices
Fight the way you want as you can choose your own unique heroes, determine your favorite fighting style among slashing a big sword, shooting slugs, or piercing invisible spears. In each match, you can pick 2 characters to play and they can be readily switched. 

Keep in mind that Each hero can knock the enemy up, knockdown, toss back,...
Dodging smoothly, controlling enemies effectively, and using skills combo calmly is the key to win every battle

▶ Embark on a horrid but fascinating adventure!

Not only you, we also get bored with the limit of horizontal gameplay only mode. 
In Shadow Knight, you will go on a journey with different terrains by running, climbing, jumping, where you will confront more danger, further difficulty, and additionally have chances to get more rewards in return as we put some easter eggs and hidden rewards along the way. 

▶ Interact with others and show the world your skills

You will be immersed in endless dark fantasy shadow battles. Besides towns, forests, dungeons, as an online game, you can interact with others unlimitedly, engage in endless battles with tremendously competitive and merciless battlefields such as Survival, World Boss, PVP Arena,... These features will be available soon!

▶ Gear Up In Style
Collect the best weapon, equipment, rune from hundreds of items, then fully customize your Shadow Knight to stand out from other knights. Join the adventure and create the craziest combats 'cause Your Knight, Your Style! 

▶ Easy In Upgrading
While you're away, your knights are still being trained and collecting resources to upgrade. When you're back, they will be stronger, gain new levels, learn new skills. Grow and train a powerful team and ready for battles!

ACE THE SHADOW!

* Follow us on social media for more information and get support:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnight.Official
Email: support@fansipan.hk

* Notice:
Shadow Knight is an online game and requires a stable internet connection.

▶ Shark Universe: Ocean Predator Adventure
Dive into the deep blue and become the ultimate sea predator!

In Shark Universe, you control a fierce shark on a nonstop feeding frenzy, exploring an underwater world full of fish, whales, humans, and countless creatures to eat, attack, and evolve.

Enjoy this thrilling offline arcade adventure and rule the ocean as the most terrifying predator alive!

▶ EAT & SURVIVE
The ocean is your hunting ground. Swim freely, devouring anything that moves — small fish, divers, whales, and even ships!

The more you eat, the stronger you become. Your mission is simple: eat or be eaten. Grow stronger with every bite and rise to the top of the ocean food chain. No Wi-Fi? No problem — play completely offline anytime.

- Devour hundreds of sea creatures
- Attack humans, boats, and rival predators
- Feed your hunger and dominate the ocean

▶ EVOLVE YOUR BEAST
Start as a baby shark and evolve into a monstrous sea dragon! Every evolution unlocks new forms — Great White, Hammerhead, Megalodon, and more — each with unique abilities and deadly jaws. Upgrade speed, health, and damage to crush everything in your path.

- Unlock powerful shark species
- Upgrade stats for increased strength
- Evolve into legendary ocean predators

▶ EXPLORE SEA & ISLANDS
Discover stunning underwater worlds and mysterious islands. From coral reefs and wrecked ships to deep trenches and hidden caves, every zone holds treasures and dangers.

Leap above the waves to attack planes or uncover secret areas in this massive 3D open-world ocean.

- Explore oceans, seas, and islands
- Encounter submarines, divers, and giant predators
- Find hidden treasures across the underwater world

▶ ATTACK & DESTROY
Challenge the strongest bosses of the sea! Battle giant whales, armored submarines, and monstrous deep-sea beasts.

Each victory proves your dominance and unlocks new rewards. Smash, bite, and destroy everything — the ocean belongs to you!

- Fight huge sea monsters and bosses
- Destroy ships, submarines, and aircraft
- Unleash your inner predator

▶ UPGRADE YOUR SHARK
Make your shark stronger with powerful upgrades! Boost attack power, swimming speed, and biting strength to survive tougher enemies and hunt bigger prey. Earn coins and resources to keep evolving your unstoppable beast.

- Upgrade speed, health, and damage
- Strengthen your shark to explore deeper oceans
- Become the ultimate sea predator

▶ OFFLINE FUN & IDLE ACTION
Your shark keeps eating and earning rewards even when you’re away! Enjoy relaxing idle mechanics as your beast auto-swims and hunts on its own. Perfect for players who love offline and idle progression.

- Auto-swim & idle eating
- Earn offline rewards
- Enjoy nonstop action anytime

▶ BECOME THE LEGENDARY PREDATOR
This is more than a fish game — it’s an ocean survival adventure where only the hungriest survive.

Attack, explore, evolve, and conquer the sea filled with life, danger, and endless excitement.

it.name: Sky: Children of the Light
it.d:
Three hearts, one infinite canvas, together we illuminate a starry night.

Dear Van Gogh is an interactive journey through the life, art, and inner world of Vincent van Gogh. Travel inside his paintings to witness his earliest uncertainties, his Paris awakening, and the fragile beauty of his final years. Discover and feel the weight of a life lived, and the invisible hands that held it together. 

From the award-winning creators of Journey, join a global community and play through an unforgettable experience of empathy, connection, and art.

A Story Most People Have Never Heard
Everyone knows the legend of Van Gogh. Few know the full story.

At the heart of Van Gogh’s life was a decades-long exchange of letters with his brother, Theo, filled with doubt, wonder, and unfailing devotion that made Van Gogh’s art possible in the first place. Now you can discover that bond firsthand. Guided by Johanna, Theo’s wife and the quiet force who carried Vincent’s legacy forward, you will piece together the story behind the paintings and discover that what we call genius was also, and always, an act of love.

Dear Van Gogh is their story, as much as his. 

Art You Can Walk Through
Explore beautiful, playable environments made from Van Gogh's best known paintings, from sunlit fields in the Netherlands to the glowing night skies that only he could imagine. Each and every landscape is a work of art in motion, rendered in his bold, expressive brushstroke style and alive with the emotion he poured into every canvas.

Paint the World with Others
Just as Van Gogh was never truly alone in his creative journey, neither are you. Use Sky’s signature brushstroke mechanic to collaborate with other players, bringing color and light back to the world together. Because some things are simply more beautiful when shared.

Return to the Real World, Evolved
At the end of the experience, pause and look back at what you experienced. You’re welcome to reflect on and share what you observed and what moved you. Dear Van Gogh in Sky is more than just a game, it is an invitation to see one of history’s greatest artists in a new light, and question everything you thought you knew about the story behind the art.

Winner of:

-Best Visual Design: Aesthetic (Webby)
-Best Gameplay & People's Choice (Games for Change Awards)
-Audience Award (Game Developers Choice Award)
-Best Indie Game ( Tap Tap Game Awards)

it.name: Solar Smash
it.d:
Harness the power of space and embark on an epic journey of creative destruction with Solar Smash, the ultimate physics-based sandbox simulation game!

Simulate the Universe: Control the forces of nature and become a cosmic architect as you explore the boundless expanse of space. Craft and customize your own planetary systems, from the tiniest asteroids to massive gas giants.

Two Thrilling Game Modes:

Planet Smash: Annihilate planets and moons with over 50 different weapons! Choose from lasers, meteors, nukes, antimatter missiles, UFOs, battleships, space fighters, railguns, black holes, space shibas, orbital ion cannons, supernovas, laser swords, giant monsters, celestial beings, and even defensive weapons like shields and defensive satellites. Destroy everything in your path in both familiar solar systems and exotic star systems with artificial megastructures like ring worlds and giant moons with planetary force fields.

Solar System Smash: Dive deep into physics simulations and unleash your creativity in a mode that allows you to play with one of three star systems, including our very own Solar system. Or create your own star systems, complete with planets and set their orbits. Experiment with planetary collisions, create black holes to disrupt orbits, and engage in endless cosmic simulations.

Realistic Physics: Experience the breathtaking beauty of scientifically accurate gravitational interactions and celestial mechanics. Witness the awe-inspiring consequences of your every action as you set celestial bodies on collision courses, triggering cataclysmic events that defy imagination.

Unleash Your Creativity: It's your universe to shape and reshape! Build, experiment, and destroy to your heart's content. The power to craft worlds or obliterate them is in your hands. What will you create, and what will you obliterate in your quest for cosmic dominance?

Destruction Like Never Before: Tear apart planets, cause supernovas, and create black holes that consume everything in their path. Embrace the chaos and experience the visceral satisfaction of witnessing your cosmic masterpieces crumble to dust.

Intuitive Controls: Dive into the cosmos with easy-to-use controls designed for both beginners and experienced players. Explore the infinite reaches of the universe and let your imagination run wild.

Solar Smash is the ultimate sandbox for those who crave both the creative and the destructive. Are you ready to make your mark on the cosmos? Download Solar Smash now!

Indonesia (IGRS) Age Rating: 13+

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio
NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center
