desc: Solo Knight IPA File Overview Solo Knight IPA File gives iOS players access to a fast and immersive action RPG that focuses on dungeon c

it.name: Solo Knight
it.d:
Solo Knight is a hardcore Diablo-like game. Come and create your Build from more than 200 pieces of equipment and 600 perks. Massive contents await you to explore.

- Introduction:
Solo Knight is a Diablo-like game designed for players who love to hack and slash. You are going to explore the hazardous underground world and fight against different monsters and strange creatures. You can use resources that you collect such as gold coins, equipment, and smelt stones to strengthen yourself. Try to create your own BD via a different combination of perks, runes, and affixes.

-Game Features:
·  200+ equipment—— every equipment comes with an exclusive skill
You can collect more than 200 pieces of equipment. Each of them comes with a unique skill. You can change your equipment at any time you want. Let’s try some different combinations and experience a wide variety of battles.

·  90+ runes——  DIY skills! It‘s all up to you!
Besides a lot of equipment skills, you can also use different runes to change and strengthen the effects of your skills. For instance, runes can be used to increase the number, size, and speed of projectiles. It also allows your weapon to penetrate more enemies, or split up more projectiles when you hit your target. What's more, you can even summon a totem to fight for you.

·  600+ perks——create a growth route of your own.
In this game, you will have two basic perks to represent offense and defense respectively. More than 600 perks provide you with countless options and possibilities. Try to plan your growth route with limited perk points, and find the best way out.

·  Leave it offline—— you can strengthen yourself as well.
We designed offline gameplay for our players who are limited by time. In addition to online gameplay, you can also get offline benefits based on your equipment level. Even if you don't start this game for a long time,  you will collect resources as well.

·  Seasons—— massive contents await you to explore!
The new season will be released every 3 months. In the new season, you are going to experience a brand new system, gameplay, equipment, and perks. All these new elements allow you to create a unique BD. Up to now, we have released several seasons, and we still keep designing more for our players.

-Story:
It was a silent night with heavy snow. My uncle who was one of the prestigious members of Solo Knight unexpectedly came home from a mysterious place. He took out a shabby parchment which was said to be written by Max, the head of Solo Knight.
There was a blurry mark on that paper. My uncle told me that was the very place where his old friends were located.
Everything's going so adventurously. We finally arrived at the location. What we were facing was way beyond our imagination. Monsters and strange creatures were hiding in the darkness. We had to struggle to survive. Coincidentally， we discovered a vast and miraculous underground world.
My story as a knight starts from now on. Endless darkness and abyss await us to explore together.

Below Zero is the next chapter of Subnautica, the underwater survival open world set on an alien ocean planet.

What's new in the 2.4 update:

- Seasons! Survive through summer, autumn, winter and spring.
- Community Content search box and filters added
- Poplar trees
- Explosion ground shake
- Werewolves interact with block and open doors
- Dirt slabs and stairs
... and many more: full list of changes on our website

You are marooned on the shores of an infinite blocky world. Explore, mine resources, craft tools and weapons, make traps and grow plants. Live through all four seasons. Tailor clothes and hunt over 30 real world animals for food and resources. Build a shelter to survive cold nights and share your worlds online. Ride horses, camels or donkeys and herd cattle to protect them from predators. Blast your way through the rock with explosives. Build complex electric devices. Craft custom furniture. Paint. Use pistons to build moving machines. Farm crops and plant trees. Make and combine 40 different items of clothing to protect yourself from attacks and weather or to look smart. Play with up to 3 friends using split screen. Possibilities are infinite in this long-running sandbox survival and construction game series.
 
Enjoy!

it.d:
■ Survive with real-time tag battle!
TagTag Survival is a roguelike action RPG where you switch between 3 characters in real-time to defeat endless waves of monsters.

■ Features

• 3-character tag battle system

• Unique roguelike skill builds every run

• Collect anime-style heroes with special abilities

• Optimized controls for fast-paced mobile gameplay


Can you survive to the end? Build your squad and enter the battlefield now!

▶Defend the Otherworlds, Mercenaries!◀
Monsters are pouring out of the Mana Crystals, threatening not just one world—but all worlds!
To combat this menace, a massive organization known as "UNION" has been established.
UNION promises generous rewards and recruits elite mercenary squads from every dimension. Many squads now fight tirelessly to protect the realms.

Now, a young girl named **Zula** has just become a mercenary captain. With her team ready to depart, their airship slowly begins to ascend...
What adventures await this new squad? Join them and find out!

"TagTag Survival" is a roguelike survival RPG set in a rich otherworldly universe. Combine powerful skills, battle fierce enemies, and survive to the very end!
Collect unique characters and equipment, and switch your lineup at just the right time to seize victory through smart strategy!

■ Game Features

• **Dynamic Combat Skill Tree**  
Mix and upgrade a wide range of skills to create your own unique fighting style.  
To counter monsters empowered by Mana Crystals, strategic skill combinations are key!

• **Unique Character Synergies**  
Utilize each character’s class skills and special abilities to create powerful team combos.

• **Tag Battle System**  
Survive, defeat, and grow—all at once! Swap characters mid-battle using dimensional transfer to counter enemy patterns.  
Using the right skills and managing HP wisely is the key to victory.

• **Varied Enemies and Boss Battles**  
Face off against everything from standard monsters to powerful bosses!  
Analyze their patterns and conquer them to earn valuable rewards.

• **Multiple Battle Modes**  
Level up your squad through Arena, Treasure Hunts, Daily Dungeons, and the Tower of Trials!

• **Collection & Growth**  
Collect and enhance characters and gear to build your very own ultimate mercenary team.  
Become the true warrior who will overcome the darkness of the Mana Crystals!

Download now and lead the most powerful mercenary squad across the otherworlds!  
The battle to reclaim peace from the darkness begins now.

Are you ready for the action-packed 2D tank warfare? Welcome to the Tank Stars, one of the best battle tank games. Find the right shooting angle and unleash your iron force on your foe's war machines! Make the right shot quickly or you'll lose!

CHOOSE YOUR WEAPON

There are dozens of deadly rockets and guns available at your arsenal. Nukes, freezing bombs, tasers, railguns, plasma cannons, and many more! Pick the right weapon to eliminate your targets as quickly as possible. Burn all the enemy's tanks to the ground!

COLLECT WAR MACHINES

Want to have the coolest tank ever? Win the crazy tank battles, get tons of gold, and collect all the awesome tanks of the past & future! T-34, Abrams, Tiger, Toxic Tank, Atomic Launcher, and many other dead machines are waiting for you in your military base.

WIN ONLINE TANK BATTLES

Command your war machine in multiplayer tank battles with thousands of players all around the globe! Don't get shell shocked and dominate on the online PvP arena – show the world who is the true tank star!

JOIN TANK TOURNAMENTS

Get prepared for tough PvP tank battles to win extra coins and unique upgrades! In the Tournament mode, you'll meet real challenges and waves of skilled opponents ready to unleash all their war potential to destroy you! 

Command your heavy armored mad tanks and dominate the battle arena! Join the bustling Tank Stars community and enjoy one of the best tank games! Play for free right now and become a real tank hero!

it.name: Tap Titans 2 - Hero Legends
it.d:
Tap to play one of the most downloaded idle RPG games with +10,000,000 installs. 

Winner of 2016 Overall Awards - Best Mobile Game of 2016 based on Best Mobile App Awards.

Grab your sword, assemble a team of heroes, and join Sword Master on an epic adventure to defeat the mighty Titan Lords in over 150,000 levels. 

Tap to slay hundreds of Titans with your sword as you journey through the land in this clicker RPG adventure. Upgrade your blade for new gear, gather pets, and enter multiplayer clan raids with users across the globe to leave your legacy as the Ultimate Sword Master. 

Strategically progress your heroes and Sword Master’s skills to attack legendary Titans and fight nonstop monsters in this quest to bring peace back to the land. 

WITH TAP TITANS 2 YOU CAN
▶ PLAY the full idle RPG game experience offline and on the go.
▶ TAP to defeat +150 all-new Titans in 14 gorgeous, hand-drawn realms
▶ RECRUIT heroes and loyal pets to help you withstand the endless Titan onslaught
▶ UNLOCK unique skills to power up strategically to fight monsters
▶ PRESTIGE and cash in your progress for powerful old artifacts and become stronger
▶ COLLECT equipment to customize your hero's blade & armour to suit your play style
▶ CREATE or join clans to defeat the almighty Titan Lords in multiplayer mode.
▶ ADVENTURE down scenic paths during seasonal events to collect rewards and exclusive gear
▶ COMPETE against other players from around the world in global tournaments to show off your strength and earn amazing prizes

WHY PLAY TAP TITANS 2?
▶ RAIDS introduce a whole new way to fight multiplayer with your clan, featuring new titan bosses with unique abilities, powerful rewards, and a new combat system.
▶ HERO SCROLLS granted from completing raids allow you to upgrade your Sword Master further than previously possible.
▶ TITAN LORDS have entered the raid arena with a brand new way to fight! Break off individual armour segments to expose the weaker skeleton underneath these super monsters.
▶ CARD COLLECTING is the newest way to increase your Swordmaster’s power, granting powerful passive and active abilities to slay Titan foes in this idle clicker game.
▶ DUST is your new collectible currency for upgrading and crafting collectible cards to battle.
▶ CLAN UPGRADES including clan XP and Raid Tickets give you more reasons to connect and play with fellow Sword Masters and fight online.

ABOUT TAP TITANS 2
Swinging a mighty blade, Sword Master rose from his eternal slumber to find monstrous Titans wreaking havoc across the realm. As he broke the chains that bound him, he vowed to wage war with the Dark Lord and hunt any Titan that stood in his path. With ninja-like reflexes and an army of heroes at his aid, Sword Master is on a new nonstop tapping adventure. 

As you charge across the land in this idle action game, assemble a team of heroes with unique abilities like Lance, the Knight of Cobalt Steel, to fight beside Sword Master as he faces any monster in battle. Tap tap alongside your heroes as you strategically power up to make your way across 14 hand-drawn realms. Upgrade or craft custom gear and unlock unique hero abilities in this incremental action RPG. Trade-in your blade for lethal weapons and cause maximum damage to Titan Lords in raids or through tournaments. Tap tap tap to victory as you adventure through event takeovers and unlock extraordinary prizes. Along the way, join or build your clan with Sword Masters worldwide in this free to play clicker game.

[ TRY BEFORE YOU BUY ]

Welcome to the FDI, Mr Tanner.

Time to clear your head, work through your hangover and start your first day as an Operator. There are plenty of cases to solve. Assist our field agents using your computer console and ingenuity to bring criminals to justice. Ready to make the world a better place?

Investigate Crimes: Solve cases such as murders, missing people, and cyber attacks.
Use FDI Software: Analyze evidence and find clues using cutting-edge tools.
Dig Deeper: Follow the evidence as it twists and turns, no matter where it leads.
Uncover the Truth: Each case is a mind-bending story to unravel, so take notes.

Assist Our Field Agents
When our field agents need support, they'll call you. Help them by fact-checking, searching databases, identifying killers, and more. Each case will have evidence to evaluate, and it's your job to dig into documents, connect the clues, and solve the mysteries.

Cutting-Edge Software
You have the finest FDI software to help with those challenging cases. Tap through the Video and Photo Analyzer, Citizen and Vehicle Database, ChemScan, Notepad and a fully functional Terminal at any point to find out what you need.

In Truth, We Seek
To find the truth, you must follow the evidence and see where it leads, no matter how unsettling. But don't poke into unauthorized areas without first notifying your superiors.

FDI's Most Wanted
WARNING: Any new information on the cyber criminal known as HAL should be reported to your supervisor immediately. For the safety of the general public and your fellow agents, please keep all evidence confidential.

///// TRUST NO ONE /////
[End Transmission]

it.name: This Is the Police 2
it.d:
IMPORTANT 
DOES NOT support: iPhone 5S, iPad Air, iPad Mini 2 & 3 and iPod Touch

Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more!

Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience.
Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control.

Take charge of the Sheriff’s department.
Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department.

Engage in tactical combat.
During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life.

Become a true detective.
Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought.

Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’!

■ Tiny Cafe, a cute and cozy cafe game featuring cat customers and winner of the 2024 BIC Best Casual Game Award, has officially launched!

A new cozy cafe game from the developers of Forest Island, a relaxing animal game downloaded by 7 million players who love beautiful nature and animals!

[Game Introduction]
1. Run your own cafe for free!
Open and run a cafe with Dolce, the world's smallest barista mouse, and the cat Gusto.
Brew drip coffee with beans from Gusto's own roastery.
The aromatic smell of coffee will attract cats to your cafe.

2. A casual idle simulation cooking game that's easy to play and simple to learn.
Leave the cute staff to their own devices to work hard brewing coffee.
The showcase will automatically fill with freshly baked donuts.
Install new tools such as espresso machines, ovens, and more, and add cakes and other items to the menu.

3. Serve coffee to cat customers
Treat cat customers to heart-melting hot coffee and sweet treats.
Make sure they like your cafe and become regulars.
Enjoy additional stories of your regulars along with their daily or special menu orders on Catbook, the feline social network.

4. Cute part-timers working hard to create your menu items
Watch as cute little mice scurry around making espressos, lattes, and other drinks and desserts.
Set up various rest areas, like a bathhouse, and earn Cheese when staff use them.
Collect Cheese to hire more staff and grow your cafe.

5. 30+ managers with different skills at each grade to help you run your cafe
Call in a special manager with the special delivery service.
If you're lucky, you'll get a top-tier Platinum-grade manager with 4 stars.
When you put managers in your cafe who have a good synergy with each other, your cafe will grow even faster!

6. Go global!
Gather a loyal customer base and harness word of mouth on social media to expand your cafe to cities like New York, Paris, Hawaii, Seoul, Tokyo, and more.
Become a global franchise brand like many you know from the human world.
With a trusted manager and well-trained part-timers, your cafe dreams will certainly come true.

7. Soothing cafe music
Enjoy cafe music from the developers of the global hit, Forest Island.
Listen to them and you'll feel refreshed after a tiring day or a depressing mood.

[Official Instagram]
Follow Tiny Cafe's official Instagram for special events, announcements, free merchandise, and more.

it.name: Tokaido™
it.d:
Discover the digital adaptation of Tokaido, the boardgame phenomenon that has already sold more than 350,000 copies worldwide, and has been translated into 16 languages!

// A magnificent voyage --------------------------------------------

You are a traveler, in the heart of ancient Japan, walking the legendary East Sea road from Kyoto to Edo, trying to make the trek as fulfilling as possible. Discover the most magnificent landscapes, taste numerous culinary specialties, acquire rare and precious souvenirs, bathe in hot springs, visit the temples, and meet other travelers…. Tokaido is a rite of passage for the heart, walking in serenity and contemplation.
But do not be fooled by the peaceful appearance of the voyage, because you will have to demonstrate stronger strategy than your opponents if you want to win!
Whether you sneak along as a messenger, a geisha, or even a ronin, you must discover as many hidden marvels as you can along the road, so your journey is the most satisfying of all!

// Unique ambience --------------------------------------------

Discover characters and scenery in a new light!
Developed by Funforge, original publisher of the boardgame, the video game offers an entirely new graphical experience! Whether you are a first-time fan, in love with Japan, or merely a curious newbie, the digital version allows each player to discover the celebrated Tokaido road in a new form.
While Tokaido retains the famous clean graphic design of the boardgame, it offers unprecedented immersive 3D, realtime graphics, all accompanied by a superb and unprecedented soundtrack, composed specifically for the game.

// Play anywhere, solo, with two, or with the whole world --------------------------------------------

Available for smartphones and tablets, Tokaido offers several play modes for infinite replayability:
- Solo against the AI
- Pass & play
- Online multijoueur
Languages supported: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Chinese.

// A worldwide success --------------------------------------------

** Tokaido, nominated for People's Choice Award, at the 14th International Mobile Gaming Awards 2018
** Tokaido, nominated for Game Artist Award, at the 14th International Mobile Gaming Awards 2018
** Tokaido, nominated for the Hra roku, in 2014
** Tokaido, nominated for the Golden Geek Best Board Game Artwork, in 2013
** Tokaido, nominated for the Golden Geek Best Family Board Game Nominee, in 2013
** Tokaido, nominated for the Gioco dell’Anno, in 2013

// In the press --------------------------------------------

** The Dice Tower: "That’s a gorgeous looking game."
** Gameosity: "The animations are gorgeous, the gameplay is smooth."
** Dageeks: "…the app looks like it’s going to break the tradition of just bringing the digital experience of playing a board game."
** Gameblog: "Everything has been polished: the UI has been completely redesigned for a video game experience."
** TechArtGeek: "It's beautiful, it flows, it's poetic. To make it short this digital version perfectly completes and honors the board game."
** Ludovox: "Graphically speaking, you have to admit that it's gorgeous, giving credit and honor to the original board game edition."
** Tric Trac: "To me Tokaido is therefore a game that invites to travel, and that is perfectly adapted to be played quietly in family."
** Kiss My Geek: "Everything has been carefully modeled in 3D, the UI is flawless and each feedback goes through well designed ergonomics."

Subscription options

In Tomb of the Mask we offer you the following subscription options:

it.name: Turboprop Flight Simulator
it.d:
FLY MILITARY AIRCRAFT AND PASSENGER AIRLINERS:

"Turboprop Flight Simulator" is a 3D airplane simulator game, in which you pilot various types of modern turboprop aircraft, and also drive ground vehicles.


THE AIRCRAFT:

* C-400 tactical airlifter - inspired from the real-world Airbus A400M.
* HC-400 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-400.
* MC-400 special operations - variant of C-400.
* RL-42 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-42.
* RL-72 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-72.
* E-42 military early warning aircraft - derived from RL-42.
* XV-40 concept tilt-wing VTOL cargo.
* PV-40 private luxury VTOL - variant of XV-40.
* MV-40 special operations VTOL - variant of XV-40.
* PS-26 concept private seaplane.
* MS-26 special operations seaplane - variant of PS-26.
* C-130 military cargo - inspired from the legendary Lockheed C-130 Hercules.
* HC-130 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-130.
* MC-130 special operations - variant of C-130.


HAVE FUN:

* Learn to fly with training missions (teaching the basics of flying, taxiing, takeoff and landing).
* Complete various missions.
* Explore the plane's interior in first-person (in most levels, and free-flight).
* Interact with various items (doors, cargo ramp, strobes, main lights).
* Drive ground vehicles.
* Load, unload, and airdrop supplies and vehicles with the cargo planes.
* Takeoff and land on improvised runways (and airports, for sure).
* Fly without restrictions in free-flight mode, or create flight routes on the map.
* Perform refueling on ground and mid-air refueling.
* Use JATO/L (Jet Assisted Take-Off and Landing).
* Fly in varied time-of-day, fog and wind conditions.


OTHER FEATURES:

* FREE airplane simulator game updated in 2025!
* NO MANDATORY ADS! Only optional, rewarded ones in-between flights.
* Good 3D graphics (with detailed cockpits for all the airplanes).
* Realistic physics for flight simulation.
* Complete pilot controls (including rudder, flaps, spoilers, thrust reversers, auto-brakes, and landing gear).
* Multiple control options (including mixed tilt sensor & stick / yoke).
* Multiple cameras (including cockpit cameras with captain and copilot positions).
* Close to realistic engines' sounds (turbines and propellers noises recorded from real airplanes).
* Partial and total aircraft destruction (clipping wing tips, full wings separation, tail separation, and main fuselage breakage).
* Several islands with many airports.
* Selection of measurement units for air speed, flying altitude, and distance (metric, aviation standard, and imperial).

it.name: Vinland Tales: Viking Survival
it.d:
Vinland Tales is a Survival Action RPG with casual sandbox game mechanics and big village-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, frosty surprises in dark winter and opportunities to raid until the Armageddon comes knocking.

=== Survival Games casualized ===
Chop every tree, hunt rabbits and deer, stone and copper mining - resource management are a staple of every survival game, and Vinland Tales is no different. However, we threw away the hunger games in favor of a replenishable health pool so you can start every game session on exploration instead of just preventing yourself from dying.

=== Build your own Viking colonial village ===

From setting up your first camp to building an entire Viking village, you'll be pretty busy making a home for yourself and all the rescued clansmen that turn up to settle as workers. Manage their resource refining jobs, build houses and enhance the settlement with wells and defense structures.

=== Sharpen your axes ===
Craft your weaponry from a selection of clubs, swords, bows, spears and more. Upgrade them to make pointy ends even more pointy, embellish your craft with gems and their attributes, and poke around at the armies of the Ragnarök, bandit bosses and other generally unfriendly folk.

=== Explore Vinland and its harsh nature ===
Dive into dark medieval history and unravel the story of Leif Eriksson, known as the great Viking explorer; lead the siege to the strongholds of other survivor players, or build the mining shafts and worship sites for Thor and Odin. Crafting history has never been more fun!

As developers of Vinland Tales, we hope you enjoy our casual approach to the Survival RPG genre. We are always happy to get in touch directly with our players and gather feedback - hop onto our Discord: https://discord.gg/TutCRbZryR

Thanks and have fun surviving!

it.name: Virtual Families 3
it.d:
The sequel to the smash hit mobile game “Virtual Families 2” is here!

A note from the developer:
Hi, and thanks for taking a look at Virtual Families 3! We have been working on it for quite a while, and we’re very happy to be able to finally share this new chapter with everyone. 

With Virtual Families 2 being downloaded over 40 million times, we are so grateful to our dedicated fans and humbled by all your kind words and support! You are the reason we set out to make the third chapter of Virtual Families! We spent years crafting an experience would live up to your expectations, and we plan to continue to listen to all your feedback to make it better with every update! 

Before you skip down to the bullet points and screenshots, let me say a few quick words about this game, and life simulations in general: I love life simulation games. I have always been passionate about designing them, and almost everything that comes out of Last Day of Work is a life sim of some kind. This one, in particular, thrills me so much because it is designed to have a life of its own: unpredictable and so different each time I play it, and each time another player plays it. I love that the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it, and your experience with the game might be wildly different from your friends’ experiences.

Designing this type of game, however, has its own special challenges. The main challenge is that EVERYTHING in life is a great idea to add to a game like this. There are SO many great ideas, and we simply cannot put them all in at launch. So, while I hope the game captivates you as much as it does us, there will inevitably be things that you feel are missing and you would love to see added (tell us!).

We plan to update the content in this game. We want to add improved pets that are more like real life, more storyline, more events, tons of new things to buy, and the list goes on and on. We will also continue to tune and deepen all the game's inner workings that control happiness, health, and everything else. While the game has been balanced to be playable for free and without purchasing anything, we hope that you will find something compelling enough in the game to give us support so that we can continue to create fun new updates.

Enjoy Virtual Families 3! Please visit our Facebook page and our forums to give us your own amazing ideas and suggestions, and don’t forget to check in on your little family or they will get very sad. :)

With sincere gratitude, 
Arthur Humphrey
Lead Designer, Last Day of Work



Virtual Families 3 has all this and more:
* Adopt a little person and start a family. Make babies and pass the house on to the kids!
* Train your little people to behave as you wish by praising and scolding them.
* Create your family the way you choose, with the same diversity that you would expect in real life!
* Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them.
* Runs in True Real Time. Your little people continue to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off.
* Your little family is in your time zone! Is it getting dark where you live? Your little family is probably getting ready for bed then...
* Highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same. 
* Make babies. Cure illnesses. Help nurture and guide generations of your family.
* Restore the house. Remodel rooms and add new ones. Shop and decorate.

Recommended for people who enjoy Virtual Villagers and other life simulation games!
Visit our Official Virtual Families site at www.VirtualFamilies.com for instructions, strategy guides, and much more! 


LDW games have been awarded with:
* Sim Game of the Year – Game Tunnel
* The Zeebys – Gamezebo
* Parents Choice Recommended Award

* iParenting Media Award
Check out our other hit games like Virtual Town, Fish Tycoon, Virtual Villagers, and more at https://itunes.apple.com/us/developer/ldw-software-llc/id297606729

Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

In Where Winds Meet, Chinese martial arts meet a seamless open world. Roam vast landscapes, uncover hidden ruins, and descend into layered underground catacombs. Here, freedom is yours, but every action has its weight. Cause chaos, defy the law, and face bounties, pursuit, even time behind bars. desc: Wrestling Revolution 3D IPA is a preventing recreation wherein you’ll get to play as your favorite wrestlers. In this recreation, you co

it.name: Wrestling Revolution 3D
it.d:
The Wrestling Revolution rumbles into the 3rd dimension - now featuring BOTH aspects of the business in ONE shared universe! A wrestling career challenges you to take shots in the ring, whereas a "booking" career allows you to call the shots backstage - promoting entertaining matches every week for ratings. Seeing each side of the curtain gives you an even better appreciation for the other, and ensures you'll never grow bored of wrestling again! Both modes are available to play for free, with the option to upgrade to enjoy the "Pro" experience with no ads or limitations.

And if playing Pro isn't enough, a separate "Backstage Pass" allows you to play God by saving your changes to all 9 rosters before pitting them against each other in dream matches of your own creation! With 4 pages of rules to mix & match - including up to 20 wrestlers in rings of any shape or size - the only limit is your imagination. You can also blow off steam with no pressure by revisiting the 8 weeks of free shows from the game's promotional tour. Not to mention the interactive training process that teaches you how to lock up in the first place.

BASIC CONTROLS
The game features an interactive tutorial that you are advised to play through, but the basic controls are as follows:
CURSORS = Movement (double-tap to dash)
A = Attack (with a direction to aim high, without to aim low)
G = Grapple
R = Run
P = Pick-Up / Drop (with a direction to throw)
T = Taunt / Pin / Referee duties
EYE = Change focus / Turn opponent around
HEALTH METER = Switch character
CLOCK = Pause / Change camera angle

PERFORMANCE
Although every effort has been made to keep performance as high as possible, some devices may benefit from a visit to the Options menu to fine tune the display:
- The number of characters is perhaps the biggest factor so consider turning off referees and setting a limit on the match size.
- If you don't want to sacrifice numbers, you can sacrifice polygons instead and opt for "Basic" character models (no fingers).
- The ropes are surprisingly demanding and you may squeeze in an extra character if you make them "Static".
- Turning off shadows and reducing crowd sprites may also help.

Enter the zombie apocalypse in Zombastic — a zombie survival game, zombie shooter, and roguelike action game where endless zombie hordes attack from every direction.

Move your hero, shoot zombies automatically, collect experience, and choose one of three abilities every time you level up. Upgrade your skills, unlock powerful weapons, create devastating builds, and fight to survive each wave. Simple controls get you into the action fast, but only smart ability and weapon choices will carry you through the toughest zombie survival battles.

Explore a fantastic world packed with zombie hordes, dangerous bosses, powerful gear, epic loot, and nonstop shooting action. Build your hero, improve your equipment, and become the ultimate survivor.

SHOOT ZOMBIES 

Fight through intense zombie shooting as massive hordes surround your hero. Keep moving, dodge enemy attacks, and shoot zombies before they overwhelm you.

This top-down shooting game combines auto shooting, horde survival, and roguelike progression, offering new ability choices, new builds, and new ways to fight in every run.

Face stronger enemies, larger zombie hordes, elite monsters, and dangerous zombie bosses as you progress. Master powerful weapons, use upgraded abilities, and claim valuable rewards after every battle.

UNLOCK POWERFUL ABILITIES 
 
Choose one of three cards every time you level up.

Unlock new abilities or upgrade the ones you already have. Call air support, throw axes and boomerangs, deploy drones, unleash lightning attacks, and destroy waves of zombies with powerful explosions.

Upgrade your main abilities to level 5 and evolve them into super abilities. Combine active and passive skills, create powerful synergies, and experiment with different builds for every zombie survival challenge.

UNLOCK AND UPGRADE WEAPONS 

Collect powerful weapons and equipment to survive the zombie apocalypse.

Unlock new guns, upgrade gear, and increase your equipment’s rarity. Equip gloves, belts, helmets, armor, and boots to boost your damage, defense, and combat power against stronger zombies.

Create the perfect loadout, destroy zombie hordes, defeat zombie bosses, and push deeper into the campaign.

it.name: Zombies Clicker
it.d:
Imagine a world where the zombies have taken over... but YOU are one of the last humans left! In this awesome action-packed game, you step into the boots of a brave survivor, fighting back against waves of super scary, super aggressive zombies who are hungry for one thing: BRAINS! (Ew, right?!)

But don’t worry - you’re not just running around with a stick. No way! You’ll get to upgrade your weapons, unlock crazy new ones, and build the ultimate zombie-smashing gear! Whether it’s a lightning blaster, freeze gun, or mega rocket launcher - you’re gonna need some serious firepower to stay alive!

This isn’t just one tiny level. Nope! You’ll move across a giant map filled with dangerous places, hidden secrets, and zombie hideouts. Beat levels to unlock new zones - like spooky forests, haunted cities, creepy labs, and more! Every area brings new challenges... and even bigger, badder zombies.

Here’s the cool part: you’re not just a fighter - you’re a thinker, too! Use points and parts you collect to research new weapons and tools. Maybe you’ll unlock a flamethrower, or even some robotic armor to help you take on those zombie bosses!

Your human isn’t just going into battle in PJs. You get to equip gear for your head, torso, arms, legs, feet, and hands. Want a helmet that gives you more defense? Or gloves that make you reload faster? What about super speedy boots or armor that shocks enemies when they hit you? You can mix and match gear to build your perfect zombie-fighting outfit!

Each battle is full of action - you’ll need to dodge zombie attacks, blast your way through hordes of monsters, and collect loot along the way. Open crates, find coins, discover rare items, and power up your survivor to the max!

Face Crazy Zombie Bosses!
Not all zombies are the same. Some are fast. Some are huge. Some spit goo (gross!). And then... there are the boss zombies. These giant monsters have powerful attacks and weird powers, but if you beat them, you’ll get awesome rewards!

Don’t worry if you’ve never played a game like this before - the controls are simple and fun! But the more you play, the smarter you’ll get. Build your strategy, pick the right gear, and become the ultimate zombie-destroying hero!

Are you ready to save the world? Grab your gear, power up your weapons, and join the fight against the zombie invasion!

The world needs a hero… and it’s YOU!

Fill your zoo with a wide variety of animals, from small cute animals to majestic wild animals. Feed, care for, and interact with your cute animals to keep them happy and healthy. Every animal in your zoo feels like part of your family.

Start with a blank canvas and build your dream zoo park. Customize every corner with habitats, facilities, and decorations to make your animal zoo truly unique. From lush landscapes to cozy corners, your creativity will bring your animal kingdom to life!

COMPLETE QUESTS AND ACHIEVEMENTS

PLAY OFFLINE, ANYTIME, ANYWHERE

No internet? No problem! Enjoy this offline zoo game and manage your zoo world on the go.

Perfect for players of all ages who love animal games, animal care, and zoo simulation.

Planet ÆRTH is toast. Literally shattered into space CHONKS. Thanks to the MOONLINGS… tiny chaos gremlins who thought crashing their MOON into the ÆRTHLINGS’ home planet was a “good idea.”

The ÆRTHLINGS had to go into deep cubernation just to ensure their survival, but the destruction was so violent they were ejected from their world and into ours.

In the aftermath of the MOONCRASH, the ÆRTHLINGS, stranded on EARTH, are scattered across our world, waiting to be returned to ÆRTH and awakened from cubernation.

Now it’s up to you to put ÆRTH back together and bring all the ÆRTHLINGS back home while defending against those pesky MOONLINGS.
	•	Each of the ÆRTHLINGS has their own unique attack and MUTÆTION tree.
	•	Collect and scan all 24 ÆRTHLINGS Genesis Collection NFC-enabled figurines (available at Amazon, Big W, EB Games, Target and more!)
	•	Can you find the four limited edition Seed Series I figurines? Available at special launch events from 28 September.
	•	Trade ÆRTHLINGS figurines with your friends to expand your collection and earn MUTÆTION points to evolve your ÆRTHLINGS.

Starting off on a CHONK of ÆRTH, you’ll explore, expand, chop, smash, and craft your way through survival challenges, and rescue stranded ÆRTHLINGS who may or may not remember what happened to their beloved home planet.

Meanwhile, the MOONLINGS keep showing up to steal the ÆRTHLINGS’ gear, cause trouble, and generally be the annoying little trolls they are.

	•	Build your collection of ÆRTHLINGS by trading the NFC-enabled figurines with friends.
	•	Explore, Expand & Survive while putting the pieces of ÆRTH back together. Discover a world of diverse biomes full of surprises.
	•	Craft Gear & Build Tools to fix CHONKS of ÆRTH (and defend your gear).
	•	Outsmart the MOONLINGS. They’re sneaky, loud, and not half as clever as they think they are.
	•	The epic story of saving a planet has never been this ridiculous.

ÆRTH is broken. The heroes are… underdogs. The enemies are ridiculous little menaces. And somehow, YOU are in charge of fixing it all.

Download ÆRTHLINGS and prove you’ve got what it takes to rebuild ÆRTH (and maybe troll some MOONLINGS along the way).

Join Alto and his friends and set off on an endless sandboarding journey to discover its secrets.

Soar above windswept dunes, traverse thrilling canyons, and explore long-hidden temples in a fantastical place far from home.

Along the way, you’ll grind across vines, bounce atop hot air balloons, ride towering rock walls, and escape mischievous lemurs – all while uncovering the desert’s many mysteries. 

Features:

• A standalone experience. Alto’s Odyssey is the follow-up to the critically acclaimed Alto’s Adventure, but you don’t need to have played one to enjoy the other.

• Easy to learn, difficult to master. At the heart of the Alto series is an elegant one-touch trick system. Chain together combos, and complete 180 goals —  all with intuitive controls.

• Explore Biomes. From the dunes, to the canyons, to the temples, explore a rich and diverse landscape, with each area boasting unique visuals and gameplay.  

• Newfound heights. Discover secrets in the sky with hot-air balloons, moving grind rails, and wall riding.

• Master the elements. In addition to dynamic lighting and weather effects like sandstorms and shooting stars, the desert is home to swirling wind vortexes and rushing water.

• Meet Alto and friends. Unlock six unique characters, each with their own attributes and abilities.

• Zen Mode. Complete with its own serene soundtrack, this relaxing mode distills Odyssey down to its purest elements: no scores, no coins, and no power-ups. Just you and the endless desert. 

• Photo Mode. From the pause screen, get behind the lens and take stunning photos of your trip through the desert. Pinch, swipe, pan and zoom to frame the ideal shot, and share them with friends and family.

• Original music and handcrafted audio. Headphones recommended!

• Universal app with iCloud support. Play on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, and your progress will always be in sync.

Alto’s Odyssey is a premium game with no ads or in-app purchases. Purchase once, play forever.

it.name: Arcane Arena: Tower Defense TD
it.d:
Welcome to Arcane Arena TD, a tactical, competitive tower defense PvP game where every choice shapes the TD battle. Build your tower defense strategy, defeat rivals in real-time PvP, and rise through arenas!

Forge your battle deck with legendary tower, skill, and heroes, place perfect paths, and win the TD battle with an epic defense strategy. Every PvP battle challenges your TD strategy. Defend your base from relentless enemy waves longer than your rivals, or crush them before they break through your defense.

BUILD YOUR STRATEGY
Create your battle deck from dozens of tower, skill, and heroes. A sharp defense strategy and the right synergy make every TD battle a victory!
• Towers: Build a tower mix with air and ground targets, stuns, slows, and area damage, so you’re prepared for every enemy type. Select 6 tower that best fit your defense strategy and upgrade each tower with tower cards you earn from PvP battles.
• Heroes: Choose class-matched heroes to support your tower. Upgrade heroes with hero shards from TD battles and amplify your defense strategy.
• Skills: Use powerful skills to defeat enemy waves and turn the battle in your favor at the perfect moment. Upgrade your skills with skill cards collected from TD battles for an even stronger tower defense strategy.

REAL-TIME PvP BATTLE
Face an opponent in a live and fair tower defense battle. Since both sides fight the same enemy waves, the match becomes a duel of strategy. Tactical tower placement, clever defense paths, epic skills, and trick cards form your TD strategy; that’s how you win the PvP tower-defense battle. Hold your defense longer than your rival does, or wipe out every enemy to claim victory.

STRATEGY MEETS LUCK
During each TD battle, choose one of three random tower drawn from your battle deck. Place the tower in the best position and adapt your defense. Smart picks and a flexible defense strategy keep your line of defense unbreakable.

SHAPE THE PATHS, SHAPE THE BATTLE
Control the enemy route with path units. Bend, extend, and shape the road to multiply tower damage and maximize defense uptime. Know your tower stats and ranges, then design a path that fits your TD strategy. Infinite path options mean infinite tower defense ideas.

TRICK CARDS FOR DOMINANCE
Use trick cards to disrupt your rival’s TD strategy. Create pressure, force mistakes, and prove your tower defense mastery. In tight PvP TD battles, a single trick play can secure the win.

LIVE EVENTS, QUESTS & REWARDS
• Explore new maps, arenas, and TD chapters as you level up. Climb the PvP leaderboard and face tougher enemy waves.
• Join events, challenges, and tournaments to earn rewards that upgrade tower, skill, heroes, and strengthen your overall defense strategy.
• Complete daily and weekly quests, gather medals across the season, and unlock even more power for your defense strategy.

CLANS & TEAM PLAY
Join a clan to complete clan quests together. Request donations to power up the tower faster and donate to teammates to earn gold. Coordinate TD strategy, share tower builds, and prepare for higher-tier PvP TD battles.

• Addictive, action-packed gameplay

it.name: BagMaster Isekai – Bag Battle
it.d:
One minute you’re just chilling, playing your favorite game, and then next suddenly you’re IN the game! Welcome to the world of isekai, where you, the player, get to experience being transported to a whole new world. Here you’ll be helping the local piggies defeat waves of enemies in this delightful turn-based RPG. Collect and merge items in your bag to create awesome weapons, explore dungeons and castles, battle bosses, and test your strategy skills: on your mark, get set, oink!
 
► SURVIVAL OF THE SMARTEST

In this roguelike RPG, you’ll have a chance before each wave of enemies to try and max out your weapons by merging them and using synergy to create bigger, better, and badder equipment. You’ll also have a chance to pick which buff you want to add at the end of the battle, allowing you to create and build on a strategy. The fun never ends in this role playing isekai game as you also get to explore new territories and grow your character!

Fun features:

◾Bag it up – A key mechanic of this turn-based role playing game is your backpack. Use it to both store your gear as well as merge individual pieces to create stronger weapons and equipment.

◾Waves on waves of enemies – as all good tactical strategy games go, this one too features tons of waves of increasingly strong enemies and bosses for you to test your ideas and might out on. That also gives you a chance to change tactics if you feel like your survival is at risk! Between battles you can make little adjustments that will add up over time and help you win… if you’re smart.

◾Turn based strategy – that’s right, all those little buffs and weapons merges will either help or hinder you, and there’s no way of knowing if you picked the right battle plan until you’re facing down a horde of bosses. That’s the true joy of this type of roguelike RPG game!

◾Roguelike goodness – As you wipe out your enemies and fight for survival, have fun exploring the various levels and learning more about your new world. Navigate through the maze of monsters as you level up and get to know your piggy overlords. The roguelike mechanics will make this isekai role playing game feel familiar for fans of the genre, while also being accessible to newer players.

◾Fun in the sun – despite all the strategizing and merging and fighting you’ll be doing, this game is still about having fun after all! Build out your character, explore new realms, and of course, enjoy the great graphics and sound effects. With short battle waves you can always find time to squeeze in a fight or two!

► THE OINKIEST TACTICAL STRATEGY GAME

Come one, come all, and let yourselves be transported to an exciting new world thanks to this roguelike role playing game. Use your magical bag to create the ultimate weapons as you seek survival by making the right choices each round. Let the turn-based roguelike mechanics lead the way as you battle your way through this dungeon crawler tactical strategy game and prove your might.

Bridge Constructor Studio is the latest in the best-selling series. Test your engineering skills in this physics-based puzzle game, combining the best of previous titles with a modern, charming visual style—the ultimate experience for creative builders!

Get building today!
Bridge Constructor Studio is a must-have for fans of engineering puzzles and creative sandbox games. Whether you're crafting a sturdy architectural masterpiece or experimenting with wild and unconventional designs—anything is possible!
As a bridge architect, bring your visions to life: Design your constructions in animated 3D mini-dioramas and start the simulation to watch as your creations are put to the ultimate stability test.

Back to the Roots
Bridge Constructor Studio is a classic bridge-building game where you can let your creativity run free with an intuitive building system, easy controls, no budget constraints, and optional challenges. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned bridge-building pro, there's something for everyone!

Key Features
- 70 Challenging Puzzles – Test your construction expertise with dozens of unique bridge-building puzzles across varied biomes. Seven different vehicles and multiple construction materials (wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars, and roadways) ensure each puzzle is a fresh and varied challenge.
- Limitless Creativity – With no budget or material restrictions, you can freely experiment and design without limits. For an extra challenge, earn a special reward by keeping costs within a set budget while ensuring your bridge holds up under pressure!
- Diverse Environments – Build bridges across five beautiful biomes, from skyscraper-filled cities to snowy canyons, lush green valleys, and more. The possibilities are endless with seven unique vehicles offering different physics and challenges! Construct ramps and loops for daring monster truck stunts, create sturdy steel bridges for heavy timber transporters, or use moving objects in levels to overcome obstacles with the off-road vehicle. A pizza delivery van, parcel service truck, vacation van, and city bus also join the fun!
- Sharing is Caring – Let your friends and family experience Bridge Constructor Studio without wrecking your carefully crafted masterpieces. Create up to five player profiles, each with its own campaign progress!



Are you ready to push the limits of engineering? Start building today!

it.name: Blasphemous
it.d:
Fight. Endure. Break eternal damnation.

Blasphemous is an award-winning 2D indie action platformer with soulslike elements, offering brutal hack and slash combat and deep exploration across a dark, gothic world steeped in penance and suffering.

Set in the cursed land of Cvstodia, ravaged by a twisted curse known only as The Miracle, you play as The Penitent One, the last survivor of the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow, bound to a cycle of death and rebirth.

Face monstrous enemies, navigate deadly traps, and uncover hidden secrets in pixel perfect handcrafted levels. As you fight for redemption, you'll explore desolate cathedrals, forsaken wastelands, and blood-soaked dungeons, encountering grotesque monsters, merciless bosses and tormented souls along the way.

Penance Never Ends.

MAIN FEATURES
- Explore a Non-Linear World: Venture through diverse platformer environments filled with fearsome enemies and deadly traps. Seek redemption across the dark gothic landscapes of Cvstodia.
- Brutal Action Combat: Wield Mea Culpa, a blade forged from guilt itself. Unleash devastating combos and skills, and hack and slash your way through hordes of twisted monsters.
- Executions & gore: Deliver savage executions with pixel perfect animations that celebrate brutal combat and grotesque detail.
- Customise Your Build: Equip powerful Relics, Rosary Beads, Prayers, and Sword Hearts to shape your playstyle. Experiment with builds and unlock new progression paths to survive the impossible.
- Intense boss Battles: Face off against colossal bosses and deadly mini-bosses. Learn their patterns, endure their fury, and crush them.
- Unlock the Mysteries of Cvstodia: Meet a cast of tortured NPCs. Some will help, others will test your resolve. Unravel their stories and shape your fate in blood, guilt and damnation.

ALL DLCs INCLUDED
This mobile version includes all free DLCs ever released for Blasphemous, expanding the core game with new content, features, and challenges:
- The Stir of Dawn – Unlock New Game+, encounter new bosses and enemies, and dive deeper into the lore.
- Strife & Ruin – Brave the brutal Boss Rush mode and embark on a crossover quest with Miriam from Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.
- Wounds of Eventide – Witness the conclusion of The Penitent One’s first journey and unlock an ending that connects directly to Blasphemous 2.

THE FULL BLASPHEMOUS EXPERIENCE – NOW ON MOBILE
- Includes every feature and content update from the original PC and console versions. Switch between precise touch controls or full controller support (gamepad compatible) for a seamless experience.
- No ads, no microtransactions.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

it.d:
Blast Busters is a real-time 1v1 PvP shooting game where two squads of soldiers face off on a fully destructible battlefield. Build your squad of four, take aim, fire powerful weapons, destroy enemy positions, and eliminate the rival army before they take down yours.

Every shot matters. Aim directly at enemy soldiers or blast the terrain around them and let physics do the rest. Watch enemies fly, tumble, and fall as explosions tear the battlefield apart. In this Blue vs Red fight, destruction is part of the action.

AIM. SHOOT. DESTROY.

Take control of your squad in fast 1 vs 1 battles where good aim and smart decisions can change the fight. Choose your target, line up the shot, and fire.

Different soldiers bring different weapons and ways to attack. Unleash automatic weapons, fire a bazooka, use powerful artillery, or destroy the terrain beneath your opponent. Every weapon creates new opportunities to outplay the enemy squad.

DESTRUCTIBLE 3D BATTLEFIELDS

Explosions blast away terrain, heavy weapons wreck enemy positions, and soldiers react with physics-driven movement when they're hit. Break apart cover, create new openings, and use the destructible environment against the opposing army.

Every shot can reshape the battlefield, mixing tactical shooting with satisfying destruction and unpredictable 3D physics.

REAL-TIME 1V1 PvP

Face rival players in fast online PvP battles. Aim carefully, choose which enemy soldier to attack, and make every shot count. Eliminate the opposing squad to win the PvP duel.

Precision shooting, powerful weapons, and destructive physics give you different ways to defeat your opponent. Blue vs Red, squad vs squad — two armies face off, but only one is left standing.

COLLECT & UPGRADE YOUR SQUAD

Collect unique soldiers and assemble a squad of four. Each soldier brings a different weapon and combat style to your team.

Upgrade your soldiers, strengthen your squad, and experiment with different combinations as your collection grows.

PHYSICS, EXPLOSIONS & CHAOS

Blast Busters: combines fast PvP action with tactical shooting, explosive physics, and satisfying 3D destruction. Blast soldiers with bazookas, tear apart terrain with artillery, and send enemies flying with powerful hits.

Sometimes the best tactic is a perfectly aimed shot. Sometimes it's a massive explosion.

Blast Busters FEATURES:

• Real-time 1v1 PvP battles
• Squads of four collectible soldiers
• Aim-and-shoot 3D combat
• Different weapons and attack styles
• Bazookas, automatic weapons, artillery, and more
• Fully destructible terrain
• Physics-driven hits, falls, and explosions
• Soldier collection and upgrades
• Tactical Blue vs Red fights
• Fast online PvP duels

Build your squad, take aim, and defeat the rival army in Blast Busters!

Join Defence Forces with Mighty Heroes

Assemble a team of powerful heroes and embark on an epic journey through enchanted lands. Partner with allies like the resilient Dwarfs and noble Elves to repel evil forces and safeguard the realms. Upgrade mighty heroes and survive waves of enemies in this idle tower defense, ensuring your castle remains unbreachable against the darkest of threats.

EXPLOSIVE TOWER DEFENSE ACTION
Prepare for heart-pounding excitement and deep strategic gameplay in Boom Castle! Each wave of enemies presents new tactical challenges, requiring you to adapt and optimize your defenses to maintain your stronghold’s integrity.

IDLE TD SURVIVAL

Progress and upgrade each hero’s skills. Enhance your towers, weapons, inventory, and castle defenses to withstand even the toughest enemy assaults. Invest in powerful upgrades to maximize your defensive capabilities and adapt to increasingly challenging waves.

ENGAGING CARD COLLECTIONS
Unlock and collect a wide array of unique heroes with powerful doodle magic skills. Improve their defensive abilities and expand your hero collection to build the ultimate defense team.

it.name: Boomit - Most Likely
it.d:
Someone always gets exposed. Someone always loses. The only question is who will be holding the phone when the bomb goes off.

Boomit Party combines pass-the-phone gameplay, Most Likely questions, party challenges, and a ticking bomb mechanic to create a different experience every round —for any group, anywhere, any night. No cards. No setup. One phone. Let's go.

GAME MODES
Pass It On: The phone moves around the group. Read the prompt, answer fast, and keep passing. Whoever holds it when the bomb explodes loses the round. Simple. Tense. Impossible to put down.
Be Exposed: Everyone votes anonymously on a question. The person with the most votes gets revealed. Find out what your friends really think — whether you're ready for it or not.
Team Rush: Split into teams and race through challenges, categories, and rapid-fire rounds. The bomb is still ticking. Work fast or lose together.

MOST LIKELY QUESTIONS
Who is most likely to ghost someone and pretend nothing happened? Cry at a commercial? Start a rumor by accident?
Most Likely is one of Boomit's most-played formats. The group votes, the result gets revealed, and someone always has something to say about it.

WHAT MAKES EVERY ROUND DIFFERENT
4,000+ prompts and challenges — lighthearted, funny, bold, unexpected, and everything in between.
Themes for every vibe — icebreakers, casual hangouts, chaotic party nights, travel sessions, and more.
Fully customizable — set the timer, player count, and theme so the game fits your group, not the other way around.
Built for 6+ players — house parties, college nights, road trips, birthday parties, game nights, and any moment someone asks "what should we do?"

THE BOMB CHANGES EVERYTHING
Most party games let you think. Boomit doesn't. The ticking bomb keeps every round moving — no long debates, no slow turns, no dead moments. Just pressure, laughs, and someone holding the phone at the wrong time.
Whether you're breaking the ice with new people or playing with your closest friends, the bomb makes sure everyone stays in the game from the first round to the last.

PERFECT FOR
A party game for friends at a house party
A no-card game for game night
A Most Likely questions app for groups
An icebreaker game for new people
A travel-friendly group game for road trips and vacations
A fun party game for college students, roommates, and friend groups
A quick party game for 6 or more players

HOW TO PLAY
Choose a game mode. Set your timer and player count. Read the prompt out loud. Answer, vote, guess, or pass the phone. Whoever holds it when the bomb goes off loses the round.
Every round plays differently. Every night becomes a story.

Download Boomit Party and find out who gets exposed first.

it.name: Border Wars: Army Games RTS
it.d:
Commander, you are needed to take control of your soldiers in the new army games. You are able to command troops ranging from pistol wielding units to snipers, tanks, machinegun jeeps and artillery. Inspired from some of the best military games on mobile which will challenge your skills in battle simulator.

Players of battle simulator and military games will love the trench warfare like style of each mission with warpips like strategy games.  You can deploy your troops like trench battles but also manage money like classic RTS games. The gameplay is styled to play like ww2 and ww3 strategy games with trench warfare like mechanics.

Fight on the borders of your country in a battle simulator of infantry units. Or command missions in the forests and fields of your country with trench defense. You must protect your home from the enemy in battles that take place in the harsh weather of the desert and finally you must command your troops in tank games where large tank battles take place in the city.

The goal of each mission in the military games is to destroy the enemy base or survive until reinforcements arrive. To win you will need to manage your money carefully and perform strategic advancement to win all the campaign missions. Mini warriors can be called to the battlefield by pressing their button from the soldier panel. Money is earned by killing enemy soldiers. Make careful use of tanks and artillery to win the battlefield. At the end you will have to fight the enemy general and defeat him by destroying the boss tank.

A lot of work and effort was put in developing this project so that it can be enjoyed and played like classic ww2 games and modern ww3 games combined. The gameplay of both these military games combined makes this a fun and one of the more challenging campaign games. I hope you will enjoy playing this and if you do please leave feedback here as it encourages me to add even more campaign missions to the game.

Enter new environments, meet a variety of characters, collect rare treasures and uncover the many secrets hidden in Botworld. You can freely explore the many lush forests and arid deserts but make sure you have a strong team of bots because you never know what's around the corner!

Outsmart your foes in a unique strategic battle system. Your bots will leap, charge, stun or blast around the arena using advanced AI while you pick the perfect abilities to stomp your foes. Each bot has unique abilities and a powerful ultimate, combine these with your favourite player abilities for maximum effect.


COLLECT & CUSTOMIZE

You will discover, build and collect rare and powerful bots to create the ultimate team. Search the world to discover new bot recipes and collect rare scrap to build and upgrade your favourites. Customise their powers and abilities as they level up and get stronger.



CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER

Play as one of 4 species: cats, dogs, buffalo and lizards. Choose a unique look to add your own personality to the character.



CREATE OR JOIN A GUILD!

Now Botmasters can come together and collaborate in completing quests! Join an existing guild or create your own, with the ability to share strategies and discoveries through the guild text chat. When you have enough botmasters in your crew, venture forth and take on the guild exclusive events! Finish these so you can score some unique scrap and outfits!

it.d:
Mobile game - Caucasus Parking.

You don't need an expensive, powerful car to cause a stir on the warm southern streets; all you need is a phone.

The game's objective is to spawn at a random location on the map, find a parking space marked with a green marker, and then park your car with the front wheels facing in.

A beautiful, high-quality 3D parking simulator where you can hone your driving skills.

Car tuning is available, so you can customize your car as you wish! Choose the type of car you'll use to complete the levels; you can create anything from a flashy car to a more formal, opera-style vehicle.

The parking simulator features over 20 cars! From the most popular LADA, BMW, Mercedes, Audi, and Nissan models to rare vehicles like Buggati and Aston Martin.

The game also features an Investigative Committee car! Feel like a real detective!

Realistic car physics will add to the enjoyment of this 3D parking simulator! Race your favorite cars through the narrow streets of the Caucasus and improve your driving skills. Every resident of the south should know how to drive!

The game features 104 levels. Complete them all and become a true "fussologist"—only true racers are awarded this title.

The game takes place in Russia! Lots of Russian cars! Tune and race Russian cars!

Caucasus Parking is a car game and driving simulator, and one of the most realistic driving games you've ever played. Enjoy modern car parking and driving simulation with amazing difficulty levels, from the easiest to the most challenging.

If you enjoy 3D parking games, car driving games, and car parking games, and are looking for an amazing parking simulator, this game is for you. Become the king of parking, show off your skills to your friends, and become a parking master!

Playing Caucasus Parking, you'll learn to control your iron horse even more effectively.

The creator of this game was inspired by the nature and streets of Russia, Dagestan, Chechnya, Armenia, Georgia, and other regions! He also used examples of buildings from popular cities like Krasnodar, Makhachkala, Derbent, Grozny, Sochi, and more!

Features:
- Realistic 3D graphics.
- 2 camera modes.
- Option to disable the interface for high-quality screenshots.
- Realistic car controls for better driving simulation.
- Over 20 different cars.
- Realistic map of the Caucasus.
- Control with the accelerometer, steering wheel, or arrow keys.
- Personalization with car paint.
- Multiple wheels.

it.name: Chrome Valley Customs
it.d:
Help save the garage by restoring classic cars to their former glory with a wide range of customization options! Work on your mechanic skills: repair, restore, paint, upholster, and finish the cars in the way you like best. To get the parts you need you’ll have to solve puzzles with explosives. What a business model!

CARS. Cars are cool. And this game has lots of cars. Choose how to make them look cool. Or not if that’s your thing. Restoring and customizing cars is pretty much the most fun thing in the world, and this is a game where you do that! 

BUSINESS. This garage could become a thriving empire of incredible automobiles. Huge profits, stock options, a cult of loyal customers. Or it could fail. It’s really up to you and how well you can customize cars. 

PUZZLES. Solve satisfying car themed puzzles with bombs and turbos and saws and hammers and rockets. Who knew power-tools and explosives could be so relaxing. 

EXPLOSIONS. That’s right, explosions. Lot’s of ‘em. 

DREAM JOB. Customizing cars for a living is a pretty sweet gig. In this game, it will be your job. And like all great jobs you don’t have to think too much and can get it done in just a few minutes. 

HANG OUT. Work with the best ragtag crew of gearheads in the car business. Big Rig, Donna, Uncle Hank, Angelo, Gabi, and of course Gasket, the goodest pooch around. As a wise man once said, it’s all about family. He was talking about cars.

Every restaurant and diner dash around the world could use the help of an interior designer! Hone your skills in the world of design and make bold choices from your options for furniture and style. You can change your selection at any time.

As you develop your business, you'll face an increased number of customers. Modernize your kitchen equipment, complete orders in time, and amaze customers with even more tasty dishes!

- Classic restaurant games and time management games gameplay.

Progress through the plot step by step and unlock new themed cafe shops and beautiful locations. Whether it's a pizzeria, bakery, or diner dash, every chef has their own unique taste and their own recipes and stories. Learn them all — join the game right now! Show off your cooking fever and help save every cozy diner dash from the hands of soulless corporations!

it.name: Crossword Master - Word Puzzle
it.d:
Crossword Master is a turn-based word game where you and your opponent work together to complete a crossword puzzle while competing for the highest score. Dive into this highly addictive experience and enjoy endless fun! Solve crosswords, outsmart your opponents, and become a word master!

Discover a fresh take on daily crossword puzzles: draw letters from the deck, and craft words according to the clues. Inspired by Scandinavian-style crosswords, Crossword Master features clues within the cells to enhance gameplay convenience. Some of the clues are pictures, which adds an extra layer of challenge and fun!

Crossword Master strikes the perfect balance between entertainment and a useful brain exercise. Each crossword puzzle is carefully designed to train your language skills, spelling, logic, and general knowledge. Explore thousands of words, enrich your vocabulary, and master the art of crossword games!

How to play:

- Your goal in this turn-based game is to craft words on the crossword board according to the clues and outscore your opponent.
- Use blue cells with clues to guess words. Find the right fit for each letter from a set of five and place them one by one from the deck to start forming words.
- Try to place all the letters from the deck in each turn to maximize your score. Every correct letter earns one point, with additional points awarded for completing words. Aim to construct longer words and multiple words in a single move for the highest scores.
- Think strategically. Sometimes, holding back a crucial letter for a future move can help create a longer word and boost your score potential.

What you get:

• Engaging crossword game with smooth graphics and a modern look
• Plenty of unique crossword puzzles for adults packed with countless words to unravel, keeping you hooked for hours!
• Hints available to assist when you're stuck and need a clue
• Auto-save ensures you can resume any unfinished crossword anytime without losing your progress
• No time limit. Enjoy this crossword game at your own pace.

Solve crossword puzzles anywhere, anytime, stretch your cognitive limits, and become a master of words!

it.name: Crozzle - Crossword Puzzles

Upgrade your daily brain training, crossword style! Play the word puzzle game that bumps the classic daily crossword puzzle up to a new level of word fun with strategy, competition and tons of surprises. Play is the new way to crossword!
Feel smarter after every play as you solve clever clues and rack up points word by word. And don’t forget to relax between daily brain workouts!

Crozzle is the daily crossword puzzle you know and love, only better. Crossword + game = way more fun! We’ve gamified the classic daily crossword puzzle, so going that extra mile making words in your daily brain workout is a game, not a chore.

Each game is a puzzle you solve against an opponent! Take turns adding all the letters you can until the puzzle is solved. Crossword skills are a must, but you’ll also need strategy to win. Brain boosting fun right?! Here’s how the game works:

How to Play
• Play a 1-on-1 crossword match versus an opponent
• Add as many of your letters as you can to the puzzle, then it’s your opponent’s turn
• Earn points for correctly placed letters
• Earn more points for completed words
• Earn even more points for placing letters on bonus squares!
• Once all the words in a puzzle are solved, the player with the most points wins!

Pretty simple eh? Here’s some fun, brain busting twists!

Fun Features
• Fun picture clues + clever brain-training word clues
• Multiply points by placing letters in words on bonus squares
• Swap out letters you don’t want to play for new ones! (costs gems)
• Gain advantage with boosters like wild tile, double bonus, more letters (cost gems)
• Unlock hidden clues for words in fun daily Events!

Strategy sets Crozzle apart from other crosswords. The more words you play, the better your word puzzle skills and the better you’ll get at outscoring opponents.

The fun doesn’t stop there. You don’t have to leave the game to relax and give your brain a break between daily crossword workouts!

Open the Crozzle Map to visit dreamy destinations! Whether it’s beautiful city parks, cafes and museums, tropical island getaways or fun mountain adventures, the Crozzle Map has you covered.

There’s a million reasons for crossword lovers to play this unique new word puzzle game. If you’re a wiz with words, curious about crosswords and love brain training word games, here’s some more reasons to play!

Why You’ll Love Crozzle
• Thousands of quick, solvable puzzles
• Play words at your own pace, no timer!
• Challenge hard opponents
• Earn coins and gems with wins and frequent play
• Get game-boosting goodies in the shop
• Climb event leaderboards

Brain train with the best and scratch your daily crossword itch with the smartest word puzzle game around. Stay sharp the fun way with Crozzle.

it.d:
A BRAND NEW EPIC CYBERPUNK FANTASY ACTION GAME
Cyber Fighters is a free-to-play of the new shadow stickman style game in cyberpunk theme, a great combination of action games, role-playing (RPG), and player versus player. 

A new experience for players to enjoy the classic fantasy action fighting game. You will be amazed that Cyber Fighters is an offline cyberpunk game, which doesn't need the internet to dive in a fantasy world & fighting the epic shadow battle. Fight in your own way because you can select among 5 unique cyber fighters with diversity skill & battle style. You can choose Cyber Officer Swordsman, The Punisher of God Thunder, The Queen Bee Archer Assassins, Cyborg Senseless Killer, and The Deathly Shadow Panther.

Ready to plunge into the cyberpunk world with infinite hack and slash battles & countless fast-paced action? Then welcome to Detroit city, where it all begins!

In 2077, World War 3 ended, the world map was redrawn. North America was divided into 5 regions intersecting in the city of Detroit. After a series of failed agreements between states, the city fell into anarchy.
More than 750.000 of civilians were forgotten by the rest of the world. Over time, in the forgotten city, formed criminal forces. They rebelled and fought with each other to compete for their influence over the city.

Everything in Detroit is now operating like an amip. If you can not be a part of it, then you will soon become its prey. 
Will you be powerful enough to change that, cyber fighters?

For fans of classic Action RPG and Stickman Fighting Games around the world, you will not be disappointed for sure once join this game - a massive cyberpunk world full of gang wars, cyber weapons, hack n slash combats, survival battles, and many more. 
Let's start the adventure right now, fighters! It's time for you to become the Greatest Cyber Fighter Legends!

**********
THE LEGENDS STICKMAN CYBER FIGHTER

Cyber Fighter offers five different heroes with a diversity of combat styles for players to choose:  Slashing monster by a Thermal Blade, Thunder Hammer & Energy Spear or shooting their way over bosses by a Mighty Arrow or Power Cannon.

Choose your stickman cyber fighter with a diversity combat style to fight the monster cyber hunter in this dark cyberpunk world. Build your own fighting style with your own skill tree and deep inventory system that encourages endless combat experimentation and customization.

BRING JUSTICE FOR THE DARKNESS CYBERPUNK CITY

Each chapter goes through, you'll experience an epic battle with the darkness shadow force: zombie, ninja, yakuza, cyber monster, gangster, assassins, cyber dark angel, or the gigantic boss.

COMRADE-IN-ARMS SYSTEM

Besides the unique combat style, each hero will have their own comrade-in-arms to summon and it has their own combat style too. Fighting alongside your soul knight robot through the deathly shadow battle. 

STUNNING DESIGN, EFFECT & GRAPHICS

The Cyberpunk world in Cyber Fighters is full of the amazing design concept from background to character, & enemy design. You will be amazed by the fascinating graphic & effect skill in Cyber Fighters. 

Game Features:
- Offline Mode: Experience the game with no internet connection required! 
- Enjoy incredible graphics of the Cyberpunk world!
- Fight against other Player with online mode (PVP)
- Dive into this Action RPG on your own fighting style!
- Learn skills, face against many cruel enemies, evil cyber monster, the cyber mafia, cyber shadow hunter assassins, and mighty bosses. 
- Collect lots of cyber weapons in the huge weapon system!
- Customize your hero with the costume & drones system.
- Challenge yourself to survive in challenge mode with endless waves of cyber hunter enemies.
- Many more interesting features that you will find out in-game!.

Follow us at: 
https://www.facebook.com/OfficialCyberFighters/

ezgcyberfighters@gmail.com

When the call of battle echoes through the valleys, wield your katana with unmatched skill, defending your honor and protecting those under your care. Master the art of sword fighting, employing swift and deadly maneuvers, and unleash devastating ultimate skills to kill your foes.

• Embrace the Bushido

The Bushido is a path of unwavering determination, meticulous craftsmanship, and unwavering courage. Embrace the challenges, hone your skills, and forge your destiny in this epic survival adventure.
