it.name: Dawn of Ages: Medieval Warfare
it.d:
No Dragons, No Magic, Just Pure Strategy! 

Join the other 2.5+ million players in our fast growing, worldwide community of kingdom building strategists! Be brave, calculated, and cold-blooded to thrive in this epic multiplayer auto-chess / city-building medieval war game.

Step into the medieval era, progress your empire through the ages and engage in fierce battles. Lead mighty warriors, dressed in the finest armor, wielding lethal weapons, as you embark on a journey of exploration, and conquest.. Dominate in one of the most genuine and historically accurate war games ever made for mobile. Leave your mark on the annals of history, your troops await your command!

Every weapon, piece of armor, and tactic is based on real history. The game echoes tactical, cultural, and technological discoveries across many regions, from feral axe-wielding savages, to disciplined men-at-arms, & organized pike blocks, all inspired by the elite, regional warriors from around the world including: English Longbowmen & Billmen, French Knights & Men-at-Arms, Teutonic Knights, Byzantine Cataphracts, Swiss Pikemen, Viking & Norse Warriors, Mongol Hordes, Japanese Samurai, and many other inspirations.

The game features extensive historical military equipment such as: Kite shields, Heavy Dane axes, Longbows, Chainmail, Zweihänder greatswords, Javelins, Plate armor, Spears, Pikes & Halberds, Tower Shields, Lamellar armor, Maces, Cannons, Crossbows and many more!

Key Features: 

● Battle Simulation - Experience large-scale auto-chess battles where placement, equipment choice & agro / targeting decisions impact your overall success. Command your villagers and equip them with powerful weapons and armor to claim victory.

● Choose Your Starting Faction - Viking, Teutonic, Frankish, or Anglo-Saxon. These base nations come with a strong Commander who will shape the fate of your land through unique abilities, nation perks, and research trees reflecting their strengths.

● Civilization Progression - Expand your kingdom through the ages. Develop your key buildings, increase resource production, educate your population, and prepare for battle by training powerful fighters. Unlock advanced technologies, forge new tools, and discover new materials to advance your technological strength.

● Forge Clan Alliances - Fortify your shared city together, and conquer enemy lands in a rich late-game experience where the stakes are high. Real losses and enormous rewards await the brave participants.

● Engaging Gameplay with Easy Controls – Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a newcomer to war strategy games, take command with our simple drag and drop troop management and single tap agro mechanics on the battlefield.

Fans of traditional total war / civilization games will fall in love with our mix of city building, resource management, tactical warfare, and large-scale conquest available in this game. 

Join the Community and Shape the Future of Dawn of Ages.

it.name: Dead Impact: Survival RPG Game
it.d:
Survive the apocalypse together in Dead Impact – the ultimate co-op zombie survival RPG!

Dive into the intense post-apocalyptic world of Dead Impact, a thrilling MMORPG adventure where survival depends on teamwork. Join forces with friends to raid dangerous locations, battle zombies and deadly bosses, and scavenge for essential supplies. Build your shelter, craft weapons, and upgrade your hero to become an unstoppable survivor.

- Co-op survival action: team up with friends or brave the challenges solo

- Unique classes, each with distinct abilities, so you can create your perfect fighting style and customize your appearance

- Weapons with special powers that can turn the tide of battle

- Survival game with increased durability of items, extensive crafting & construction system

- HARD MODE: for veteran survivors who crave even tougher battles and bigger rewards

- Battle Pass: complete quests and earn exclusive rewards

A world after the asteroid impact
After the asteroid’s destruction of civilization, humanity is scattered across desolate landscapes, clinging to life in small bands of survivors. As the undead roam and danger lurks around every corner, you and your team must find shelter, gather resources, and fight for survival in this transformed world.

Unite and conquer the undead together
Switch between classes like Rogue, Engineer, Alchemist, Trap Master, and Pyromancer—each with unique skills and playstyle.

Immersive multiplayer RPG
Form alliances with friends or other players during intense raids, use chat to coordinate your tactics, and face the challenges of the undead together. 

Customize your hero
In this immersive MMORPG, your hero’s destiny is yours to shape. Unlock new skills, fine-tune your equipment, and become the ultimate survivor.

Craft, loot, and build to thrive
Survive by gathering resources, crafting powerful gear, and constructing shelters to withstand the relentless undead. Conquer the apocalypse in this action-packed multiplayer RPG!

Explore a dangerous world
Journey through a vast open world, from desert sands to frozen forests and the ruins of abandoned cities. Brave the underground catacombs where the dead guard treasures beyond imagination.

Experience the ultimate zombie survival adventure in this cooperative online RPG. Build your team, customize your hero, and forge your path in a world reborn from destruction. Are you ready to face the challenge?

Embark on an exhilarating tower defense battle where strategy meets luck in an idle war against hordes of menacing monsters! Roguelike TD is a unique blend of strategy games, dice games, and fantasy games, offering an epic adventure for players of all kinds.

Choose from mages wielding powerful spells, archers with deadly accuracy, necromancers summoning the undead, and more. Strategize your attacks and utilize each hero's special abilities for castle defense against waves of monstrous foes.

- Unlock Idle Heroes: Progress through the game to unlock new idle heroes and grow your idle army. Upgrade their abilities using dice rolls and collect artifacts to enhance their powers. Build a formidable kingdom guard capable of facing increasingly formidable enemies.

Why Play Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD?

Experience the thrill of combining idle heroes management with tower defense strategy in a dynamic and addictive gameplay experience. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to dice games, Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD offers endless hours of roguelike tactical fun.

Will you roll the perfect combination of idle heroes and claim victory, or will the monsters reign supreme? The fate of the realm rests in your hands. Join Dice vs Monsters: Roguelike TD, embark on an epic quest to vanquish the monstrous horde and prove you're the dice master!

it.name: Disney Magic Match 3D
it.d:
Disney Magic Match 3D is a brand-new 3D matching game where you’ll solve captivating Disney puzzles by sorting and collecting iconic items from beloved Disney and Pixar movies including Moana, Aladdin and Toy Story. Dive into the enchanting world of Disney Magic Match 3D, a captivating puzzle game adventure with beloved Disney treasures!

The ancient Disney Book of Magic, filled with iconic artifacts, has been opened, releasing a whirlwind of nostalgia. It’s your mission to return these cherished items to their rightful place by sorting and matching the pieces in magical puzzles in this relaxing sorting game. Disney Magic Match 3D blends sorting, collecting, and puzzle-solving gameplay.

DISCOVER ICONIC DISNEY 3D TREASURES!
Explore stunning 3D puzzles inspired by your favorite Disney films and discover a vast array of nostalgic items in this immersive puzzle game. From Mickey Mouse’s iconic gloves to Aladdin’s magic lamp or Toy Story’s classic Woody boots, each 3D piece is brimming with Disney charm.

Unlock new chapters in the magic book and uncover even more iconic Disney treasures in Enchanted Levels! Enchanted Levels include themed pieces from your favorite movies or nostalgic characters, making each level a fun Disney Magic Match experience with sorting and matching game play. Collect themed items from classic Disney characters like Mickey Mouse’s shoes, Minnie Mouse’s bow, and Donald Duck’s hat.

SORT AND MATCH IN ICONIC DISNEY PUZZLES!
Test your skills with a variety of engaging Disney puzzles in Disney Magic Match 3D, a relaxing matching game that will challenge your mind and appeal to nostalgia. Match and sort scattered Disney items, from Moana’s Heart of Te Fiti to a vast array of Disney princess dresses, in this satisfying sorting game.

By identifying and sorting scattered items, each completed match brings you closer to restoring order to the Disney universe. Feel the satisfaction of collecting and organizing treasures in Disney Magic Match 3D, a beautifully crafted puzzle game.

Download Disney Magic Match 3D and enjoy Disney Magic Match, a magical matching game, immersive puzzle game, and relaxing sorting game where you can collect and play with iconic Disney treasures in a stunning 3D world.

it.name: Doctor Who: Lost In Time
it.d:
Take a step into the Whoniverse and join BBC's Doctor Who in our exciting idle game, Doctor Who: Lost in Time. Here you will embark on an epic adventure, joining forces to unravel a universe-threatening plot!

BRAND NEW STORIES 
Explore a massive conspiracy across time and space, putting the Doctor in danger. Dive into an exciting new adventure with different Doctors, companions, and iconic locations from the entire Whoniverse.

EXPLORE ICONIC LOCATIONS
Explore iconic locations from the show and team up with your favorite companions! Battle foes like Daleks, Cybermen, and more! Collect character cards and use unique resources like Kyfred Gems and Henoch Matter to level up your companions. These resources hold the key to understanding why the Doctor and friends are lost in time.


COLLECT YOUR FAVOURITE CHARACTERS 
Meet familiar characters as you journey through time and space! Collect cards featuring different versions of the Doctor, their companions, and more. Use your resources to upgrade these cards and unlock powerful bonuses.


WEEKLY LIMITED-TIME EVENTS 
Join live events and race against friends to the end of time! Encounter new threats like Cybermen, Daleks, and beyond. Watch for new characters and Doctors as the story unfolds!




SAVE THE UNIVERSE
Boost your Waypoints to unlock the powerful Vortex Energy, an important resource used to charge the Doctor’s TARDIS. Complete tasks to earn rare rewards packed in Kerblam Boxes when supplies are low. But be quick! Tap away to power up the TARDIS and jump to your next adventure just in time. Manage Waypoints linking TARDIS versions across space and time. Gather resources from Gallifrey, Skaro, and Victorian London to thwart a host of villains' plans.

IDLE FUN
Enjoy idle fun just like the Doctor! Collect cards and characters effortlessly, even while offline. Dive into all of time and space, untangle the mystery, and help the Doctor save the Universe!

Build your own Dog Hotel and create a paradise for dogs! Take care of your dog guests, pet them, play with them, and take them to Dog Talent Shows!


CREATE A WORLD FOR YOUR DOG GUESTS TO ENJOY!

Start with a small dog hotel in a suburban area, and improve it to become the first 5+ star dog hotel! Create spaces for your dogs to take naps, eat delicious snacks, play with each other, swim, excercise and much more! Anything to ensure the satisfaction of your dog guests!


WELCOME DOGS FROM ALL AROUND THE WORLD!

Grow your dog hotel and accept more breeds as your capacity increases. Each and every single dog will have their own unique character, behavior, wants and needs; and it is up to you to satisfy them!


CREATE YOUR OWN DOG

Create your own dogs, and add them as permanent residents to the hotel! Pick their breed, set their age, give them some character traits and your dogs will be the first to great you at the hotel every day!


DAILY DOG SHOW

Take your favourite dogs from the hotel to a special daily event; the Dog Show! Each day, your dog guests will be able to take part in a brand new challenge, which might consist of physical contests like a running or a jumping tournament; or it can be more creative challenges like a singing or a dancing tournament!


DAILY DOG TRIVIA

Test your knowledge of dogs and learn interesting facts about our four-legged friends with this daily trivia quiz.


BUILD STATUES OF ICONIC DOGS

Dog Hotel Tycoon has an icon's corner called "Paws of Fame" that celebrates the iconic dogs from history and their stories. Here, players can build statues of these dogs and learn about what made them special.


FEATURES

- Easy to play game for every animal lover!
- Cute dogs with unique characteristics and lifelike behavior!
- More than 80 dogs to have as guests, and more to come!
- Fun rooms and items for your dogs to enjoy!
- Amazing side activities to keep you busy while your hotel keeps growing!


If you love dogs, you will love Dog Hotel Tycoon.

it.name: Draw Arena: Battle Tactics
it.d:
► A BATTLE OF WITS

Now THIS is a tower defense game! Not only will you have to defend your tower from enemy takeover, but you’ll need to do battle with your enemy’s army at the same time – keep your wits about you though, because this is no ordinary in-game opponent! The other tower is manned by a real live person, just like you, so get ready for hours of exciting strategy and tactical takeovers as you each draw your armies on the map and square up to do battle. Explore, conquer, but most importantly, have fun!
 
► ARMOR UP!

With each battle you’ll have a chance to explore new terrains and strategies – draw your army on the map, choosing which soldiers to send into battle and where, as you keep an eye on your opponent. As you wage war, you’ll get to explore a variety of locations while also building up your tower defenses at the end of each level. Between the real opponents and funky equipment (mammoth anyone?) that you can collect, you’re sure to love all of the unique features we’ve crammed into the game:

◾Real-time enemies – intense PvP fights await as you do battle with other gamers. Since you’re playing against real people, each level and battle will be exciting and new as you each try new tactics.

◾Strategy at play – thanks to the unique drawing mechanism, you can choose where you place your army so as best to conquer the enemy. Place them well at the start of the fight and then keep adding them to steamroll your opponent. Keep your wits about you though because your enemy is doing the same!

◾Diverse units – as you progress in the game you’ll keep unlocking exciting new soldiers and equipment that will serve to help you win the fight. Collect and use everything from infantry and archers to robots and ninjas! You’ll also have the chance to build up your own tower so that its defenses are top notch.

◾Exciting locations – in addition to fights and wars, explore this exciting and fun world, which is filled with all sorts of unique landscapes. Conquer them all in your quest to take over the world!
 
► A TOWER-IFIC STRATEGY GAME

With real opponents, the need for an ever-changing strategy, and the ability to conquer exciting lands, Draw Arena is sure to become your new favorite PvP tower defense game – download it today to get started winning! Along the way, don’t forget to build up your own bases and towers so that your opponents can’t conquer you easily, collect infantry, and build out your army with all manner of delightful equipment and of course, have some fun while you’re out there taking over the world!

it.d:
Dreamdale – Enter a world of fairy tales


► ONCE UPON A TIME…

Set off on a fairy tale adventure as a humble woodsman and build a whole wide world of wonder in this magical game. Dig, mine, build, farm, craft and fight in this entertaining and original RPG with time management elements that’s guaranteed to provide hours of absorbing fantasy action. Bring your fairytale dreams to life in the beautiful world of Dreamdale.

► ALL THE INGREDIENTS OF GREAT ADVENTURE

• A resourceful hero – starting out with nothing but an empty backpack and your trusty axe, get chopping and mining, and gather up resources to construct new buildings or exchange for coins and diamonds at the market. Spend coins on upgrading your equipment and buildings, or on expanding the map to find ever more varied resources.

• The right tools – each resource requires a different tool for mining, and each tool can be upgraded to get more resources faster. Progress through the game to find pickaxes, shovels, fishing rods, and a whole lot more, including unique gold tools that make you the fastest digger, miner, farmer or fisher ever.

• A few good friends – soon you’ll be joined by other villagers who help you expand your world, tending your farm, catching your fish, crafting your tools, and mining your resources. In no time, you’ll be in charge of your own little empire of commerce, rushing across the map to craft, collect, upgrade and expand.

• A place for everything – build storage for all the different resources you collect, and upgrade the buildings along with your backpack to make trade move faster and bring in ever more coin.

• Steady progress – complete quests to gain XP, level up and get a huge variety of rewards to help you progress through the game, including a wide range of different player attributes that give advantages in different aspects of the game.

• A little luck – get more rewards and extra coins from chests that pop up randomly on the map, or dig for treasure where X marks the spot.

• A hint of mystery – find a boat and sail to five different mystery islands where you’ll find unique, unusual, and especially valuable resources.

• A splash of danger – what RPG would be complete without a little action? If you dare, explore eight different caves, battle with enemies and reach a showdown with monster bosses to win spectacular loot, and head back to your village a true hero.

• And just a little touch of magic – this is a fairy tale, don’t forget, so among all the industry, commerce and action, don’t be surprised to find saddle-broken pigs, magic trees that never stop growing, and a whole host of other miraculous elements to keep your sense of wonder alive in this fantasy RPG.

► LIVE HAPPILY EVER AFTER

Ever dreamed of being a farmer and a fighter, a digger and a chopper, a merchant and a miner, a fisherman and an adventurer, a pig-herd and a true fairytale hero? Make all your dreams come true in the idyllic and hugely entertaining world of Dreamdale. Download the game now and set out on a real adventure.

Experience breathtaking 3D worlds in every element’s realm, from vibrant landscapes to the unforgettable heroes who call them home.


— Your Adventure Awaits —  
The elemental war has begun. Gather your heroes, forge unstoppable teams, and master all six elements to claim your place among the legends. Download Echo of Elements today and begin your journey through Valdyra!

it.name: Eras of Wrestling
it.d:
Eras of Wrestling by Checkmate Creative is a wrestling GM and booking sim. Run your own promotion across five eras of pro wrestling history, with hundreds of original, fully voiced characters and no licensed wrestlers. Free to play.

It's the ultimate fantasy wrestling GM experience, where eras collide in epic fashion. 

Build your promotion across five decades of pro wrestling history. Draft your roster, book your shows, create feuds, titles, teams, and championships, and rise to the top as the greatest promoter of all time.

Featuring hundreds of original characters inspired by the golden ages of wrestling, full voice-overs, animated show outcomes, and a deep booking system that puts you in control of every decision.

FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS
• Act as General Manager and Promoter in a wrestling booking simulator
• Build a rich history across five distinct Eras
• Collect wrestlers, managers, venues, titles, and special match types
• Create and customize your feuds, factions, tag teams, and championships
• Assign unique stats and traits to every character
• Unlock and upgrade Tag Teams and Feuds
• Induct legends into your Hall of Fame
• Commentary teams, referees, and animated match playouts
• Tournaments, Battle Royals, and exclusive P4V (Pay-4-View) Events
• Player profiles, leaderboards, and more

RUN THE SHOW. CONTROL THE BUSINESS. SHAPE WRESTLING HISTORY.

Step into the role of General Manager and build the ultimate pro wrestling promotion across five unforgettable eras. Draft your roster, book matches, manage rivalries, and lead your company to dominance in the deepest wrestling GM simulator and booking simulator on mobile.

If you’ve ever wanted a true pro wrestling manager game, wrestling promoter simulator, or GM mode experience, this is your chance to run the business your way.


FIVE WRESTLING ERAS COLLIDE

Guide your organization through the evolution of professional wrestling:

• Territory Era
• Mania Era
• Next Gen Era
• Xtreme Era
• Millennium Era

Each era introduces new superstars, match types, storylines, and challenges, creating a massive wrestling history sandbox for strategy and simulation fans.

Territory Era (Mid 70s - Early 80s)
Regional feds rule the landscape. Grit, brawls, and raw toughness define the fight.

Mania Era (Mid - Late 80s)
Color explodes and characters go big. Spectacle becomes the heartbeat of wrestling.

Next Gen Era (Early - Mid 90s)
Technical skill rises. New stars push innovation through wild gimmicks and elevated in-ring work.

Xtreme Era (Late 90s)
Chaos reigns as ratings wars commence. Hardcore action and unapologetic attitude break every rule.

Millennium Era (Early 00s)
Athleticism surges. A faster, sharper, global style takes center stage in a more modern world.


BUILD YOUR DREAM ROSTER

Scout talent, sign contracts, and assemble a roster filled with iconic archetypes and colorful characters inspired by pro wrestling and pop culture fused with hilarious parody.

Wrestler Stats include: 
• In-ring SKILL
• Ability to talk on the MIC
• Promo ability resulting in crowd POP
• Ability to Win Matches with PUSH

Balance your roster and manage Morale to dominate in the ratings.


BOOK MATCHES & STORYLINES

Create unforgettable shows as you book MATCHES, MIC SPOTS and SKITS that define distinct eras.

Choose from a wide variety of match types, unlock Tag Teams and Feuds, collect Venues, and produce Shows that keep fans on the edge of their seats.


A TRUE WRESTLING TYCOON EXPERIENCE

Fans of wrestling manager games, booking simulators, sports management games, and GM mode will find endless depth and replayability.

Build your legacy from a small territory to a global powerhouse and shape the future of wrestling history.
 

YOUR ERA. YOUR RULES. YOUR PROMOTION.

The locker room is waiting. The fans are watching.

Now it’s your turn to run the business.

Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game
Begin your role playing game (RPG) journey as a new recruit in the Shoru Police Academy. Creo Monsters are disappearing, and it's your mission to uncover the truth behind these mysterious events. But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Along the way, assist the citizens of Shoru by completing over 50 engaging missions, building alliances, and discovering hidden treasures.

Capture and Train Over 300 Monsters
Love monster-collecting games? Build your RPG dream team of Creo in this open-world role playing game. Hunt rare and legendary monsters, each available in unique alternate colors. With over 300 unique monsters to capture, evolve, and train, you’ll have endless possibilities to customize your strategy in pocket monster games. Create powerful combinations and lead your Creo to victory in thrilling turn-based battles.

Explore this monster adventure game
Experience more than 30 hours of offline and online rpg gameplay as you dive into a richly detailed open world. From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter
Prepare for trainer battles with a highly customizable system. Equip your Creo with items and unlock over 100 unique traits to enhance their abilities. Train your Creo to learn and master over 200 moves, which you can swap anytime to adapt to new challenges. Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Master Trainer
Challenge the strongest monster trainers across Shoru and rise through the ranks in this paid role playing game. Compete in the prestigious Coliseum, where only the best monster trainers are crowned as champions. Will you conquer every rpg battle and claim the title of Evoking Master Trainer?

Key Features:
- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide
- 300+ collectible monsters to capture, train, and evolve.
- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster-Catching games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.

PLAY FIFA: PLAY FAST, PLAY FUN
Jump into action-packed, arcade-style soccer gameplay with casual-friendly controls that make passing, shooting, and scoring effortless. Build a dream team of superstars, master football formations, refine offensive and defensive strategies, and make quick transfers with tactical depth and intuitive gameplay. Play the official FIFA experience anytime, anywhere and prepare your squad for the ultimate FIFA World Cup™ competition!

COMMAND THE ATTACK
Test your skills in turn-based soccer gameplay by strategizing key moments to score goals in unique scenarios, or dive into high-speed, real-time matches against live rivals in soccer league competitions. Train your squad for intense league battles and prepare them for FIFA World Cup™ style tournaments. Master every mode with tactical precision and lightning-fast gameplay to outplay the competition on the pitch in every match.

POWER UP WITH SUPER MODE
Turn the tide of any FIFA football match with Super Mode, an exclusive FIFA Rivals game-changing mechanic that doubles stats and unlocks special abilities like offside-immune passes and foul-free tackles. Score goals faster and crush rivals with ease. Strategically position your soccer team to activate Super Mode and unleash an unstoppable force on the pitch, securing victory over league challengers and high-stakes FIFA World Cup™ clashes.

BUILD YOUR DREAM FIFA RIVALS TEAM
Assemble your favorite FIFA superstars to build the ultimate football team in this officially licensed FIFA mobile game. Represent legendary football clubs (FC) and choose from the world’s most iconic soccer players. Customize formations to maximize their strengths, harness rival-crushing tactics, and strike your way to goal-scoring glory on the pitch. Compete in the league, perfect your FC, chase your FIFA World Cup™ dream, and become the ultimate football coach.

OWN THE PITCH (AND THE TEAM)
Collect, own, and trade exclusive limited-edition digital player items featuring legendary soccer superstars on the Pulse Market. Strengthen your team with authentic FIFA digital collectibles and seasonal items, including your boots and kits inspired by the FIFA World Cup™. You have full control to build and upgrade your ultimate dream squad and dominate league rivals on the pitch.

LIVE THE ACTION WITH REAL-TIME TOURNAMENTS
Test your skills in real-time PVP matches against players around the world. Compete in esports-centric competitions, special live events tied to real-life football events, and global tournaments leading up to the FIFA World Cup 26™. Face off against league rivals, represent your club, and climb the worldwide leaderboards to prove you’re the ultimate football coach!

RELIVE THE GLORY WITH FIFA WORLD CUP™  LEGACY MODE
Step back in time and relive or redeem the greatest FIFA World Cup™ tournaments. Select a FIFA World Cup™ year (2010, 2014, 2018, 2022), choose your nation, and take the pitch with that tournament's iconic squad featuring legendary players, kits, and unforgettable moments. Battle through each round of the bracket, from the group stage to the Final, to become a FIFA World Cup™ champion. Complete the journey and earn Legacy Players, historic FIFA World Cup™  legends you can bring back into your PvP squad to build a team that spans generations.

it.name: Foodventure Inc: Idle Tycoon
it.d:
► ORDER UP!

Every restaurateur dreams of opening not just one, but a whole chain of eateries, and you’re about to live that life as you grow your cooking business empire and become the greatest food tycoon ever seen! Start your Foodventure story as a humble chef, and work your way up to managing multiple different restaurants that serve everything from pizza to sushi. Not only will you enjoy the restaurant simulator experience as you manage all parts of the business, but you’ll also get in on that sweet idle tycoon action, meaning tons of growth even when you’re not in the game. The perfect game for foodies and business lovers alike, give opening your own restaurant a go today!

► HOW IT WORKS

● Step 1: Open your first restaurant. It may be a small pizzeria, but that doesn’t mean it’s not mighty. Serve up great pizza, lemonade, and other delicious meals, and have your customers raving and coming back for more. As business booms, hire more wait staff, and consider adding new items like hot dogs or burgers to the menu. Keep cooking!

● Step 2: Branch out. Once your first location is successful, why stop there? The world needs more than just one pizzeria or sushi bar, so do a little market research and see what the people want to eat the most. At one location customers may prefer fresh strawberry lemonade, at another it’s good coffee – figure it out to keep your business empire running and your dreams growing.

● Step 3: Improve your business skills. If you want to be the ultimate food tycoon, you’ll need to be business savvy. Raise prices carefully, hire skilled staff, expand your food and drink offerings, and more as part of this idle tycoon cooking simulator game where you’ll need to balance sourcing resources with hiring the best chefs. Customers may love your good coffee or burgers, but if the staff are slow that’s a big turn off, and your tycoon dreams may suffer.

● Step 4: Move up the chain. Cooking may be your passion, but if you want to make the big bucks you’ll move from the kitchen to the office, and start managing your different restaurants from above. Hopefully you’ve done your due diligence and hired the best staff, because that means you won’t need to worry if the pizza’s ready or the coffee’s good – you’ll know they are!

● Step 5: Profit. It’s all about the idle tycoon goodness in this simulator, where if you’ve played your cards right your restaurants will keep bringing in the big bucks even when you’re not in the game thanks to the idle mechanics.  Enjoy playing and managing, then step away to let your staff do all the heavy lifting and rake in the dough (both literally and figuratively: those burger buns and pizza pies aren’t made from air you know!)

● Step 6: You’re on top, baby! That’s right, you made it and are the world’s ultimate food tycoon. Just about every type of food imaginable is cooked and served at your restaurants, and with tiptop staff and facilities customers just can’t seem to get enough. The world’s your oyster – hey, speaking of, what a great new menu item!

► WHAT’S COOKING, CHEF?

Pizza, burgers, sushi, coffee… the choices of food and drink are endless in your restaurants! From a simple pizzeria food truck that served fresh hot slices, to sit-down restaurants with gourmet burgers, to cafes full of hot coffee and tasty strawberry pastries, you offer it all. But none of this would work without your expert business management skills that you’ve gained while playing, from hiring staff to managing customer expectations.

If you’re ready to become the ultimate food tycoon, download Foodventure today and show the world you’ve got what it takes!

Step into a frozen world where warmth is the only thing standing between you and the endless cold. Frozia: Eternal Frontier is a survival strategy game that drops you into a harsh winter apocalypse of snow, ice, and unforgiving frost. Keep the Fire Alive
In the freezing wild, fire is your lifeline. Gather wood, feed the flame, and hold your warmth through every big blizzard. Let the cold win and the whiteout will take everything — every fire you light pushes the freeze back one more night.

Build and Rebuild Your Base
From the ruins of an abandoned town, create a home in the snow. Build a shelter, restore lost supplies, and grow a cozy base strong enough to survive the winter. Manage every resource, item, and scrap of food, and rebuild the frontier one warm room at a time.

Recruit Survivors and Grow Your Alliance
You are not alone on this frozen land. Uncover hidden survivors, recruit new companions, and form an alliance ready to conquer the cold together. Assign each character a role, level up their skill, and manage a team that turns a lonely camp into a thriving town.

Explore the Icy Frontier
Every step uncovers a new area of the wild, frozen world. Explore ruins, reveal hidden supplies, and adventure deeper into the frontier. Collect resources, upgrade your gear, and unlock rewards that make every decision and every expedition count.

Endless Challenges Await
Face endless challenges where every choice matters. Fight off danger, chain your upgrades, and progress from a lone survivor into the leader of an unstoppable frontier. Warm, strategic, and full of hope — Frozia is survival the frost can't freeze.

- Survival strategy in a frozen, snow-covered world
- Build, restore, and upgrade your base and shelter
- Gather resources, supplies, and food to survive the cold
- Recruit survivors and grow a powerful alliance
- Explore hidden areas and uncover the frontier's secrets
- Endless challenges, rewards, and progress to unlock

Light the fire. Rally your alliance. Conquer the eternal frontier of Frozia.

it.name: GhostM Global
it.d:
[Introduction]
In a world plunged into chaos by malevolent ghosts unleashed from an eternal seal, only the strength of brave martial arts warriors can restore order. Rise up to rescue a realm where justice and peace have faded, and help return it to a place where both can thrive once more.



[Ghost M Global]
Experience the timeless appeal of the legendary side-scrolling martial arts MMORPG, Ghost Online, now seamlessly adapted for mobile. Customize and train your character to become the warrior destined to restore peace to a chaotic world.



[Summon Ghost]
Summoning the ghosts sealed within scrolls will enhance your abilities.



[Spirit]
The six types of spirits obtained by vanquishing evil ghosts will greatly aid you on your journey.



[Pet and Sub pet]
Don’t forget about the Pets and Sub pets that will provide comfort on your long, solitary journey. If you diligently care for them, they will become loyal companions, standing by your side to uphold justice during these turbulent times.



[Collection]  
The journey to becoming a martial arts warrior requires relentless training. By exercising patience through fishing and building strength through mining, you can cultivate both body and mind, ultimately transforming into a true martial arts warrior.



[Monster Encyclopedia]
By completing puzzles with the monster piece obtained from defeating evil monsters, you can achieve milestones that will be forever etched in your legacy.



[Infinite Dungeon]
You can now sweep away demons and grow in a comfortable, private space in the Infinite Growth Dungeon.



[Ghost World]
GhostM Global features multiple continents, some of which remain untouched by evil monsters, preserving their stunning natural landscapes and peaceful atmosphere. Others have been overrun by malevolent creatures, roaming freely. In the eerie underworld, grotesque beings with sticky tentacles and secretions lurk, luring you into danger—a chilling place where even the most skilled martial arts warriors will feel their blood run cold.



[Community]
Through sects, groups, friends, and chat, you can connect with like-minded martial arts warriors from around the world and join forces to defeat evil monsters together.



[Game Features]
▶ Marketplace
Buy and sell various equipment freely.



▶ PVP
Test your skills and measure your abilities by facing off against other 
martial arts warriors.



▶ Arena
Compete against other martial arts warriors to showcase your skills and
establish your rank.



▶ Promotion
As you accumulate power, you can unlock new martial arts skills and 
elevate your abilities, reaching a higher realm of  martial mastery.



▶ Blacksmith
Upgrade your equipment to craft higher-tier equipment for martial arts
warriors.



▶ Shop
Utilize the items obtained from defeating evil monsters wisely by 
trading them for valuable resources.

it.name: Gladiator Survival ・ Roman RPG
it.d:
Gladiators: Survival in Rome is a survival RPG with quests, crafting and city-building aspects. Set in the era of the Roman Empire, you'll play a young warrior whose mentor went missing, and who is exploring an open world of treasure and dangers.

Free slaves from cruel soldiers, explore mythic secrets in barbarian and uncharted lands and build a city of free, surviving men. Craft your weapons and armor from what you have gathered, then slay the king's legions and conquer the Roman Empire!

=== The first social survival game on mobile ===

You're not alone: Thousands of other legionnaires yearn for glory and recognition of the Roman emperor. Team up with fellow survivors or fight rivals in the arena, for you to become the greatest Gladiator before the eyes of the citizens of mighty Rome!

=== Features of Gladiators: Survival in Rome ===

• Action Combat: Free movement and hack'n'slay at its finest
• Deep Crafting: Harvest plants, mine stone and chop trees all over the game world
• Open World: Explore the kingdoms of the past and find treasures
• City Building: Plan your home and raise your own city and farms
• Strategic Choice: Customise your weapons for different effects
• Unique Art Style: Hand-crafted 3D models and stunning animations
• Great History: Survival against zombies is boring, we’ll put you on a historical fantasy journey into Caesar’s times!

=== A note from the developers ===

In our game, we're examining natural player behaviour to tweak our game design for the best user experience, using game analytics tools that show us in an anonymized way how users play. There's no possibility to identify you personally or have access to your personal data. Please also familiarize yourself with our privacy policy: 

We have built a world in Ancient Rome with myriads of puzzle pieces from a single hand-drawn pebble to procedurally generated maps for players to conquer and give the journey purpose. As with all major game development projects, reality and reception are the only source of truth so please don't be afraid to share your feelings towards any and all aspects of Colossi's first game.

Thank you for trying out Gladiators: Survival in Rome! If you like what you see or have feedback, we’re super happy about an App Store review or your visit on our Social Media pages:

-> Discord: https://discord.gg/xg6XYzJgJm

-> Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Gladiators.Survival

Where every style tells a story, and every makeover begins with a spark of creativity.
In Glow Tales: Merge & Makeover, you’ll enter a vibrant world where beauty, fashion, and storytelling intertwine. Merge beauty items, design stunning looks, and follow Michael and his team as they transform their salon—and the lives of everyone who walks through its doors.

Merge & Makeover
Dive into a relaxing merge gameplay where every match brings a touch of beauty!
Drag, drop, and merge beauty items — from makeup brushes and perfumes to stylish dresses and salon tools. Combine them to craft upgraded cosmetics and unlock new makeover materials.
As you merge, you’ll prepare for real transformations: glowing looks, bold hairstyles, chic fashion pieces, and salon-ready vibes! Watch as your beauty table turns into a glowing canvas of creativity.

Fashion, Style & Story
In Glow Tales, every makeover hides a story.
Help clients rediscover their confidence — from brides-to-be seeking their dream look, to celebrities preparing for red carpet moments, and everyday people chasing a fresh start.
Each chapter introduces a new challenge, a new style, and a new emotional twist.
Will Michael’s creative spark return?
Can Mina prove herself as more than a newcomer?
And who’s behind the mysterious “Glow Agency” that’s competing to steal your spotlight?

Relaxing & Satisfying Merge Fun
Enjoy soothing ASMR moments as you merge brushes, tap lipsticks, and polish nails.
Feel the satisfaction of transforming messy salon corners into glowing studios, one merge at a time.
Perfect for relaxing after a long day — calm visuals, soft animations, and satisfying sound design make every action rewarding.

Build Your Dream Salon
Work alongside Michael, the studio’s founder and visionary lead, a talented crew stands by his side:
Collette — the sharp-eyed stylist who turns concepts into runway-ready looks.
Mina — a cheerful makeup artist with a love for color and soft glam.
Leo — the charming photographer who captures every transformation in perfect light.
Luca — the creative hairdresser crafting signature cuts and head-turning styles.

Features You’ll Love
Merge Beauty Items – Match and combine tools, products, and accessories to create premium beauty kits.
Complete Makeovers – Transform characters from simple to stunning using the items you merge.
Fashion Design Challenges – Choose outfits, colors, and accessories to match every story.
Interactive Stories – Experience heartfelt journeys, dramatic rivalries, and touching character moments.
Relaxing Gameplay – Soft music, glow effects, and ASMR-inspired visuals to unwind anytime.

Welcome to the ultimate goblin tycoon game!
Goblin Miner: Idle Merger is a fun and addictive idle game where mischievous goblins work, dig, and merge their way to unimaginable gold riches. Build your goblin kingdom, upgrade your labs, and watch your empire grow — even while you’re away!

BUILD YOUR GOBLIN EMPIRE
Start the game in a small enchanted mine, and turn it into a thriving goblin empire! Chop wood, mine resources, and earn piles of gold to unlock new labs, upgrades, and runes.

MERGE & UPGRADE GOBLINS
Combine similar goblins to create faster and more powerful ones! Merge your way through the game to evolve lazy workers into elite gold-digging tycoons.

EXPLORE AND EXPAND
Unlock new territories and dig deeper! Grow your goblin workforce, upgrade labs, and discover hidden secrets that boost your gold income in this exciting idle game.

COLLECT RUNES & BOOST YOUR GAME
Gather powerful game cards that unlock special goblin abilities, increase your mining speed, and help you generate even more gold. Progress faster and dominate the mine!

STRATEGY OR CHAOS — YOU CHOOSE
This game lets you play your way! Plan your merges and upgrades for max efficiency, or let your goblins go wild and reap the gold rewards either way.

SPECIAL EVENTS & CHALLENGES
Take part in themed in-game events packed with exclusive rewards. Compete, collect, and climb the leaderboards in this dynamic goblin-powered game.

Start your journey to become the richest goblin in the forest!
Whether you’re a fan of idle, merge, or tycoon games, Goblin Miner delivers nonstop fun, greedy goblins, and mountains of glorious gold.

Be careful of underground explosions and use the checkpoint base to save your progress.

Start mining and fill your bag with gold and diamonds in the best free digging game ever! Can you become the speleology tycoon?

it.name: Gold Rush: Frozen Farm
it.d:
► STRIKE IT RICH

There’s gold in them hills! Join in on this thrilling gold rush adventure as you build bustling settlements, stake your claim on land, and mine for gold deep in the treacherous mountains. Face the harsh realities of survival as you brave freezing winter temperatures and scarce resources, all while trying to strike it rich and earn enough money to save your sick father.
It’s a race against time and nature, but fortune favors the brave. So what are you waiting for, partner? Grab your snow shovel, and let’s start mining for gold! The adventure of a lifetime awaits!

► MINE YOUR OWN BUSINESS!

Your adventure begins in the dead of winter during a whiteout, so you’ll need to focus on clearing snow from the settlement and mine after they were hit by an avalanche in order to ensure your survival before you can even begin to think of earning money. Once you’ve gotten things in the town under control, you can move on to the mines where you’ll pan for gold to send back home to your family. Enjoy exploring and while also earning resources in this frozen idle adventure game where there’s always something new to do, be it build a town, thaw survivors, or explore all the fun locations!

- Snowy settlements – Following an avalanche and a whiteout, the town is completely snowed under! Use your trusty snowplow to clear it and uncover a wealth of resources underneath, including a few frozen friends…

- Frozen survivors – thaw them out by the fire and soon you’ll have helpers in your quest to get the settlement up and running again. Your new friends will be happy to stay back and work idly on tasks for you, increasing the town’s production rate and keeping you all fueled while you’re off on adventure.

- Great resources and buildings – it’s survival of the fittest out there, so collect all manner of resources from under the snow and in the mines that can be either used as they are or combined to make something special! Build structures and improve on other items, all with what you can find under the snow.

- Harvesting – If you want to mine gold, you’re going to need energy! Uncover crop land and plant seeds to both feed your growing town and earn you coins.

- Expeditions – your survival depends on your ability to keep finding resources, so once you have your base up and running, start pushing North in search of more gold, resources, and adventure. Remember, the more you can find and mine, the more you can send back home to your family to help your father!

► THE WORLD IS YOUR (GOLDEN) OYSTER

Set out on the adventure of a lifetime to earn money to pay for your father’s treatment, and along the way uncover frozen friends, rebuild towns, mine gold, and so much more. With lots of great locations to uncover and resources to collect and use there’s always something happening in this frozen adventure!

If you’re looking for a fun idle survival game that is chock full of hours of fun, Gold Rush: Frozen Adventures is the game for you so download it today to get to playing!

desc:
Will you be able to manage a whole golf club, build your golf empire and become the biggest golf tycoon in the world?!

Become rich as an idle golfing capitalist and build and grow your golf course from one small hole to a thriving golf club with happy members enjoying the best golf of their lives. If you like sports…

it.name: Idle Golf Club Manager Tycoon
it.d:
Will you be able to manage a whole golf club, build your golf empire and become the biggest golf tycoon in the world?!

Become rich as an idle golfing capitalist and build and grow your golf course from one small hole to a thriving golf club with happy members enjoying the best golf of their lives. If you like sports games, golf games or management and simulation games, then this is going to be the most enjoyable game with many updates, courses and features to come.

As a golf club tycoon, transform your small patch of land into a green and luscious golf course with hundreds of members playing at your prestigious golf club. Attract the best players in the world to tournaments.

EXPAND YOUR GOLF COURSE
You start off with just one golf hole, but there are 18 holes in total to unlock as you expand your world, see your golf club grow and your golf players will love being part of your growing empire. Be a real tiger and an ambitious manager of this thriving golf club. Each hole can be upgraded with trees, bunkers, flowers and plants, better tees, ball cleaners, trash cans, lakes, rivers and more. It’s up to you to manage your golf course to make it the prettiest golf club in the world.

GOLF BUGGIES
As you manage your golf club to become a golfing millionaire, you’re building a big golf course. And there’s only one way to get around in style - with your own golf buggy of course! So make sure you’ve got enough golf buggies for your club members as, without a buggy, you can’t get on the course. Plus you can get players around quicker and you know what that means...you get richer quicker!

PUTTING GREEN
As they say, “distance for show, putting for dough”. Well here’s your chance to practice your golf shots on the putting green. Can you hold your nerve and hole the putts on the golf putting green? Don’t clash with your golf rivals until you’ve battled your way on the putting green before you take to the golf course. You can also manage your putting green with benches, trash cans, bushes and lots of holes. In the hole!!

RUN TOURNAMENTS
Having golf club members is great, but the way to really become a golf club tycoon is to run tournaments where you attract the best pro players from around the world. And that means you’ll earn money and get rich with TV companies wanting to film the hot golfing battles and clashes on the golf course. You’ll also attract fans to watch the game and so you’ll need stands, restrooms, TV crews and more.

SPORTS LOUNGE
Once you’ve finished 18 holes on the golf course, you deserve to relax with your other golfing friends in the sports lounge. You can expand the number of tables and chairs you have to entertain the other golf club members. Get comfy seating but also ensure you manage your lounge properly with drinks and snacks, potted plants, TVs to watch the best golf tournaments in the world, snack machines, trophy cabinet (where you can place your golf battle trophies!), plus good speakers for the best music.

PRO SHOP
No idle golf tycoon would miss out on the chance to make money and cash to become rich, with their own pro shop or golf shop. There are so many ways to become a capitalist millionaire in your shop. With golf clothes, golf clubs, golf bags, golf balls, videos, posters, standing displays and more. This golf pro shop is made to be managed to become a rich golf club tycoon!

PREMIUM UPGRADES
As your members start to demand more from their golf club and golf course, you’ll need to upgrade your course with things like fountains, topiary sculptures, maple trees and more. It will be worth you investing in these premium items as you’ll become an even richer tycoon and attract higher-paying members. Yes!

LOTS MORE TO COME!
We hope you enjoy playing our Idle Golf Club Tycoon game. We look forward to updating the game with many more features, holes, courses, tournaments, plus expanding your golfing world to give you the players the chance to become rich as a millionaire tycoon!

it.name: Good Coffee, Great Coffee
it.d:
Wake up and smell the coffee because TapBlaze's newest simulation cooking game, Good Coffee, Great Coffee, is finally here! Prepare delicious drinks, experiment with new flavors, decorate your shop, and manage cafe costs to become the best barista in town!

Fulfill quirky customer orders with coffee drinks that look and taste delicious! Upgrade your shop with new decorations and equipment to increase your cafe profit! Make friends, rivals, and more when locals visit your shop! Listen to their stories and inspire the town with your coffee-making skills!

Download the game now to become the next coffee master! This cooking game is free to play, can be played offline, and is perfect for anyone who loves cozy games, cafe games, simulation games, and coffee! Grab your apron and start your journey as a barista now!

GAME HIGHLIGHTS

* Over 200 customers with unique coffee orders, stories, and personalities!
* Coffee drink recipes featuring a variety of ingredients and toppings.
* Creative and fun latte art drawing to up your coffee game!
* Customizable and collectible cozy coffee shop decorations!
* An immersive main story with coffee challenges and funny side stories!
* Charming scenery, relaxing BGM, and ASMR sounds to complement your coffee-making experience!
* Customizable and collectible cozy coffee shop decorations!
* Powerful cafe equipment upgrades for maximum cafe efficiency and proficiency!
* Featuring Coffee News Scoop (CNS), the first newscast about all things cafe-related.

FUN FACTS

* Good Coffee, Great Coffee was made by a team of coffee lovers who took barista classes to ensure they captured the relaxing and realistic feeling of making coffee in the game!
* Made by the team that brought you the simulation game, Good Pizza, Great Pizza!

This simple, cozy, and cute coffee cafe cooking game is free to play! Download now and start your barista journey today!

it.name: Grand Theft Auto III
it.d:
The sprawling crime epic that changed open-world games forever.

Welcome to Liberty City. Where it all began.

Rockstar Games celebrates the 10th anniversary of one of the most influential games of all time.  The critically acclaimed blockbuster Grand Theft Auto III comes to mobile devices, bringing to life the dark and seedy underworld of Liberty City. With a massive and diverse open world, a wild cast of characters from every walk of life and the freedom to explore at will, Grand Theft Auto III puts the dark, intriguing and ruthless world of crime at your fingertips.

With stellar voice acting, a darkly comic storyline, a stunning soundtrack and revolutionary open-world gameplay, Grand Theft Auto III is the game that defined the open world genre for a generation.

Features:
• Visually stunning updated graphics, character and vehicle models
• HD quality resolution
• Gameplay optimized for touch screen devices
• Custom controls for the mobile platform
• Countless hours of gameplay

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish and Japanese.

Universal App:
Grand Theft Auto III is supported on iPhone 4, iPhone 5, iPhone 4S, iPod Touch 4, iPod Touch 5, iPad 1, iPad 2, iPad 3rd Generation, iPad 4th Generation, and iPad Mini.

For optimal performance, we recommend re-booting your device after downloading and closing other applications when playing Grand Theft Auto III: 10 Year Anniversary Edition.

it.name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
it.d:
***PLEASE NOTE: This game is officially supported on the following devices only: iPhone 4s, 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6s, 6 Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, iPod Touch 6th Gen, iPad Mini 1, 2, 3 & 4, iPad 2, 3rd Gen, 4th Gen, iPad Air 1 & 2, and iPad Pro.***


Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features:

Gun Force is a run-and-gun metal shooter video game with classic 2D pixel art, mixed with exciting rogue-like elements.

Welcome to Happy Campers - Idle Tycoon where your dreams of creating the ultimate campground come true!

Have you ever wanted to manage your own campground, build a space in nature to share with others, and make a profit doing it? With Happy Campers - Idle Tycoon, you're not just playing an idle game, you're creating a space in nature for yourself and your customers to enjoy. Start with just a single campsite and tame and shape nature to create a booming campground. Use your funds from your first campground to found new ones all over the world, and build your cozy camping empire!

Build & Expand your Camping Empire:

Ultimate Campsites: Begin your journey with a single tent space, and expand to fit luxury yurts and host hundreds of families!
Create Fun Activities: Open special activities to set your campground apart and keep your campers around for longer. Try archery ranges for your adventurous customers, or open a bait shop for those that way to relax on the lake and catch a few fish. 
Feast on Snacks: Deliver ice cream, hot chocolate, smores, hot dogs, or even open a bar. Why would your campers ever want to leave if they can get great food right on site!?
Provide necessities: Set up water sources, showers, and other necessities for your campers. Help create a comfortable environment for them to relax in.
Deep Management Mechanics: Engage in the nitty gritty of campsite management. Hire camp rangers, stockers, entrance operators, servers, activity monitors, and more to help organize and manage everything going on in your park. Deal with customer special requests, restock services, let in extra customers, choose where to invest your funds, and keep the park running smoothly!

Are you ready to create the perfect outdoor adventure? Download now and build your space in nature!

it.name: Happy Citizens - Mayor Sim
it.d:
Mr. Mayor, come and create your very own dream city! This will be an incredibly creative and entertaining simulation management experience.
Not only can you observe the rich and colorful lives of citizens, but citizens can also get married, start families, and have children! Protect their city life for generations to come!

A barren wasteland awaits your development. 
You will take on the important mission of building the city. 
From planning the initial street layout to gradually constructing various functional buildings, each step tests your planning wisdom.

You must not only shape the city's appearance but also recruit unique citizens. 
They might be brilliant artists who illuminate the city's culture with their works; skilled craftsmen who drive the city's industrial development; or warm and friendly service workers who bring warmth to the city.
You need to reasonably assign their positions according to the city's needs, allowing every citizen to find a sense of belonging and live happily in this city.

Additionally, various exciting transportation vehicles will appear one after another! Besides bicycles, motorcycles, cars... there are even airplanes and hot air balloons?! There might even be UFOs appearing. Let's cheer for the residents who work hard to master them.

Observe the residences carefully - residents are actually keeping pets! Cats, dogs... elephants, pandas, giraffes, capybaras, and even lions can be kept!?

As the game progresses, you can unlock different styles of buildings: from happiness-filled restaurants to vibrant fountain parks, from towering skyscrapers to leisurely spinning windmills, adding unique charm to the city.

Work hard to develop and create a mega-metropolis that shocks the world!

Never played this type of game before?
Don't worry, "Happy Citizens" is simple to operate and extremely easy to get started: you only need simple and relaxed tap operations to complete city design and construction, easily earning profits. You can play anytime, anywhere.
Whether you're a master well-versed in simulation management or a newcomer just starting in city management, you'll fall madly in love with this healing, warm, and interesting city simulation management game!

it.name: Hero Age - RPG classic
it.d:
NEW STORY OF ANCIENT 
This is the world of hero and ancient. You will become a hero to protect your continent.

8 HEROIC CLASSES
- Knight: powerful with melee skill, he uses sword to attack monsters.
- Wizard: powerful with magic skill, he uses staff and magic skill to attack monsters in wide range.
- Archer: powerful with archery skill, she uses bow to shot enemies.
- Magic Knight: powerful with magic sword, he can use both melee and magic skill.
- Summoner: powerful with poison, summon and curse magic, excellent development.
- Warlord: powerful with scepters and pets.
- Fighter: use claws, axes with power fist, kick.
- Lancer: use lance and spear.

UNIQUE WEAPONS AND SKILLS
Your hero can use many kind of weapon, armor set. Each class has different item, skill tree.

CHALLENGE ZONES AND MONSTERS
Your continent has many land to train, hunt. Each land has many kind of monster, each monster has different skill and strength.

CLASSICAL ROLE PLAYING GAME
This is truly RPG game, you will see Health potion and Mana potion in game. Train your character and level up, hunt monsters to receive jewel or rune to upgrade item. There is the leaderboard to show up your power, your achievement, your item.

YOUR CHARACTER WILL GO ON
This content of game will be upgraded usually.
Nice time to train your character now.

SPECIAL FEATURES:
1. Item upgrading system.
- You can use Ancient Jewel to upgrade your item level such as armor, weapon, shield, pendant and ring up to 15, each level has different graphic effect.
- You can use lots of Rune to add more options to your item to increase your item power.

2. Quest system.
- In order to receive more attribute point, skill point, coin, exp or lucky item, you have to do quest.
- There are many kind of quest: kill boss, hunting, find quest item.

3. Event system.
- Hell Forces is the main event in this world, you will fight with them to get quality items.
- Mini game, line up the Lucky Box to get it, you will have chance to get lucky item or coin.

4. Mobile friendly.

Search and find like Sherlock
Hidden Hotel game is different from other puzzle games such as Match 3! Here, you’ll find hidden objects concealed within a picture. Feel like a detective from the addictive novels. To make things even more exciting, we constantly update our content with brand-new mysteries! Pay attention to all the hidden clues, and Hidden Hotel will reveal its secrets to you!

Get ready, your mysterious adventure in this hidden object game is about to begin! Harness your seek-and-find skills and immerse yourself in the world of hidden objects adventure!

it.d:
"A New Life on Horizon Island"

Karl was one of the ones who survived after the earth was submerged in water due to global warming. He was drifting on a raft in the open sea, when he saw a figure being swept into a whirlpool. He recognized her as Lara, a history teacher he had met on a trip before the disaster. He did not hesitate to swim to save her, and they escaped the whirlpool. They clung to the raft and hoped to find land.

After a while, they saw a deserted island in the distance. They struggled to swim to the island and stepped ashore. They looked around and saw the desolation of the island. There was no sign of life, only dry trees and piles of rubble. They did not know if the island was dangerous or not, but they knew they had no other choice.

Could Karl and Lara build a new life on this deserted island?

Do you want to experience the survival adventure with Karl and Lara on the deserted island? Or do you want to build your own farm and explore the mysteries of Horizon Island? If so, Horizon Island: Farm Adventure is the game for you!

Horizon Island: Farm Adventure is the game that combines adventure and farm building genres. Here, you will have to overcome survival challenges, build a farm to grow crops, raise animals, craft tools and items, build facilities to serve your life on the island. You will also have to face the dangers and difficulties from nature and wild creatures.

Horizon Island: Farm Adventure with many features and missions:
•  BUILD: Build your own farm on the deserted island. You will have many choices with different types of crops, animals, tools and items to create food. You can also build structures such as houses, warehouses, factories, restaurants and more.

•  EXPLORE: Explore new areas on the deserted island. You will meet and interact with new friends, as well as dangerous enemies. You will discover the secrets and stories hidden on the island. You can also explore other islands around to collect more resources and items.

•  STORY: Enjoy a romantic and humorous story with surprising twists. You will not only survive on the island, but also have the opportunity to find your true love. You will have to decide your fate and that of your loved one in this new life.

•  EVENTS: Participate in special events daily and weekly to receive attractive items
Horizon Island: Farm Adventure is a game that brings you joy, relaxation and great challenges. With adventure, farm building and love story games, you will never feel bored. Download the game now and join the journey of survival and farm building. 

Play Horizon Island: Farm Adventure today.

it.name: Hunt Royale: Action RPG Battle
it.d:
Hunt Royale invites brave hunters to join the neverending battle against fearsome monsters and other warriors. Dust off your trusty sword, get into your old armor, and join others in shaping legends and songs of glory that will echo through generations!

Step into the shoes of one of the PLETHORA OF DIFFERENT CHARACTERS. Each one offers a wide array of SKILLS TO MASTER. Only by using them in battle will you be able to FEND OFF YOUR COMPETITION and become the one that rules the battlefield.

Features:
- 80+ characters to unlock and level up!
- Many different game modes, PvE and PvP
- Dungeons with unique enemies to fight
- Powerful skills to use and master
- Unpredictable special events and daily challenges
- Amusing voxel-based graphics

So get our eyes on the prize and prepare to JOIN THE FIGHT. The game seamlessly marries STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY with real time COMBAT ACTION to create an exciting, vibrant environment full of CHALLENGE, EXCITEMENT AND ADVENTURE. 

Every upcoming and seasoned warrior has something to find here. With each obstacle faced, either in PvE or PvP modes, your experience and skill set will grow, allowing you to become a true legend. Each of the 70 CHARACTERS offers UNIQUE MECHANICS to discover, giving you endless opportunities for discovery and growth.

ENTER THE DUNGEON to hone your skills. Feel the CALL OF THE MAZE, which offers something new every time you enter. Use your hard-earned loot and XP to grow ever stronger on the field of battle. FIND TREASURES to feast our eyes on. TRY OUT NEW BUILDS and use them to win battles and earn more trophies!

Test your mettle ON THE ARENA, the ultimate hunting grounds where survival is key. STAY EVER VIGILANT as other players compete against you for the highest score. The best loot and the most sound strategy will be nothing if you can’t execute it. So GET ON THERE AND FIGHT!

Those are the bread and butter of a warrior's life, but there’s more! Gather up your friends to share stories of victor and perseverance in the CO-OP MODE. When your exploits bring you together and forge unbreakable bonds, FORM A CLAN whose name will be spoken with reverence across the land. 

Or maybe the life of a BOUNTY HUNTER is something more suited to your tastes? It’s the way to discover different challenges and earn LEGENDARY LOOT along the way. 

When your purse is full and your gear is up to par, you will be ready to strike fear into the eyes of other hunters in EPIC DUELS. Show once and for that you belong in the hall of the champions. 

After hours of hard-fought battles, share your stories of valor with others in the tavern. This is a SOCIAL SPACE free of danger, where glorious warriors meet and fates intertwine. SHOW OFF YOUR LOOT. Bask in your accomplishments. 

When you feel rested and energized, TRY OUT NEW APPROACHES. Tired of melee combat? Try range! Want to feel the power on your fingertips? Learn magic! Be good, be evil, be anything in between. CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER with unlockable skills to express yourself.

And when you think you’ve seen and done everything, regular UNPREDICTABLE EVENTS will be ready for you to jump into. Never stop learning, never stop fighting, never stop earning. Hunt Royale awaits!

it.name: Idle Distiller: Tycoon Games

Build your brewery empire in Idle Distiller Tycoon, an idle tycoon game where you brew beer, distill spirits and turn a small business into a growing factory empire. Hire managers, automate production and invest your in-game cash as you expand into breweries, distilleries and wineries.

Enjoy idle games and tycoon games? Take charge of a brewery where every upgrade helps your operation grow. Upgrade your factories, increase profits and build an idle tycoon empire that keeps earning between sessions. A corrupt mayor wants to shut your business down. Ready to give him a brewery he cannot ignore?

BUILD YOUR BREWERY TYCOON EMPIRE
Start by brewing your first beer, then grow beyond your original brewery. Unlock factories, develop your distillery and expand into wine production. Every business is another opportunity to invest your earnings and build a bigger empire.

Combine beer brewing with factory management as you build your drinks empire. Choose where to spend your in-game money, improve production lines and turn small profits into your next expansion. For fans of tycoon games, the goal is simple: build, upgrade and grow.

AUTOMATE YOUR IDLE FACTORY
Hire managers to automate your brewery and distillery businesses. Keep production moving without endless tapping and let your team handle the factory workflow. Your job as a tycoon is to decide what comes next.

Enjoy the progress of idle games with a hands-on management twist. Collect idle cash, upgrade your factories and put your profits back into the business. This idle factory simulator lets you focus on expansion while your managers keep things running.

UPGRADE YOUR BUSINESS AND EARN IDLE CASH
Make your next investment count in this idle tycoon simulator. Upgrade production lines to increase profits, unlock new factories and build your business empire one improvement at a time. Spend your in-game money on the upgrades that move your operation forward.

Your automated businesses keep earning between sessions. Return to collect idle cash and choose your next upgrade. Whether you enjoy idle clicker games for quick check-ins or tycoon games for growing an empire, your next investment is waiting.

TAKE ON THE MAYOR
A corrupt mayor is determined to close your business. Follow a humorous storyline as you grow your brewery empire and push back against his plans. Build your distillery, expand your factories and give him more than a small business to worry about.

Idle Distiller brings a story-driven adventure to idle tycoon games. You are not just watching numbers grow: you are building a business with a rival who wants to see it fail. Keep investing and prove you have what it takes to become a distillery tycoon.

EXPLORE EVENTS AND FACTORY CHALLENGES
Step into themed events alongside your main business. Take on factory challenges, work toward rewards and enjoy a change of setting. Collect bottle caps and earn achievements as you keep progressing.

Play your way with idle clicker gameplay and optional tapping boosts, or let automation handle production. From a quick upgrade to another event challenge, there is more to explore as your brewery grows.

BUILD, AUTOMATE AND BECOME A TYCOON
Turn your first beer into a thriving drinks empire. Idle Distiller combines the growth of idle games, the upgrades of tycoon games and the satisfaction of automating your own factories. Manage your factories, hire your managers and make every batch part of your next expansion.

From brewing beer to distilling spirits, you set the pace. Take charge of production, grow your profits and make your brewery thrive.

Start your idle tycoon adventure and build your brewery empire today!

it.name: Idle Mars Survival: Migrate
it.d:
As an astronaut stranded on Mars, your main objective is to survive and thrive in this challenging game. Here's a guide on how to survive:

Generate Power: Maintaining various devices is crucial, so you need to find a way to generate electricity. This can be achieved through solar panels, wind turbines, or other power sources available on Mars.

Secure Resources: You must find food, water, and other essential supplies to sustain yourself. Explore the surroundings to gather resources like plants, minerals, and water deposits. Develop strategies to extract and store these resources efficiently.

Expand Your Base: As you progress, expand your base to accommodate more survivors. This involves constructing additional structures, living quarters, and facilities to support the growing population. Each survivor brings unique skills and abilities, so recruit more astronauts to enhance your chances of survival.

Produce Oxygen: Develop systems to produce sufficient amounts of oxygen to support the colonization plan. This can be achieved through the cultivation of plants or the utilization of oxygen-generating equipment.

Defend Against Spore Invasions: Mars is inhabited by dangerous spores that can harm both humans and infrastructure. Build defensive structures and implement countermeasures to protect your base from spore invasions. Research and develop new technologies to improve your defenses.

Remember, perseverance and resource management are key to your survival. Good luck in your journey to establish a successful colony on Mars!

Features:

1.Combination of simulation (SIM) and light role-playing game (RPG) elements.
2.Simple and relaxed 2D graphics style.
3.Explore the map to collect various mineral resources.
4.Construct defensive fortifications to fend off spore invasions.
5.Recruit more astronauts as companions to aid in your survival.

it.name: Invincible: Guarding the Globe
it.d:
Invincible: Guarding the Globe is an idle squad RPG set in the Invincible universe featuring a new story never seen in the comics or Amazon Prime TV series, with graphic multi battle action, character collection, team management, idle features and, of course, super-powered visuals.

THE WORLD OF INVINCIBLE
Accompany the highly rated Amazon Prime Video show with the first Invincible mobile RPG.
Embark on a complete campaign with an original story – a new narrative where you join the Global Defense Agency to unravel the mystery of a deadly clone army (and… stolen burger meat?) working alongside the head of the GDA, Cecil Stedman.

CHARACTER COLLECTION
Recruit a team of iconic characters from the Invincible comics and show. From obvious all-time favorites like Invincible and Atom Eve, to the notorious Flaxans, Mauler Twins and more.
Gain battle experience to level up your team, combining clones to increase their rank and achieve new heights of strength, power, and overall badassery.

SUPER-POWERED ACTION
Assemble your line-up and deploy them into blood-soaked RPG battle action.
Each squad member has a role: Attacker, Defender, or Support. 
It’s up to you to choose the best combo for each encounter. During combat, each member of your team can unleash their own powerful ultimate ability to smash and/or rip the enemy to a pulp and/or shreds and claim victory.

IDLE BATTLE & GDA OPS
Run idle battles in the background while you’re AFK living your everyday life. Even better, accumulate tons of rewards to collect when you’re back!
Get more out of your team, send them on GDA Ops: secondary battle that runs separate from the main storyline, played simultaneously.

ALLIANCES WITH FRIENDS
Team up with friends to deploy a group of heroes co-op. Prepare for social battle together, facing waves of Magmanites, Reanimen and Flaxans popping up, dropping down, or portal-ing themselves in from other dimensions.

GEAR & ARTIFACTS
Always good to have a little extra padding! Send your team into battle fully equipped with four categories of gear: chestwear, legwear, footwear and gloves. 
Add special, unique gear known as artifacts for extra stat bonuses or passive effects. 
Each piece of gear has a rarity level and can be upgraded to enhance its benefit even further.

SHOPS, NOT LOOTBOXES
There’s a mall’s-worth of different stores to check out. Recruit heroes, acquire gear, currencies and more! Pop into Cecil’s Recruitment Department to get new heroes. Or visit Art’s Tailor Shoppe to purchase equipment and other items of interest. 
This is no casino: get what you want in transparent shops without frustrating gacha mechanics or lootbox systems.

MISSIONS & EVENTS 
More action to keep you on your toes - complete daily and weekly goals for huge in-game rewards, with frequent special offers, unique in-game events, and more to come. Each month a new character from the Invincible universe will be revealed and available to recruit for your team.

Stranded. Alone. Your Family Awaits. Unravel the Island's Secrets!

Welcome to the ultimate test of survival and love. After a devastating plane crash, you awaken on a mysterious, untouched island, your family nowhere in sight. Your only mission: find them, no matter the cost.

Break through dense jungle, shatter ancient ruins, and scavenge vital resources. Every swing of your makeshift weapon brings you closer to crafting advanced tools and uncovering the island's hidden truths.

Face the raw power of nature. Experience a dynamic day-and-night cycle where dangerous wild animals emerge under the moonlight, demanding evolved weapons and cunning tactics. Will you survive the night?

Upgrade your tools and weapons from basic survival gear to powerful instruments of discovery. Meet other survivors, build alliances, and piece together the conspiracy behind your crash.

Download Idle Island Scavenger now and embark on an emotional journey to reunite your family and conquer the island's mysteries!
