it.name: Island Times: Easy Life
it.d:
This is a pixel style casual game.
In this game, you will step onto a mysterious island and start your pastoral life.

On the island, vast fields await you to cultivate.
You can plant various crops, from common vegetables to rare fruits, and every piece of land is full of vitality.
Watching the crops grow vigorously under your careful care, the joy of harvest will overflow in your heart.

Surrounding the island, there are abundant marine resources waiting for you to explore.
You can sail out to sea and enjoy the fun of fishing.
Different seas harbor different types of fish, and every fishing experience brings new rewards.

You can raise various cute animals, from gentle sheep to lively chickens, and even slime.
Through careful care, you can harvest a wealth of pastoral products and add more color to your life.

During the exploration of the island, you will also discover hidden mineral caves containing hard minerals, dazzling gemstones, and more.

This island is also home to cute elves and pets.
You can establish deep friendships with them and explore the mysteries of the island together.
Elves will take care of crops and small animals for you, while pets will accompany you through every joyful time.

Featuring a unique pixel style, rich gameplay, and a relaxed gaming atmosphere,
Join us now and embark on your island adventure!

it.name: Jetpack Joyride Racing
it.d:
Get ready to hit the track in Jetpack Joyride Racing – a fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the iconic Jetpack Joyride universe. Take on the new Time Trial mode, set your fastest lap times, climb the global leaderboards, and challenge your friends to beat your records.

Drift through corners, time your boosts, and outplay up to 6 rivals in intense real-time races. Every turn is a tactical choice, and every boost is your chance to take the lead.

Time Trial Mode

Race against the clock to set your best time on every track.

• Set personal records and improve your fastest times
• Compete with friends for ultimate bragging rights
• Climb global leaderboards and compare your performance with racers around the world
• Master every corner, boost, and shortcut to shave precious seconds off your run

High-Speed Multiplayer Racing
• Race up to 6 players live in real-time multiplayer races
• Drift, boost, and overtake through tight corners and high-speed straights
• Party Mode lets you team up and race with friends for ultimate bragging rights

• Slow Zone (Purple): A sticky trap that drags you down
• Cutout Zone (Red): Lose control as engines shut down temporarily
• Charge Zone (Green): Supercharge your Special Ability and blast ahead

Memorize the Zones and use them to your advantage to secure first place, all while speeding through iconic Jetpack Joyride locations. From the Legitimate Research Lab to New Skytown, every circuit is packed with character references and an original soundtrack.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master
• Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to jump in
• Deep skill ceiling for drifting, boosting, and track mastery
• Compete in both casual races and high-stakes competitive showdowns

Built for Social Play

Discord voice integration lets you talk with your friends directly in-game, taking every session to the next level. Coordinate tactics, celebrate victories, and trash-talk rivals without ever leaving the race.

Jetpack Joyride Racing is powered by Halfbrick+, allowing players to collect unique cards, unlock rewards, and progress across the Halfbrick ecosystem. Anyone can join and start collecting for free with no subscription required.

Iconic Characters & Ship Customization

Race as Barry Steakfries, Dan The Man, Josie, Professor Brains, King Raskulls, and more!
• Show off your style with unique cosmetics, from ship trails to emotes
• Build a racing identity that rivals will recognize on sight

What is Halfbrick+?

Jetpack Joyride Racing is free to play – no ads, no gimmicks. Powered by Halfbrick+, anyone can race, collect cards, complete Quests, and earn rewards without a subscription.

For players who want more, Halfbrick+ also offers a tiered membership system:

Free Tier
• Access selected games, earn cards, and join events at no cost

Silver Tier
• Unlock additional games, boost Season Pass progress, and earn extra rewards

Gold Tier
• Get the full Halfbrick+ experience with all games, premium cosmetics, faster progression, and exclusive content

Merge, Upgrade, Serve
In Journey Home Merge and Stories, you can drag and combine same casual objects to upgrade them into better and more powerful items for your journey. Merge and match delicious meals on the board to create new recipes to serve hungry customers and complete tasks. Unlock new merge categories from delicious treats like cakes, pies and coffees to fantastic design objects to make you experience a relaxing and dream journey. This merging game is easy to learn and challenging to master.

Be a renovation master by decorating areas from scratch! Home, cafe, garden decoration and renovation here in one place! Renovate new building related with the story and give them a fresh makeover! Restore your inner designer skills as time goes by. This merge puzzle is everything you need in a merge design game.

Explore The Neighborhood, Uncover The Mystery
Community in the neighborhood is welcoming but everyone love gossip! The investigation is full of twists and hidden mysteries. Solve mysteries and explore unexpected love secrets and progress in the merge puzzle. This is not the classic casual merge and makeover design game you experienced! Explore exciting characters and discover case with the handsome young Detective Collins while getting mixed signals from the town’s hottest neighbor Kai. Help Rachel discover love while she solves amusing mysteries in the most popular cafe of the region.


JOURNEY HOME FEATURES:


• MERGE eggs, coffees, jams, spices and many more everyday objects and recipes.
• REVEAL the secrets of Rachel’s family and friends.
• MAKEOVER garden, kitchen, mansion, cafe and other building from scratch.
• EXPLORE hidden merge items and upgrade them once you progress.
• MEET the neighbors in town.
• RENOVATE various indoor and outdoor areas.
• UNWIND as you play a fun and interactive merge game.


Love pies? Calling all merge puzzle, and matching game enthusiasts! Play Journey Home to merge and upgrade everyday items and reveal mystery and renovation stories in merge games filled with the fever of romance, mystery, love and hidden object! Join the journey to bring order to the chaos and matching puzzle pieces to make your game world look exactly as you dream. Explore investigation and love story in this design and renovation merge puzzle!

Journey Home is the perfect choice for those who love mergedom, mansion, gossip harbor, travel town, or love pies. This easy to learn but challenging to master merging game is a must-play for merging game lovers seeking an immersive and addictive experience. 

Enjoy!

it.name: June's Journey: Hidden Objects
it.d:
June's Journey does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Search for hidden objects, find clues and unlock rewards in this glamorous murder mystery adventure - June’s Journey!

June’s Journey is the ultimate adventure for fans of mystery games. Set in the glamorous 1920s, this thrilling detective mystery lets you search for hidden clues, uncover secrets, and explore stunning scenes full of suspense. Join June Parker on a captivating adventure through family scandals, clever puzzle games, and unforgettable twists. Whether you're solving crimes or enjoying the thrill of the search, this is one of the most captivating hidden object games you’ll ever play.

- Search & Find Hidden Objects
Sharpen your skills with hundreds of illustrated hidden object puzzles, where each location offers a new mystery to search through. From lavish mansions to exotic destinations, uncover missing objects, vital clues, and hidden secrets. Fans of finding hidden objects, seek and find, murder mysteries, and classic search puzzles will love this mystery adventure game!

- Solve Puzzles, Master Mysteries
Get swept into a dramatic adventure full of intrigue, deception, and murder mystery. Follow June through twists and turns as you solve cases, collect evidence, and crack codes. With clever puzzle games, layered storytelling, and immersive world-building, this is one of the most addictive mystery games. Whether searching for a key clue or following a trail of secrets, every 
chapter offers something new to explore - ideal for fans of brainteasers and problem-solving puzzle games.

- Design & Decorate Your Estate
Design and upgrade your luxurious island manor as you uncover clues to solve thrilling mysteries. Complete scenes to earn rewards, unlock new areas, and bring life to your estate. The perfect blend of home design and detective work gives this mystery game its own unique charm among other hidden object games and creative puzzle experiences.

- Relax & Stay Sharp
June’s Journey offers relaxing gameplay with just the right level of challenge. Solve mystery puzzles, search for clues, and enjoy the soothing pace that makes every adventure rewarding. It’s the ideal choice for fans of search and find games, murder mystery games, and cozy adventure games. Whether you're uncovering hidden objects or unravelling secrets, there's always something new to discover.

- Join Detective Clubs
Join forces with other players in Detective Clubs and take your investigations to the next level. Compete in special spot the difference events, share strategies, and search together to top the leaderboard. Whether you're collaborating or going solo, there's always a new mystery game moment to experience.

- New Chapters Weekly
The search adventure never ends! Every week brings new chapters packed with fresh hidden object scenes, compelling stories, and clever twists. Stay engaged in a mystery game that’s always evolving—part narrative, part puzzle game, and pure adventure.

it.d:
Return to Isla Nublar with the creators of the smash hit Jurassic Park™ Builder for your next adventure: Jurassic World™: The Game, the official mobile game based on this summer’s epic action-adventure. Bring to life more than 300 colossal dinosaurs from the new film and challenge your opponents in earth-shaking battles. Construct the theme park of tomorrow in this unrivaled build-and-battle dinosaur experience.

In order to build a winning Battle Arena team, you’ll need to design the most efficient and effective park, one that will allow your dinosaurs to thrive and evolve. Discover new and amazing species of dinosaurs by acquiring surprise-filled card packs. Join Owen, Claire and your favorite characters from the film as, daily, you feed and genetically enhance your dinosaurs. Now that the park is open, it’s time to make Jurassic World™ your own!

In Jurassic World™: The Game you will:

* Defy the laws of science as you COLLECT, HATCH & EVOLVE more than 450 unique dinosaurs!
* CONSTRUCT & UPGRADE iconic buildings & lush landscapes inspired by the film. 
* CHALLENGE opponents from around the world in earth-shaking BATTLES!
* INTERACT with characters from the film as you navigate exciting new storylines & thrilling missions! 
* CHOOSE from multiple card packs; each can bring a special dinosaur to life!
* EARN daily rewards such as coins, DNA & other essential resources.

► ARE YOU A FARMER OR A FIGHTER?

In this fun new idle role-playing game, you’re both, with sidelines in mining, crafting, construction and management too. In fact, you’re a king, with a kingdom to protect, expand and develop, and if you want to succeed there’s a lot of work ahead of you. Start with just a small squad of swordsmen and a few berry trees, then get working to build a city, feed your people, raid enemy castles for resources and experience, expand your army and turn your tiny village into a flourishing and fearsome empire.

► ARE YOU WORTHY OF THE CROWN?

• Turn your swords to plowshares: Start the game farming berries, sell them at market to feed your hungry people and use the coins you make to invest in the development of your kingdom and your wars of conquest. 

•  …and your plowshares into swords: Spend the profits you make from crafting in this all-action RPG on expanding and upgrading your army, with five different types of soldier to recruit and improve. Turn your small band of raiders into a mighty horde of fiercely armed knights and archers, ready to conquer the known world.

• Head for the longboats: Time management and resource mining aren’t enough: a great king has to prove themselves in battle. So, once you’ve taken care of your subjects’ basic needs, earned coins and upgraded your army, sail off to war, raiding over 90 enemy towns and castles for plunder and XP.

• The builder king: Equip your town with new houses and facilities. The game has over a dozen different types of resources for you to craft into over 150 different new buildings and industries, from warehouses to taverns to luxurious palaces, that will also bring you idle profits when you’re out of the game.

• By royal command: Of course, a king needs soldiers, but you’ll also need a whole host of other workers to keep your kingdom and your idle income ticking over. Hire and upgrade farmers, woodcutters, miners and more to really make your craft empire flourish.

• Go ballista: Start every battle with a bang by using the ballista to hit the enemy where it hurts. Upgrade this powerful weapon to get access to ten increasingly destructive types of projectiles so you can really show the enemy who’s king of the castle!

► ARE YOU READY FOR A ROYAL ADVENTURE?

Download King or Fail now and dive into an all-action RPG that combines crafting, conquest and world-building in a fun and addictive casual format. If you like the idea of role-playing as a hard-working, hard-fighting medieval monarch determined to build the biggest, fiercest, most prosperous kingdom, you’re guaranteed to enjoy King or Fail. Failure—like boredom—just isn’t an option.

What critics are saying about Kingdom Rush: Origins:

"The Kingdom Rush franchise is one of the best tower defense series around, and the third entry, Origins, is as fun as the franchise has ever been.” –Entertainment Weekly

“I’ve played plenty of tower defense games over the years, but none have ever captured my heart the way the Kingdom Rush series has.” –The Verge

Kingdom Rush: Origins is the third installment of the award-winning Kingdom Rush saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe. Take a trip back to the beginning, before Vez’nan ever thought to threaten the kingdom with the gem of power, and experience even more of the lightning-fast, exceptionally captivating gameplay that made the franchise a cornerstone of essential tower defense games. In this exciting prequel, command your elven army and defend mystical lands from sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of gnoll tribesman, all with the help of brand-spankin’ new towers, heroes, and spells to fend off every last baddie.

	•	Master and upgrade 16 legendary heroes and their awesome powers and spells!
	•	Rain lightning, summon reinforcements, and use each hero’s unique power to obliterate scores of enemies!
	•	Immerse yourself in hours of gameplay with over 70 achievements, with three difficulty modes for the newbs and veterans alike. 
	•	Play different game modes - Classic, Iron, and Heroic - and prove your mettle as a master tactician.
	•	Purchase new-and-improved equipment using your hard earned gems in a revamped Gnome shop.
	•	Study your enemies and your towers with an in-game encyclopedia

it.name: League of War: Mercenaries
it.d:
League of War: Mercenaries is an exciting war strategy game where your tactical choices have a real, direct impact on an immersive 3D battlefield. Engage in an all new kind of global battle for domination - as your enemies deploy units, you must respond accordingly to attack and defend, putting your military strategy & tactics to the ultimate test. Immerse yourself in this 3D war game to build your base, grow your army, and battle your way to victory. 

As a Mercenary commanding powerful armies for your League, battle for lucrative contracts and collaborate with your Alliance to dominate the battlefield.

Build a fighting force of extraordinary magnitude to wage war on nations and corporations. Immerse yourself in a 3D world with fast-paced combat, an ever-evolving military headquarters, and armies of rival mercenaries to conquer across a lush campaign map.. Take on hundreds of missions or compete with fellow Mercenaries to and claim victory around the globe and enjoy the spoils of war!

= LEAGUE OF WAR: MERCENARIES FEATURES =

EXPERIENCE LUSH 3D CONTENT
Immerse yourself into stunning 3D content, from your massive military headquarters to intense RTS combat! See your army wash over the enemy and defend your base’s tower in incredible 3D.

ASSEMBLE AN EXTRAORDINARY ARMY
Unlock cutting-edge military units of all kinds - tanks, helicopters, infantry & more! Build your own personal fighting force and lead them from one decisive victory to the next.

CONQUER YOUR ENEMIES
Battle for resources and loot in visceral multiplayer combat, rendered in full 3D. Balance defense and offense as you send your army to crush your enemies or defend your base.

CONTROL UNITS TO DOMINATE IN BATTLE
What’s your strategy? Take control of tanks, helicopters and more and strategically configure your squad in a variety of ways to counter sophisticated enemy units! Futuristic RTS gameplay will challenge even the most hardened strategy veteran.

EXPAND & UPGRADE MILITARY HEADQUARTERS
Level up your military fortress and unlock exciting campaigns! Build a bigger, better base, and take it online in intense multiplayer matches that’ll have you fighting to rule the world.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR MILITARY CAPABILITIES
Upgrade & equip units with a vast array of technology for specific roles to defeat your enemy! From massive tanks to the smallest infantry unit, every member of your army can be powered up for ultimate domination.

FORGE STRATEGIC ALLIANCES
Join allied franchises to conquer the multiplayer battlefield and crush your enemies. Defense is easier with friends watching your back – join the battle online for free, and use strategy to conquer the world together.

League of War: Mercenaries offers incredible 3D RTS combat that you won’t find in any other apps. Build your army using sophisticated military technology, join other players in the multiplayer warzone, and fight futuristic wars in a stunning post-apocalyptic world.

Download League of War: Mercenaries and begin your reign today!

it.d:
Bros vs Foes!

At every turn, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have thwarted Kraang Prime’s plans to terraform the Earth into Dimension X. What’s an evil overlord to do? Hatch a nefarious new scheme, to create an army of Ultra Mutants! Everywhere, the Kraang have kidnapped mutants - including the Ninja Turtles - for their DNA!

With his brothers pulled through a Kraang Dimension X portal, Leonardo must recruit the Ninja Turtles’ allies and foes alike before it’s too late. 

Hang on to your shells!

ORIGINAL NINJAS: Explore the Turtles universe with an All-New Original story. Battle your way through 7 chapters and over 70 stages to take on the baddest of bosses – Shredder, Kraang and more!
RESPECT THE SHELL: For a limited-time, play and experience an all-new chapter based on this summer’s blockbuster, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows! When their recon mission goes awry, the Turtles must take on the Foot Clan and favourite bad boys Bebop and Rocksteady! Fight to win and collect these exclusive characters!
TURTLE POWER: Help Leonardo as he takes on the Kraang army to save his brothers and fellow mutants. Play alongside Leonardo in a 5-on- 5 battle with your favorite TMNT characters.
MUTANT MAYHEM: Collect and level up over 30 TMNT characters! Train them to learn their super sweet moves and build your Turtle-rrific team! Don’t forget to pack your freezer for Ice Cream Kitty!
SHRED ALERT: For the very first time, fight the Kraang as a Ninja Turtle friend… or FOE! Collect and play as Tiger Claw, Rocksteady, Bebop, and more.  Create strategic teams and take on the Kraang!
FOOD FIGHT:  Collect daily prizes and card packs to enhance your team!
WE RUN THIS TOWN:  Fight against the Kraang in the Ninja Turtles’ favorite locations from the TV show, including Dimension X, the sewers and the classic New York City rooftops!

Gentlemen, let’s save the world!

it.name: Lemmings: Strategy & Puzzle
it.d:
Lemmings game is an offline classic puzzle game in which you have to guide Lemmings in the right direction for their survival, build with tools and use commands to get them out of traps and puzzles to win missions.
 
Lemmings is a classic puzzle strategy game for those who love to play survival games. There are thousands of levels available to enjoy the endless Lemmings fun. Lemmings are crazy, they run through the Lasers independently- You have to save the Lemmings by directing them in the right direction. You have to keep the Lemmings safe and away from traps and obstacles to solve puzzles. You actually have to help the cute Lemmings in their death survival mission. 
 
You can unlock various rewards, including new ways to overcome traps, new boosters and new Lemmings to add into your collections by progressing in this Lemmings puzzle game. We are frequently releasing new seasons and planets that contain levels, puzzle challenges and new uniquely designed Lemmings to use. Just download Lemmings puzzle offline, plan a survival strategy to survive the traps, to overcome hurdles and to get Lemmings out of danger. Your mission in this game is to keep Lemmings safe from the traps and hurdles by using different puzzle strategies in the game. It is very simple and easy to use survival tools in Lemmings.
 
How to play Lemmings puzzle game?
 
Each level in this classic puzzle game has a set number of Lemmings that spawn which you must direct to the objective - an exit point. In order to get the Lemmings to that point safely you have to pass different traps, obstacles and puzzles. Lemmings aren’t very smart and will keep running through lasers, they will keep continuously running unless you guide and direct them by using your strategy to complete the Lemmings game missions. You need to be fast to set up your commands to turn them to an exit point and to save the Lemmings.
 
Initially it would be difficult for you to play the challenging missions in this Lemmings offline puzzle game, but by playing 1 to 2 missions it would become easy for you to help the Lemmings in getting them out of the dangerous zone.
 
Below are a few of the tools and commands that you can use in Lemmings survival::
 
Dig:              	Dig through destructible blocks to pass cute Lemmings through them
Umbrella:     	Slow down Lemmings fallings by using it and survive Lemmings from death
Blocker:       	Block Lemmings and make them turn away from the dangers, obstacles and traps
Staircase:    	Build a diagonal staircase to get your Lemmings to higher places before their trapping and destruction
Destroy:       	Sacrifice a Lemming to blow up and to destroy any built structure to move towards an exit point
Rocket:        	Destroy blocks above your Lemmings for survival
 
 
XP System:
 
While you are playing through levels, you will earn Lemmings puzzle experience that adds up. Once you earn enough XP you will level up and be rewarded with various Lemmings boosters, tools for survival and special Lemmings for free.
 
Seasons & Planets:
 
Every two weeks we update the game with either a new season or a new planet in this Lemmings puzzle strategy game. Each season comes along with 32 new Lemmings for you to unlock along with some challenging missions. Each planet releases with new challenging levels. This means that you would always have more than enough challenges to accept and win in this Lemmings offline game.

it.name: Little Farm Story: Idle Tycoon
it.d:
A FUN-GI TO BE AROUND
Calling all entrepreneurial farmers: come dive into a fantastic arcade-style simulator game where you can build and customize your own farm! Unlock an exciting array of plants, tools, and lands that you can cultivate to your heart’s content as you progress through the story, all while improving your business skills. Download Little Farm Story today and let your fantasies and garden blossom!
Like every good business story you start off from a humble background and a tiny, simple farm. Expand your business by catering to your customer’s wishes as you clear land to plant more crops and open more workshops to keep that money flowing. Farming has never been this fun!

FRUITFUL FEATURES
Variety is the spice of life – From a vast array of plants to diverse workshops and buildings, the possibilities are endless as you build your dream farm. Construct houses and tractors, then reap your fields of bountiful harvest to craft delicious products, delighting your customers in the process. There’s always something new to discover and add to your offerings, keeping you entertained for hours on end.
Zen gardening – Sure there’s a time and place for games that involve timers and clocks and deadlines… but this ain’t one of ‘em! Kick back and relax as you build your family farm, never once worrying about deadlines that might kill the mood. Whether you have just a few minutes or a half hour to kill, you’ll always feel relaxed and cool as a cucumber after dipping your toes in the game, ready to take on the world after your farming reprieve.
Mix business with pleasure – Here you’ll get to cultivate both crops and your entrepreneurial spirit! As a farmer you’ll have to learn to strategize, manage resources, and make crucial decisions so that you can make the most of your land while also getting top dollar from your customers. This fantastic game of plants and produce allows you to hone your business skills while growing crops and building your agricultural empire from the ground up, all without breaking a sweat.

BEHOLD THE FRUITS OF YOUR LABOR
Leave your stressful real-world life behind and hop on into this enchanting farm game where you can immerse yourself in a relaxing game of agricultural bliss. Whether you’re tending to your rancho, customizing every aspect of your farm, or discovering new varieties of plants that you can grow and sell, there’s always something fun waiting for you – plus, as you cultivate your farm, you’ll also be honing valuable business skills. So max your relaxing and try out Little Farm Story today!

How to Play

Ludo is easy to learn and fun to master!
Roll the dice and move your tokens based on the number you get. Get all your pieces from start to home before your opponents to win. Use smart strategy and perfect timing to block rivals, knock out their tokens, and earn extra turns. Plan every move, stay ahead of the competition, and rise to the top of Ludo Club!

Multiplayer Fun
Play real-time multiplayer games with friends or challenge players worldwide in quick 2 player games or competitive 4-player matches.

Live Chat & Social Play
Stay connected with in-game chat – talk, react with emojis and stickers, and make every match more fun and engaging.

Unique Power-Ups
Turn the game in your favor with strategic power-ups that give you control over the dice roll and help you outplay opponents when it matters most.

Rewards & Daily Bonuses
Earn in-game coins, unlock unique dice, boards, and more, and climb the leaderboard with rewarding daily bonuses.

Clubs
Join Clubs to connect with like-minded players, chat, send gifts, and build your own community.

Offline Games Mode
Play offline games anytime with no internet required – perfect for quick matches on the go.

Why Players Love Ludo Club?

Players relive the nostalgia of classic board games while enjoying a modern, competitive twist. With faster matches, social gameplay, and exciting features, every game is a chance to outplay rivals, sharpen your strategy, and win big.

it.name: Super Mario Run
it.d:
A new kind of Mario game that you can play with one hand.

You control Mario by tapping as he constantly runs forward. You time your taps to pull off stylish jumps, midair spins, and wall jumps to gather coins and reach the goal!

Super Mario Run can be downloaded for free and after you purchase the game, you will be able to play all the modes with no additional payment required. You can try out all four modes before purchase: World Tour, Toad Rally, Remix 10, and Kingdom Builder.

■World Tour
Run and jump with style to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s clutches! 
Travel through plains, caverns, ghost houses, airships, castles, and more.

Clear the 24 exciting courses to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser, waiting in his castle at the end. There are many ways to enjoy the courses, such as collecting the 3 different types of colored coins or by competing for the highest score against your friends. You can try courses 1-1 to 1-4 for free.

After rescuing Princess Peach, a nine-course special world, World Star, will appear.

■Remix 10
Some of the shortest Super Mario Run courses you'll ever play!
This mode is Super Mario Run in bite-sized bursts! You'll play through 10 short courses one after the other, with the courses changing each time you play. Daisy is lost somewhere in Remix 10, so try to clear as many courses as you can to find her!

■Toad Rally
Show off Mario’s stylish moves, compete against your friends, and challenge people from all over the world.

In this challenge mode, the competition differs each time you play.
Compete against the stylish moves of other players for the highest score as you gather coins and get cheered on by a crowd of Toads. Fill the gauge with stylish moves to enter Coin Rush Mode to get more coins. If you win the rally, the cheering Toads will come live in your kingdom, and your kingdom will grow. 

■Kingdom Builder
Gather coins and Toads to build your very own kingdom.

Combine different buildings and decorations to create your own unique kingdom. There are over 100 kinds of items in Kingdom Builder mode. If you get more Toads in Toad Rally, the number of buildings and decorations available will increase. With the help of the friendly Toads you can gradually build up your kingdom.

■What You Can Do After Purchasing All Worlds

・ All courses in World Tour are playable
Why not try out the bigger challenges and thrills available in all courses?

・ Easier to get Rally Tickets
It's easier to get Rally Tickets that are needed to play Remix 10 and Toad Rally. You can collect them in Kingdom Builder through Bonus Game Houses and ? Blocks, by collecting colored coins in World Tour, and more.

・ More playable characters
If you rescue Princess Peach by completing course 6-4 and build homes for Luigi, Yoshi, and Toadette in Kingdom Builder mode, you can get them to join your adventures as playable characters. They play differently than Mario, so why not put their special characteristics to good use in World Tour and Toad Rally?

・ More courses in Toad Rally
The types of courses available in Toad Rally will increase to seven different types of courses, expanding the fun! Along with the new additions, Purple and Yellow Toads may also come to cheer for you.

・ More buildings and decorations in Kingdom Builder
The types of buildings available will increase, so you'll be able to make your kingdom even more lively. You can also place Rainbow Bridges to expand your kingdom.

・ Play Remix 10 without having to wait
You can play Remix 10 continuously, without having to wait between each game.

*Internet connectivity required to play. Data charges may apply. May contain advertisements.

MARVEL Puzzle Quest: Hero RPG

Collect and battle with over 250 Marvel champions in this epic Match 3 RPG game!
MARVEL Puzzle Quest is the original match-3 Super Hero Game! Compete with a community of over 20 million players worldwide and play as over 250 of your favorite Marvel Super Heroes in this battle role-playing game (RPG) featuring a unique match-3 puzzle twist!

Gather your favorite Marvel characters and clash in exclusive MARVEL Puzzle Quest campaigns, complete daily quests, and engage with epic event stories! Draft your own dream team from the largest mobile Marvel character roster to date! Take your pick from the most valiant Super Heroes to the most villainous baddies! You can mix and combine your teams however you want. Spider-Man, Captain Marvel, and Squirrel Girl? Of course! Black Panther, Gamora, and Deadpool? Let’s go!

MPQ FEATURES

● Collect and upgrade your favorite Marvel Super Heroes and Villains!
● Battle in epic match-3 puzzle RPG gameplay!
● Log in daily for rewards with S.H.I.E.L.D. Resupply and for new and exciting challenges!
● Level up your match-3 skills with Puzzle Ops and take on challenging skill-based puzzles! Each puzzle comes with different clear requirements so every board is unique!
● Form Alliances and assemble teams to fight opponents in PvP Tournaments and battle epic raid bosses!

THE ORIGINAL MARVEL MATCH 3 GAME!

This is a battle! Match-3 or more tiles and harness the power of Iso-8 to build up your team’s abilities and manipulate the game board to challenge the most powerful characters from across the Marvel universe. Trap your opponents and bring forth crushing evidence with JESSICA JONES! Use BURST HEALING with KAMALA KHAN to keep up team morale! COUNTDOWN to destruction with powerful timed gems from CAPTAIN MARVEL! Go AIRBORNE and rain destruction on your enemies via VULTURE! Each character features their own in-game Marvel comic book cover! Crack the multiverse and play with alternate versions of your favorite heroes! Slash your foes with Samurai Wolverine or take up the shield with Peggy Carter as Captain America. The multiverse of possibilities is massive!


New characters are being added to MARVEL Puzzle Quest consistently. Recruit Moon Knight, Miles Morales, Black Widow, Loki, Thanos, Scarlet Witch, America Chavez, Captain America, and more! You can even collect Limited Edition characters like Spider-Ham, Devil Dinosaur, and Howard the Duck to add to the fun!

[About "Yu-Gi-Oh! MASTER DUEL"]
Fast-paced Duels with stunning HD graphics and a new, dynamic soundtrack! Get ready to challenge Duelists around the world!

◇Play Duels at Any Level!
The full Yu-Gi-Oh! experience is available for anyone at any Skill Level. Don't worry if you're a new player or if you haven't Dueled in a while, the in-game tutorials will teach you the basics on how to play the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME. [About "Yu-Gi-Oh!"] 
"Yu-Gi-Oh!" is a popular manga created by Kazuki Takahashi that was serialized in SHUEISHA Inc.'s "WEEKLY SHONEN JUMP" since 1996. Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. provides a Trading Card Game (TCG) and console games, based on "Yu-Gi-Oh!"created from the original manga, that has been enjoyed around the world.

it.name: Mecha Fortress: Robot War TD
it.d:
Defend your fortress. Command your mecha. Outlast every wave.

Mecha Fortress: Robot War TD is a post-apocalyptic idle tower defense strategy game where you build a towering war mecha, set up your defenses, and hold the line against endless waves of raiders across a ruined dieselpunk world. Command your Titan, place your turrets, and prove that only the smartest commander survives the last war.

Build and defend your base
Deploy turrets, barriers, and combat mechs across the battlefield and stop enemy waves before they overrun your fortress. Every placement matters - plan your defensive layout, cover the choke points, and adapt your strategy as tougher raiders and rival factions push toward your base. This is tower defense built around real decisions, not luck.

Master defensive strategy
No two waves are the same. Study incoming enemy types, layer your turret coverage, and position your mecha where it counts. Upgrade your defenses between waves, exploit enemy weaknesses, and turn a desperate last stand into a fortress that never falls. Deep tower defense strategy rewards players who plan ahead.

Idle progression that never stops
Your fortress keeps defending and earning even while you're away. Return to collect resources, reinforce your defenses, and push deeper into the wasteland. Built for idle and tower defense fans who love steady, strategic progression - make meaningful upgrades every session, whether you play for two minutes or two hours.

Upgrade your mecha Titan
Customize a colossal combat mecha with reinforced armor, powerful weapons, and unique abilities. Choose from multiple upgrade paths to forge the ultimate dieselpunk war machine and strengthen your defensive line. Every upgrade changes how you defend - build the Titan that fits your strategy.

Recruit elite pilots
Unlock legendary mecha pilots, each with unique skills and tactical roles. Combine their abilities with your turret defenses to counter every enemy type, cover your weak points, and survive the toughest boss waves. The right team turns a good defense into an unbreakable one.

Conquer the wasteland
Progress through relentless waves, prestige your fortress, and unlock elite defense modules and stronger mecha. As you advance, the raiders grow more dangerous and your strategy must evolve — deeper tactics, smarter layouts, and tougher Titans await every commander who pushes on.

A post-apocalyptic dieselpunk world
Survival is everything in a ruined future where ruthless raiders and rival factions fight over the last resources. Defend humanity's last colony from your mecha fortress, hold the line, and dominate a wasteland where only the toughest mecha endure.

KEY FEATURES
▶ Strategic tower defense - place turrets and mechs to stop enemy waves
▶ Idle & auto-battle - your base defends and earns while you're offline
▶ Deep progression - endless upgrades for your fortress, mechs, and pilots
▶ Elite pilots with unique abilities and tactical roles
▶ Multiple upgrade paths to build your ultimate defensive Titan
▶ Post-apocalyptic dieselpunk world with striking visuals
▶ Epic boss waves that test your defensive strategy

Perfect for fans of tower defense, idle strategy, base defense, and mecha games - players who love planning their defenses, upgrading over time, and outlasting every wave.

Plan your defenses, upgrade your mechs, and dominate the wasteland. Only the strongest commanders will hold the fortress and survive the last war.

Download Mecha Fortress: Robot War TD and start defending today!

it.name: Merge 2 Survive: Zombie Games
it.d:
Step into a world where everything's changed – zombies everywhere, and surviving is your only goal. 'Merge 2 Survive' isn't just any game. It's an epic journey where strategic thinking meets puzzle-solving excitement.

Meet Mia, brave and unstoppable, on a mission to find out what happened to her dad in a city swallowed by the apocalypse. Get ready to wade into zombie-infested war zones, remnants of a world that once buzzed with life. Every merge you make isn't just a move; it's a pivotal moment in Mia's story. You're crafting weapons, putting together defenses, and bringing people together to hold off the relentless undead.

This destroyed city's waiting for you to explore it. Unravel its secrets, track down the clues, and maybe you'll find what happened to Mia's father. But remember, 'Merge 2 Survive' isn't just about combining stuff. It's about forging a path in a world where order's been flipped upside down. Show off your strategic chops by mixing and matching vital resources, ensuring your allies don't just survive – they thrive.

Features:

- Merge & Craft: It's all about mixing and matching here. Find items and combine them to create weapons, defenses, and anything else you need to stand strong against a sea of zombies.

- Strategic Gameplay: Every choice counts. Hone your strategic skills to outwit the challenges that lie ahead on your journey.

- Epic Exploration: Immerse yourself in a city that's seen better days. Explore every nook and cranny, and uncover the mysteries of a world overrun by zombies.

- Survivor's Saga: It's up to you to gather survivors, rebuild what's been lost, and lead the charge against the undead. In a world plunged into darkness, you're the light of hope.

Ready for an adventure that'll keep you on the edge of your seat? Merge, scout, and battle your way to shine a light in a world taken over by zombies. In 'Merge 2 Survive', it's all about what it truly means to survive. Step into Mia's shoes and face the challenges head-on! Every merge you make is a stride towards hope, every fight a test of your determination. The fight against the undead is here. So, are you up for it?

it.name: Tiletopia: Triple Match Game
it.d:
Tap Tiles, Collect Triples & Merge Treasures in Tiletopia: Triple Match Game Today!

Step into a relaxing tile puzzle game where tap-to-collect tile matching meets creative merging! Tap tiles on the board, collect them into your bar, match three identical tiles to clear them away, and build a dreamy world one satisfying clear and merge at a time. Designed for players who love triple match puzzles, match-3 tile games, tile collecting games, and casual merge adventures, Tiletopia: Triple Match Game offers a unique blend of focused tile matching and creative merging in one beautifully crafted experience.

GAME HIGHLIGHTS:

- Triple Tile Match & Collect: Tap tiles on the board to send them to your collection bar. Match three identical tiles to clear them in a satisfying combo. Clear every tile to complete the puzzle — simple to learn, but mastering your collection strategy takes real skill. Fans of triple match games and match-3 tile puzzles will feel right at home.

- Merge-3 Treasure System: Earn treasures by clearing tile boards, then merge three identical items to evolve gems into rare artifacts, grow enchanted plants, and unlock magical creatures. Each merge chain reveals surprises that expand and decorate your world, adding a rewarding merge layer to every tile puzzle you complete.

- Relaxing Zen Mode: No timers, no pressure — just you and the tiles. Tap and collect at your own pace while enjoying soothing visuals and a calming gameplay flow. A truly relaxing tile puzzle game for stress relief and mindful moments.

- Strategic Tile Board Challenges: Tiles can be stacked in 3D piles, buried under layers, or locked behind obstacles. Plan your taps carefully, manage your limited collection slots, and decide which tile to pick next — one wrong move can change everything.

- Thousands of Tile Boards: Explore an endless journey through handcrafted tile layouts — from relaxing single-layer spreads to complex multi-level 3D tile stacks. Each board is a fresh tile puzzle challenge designed to keep your brain sharp and engaged.

- Evolving Worlds to Explore: Clear tile boards across enchanted gardens, mystical temples, and forgotten lands. Each world introduces new tile layouts, new treasures to discover, and new merge chains to complete. A tile puzzle adventure that keeps expanding with every match you make.

- Play Offline Anytime, Anywhere: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Tap, collect, and match tiles offline — on the go, during your commute, or wherever you find a quiet moment. Enjoy this offline tile puzzle game without needing an internet connection.

Whether you love triple tile matching games, match-3 tile puzzles, tap-to-collect puzzle games, or are simply looking for a beautiful and relaxing offline tile puzzle game for adults, Tiletopia: Triple Match Game brings together the best of tile collecting and merge gameplay in one satisfying adventure.

Tap tiles. Collect triples. Clear the board. Merge treasures. Download Tiletopia: Triple Match Game and start your tile puzzle journey today!

it.name: Bloons Monkey City
it.d:
Create, upgrade, and customize your very own Bloons Monkey City in this groundbreaking blend of city building and tower defense awesomeness!

UNIQUE SIMULATION + STRATEGY GAMING
Take back the wilderness from the invading bloon hordes and pop your way from a modest settlement to a thriving metropolis. Attack bloon-infested territory adjacent to your city, win a short tower defense game, and add the captured territory to your city as a space on which to build. Buildings are the heart of your city, and each one has a specific purpose - individual monkey towers for battle, upgrades for those towers, farms and banks to drive your economy, power to supercharge your city, epic buildings for epic powers, and decorations to make your city more awesome. Every time you build, your city looks cooler, you increase your power potential in tower defense play, and you open up even more rewards and challenges.

AMAZING DEPTH AND VARIETY
All 21 of the fully awesomized and carefully balanced Bloons TD 5 towers are available within Monkey City, with completely new unlock mechanics. More than 130 buildings and decorations give you endless strategies and city design options. Explore the wilderness to find treasure tiles and uncover 11 powerful special items like the Banana Replicator and the Dark Temple Idol. Burst bloons on 55 all new tower defense maps or test your mastery on 13 wildly challenging original special missions. Either way, be ready to encounter all new bloon waves and special bloon attack patterns like Cash Starve or Fast and Furious.

REINFORCE YOUR FRIENDS
Connect with Facebook and Game Center friends, then help each other win and expand. Send Supply Crates back and forth for bonus starting cash. Visit friends' cities to check out their strategies and their city design skills, and while you're there root out any bloon spies to win a reward for both you and your friend.

SHOW OFF YOUR SKILLS
Build up the strongest lineup of monkey towers possible and compete with other players for the best score in weekly Contested Territory events. Use the latest in monkey science to send player vs. player bloon attacks, then see whose defenses are the strongest and earn extra rewards for victory.

Download for free and play Bloons Monkey City now!

Pro tip: You can move your buildings when they are not upgrading or damaged - just tap and hold then move to a free captured tile!

Please Note:
Bloons Monkey City is free to download and play (aside from internet, carrier, data, device, and other services for which the player is financially responsible), but some in-game items can be purchased with real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device's settings, or reach us at support@ninjakiwi.com for help. City data is organized individually, so if you share multiple cities on one device through multiple Game Center or Facebook logins, do note that your IAP will only apply to the city active during purchase.

it.d:
Experience the next level in offroad gaming with Mudness, a AAA multiplayer simulator that immerses you in diverse terrains and thrilling adventures. From stock vehicles to awe-inspiring MONSTER TRUCKS, traverse a detailed map featuring three distinct biomes - a muddy forest, sandy quarry, and snowy mountains - across 6 bases. Embark on vital delivery missions, transporting cargos and workers safely and on time, or enjoy exhilarating drives with up to 20 players per server.
Free to play - High quality and Realistic Simulator in your pocket

Main Features:

- Drive Real Offroad Machines.

- Dirt, Mud, Sand, Snow, Rivers, Swamps, Mountains all the Terrains.

- Trails Mode: Tackle the Daily Trail, a dynamic challenge that tests your skills with new adventures every 24 hours. Compete for significant prizes based on your leaderboard standings.

- Daily Challenges: Engage in unique, daily tasks that offer exciting rewards and keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

- Cargo Trailers & Monster Trucks: Select from a diverse range of vehicles for your delivery missions.

- Challenging Delivery Tasks: Test your driving prowess in a variety of demanding missions.

- Rewarding Side Missions: Discover and complete lucrative and entertaining side tasks.

- Enhanced Multiplayer: Participate in exciting races and cooperative gameplay with friends and other players.

- Advanced Car Customization: Customize your vehicle with in-depth tuning options, including suspension, body, wheels, and engine upgrades.

- Winch & Towing: Outfit your car with essential equipment for navigating tough terrains and assisting other stuck vehicles.

- Offroad Mastery: Fully immerse yourself in offroading with detailed map designs and realistic vehicle dynamics.


Prepare for an unparalleled offroad adventure, crafted for true enthusiasts. Rev up your engines and become part of the vibrant Mudness community today!

it.name: Music Wars Rockstar: Rap Life
it.d:
BECOME A ROCKSTAR

From the creator of the long-running Music Wars music industry simulation series comes Music Wars Rockstar, a deep music career sim where you create an artist, release music, climb the charts, and build a legacy.

Your artist’s story is yours to shape. Choose their look, background, genre, image, and path through the music industry. Write and record songs, release singles and albums, build your fanbase, make industry moves, and decide what kind of star you want to become.

Sign with a label to reach a wider audience, or stay independent and build your career on your own terms.

CREATE YOUR ARTIST

Design your artist with an expansive 3D character creator, choose from 16 starting stories, and begin your career in one of 30+ music genres, including Pop, Hip Hop, Rock, Electronica, and more.

Your look, sound, background, and decisions all help define your rise.

WRITE, RECORD, AND RELEASE MUSIC

Create songs, build a catalog, release singles and albums, and watch your music perform across charts, streaming, sales, radio, and fan reaction.

Every release can become a breakout moment — or a lesson for your next era.

DOMINATE THE CHARTS

Climb 12 charts across 4 regions and multiple release types, including singles, albums, and streaming.

Track your progress, chase new peaks, and prove your artist belongs at the top.

SIGN DEALS OR STAY INDEPENDENT

Partner with a record label to expand your reach, or build your career independently and keep more control over your path.

Every choice shapes your career, your audience, and your legacy.

BUILD FRIENDSHIPS, RIVALRIES, AND BUZZ

Use the in-game social world to connect with other artists, build friendships, collaborate on songs, or start rivalries that fuel public attention.

Drop a diss track, stir up conversation, and turn social buzz into career momentum.

GET NOMINATED — AND WIN

Earn recognition for your singles, albums, and music videos. Build the kind of career that gets noticed, nominated, and remembered.

CREATE YOUR MERCH EMPIRE

Design and sell custom merch, including T-shirts, hoodies, vinyl, and more. Sell merch on the road during live shows or grow your own upgradeable webstore.

FILM MUSIC VIDEOS

Shoot music videos and release them online for fans and critics to react to. Watch reaction videos appear in your feed and see what the internet thinks of your latest era.

AND SO MUCH MORE

Music Wars Rockstar continues to grow with updates, new features, and deeper ways to build your artist’s career.

Create your artist. Release your music. Build your fanbase. Start rivalries. Chase awards. Climb the charts.

Your music career starts now.

it.name: My Journey - Puzzles & Stories
it.d:
Welcome to My Journey!

Olivia lived the life everyone dreamed of—until a sudden scandal stripped it all away. After her father passed away and the family broke apart, she was locked out of the family business and even her own home. Overnight, the famous travel blogger was left with nothing to her name. Now, Olivia is on a mission to navigate a web of deception and betrayal to uncover the truth and find out who’s pulling the strings.
Help Olivia find clues and piece the mystery together on this journey!

Epic Match-3 Puzzles
Take on thousands of uniquely designed puzzles featuring an all-new weather mechanic with hundreds of challenging obstacles. From lightning strikes to meteor showers, the gameplay evolves as you play. Unlock powerful boosters and utilize them to navigate through challenges and master every level on your adventure! 

Your Choices Matter
Meet a diverse cast of characters Olivia encounters on her journey, each with unique secrets and struggles to overcome. Support them through their biggest challenges and influence the outcome with your decisions. With tons of branching paths in the plot, every choice you make creates a one-of-a-kind story!

Transform & Design
Scrub away the stains, fix what’s broken, and design unique spaces with tons of stylish furniture! From luxury yachts to boutique inns, every makeover is a chance to explore your creative mind.

Various Events & Mini Games
Enjoy year-round and seasonal events and dive into our ultimate collection of mini games to win tons of rewards! Experience the fun of classic jigsaw puzzles, bingo, and merge games alongside a wide variety of other challenges. Discover new ways to play My Journey and collect every booster and reward!

Travel & Explore
Start your epic adventure and travel to iconic locations like Seneca Lake, the Grand Canyon, and the Statue of Liberty. Explore other destinations around the world to discover exotic cultures and experience the beauty of every trip. Find out where your journey takes you next!

Join Olivia to rebuild her life, uncover the truth behind the scandal, and maybe even discover an unexpected romance along the way! The story is waiting—play My Journey now!

Enjoy the game? Follow us on social media to stay updated on the latest news and behind-the-scenes stories!

it.name: My Pizza Cafe Simulation Game
it.d:
Embark on a Journey to Build the Ultimate Jungle Cafe on a mountain hiking trail!

Welcome to My Pizza Cafe Simulation Game, a unique coffee shop simulator where you; build, customize, and grow your dream cafe on a scenic mountain hiking trail. Serve adventurers, hikers, and nature enthusiasts.

Key Features: 
Build and Customize Your Cafe
Start with a humble stall and transform it into a bustling cafe in the heart of nature. Design every detail, from seating arrangements to décor, with options like tables, cozy chairs, trees, bushes, and jungle-themed decorations.

Serve Delicious Food and Drinks
Craft a variety of tasty treats and beverages! Start with simple coffee drinks and expand your menu to include gourmet pizzas, desserts, and refreshing juices. Keep your customers satisfied by catering to their unique cravings.

Food and Drinks Menu: Delight your customers with a wide range of mouth-watering items, including:

Coffee Beverages: Espresso, Americano, Decaf, Mocha, Macchiato, Latte, and Cappuccino.

Sweet Syrups: Chocolate, Caramel, Vanilla, and Mint for a personalized touch.

Juices and Refreshers: Orange Juice, Grape Juice, Mint Margarita, and Slush.

Hot Treats: Hot Chocolate, Boiled Egg, Tea, and Snacks.

Bakery Favorites: Croissants, Cookies, Doughnuts, Cheesecake, and Popcorn.

Main Courses: Burgers, Pizzas, Salads, and more.

Desserts: Strawberry Ice Cream Freezer for those with a sweet tooth.

Machines for Food and Drinks: Equip your cafe with machines for every menu item, and upgrade them for higher efficiency and faster service!

Coffee Machines: Brew Espresso, Latte, and more with faster, upgraded models.

Juicers: Extract fresh Orange Juice, Grape Juice, and Mint Margarita quickly.

Syrup Dispensers: Dispense Chocolate, Caramel, and Vanilla syrup with precision.

Pizza Ovens: Bake pizzas faster and in larger batches with high-end ovens.

Grills and Fryers: Cook Burgers, Snacks, and hot treats with speedier upgrades.

Tea Makers & Boilers: Prepare Tea and Boiled Eggs in bulk with advanced machines.

Baking Stations: Perfect for Cookies, Doughnuts, and Cheesecake.

Ice Cream Freezers: Serve Strawberry Ice Cream faster and smoother.

Popcorn Makers: Pop large batches with automatic seasoning features.

Sports Activities for Hikers: Add exciting sports and recreational activities to keep your customers entertained:
Badminton Courts: Set up a fun area for hikers to enjoy a quick match and unwind.

Swimming Ponds: Create a serene swimming spot for customers to cool off after a long trek.

Manage and Grow Your Business Expand your cafe by adding new areas, tables, and machines. Upgrade your equipment to serve customers faster and improve their experience. Hire and train staff to assist with orders, cooking, and customer service.

Attract and Serve Unique Customers

Cater to hikers, campers, and travelers, each with their own preferences and needs. Some want a quick coffee to-go, while others prefer a cozy sit-down meal after a long trek. Keep them happy to earn tips and positive reviews!

Overcome Nature’s Challenges
Navigate the dynamic challenges of a jungle cafe! Adapt to changing weather conditions like rain, fog, or snow, and deal with unexpected animal visitors or resource shortages.

Expand Your Trailside Cafe Empire
Grow beyond a single cafe by exploring new hiking trails, unlocking hidden jungle spots, and setting up additional coffee stands in remote locations.

Are You Ready to Create the Ultimate Jungle Cafe? Build, customize, and thrive in nature with Trailside Camp Cafe.

it.name: Mybots: Mech Battle Arena
it.d:
In a fractured future divided by towering walls, only the bravest dare to enter the arena. In the barren poor zone, survival is a daily battle. In the shining rich zone, technology and luxury flourish. The only bridge between these worlds? Mybots: ancient robotic warriors powered by Ionite Fragments.

As a rising pilot, you will command your own Mybot and step into high-stakes battlegrounds where every victory brings hope… and every defeat has consequences. Train, upgrade, and customize dozens of Mybots as you carve your legend across both zones. Fight for glory, resources, and freedom.

Features
- 20 Mybots and counting to unlock, fuse, and evolve 
- Create your own bot using favorite parts from other machines
- Play against other players or join forces in Coop
- Futuristic voxel-inspired visuals with explosive effects

Choose from a plethora of unique Mybots infused with Ionite Fragments. Each Mybot type offers special mechanics, powerful skills, and endless build possibilities. Master them to outplay enemies, outlast rivals, and break through the walls that hold your world captive. Whether you’re scavenging the scrapyards of the poor zone or infiltrating the neon-lit arenas of the rich zone, your skills will be pushed to the limit. Only the sharpest pilots will survive long enough to reach the top, where the fate of the world hangs in the balance.

Every battle draws you deeper into a conspiracy that threatens both zones. The leaders of the rich zone seek to build a perfect, obedient army, using your victories as data. Break their control systems, rally the oppressed, and spark a revolution from within.

Will you fight for riches, for justice, or for something greater? The arena awaits, and your choices will shape the new world rising from the ashes.

IGRS rating: 13+

it.name: Mystery Manor: hidden objects
it.d:
Mind Fitness: Your daily mind flex with the best puzzle games!
Solve mysteries in a game full of adventures!
The master of a mysterious mansion left a message for a certain brave and clever detective. Is that you? Come on, take the clue: Open the envelope and start your adventure in the Manor. There are more mysteries here than you expected!
Let’s play the most mysterious hidden objects game ever! Unveil the secrets of Mystery Manor and meet all sorts of fantastic beasts, from fierce monsters to spooky ghosts, and try to search and find clues for your investigation. Solve challenging puzzles, find hidden artifacts, uncover secret rooms, investigate crime (occasionally, even an old murder!), search for evidence, and complete exciting quests. It will be a never ending journey! The master of the Manor keeps an eye on the mansion from afar and won’t ever let you get bored. With each new chapter you’ll see new quests, rooms, and characters, that appear in the manor every once in a while! The efforts of the seekers will be generously rewarded.
Some great feature highlights:
• Explore an atmosphere of mystery.
• A captivating detective story full of secrets, romance, crimes… and sometimes even murders.
• Beautiful hand-drawn graphics.
• A wide variety of objects to search for and puzzles to solve.
• Search for objects in different modes: words, silhouettes, phenomena, and Zodiac modes.
• Regular free updates full of new characters, rooms, and quests.
• Breathtaking mini-games and a Match-3 adventure.
• This game works offline without an Internet connection, so you can play it on the plane, on the subway, or on the road. Enjoy!
Enter Mystery Manor and compare it with all the other murder mystery games, detective games, and hidden object games you ever played: you are sure to see the difference for yourself! Looking for clues, finding evidence, solving criminal puzzles, chasing a killer — what can be more fascinating! Mystery Manor is a game where your attentiveness, wit and creativity really matter.  
Be ready for a breathtaking adventure that will be a wonderful escape from your everyday routine.

it.name: Nexus Hero: Adventure RPG
it.d:
Description: The end of the world came not with war but with an asteroid strike that shattered reality. In Nexus Hero: Adventure RPG, the impact unleashed a terrifying mutation, bringing ordinary objects to life as relentless predators. Navigate this horror-filled, cyberpunk-inspired wasteland filled with danger and fight for humanity’s survival.

Key Features:
Post-Apocalyptic Horror Setting: Explore a shattered world where the remnants of everyday life have turned against you.
Mutated Foes: Face terrifying enemies transformed from common objects by the asteroid’s strange effects.
Survival Challenges: Gather resources, craft weapons, and adapt to the ever-present dangers of a hostile world.
Hero Summon: Deploy your survivors with cutting-edge cybernetic implants and unique abilities to combat evolving threats.
Engaging Storyline: Adventure through the mystery behind the asteroid's fall and the terrifying mutations it unleashed on Earth.

Get ready for an epic adventure in Pal Go! This fantasy tower defense game offers a unique blend of strategy, crash mechanics, merges, and competitive PvP battles. Easy to play, hard to master, Pal Go challenges you to protect your tower and emerge victorious against all odds.

As a brave monster hunter, your mission is to defend the Acorn Kingdoms from the dark wizard Mazdor the Black and his evil army. Assemble your pals, merge your units, rank them up, and lead them into epic battles against the forces of darkness. Unlock your monsters’ unique abilities to unleash devastating attacks and ensure victory. Every position on the battlefield can be the difference between crashing to defeat or rising in triumph, so deploy your best units wisely to overcome the Dark Army.

Merge your troops to create powerful combinations and bring even more epic moments to your battles! Don’t let your defenses crash—merge strategically to build unstoppable forces.

Dominate the battlefield in PvP mode! Battle other players in fast-paced skirmishes where strategic thinking and quick reflexes are your greatest weapons. Break through their defenses, climb the leaderboard, and earn legendary rewards. In Pal Go, your wits and skills will determine who wins the ultimate tower defense showdown!

Are you ready to answer the call? Embark on your heroic journey now!

Key Features:
- FUN & EPIC BATTLES: Immerse yourself in thrilling battles with a new roguelite skill experience, offering endless combinations.
- FORGE ALLIANCES: Team up with pals to conquer your adversaries.
MERGE & RANK UP: Strengthen your troops by merging them to take on formidable foes.
- CHOOSE YOUR STRATEGY: Customize your approach by selecting different hero roles and skills for maximum success in defense.
- PVP COMPETITION: Challenge other players in PvP battles and rise through the ranks.
- VARIOUS STAGES: Experience the challenge of each new tower defense stage with varying difficulties.
- ONGOING UPDATES: Discover new heroes, towers, and participate in time-limited events to keep the excitement going.

it.name: Paradise Paws: Merge Animals
it.d:
Save every animal in Paradise Paws — A Merge Adventure!

Prepare to inherit a once thriving Animal Sanctuary.  This merge game wants you to find and discover all the secrets of the island, and figure out who left this place to you.  Restore the grounds of the Sanctuary and care for and save all of the endangered animals. Push back on the greed of corporate developers and preserve the land for your furry and four legged friends. Only you and your BFF Lizzy can save the animals and this beloved sanctuary.

Put a stop to those evil real estate developers and create a thriving home for all of your adorable new friends!


YOU WILL…

Merge Everything: Combine plants, land animals, sea creatures and treasures to make new discoveries! Rescue and nurture a variety of adorable creatures! Be sure to feed the babies so they can grow!

Restore the Sanctuary: Unlock new areas and clear the destruction from the Hurricane! Solve challenging merge puzzles to restore animal habitats and unlock new areas!

Rescue Endangered Animals: Hatch eggs, care for young creatures, and help the sanctuary flourish. The animals need your help to thrive!
MERGE and MATCH to Save the Animals!


MERGE to match three or more items (Bigger merges, better rewards!) and evolve them into more valuable resources or creatures!
Feed and care for the animals to help them grow, and they will help care for the Sanctuary, harvesting essential resources for you to merge and use as you rebuild the Sanctuary!!
EXPLORE and RESTORE the Animal Sanctuary!


Discover new areas in the sanctuary filled with creatures, rare treasures, and hidden secrets. Every new merge brings you closer to restoring the sanctuary!
Evolve animals and plants to uncover new species and habitats. Your merging skills will help save the animals and the Sanctuary!
TAKE ON QUESTS to Unlock Rare Creatures!


DECORATE and Customize Your Sanctuary!
Use your creativity to design and organize your sanctuary layout. Be sure to leave some balls near the area where your Zebras sun themselves as they enjoy being playful too!.
Help the animals rebuild their habitats by merging items to restore their homes!
Adventure awaits and the animals are depending on you!


Download Paradise Paws now and start saving the creatures today – a fun, puzzle-filled adventure from the makers who brought joy to millions of players worldwide!

it.d:
Pirate Ships is the perfect game for those who want to experience the thrill of building and battling epic pirate vessels.
 
In a world where a terrifying sea monster, Kraken, has taken hold of the Caribbean, only the bravest pirates can defeat it.
 
Fight online alongside other pirate lords and thieves, or defeat them; take command of a beaten old schooner and upgrade it to the most powerful battleship on the seas!
 
At the heart of Pirate Ships is ship building.
Collect ships, cannons, and equipment, combine them in unique ways, and you’ll do more than just capture a fort or two; you’ll become a true pirate lord.
But don't get too comfortable, as you'll need to pay attention to the action to find out which parts of your ship require improvement.
 
With its unique blend of ship building and thrilling PvP battles, Pirate Ships offers endless hours of swashbuckling fun.
Whether you prefer to take on your rivals alone or team up with friends, there's no shortage of excitement to be had. So hoist the Jolly Roger and get ready to set sail in the ultimate pirate adventure!
Sail forth and free the Caribbean, fearless captain!
 
 
Features:

it.name: Bridge Constructor Playground

The #1 app with millions of players!

"Bridge Constructor Playground is even more fun than the prequel." – Chip.de

"Bridge Constructor Playground convinces by a fresh look and a lot of fun for several hours." - apfelnews.eu

"Bridge Constructor Playground offers players of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible." – appshopper.com

"This is a very good sequel and satisfies with all the improvements." – apps-news.de

-------------------------

Bridge Constructor Playground offers people of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible. Across 30 innovative levels you have to build bridges over deep valleys, canals or rivers. Following this your bridges will be subjected to a stress test to see whether they can support the weight of the cars and/or trucks which drive across them.

In comparison to the #1 hit Bridge Constructor, Bridge Constructor Playground offers an even easier entry to the game incl. an extensive tutorial. With no fixed budget, and next to no limitations on building materials, there are almost no limits: you can build and construct to your heart’s desire. Here you are free to do as you please and let the time fly by with creative bridge building. Experienced players will enjoy the challenges of the new badge system: for every bridge there are 5 badges to be won for which you must fulfill certain requirements. For example, building a bridge that can carry no more than a certain load limit. All of this, paired with a bright and friendly look, makes Bridge Constructor Playground an exciting and also educational experience for the whole family, offering hours of gaming fun.

FEATURES:
•             New badge system for beginners and pros
•             32 Levels
•             5 Settings: City, Canyon, Beach, Mountains, Rolling hills
•             Survey map with unlocked worlds / levels
•             Extensive tutorial for easy entry to the game
•             4 different building materials: wood, steel, steel cable, concrete piles
•             Percentages and colored visualization of building material’s stress loads
•             Two different stress levels: car and truck
•             High score per Level
•             Connection to the Game Center with leaderboards and achievements
•             Connection to Facebook (Upload screenshots and bridge scores)

it.name: Pocket Tales: Survival Game
it.d:
Welcome to Pocket Tales!
This is a unique story about a survivor who found himself in the world of a mobile game. Help him get back home! Embark on an incredible journey with your new buddy, where you'll meet new friends, uncover the secrets of this world, and even build entire cities.

Game Features: 

Survival Simulation
Survivors are the basic characters in the game, each one is unique and has their own abilities. They are a vital workforce without which the city couldn't exist. Assign survivors to work in various facilities and gather materials for production. Take care of their physical and mental health. If there's a food shortage, help them with hunting, otherwise, they'll go hungry and may get sick. If the work is too demanding or living conditions are poor, they might get tired, and you'll need to upgrade their houses.

Epic Battles
Upgrade your heroes with new gear, enhance their abilities, and build the perfect team to defeat formidable bosses. Enjoy strategic battles, exciting rewards, and endless opportunities to become stronger.

Explore the Wild Nature
You'll build towns in the various biomes of this world. There will be exploratory teams as the survivors population grows. Send teams on expeditions and find more valuable resources. Uncover the truth about the history of this world!

Game Introduction: 

Build Cities: Gather resources, explore in the wild, maintain the basic needs of your people, and balance between comfort and production.

Production Chains: Recycle materials into useful resources, keep your settlement in comfortable conditions, and improve the city's performance.

Assign Workers: Assign survivors to various tasks, such as lumberjacks, craftsmen, hunters, cooks, etc. Keep an eye on survivors’ hunger and fatigue levels. Learn information about the city’s functions. Master the challenging and enthralling gameplay mechanics.

Expand the City: Attract more survivors to your city, construct more buildings and expand your settlement's production capabilities.

Collect Heroes: Each survivor has a unique story and predisposition to different jobs. Some of them cook food faster, others excel as lumberjacks, and some are more efficient hunters than others.

Fight & Win: Build your team, improve their weapons and abilities, and take on challenging bosses in thrilling battles.

Well, you've come to the right place, buddy! Join POLYWAR — the international multiplayer first-person shooter without auto-shooting — enter the war zone and gain your first frag! POLYWAR is an exciting online shooting game that will put your reaction, accuracy, tactical and warfare skills on test. Grab the gun, rush to the battlefield, and fire, soldier! Your prime concern now is to face the enemies and survive in death ops. Be a team player or a loner - there are many ways to win the battle, and the choice is yours.

Real action experience — Standard and tactical reloading, different magnifications of sights, recoil, smoke from the barrel and many pleasant little things helping you to immerse in real action.

Dynamic gameplay and user-friendly controls — Customize the controls to your preference.
 
Marketplace — Build your collection of skins and trinkets, and trade them with other players in the marketplace.
 
Light weight and high FPS — Thanks to good optimization, the game doesn't take up much space and shows high FPS even on weak mobile devices.
 
Constant updates and active community
 
Choose your character: brave soldier, fearless woman, well-aimed sniper or other skillful shooters. Pick your favorite gun from assault and sniper rifles, pistols, shotguns, machine guns, etc. Be sure you have a bullet for each enemy to stay alive in this war. Be on top and stay strong at critical moments during the war ops. Upgrade your hero and weapons, show the force of your counter strike in this modern PvP combat.
 
Play online with millions of players all over the world or challenge yourself in thrilling private battles with your friends. 
 
Now your duty calls you to the fight! Hurry up, warrior!

it.name: Renovation Day: House Makeover
it.d:
►WHAT A MESS

Your brand new home is a royal mess after a tornado tore through and shredded everything. But luckily for you in this house flipper simulator game, you’ve got a can-do attitude and a hammer, so nothing can stand in your way! Get to cleaning up and unpacking everything as you also rebuild, decorate rooms, and make your house a home.

►DECOR? FOR SURE!

● Guide your character through the mess –  collect all the materials you can, these will be super useful for making decor and fixing up all the buildings on your property. Go from room to room and clean them up, then give them a great interior makeover, and unpack some nifty furniture to make them feel super cozy. You’ll be able to pick from various decor items to best suit your tastes, meaning this house makeover simulation is sure to please budding designers, creatives, and anyone looking to enjoy some house flipper action with none of the stress!

● Collect to create – while not fully an idle game, there are still a lot of great idle aspects, such as your ability to collect materials and transform them into more useful items that you can use to decorate and makeover your home. Leave no pile of trash unturned in your search for building materials, you never know what you might need next!

● Decorate with decor – earn points to help you advance through levels by choosing from pieces of decor to fill your house. Let your design instincts guide you as you choose from various plants, chairs, paintings, and more to make your interior design really pop.

● Whimsical graphics – if you love architecture and design, you’re sure to love the fun graphics and effects that our developers have included to make this game maximum fun. Renovating a home and picking the best design can be stressful, even in a game, so we made sure to keep things fun and lighthearted so that you can enjoy all the redecorating fun. Plus, there are no timers or other timed tasks, so you can enjoy running around doing as you please.

►AWESOME ARCHITECTURE

Come on in and give Renovation Day a try today for tons of fun and stress-free decorating fun. You’ll be collecting building materials and using these to rebuild and renovate your home. Along the way, pick out sweet decor items and enjoy uncovering all sorts of rooms that need your design touch to make them perfect. With cute graphics this game is perfect for all ages, allowing everyone to have fun gathering items and letting their inner interior designer free, with none of the stress that real home reno brings.

Download it now and go renovate houses!
