it.name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
it.d:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator. Our cutting-edge flight simulation technology allows you to experience the thrill of being a pro pilot from your device. Whether you want realistic airplane games or a professional flight simulator, RFS delivers an unparalleled journey.

FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!

Learn to take off, land, and complete full flights in a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, visit 30 HD airports, and navigate 500 SD airports. Personalize instruments, use automatic flight plans, and experience the finest detail in this global flight simulator. Master your skills with our pilot tutorials and become a master of flight simulation!
Manual/Tutorial: Real Flight Simulator Wiki
UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join virtual aviators and access premium features in the most advanced airplane simulator and flight simulator available on the App Store.

BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!

As a pro pilot in our flight simulator, you will enjoy a vast array of features for the ultimate flight simulation:
• 60+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Take command of airplane models with realistic 3D cockpits and authentic lighting. Experience pilot systems and instruments in every flight.
• 1900+ HD AIRPORTS: Land your airplane at 3D airports featuring realistic buildings, vehicles, and authentic ground procedures. This is the most detailed airport simulation in a mobile flight simulator.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic at global hubs. Experience real-time weather that challenges your pilot skills in this realistic flight simulator.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures for takeoff and landing to fully immerse yourself in the flight simulation.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars upon landing your airplane.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize real-time weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots for a connected flight simulation community.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Utilize precise autopilot and our Automatic Landing System for long-haul airplane missions.
• REALISTIC SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore the world with high-definition satellite terrain and height maps in stunning 3D. This is global flight simulation at its finest.

ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES

• Join hundreds of other pilots and fly together in any part of the world.
• Chat with fellow multiplayer pilots, participate in weekly events, and join Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points. RFS is the premier multiplayer flight simulator.

ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER

• ATC GAME MODE: Organize aircraft traffic, give instructions, and guide planes to fly safely.
• Enjoy interactive multi-voice ATC procedures and communications. Experience the dual role of pilot and controller in one simulation.

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION

• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design your own airplane liveries and share them globally.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Model your favorite HD airport, and watch other pilots take off from your creation in the flight simulator.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture your favorite planes. Experience city lights at night and the ethereal play of light and clouds during sunrise and sunset.
• Join the Real Flight Simulator community, discover new flight routes, and interact with aviation enthusiasts.

REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS

Internet Connection is required for the full scope of aviation experiences and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!

Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

it.name: Rogue Legend - Roguelike RPG
it.d:
Embark on an action roguelike RPG adventure with Rogue Legend, where every battle makes your hero stronger.

In Rogue Legend, you journey through worlds filled with monsters, treasures, and powerful bosses. Each run is a new roguelike RPG experience of strategy, combat, and growth, giving you the chance to strengthen your hero and push further with every run.



Enter a World of Endless Battles:
Every session begins in the lobby. Press Play and roll the dice to start your roguelike RPG run, diving into a board-based action RPG full of encounters and surprises.

As your hero moves across the board, different events unfold depending on where you land:

* Enemy Tiles: Engage in fast, automatic roguelike RPG battles. After each fight, choose one of three upgrades to shape your build.
* Buff Tiles: Gain boosts to attack, defense, and speed to help your hero survive longer in Rogue Legend’s idle-friendly dungeons.
* Negative Tiles: Face debuffs that test your timing and strategic decisions.
* Minigame Tiles: Roll for luck in short events where you can win extra loot or power-ups.
* Shop Tiles: Spend gold to buy new gear, upgrades, and legendary equipment.
* Special Tiles: Additional tile types will be added over time to expand Rogue Legend’s gameplay depth.


Defeat Bosses and Grow Stronger:
Your goal is to survive, adapt, and conquer every boss battle. Each fight is an opportunity to grow stronger, unlocking new roguelike RPG challenges, rewards, and abilities that prepare your hero for the next run in this idle RPG adventure.



Upgrade, Progress, and Customize Your Hero:
Between runs, return to the lobby to enhance your hero through Rogue Legend’s RPG progression systems:
* Gear System: Collect and upgrade your weapons, armor, and equipment. Collect S weapons!
* Talent System: Level up to unlock new stats, passive abilities, and bonuses that fit your playstyle.
* Pet System: Obtain and train pets that join you in combat.
* Hero Collection: Collect more heroes to unlock new strategies, then level and ascend them to raise their base power. Swap heroes to match different boards, enemies, and builds.
* Mounts: Equip & ride mounts that grant powerful stat bonuses and combat perks
* …and more progression systems to discover as you climb!


Roguelike Depth with Idle RPG Progression
Rogue Legend blends the excitement of roguelike gameplay with the satisfaction of RPG and idle progression. Each run feels fast, rewarding, and different. The board and dice mechanics make every move matter, while the idle RPG design ensures steady progress without repetitive grind.


A Journey of Strategy and Power:
If you enjoy roguelike action, RPG adventure, and idle gameplay, Rogue Legend delivers a journey of endless replayability.
Fight, roll, and rise again in Rogue Legend, the roguelike idle RPG where every battle shapes your hero’s fate.

it.name: Traffic Racer Open World
it.d:
Traffic Racer Open World (previously known as Traffic Racer Russian Village) is an original and dynamic racing game that will certainly interest fans of this genre. In the game, races take place at locations that fully reproduce the atmosphere of provincial cities and villages. The developers have created a full-fledged virtual environment with well-detailed scenery. The participant will drive along different roads, work out control skills and enjoy realistic gameplay.

In the Traffic Racer Open World game, initially the participant will have at his disposal only the VAZ-2107, on which he will pass the first tests. Over time, the user will accumulate enough money and be able to buy another car. The developers have added more than 40 Russian and imported models with unique characteristics to the project. Among them there are various modifications of VAZ, UAZ, Ford, Mercedes, Chevrolet and other options. Each car can be repainted and improved in design.

The races have different modes with unique passing mechanics. The gamer can freely ride on the roads and admire the surroundings or take part in dynamic time trials. There is a function to switch the time of day and change the weather, which allows you to practice driving in more difficult conditions. The camera displays the surrounding space from several angles. The player will see urban five-story buildings, village houses, stops and other objects.

Features of the game Traffic Racer Open World
More than 120 models of cars.
Possibility of customization.
Detailed locations.
Switching the camera view.
Various control methods.

Enjoy at realistic Russian environment with Russian and Foreign Cars.

it.name: Sand Blast - Block Puzzle Game
it.d:
Welcome to Sand Blast, a fresh and relaxing twist on classic block puzzle games!

Drop, match, and blast colorful blocks in this satisfying sand puzzle game. Fill lines with the same color sand to clear them and keep the grid under control!

Whether you're into relaxing brain games, casual offline fun, or smart logic challenges, Sand Blast delivers a fresh experience you can enjoy anytime, anywhere – no Wi-Fi or internet required.
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SAND BLAST
•	Relaxing & Strategic: Enjoy a smooth sandbox experience where blocks dissolve into colorful sand in a calming puzzle space.
•	No Wi-Fi, No Internet Needed: Play anytime, anywhere. One of the best offline games for no-connection moments.
•	Color Match + Logic: Merge blocks, match colors, and trigger combo streaks while sharpening your brain.
•	Top Puzzle Experience: Fans of top games like Block Blast or Tetris will love this sand puzzle twist.
 
FEATURES OF SAND BLAST
•	Block Puzzle Meets Sand Puzzle: A hybrid of match color, sand puzzle, and logic game mechanics.
•	Brain Teasers & Fun Games: Perfect for fans of brain games, fun games, and satisfying challenges.
•	Creative Sandbox Gameplay: Merge tiles, plan ahead, and play your way in this sandbox puzzle adventure.
•	Streaks & Combos: Maintain combos and streaks to blast rows and clear the board.
•	Free & Offline: Enjoy one of the best free games and offline games on iOS – no internet required.
•	Inspired by the Best: A unique blend of block puzzles, flowing sand mechanics, and tetris-style gameplay, influenced by top puzzle games.
•	Optimized for Everyone: Smooth and lightweight. Fun for casual and serious puzzle players.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
•	Tetris-Style Gameplay: Enjoy the familiar joy of block-dropping action, reimagined for today’s puzzle fans.
•	Puzzle Mastery: Outsmart the game with strategic moves to clear lines and rack up points.
•	Block Games Redefined: The classic block blast experience gets a fresh upgrade.
•	Brain-Boosting Adventure: Stimulates cognitive skills and sharpens your problem-solving.
 
HOW TO PLAY
•	Drag and drop 3 block shapes onto the board.
•	Blocks dissolve into colorful sand and settle into place.
•	Fill a row with the same color to clear it and earn points.
•	Use logic to maintain space and trigger bigger combos.
•	Clear multiple rows in a streak to boost your score.
 
PRO TIPS FOR PUZZLE MASTERS
•	Use logic game skills to keep the grid clear.
•	Match colors strategically to create combo chains.
•	Stay in a streak to maximize your score.
•	Mix match game strategies with sandbox creativity to last longer.
•	Love Block Blast or Tetris? You’ll feel right at home.
 
WHAT MAKES SAND BLAST SPECIAL
Whether you're building sandcastles, playing in a sandbox, or stacking merge tiles, every round feels fresh.
This is more than just a block puzzle – it’s a relaxing, visual, and strategic experience perfect for offline and free game lovers.
Inspired by classics and built for modern players, Sand Blast is your go-to puzzle game when you want to relax, think, and win.
 
NO WI-FI? NO INTERNET? NO PROBLEM.
Play offline anytime. No connection needed – just pure puzzle fun on the go.
 
CONNECT WITH THE SQUARE TEAM

Facebook: InspiredSquare

Twitter: @InspiredSquare

Instagram: @squareinspired

We love feedback! Rate Sand Blast and let the Square Team know what you'd like to see next.

Everyone. Friends, family, coworkers. Categories cover all ages, so nobody has to sit out.

Mysterious Shadow Rifts emerged all around the world. They lead to random places and bestow new abilities called Shades upon travelers. Shadow has to pass through Rifts and use this power to close them and unveil the mystery of their origin… But at what cost?

New enemies, new abilities and sequel to Shadow Fight 2 story - Shadow’s adventures continue!

Shades is a RPG fighting game that continues the story of the legendary Shadow Fight 2. Get ready for the enhanced features of the original game that bring your experience to the next level. Fight more battles, see more locations, meet more friends, encounter new enemies, collect powerful Shades and explore the expanded Shadow Fight universe!

ICONIC VISUAL STYLE
Classic 2D backgrounds with enhanced visuals combined with realistic combat animations. Dive into a fan-favorite world of shadows and astonishing landscapes.

EXCITING BATTLES

ROGUE-LIKE ELEMENTS
Each Rift run is unique. Encounter various enemies, absorb Shadow Energy and acquire Shades - random powerful abilities. Mix different Shades, unlock synergies and become unstoppable.

MULTIVERSE EXPERIENCE
Shadow Rifts open paths to three different worlds. Explore the expanded Shadow Fight universe and meet dangerous enemies you have never seen before.

THE COMMUNITY
Follow us on social media to learn the tricks and secrets of the game from fellow players! Share the stories of your adventure, get updates and participate in competitions to win great prizes!

it.name: Shadow Hunter: Special Edition
it.d:
Hardcore Hack’n Slash Action-RPG.

The must try game for any real hack and slash fan who  already got bored with just mindlessly smashing buttons on the screen.



Shadow hunter is an action-packed dark fantasy hack and slash game with an incredible combat system and awesome boss fights, assisted by a one of a kind character control mechanism and a perfect mix of RPG elements to make your adventure super immersive.



A DARKENED, RUINED AND FULL OF SUFFERING SHADOW WORLD



As the mortal world got invaded and destroyed by the horde of dark demons and shadow monsters, everything was covered in the darkness of hell and the constant insufferable noises that were the combination of the endless scream from those evils and the crying and mourning of the lucky few that manage to survive through this nightmare.



The player  will be a Shadow Hunter in this world, which is someone who got blessed by the Ancient One with a special power to fight off those dark demons. 

Through countless battles and obstacles, shadow hunters are destined to bring the light back  to this mortal world.



EPIC BOSS FIGHT



Shadow Hunter's most exciting moments must be it's epic boss battle, in which the Hunters must defeat dark giant demons to collect their souls and advance to the darkest dungeon and the highest floor of the evil tower. 

Without a decent set of equipment and highly trained techniques, any player could easily get wrecked by those big bosses. 

However, the incredible feelings that players get from successfully overcoming those challenges will make it all worth it. 

Furthermore, those dark demon souls are the key to upgrade hundreds of  shadow equipment and weapons, turning them from just a common warrior sword to a legendary hero's blade that would be worshiped by  the generations to come.



ENDLESS CHALLENGES



Shadow Hunter will have 4+ different PVE sections with multiple difficulty modes  and a PVP arena for players to explore and conquer.

“Adventure” is where players start the game with. It may not be the most challenging part,  but it is the most essential section in the game since you need to keep advancing through it to unlock further sections of  the game.

Once you have passed a certain dungeon level, you can unlock  “Altar of the Darkness” , “Boss Mode” and “Clock Tower of Challenges”. Those are where the true test of skill and power happens. For our shadow hunters to overcome those challenges, mastering the fighting technique is a must, understanding the characteristics of each demon and preparing a suitable strategy is needed and strengthening the shadow equipment is a huge plus. 



At the end of the day, shadow hunters can not only liberate the mortal world from those dark demons but also can test their skills and mastery against other fellows of the shadow. 



MULTIPLE CHARACTERS TO PLAY AND ROLL



Players will get to play as multiple different characters, each has its own unique skills, gameplay and assets. Each character is going to be a distinct way to play the game, a distinct  approach to the strategy and the combat.



KEY FEATURES



Intense hack and slash combat.

Epic Boss Fights.

Multiple characters to play.

Hundreds of equipment and weapons to loot and upgrade.

4+ PVE modes and PVP.

Play anytime, anywhere even when offline.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/shlostworld

it.d:
Start your journey with four heroes: Maximus, Mount, Quinn & Lunae. Choose your favorite hero and conquer the darkness. (Maximus is available on the free version)

A Brand New Dark Fantasy Epic 
Play a gripping pocket sized fantasy RPG on the go! Pushing the boundaries of mobile gaming, Shadow of Death is an offline fighting game which doesn’t need the internet to be experienced. Fight the way you want as players can select among four unique shadow knights, multiple gameplay styles, and loads of rare armor sets to conquer a hostile dark world. Whip out that dark sword, collect some comrades, and slash the shadows!

Choice to the Players 
Choose from a cast of four unique shadow knights each representing a vastly different play style. Whether players want to slash or force projectile their way to victory is in their hands, quite literally! Delve into a robust skill tree and deep inventory system that encourages endless combat experimentation and customization. We even have a young boy's soul in a hulking suit of armor, what other game can top that?
     
Conquer the Darkness in Style 
Inspired by classic fighting games and modern action RPGs, combat is a high-octane blend of magic and weapons based hack and slash gameplay. An intuitive touch screen interface provides different options to strategize combat and devastate enemies. The unique battle system is accessible for any player yet deep enough to satisfy the most hardcore action RPG fans. What are you waiting for? Grab that mystical dark sword and plunge into darkness! 

A Beautiful Ruined World
Driven by an all new animation system and graphics engine, players are going to be saying, "I can't believe it's not a console game." That's right, the game looks that good! Optimized for mobile gaming, the gothic fantasy world of Aurora is uniquely cel shaded to deliver jaw dropping magical effects and epic combat sequences to life. 

Play Anywhere, Anytime 
We put the “pocket” in pocket sized RPGs! Experience the thrill of combat anywhere, anytime as Shadow of Death is an offline game. No need to be online to defeat the shadows. 

Challenge the Universe     
When beating down shadow monsters just does not cut it anymore, take your game online! Vie for ultimate supremacy as you battle with other players in the Arena. 

Story: A Dark Knight's Journey 
Aurora, once a prosperous kingdom has fallen. An ancient darkness reborn savages the land with brute force. Crops decay, winds scream with rage, and the dead stir.   
In his lust for power and forbidden knowledge, a king has forsaken his people to ruin. The people cry for hope.  
A lone knight, cleansed of memory but driven by conviction is all that stands between utter annihilation. Marked by destiny, he walks alone towards the whispering shadows. 

Take your game further and level up with us! Engage our team on social media for the latest events to get gift codes, rare armor sets, loads of crystals, and other juicy prizes.

Run, shapeshift, and escape the forest's guardian golem!

Get ready for a thrilling adventure through a mystical forest in this fast-paced endless runner game! Shapeshift between five magical animals—wolf, moose, rabbit, raven, and bear—to navigate through dangerous obstacles and outrun the powerful forest golem hot on your heels.

Shapeshift to Survive
Each animal has unique abilities crucial for survival:
Wolf: Unleash your speed and agility to dash past obstacles with precision.
Moose: Use raw strength to smash through barriers and destructible obstacles in your way.
Rabbit: Slip through tight spaces and burrows where others cannot follow.
Raven (Power-Up): Soar high above danger, evading ground obstacles and collecting coins in mid-air.
Bear (Power-Up): Become unstoppable for a short time, destroying all obstacles in your path without slowing down.

Collect Coins & Unlock Skins
As you race through the forest, gather coins to unlock exclusive magical skins for each animal. Each skin is adorned with enchanting markings, showcasing their hidden mystical powers.

Daily Quests & Achievements
Challenge yourself with daily quests that push your skills to the limit. Complete objectives and earn rewards while unlocking achievements that bring you closer to becoming the ultimate shapeshifting runner.

Compete on Global Leaderboards
Think you're the best? Compete with friends and players worldwide on the global leaderboards. Prove your skills by running farther, dodging faster, and shapeshifting smarter than anyone else.

Features
Shapeshift between 5 magical animals: wolf, moose, rabbit, raven (power-up), and bear (power-up).
Dodge & Destroy: Use each animal's unique abilities to avoid obstacles or smash through them.
Collect Coins to unlock mystical skins and power up your animals.
Complete daily quests and earn achievements for extra rewards.
Compete on global leaderboards and rise to the top.
Special Events: Look out for limited-time events like Halloween for even more fun and rewards!

Why You'll Love It
Endless Action: The thrill never stops as you shapeshift, dash, and fly through the enchanted forest.
Stunning Visuals: Beautifully crafted environments and magical creatures immerse you in a fantasy world.
Constant Updates: We're always adding new skins, quests, and events to keep the game exciting!

Download Shapeshifter: Animal Run now and experience the thrill of transforming into powerful animals as you escape the forest's relentless guardian! How far can you go?

it.d:
Includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

Welcome, Mayor, to the city builder and simulator! Be the hero of your very own city metropolis. This is the city-building game to design and create a beautiful, bustling town or metropolis. Every decision is yours as your city simulation grows larger and more intricate. You need to make smart building choices as a city builder to keep your citizens happy and your skyline growing. Then build, trade, chat, compete, and join clubs with fellow city-building Mayors. The city game that lets you build your city, your way!

BRING YOUR CITY METROPOLIS TO LIFE
Build your metropolis with skyscrapers, parks, bridges, and much more! Place buildings strategically to keep your taxes flowing and your city growing. Solve real-life city-building challenges like traffic and pollution. Provide your town and city services like power plants and police departments. Strategize, build and keep traffic moving with grand avenues and streetcars in this fun city builder and simulator.

PUT YOUR IMAGINATION AND CITY ON THE MAP
The possibilities are endless in this town and city-building simulator! A worldwide city game, build Tokyo-, London-, or Paris-style neighborhoods, and unlock exclusive city landmarks like the Eiffel Tower or Statue of Liberty. Make building rewarding and discover new technologies with the Future Cities while getting athletic with sports stadiums to become a pro city builder. Build and decorate your town or city with rivers, lakes, forests, and expand along the beach or mountain slopes. Unlock your city-builder strategies with new geographic regions for your metropolis, such as the Sunny Isles or Frosty Fjords, each with a unique architectural style. The city-building game where there’s always something new and different to make your city simulation unique.

BUILD AND BATTLE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY
The city-building game that lets you defend your city metropolis against monsters or compete against other mayors in Club Wars. Plot winning city-builder strategies with your Club mates and declare war on other cities. Once the battle simulation is on, unleash crazy disasters like the Disco Twister and Plant Monster on your opponents. Earn valuable rewards to use in battle, in building or to improve your city. In addition, take on other players in the Contest of Mayors, where you can complete weekly challenges and climb the League ranks toward the top of this city game. 

BUILD A BETTER CITY WITH TRAINS
The city-building game to improve as a city builder with unlockable and upgradeable trains. Discover new trains and train stations for your dream metropolis! Build, expand and customize your rail network to fit your unique city simulation.

BUILD, CONNECT AND TEAM UP
Join a Mayor’s Club to trade city supplies with other members who love and chat about city-building strategies and available resources. Collaborate with other town and city builders to help someone complete their personal vision as well as get support to complete yours. Build big, work together, lead other Mayors, and watch your city simulation come to life in this city-building game and simulator!

it.name: Idle Space: Ship Crafting RPG
it.d:
► BUILD YOUR SHIP. JOIN THE WAR.

The galaxy belongs to those strong enough to claim it.

Build a powerful spaceship, challenge other commanders in PvP, join an alliance, and fight alongside your allies in massive Alliance Wars. Every upgrade, every module, and every decision brings you closer to becoming a force the galaxy can't ignore.

Will you build the ship everyone fears?

► CREATE A SHIP THAT'S TRULY YOURS

Start with a basic vessel and turn it into a machine built for battle. Collect weapons, shields, engines, armor, and special modules, then combine them to create your own setup.

There is no single perfect ship — only the one that works for you.

► WATCH YOUR BUILD COME TO LIFE

Once your ship is ready, send it into battle and watch your strategy play out.

Weapons open fire. Shields absorb incoming attacks. Special abilities turn the tide. A setup that looked perfect in the hangar may need to change after meeting its next opponent.

Upgrade, rebuild, and try again until your ship can handle whatever the galaxy throws at it.

► CHALLENGE OTHER COMMANDERS

Your toughest opponents aren't waiting at the end of a mission. They're building their ships right now.

Take your strongest setup into PvP and see how it performs against other players. Improve your build, climb the ranks, and come back stronger after every battle.

But you don't have to conquer space alone.

Join an alliance, grow together with other commanders, and enter Alliance Wars where every member can make a difference. Fight for victory, valuable rewards, and your alliance's place among the strongest in the galaxy.

► EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN

Beyond the safety of your hangar lies a galaxy filled with dangerous sectors, hostile fleets, mysterious encounters, and valuable resources.

Travel from sector to sector, complete missions, defeat increasingly powerful enemies, and discover what waits deeper in space. The farther you go, the greater the challenge — and the stronger your ship will need to become.

Every new destination is another test for the vessel you've built.

► KEEP GROWING WHILE YOU'RE AWAY

Your journey doesn't stop when you leave the game. Come back to new resources and fresh opportunities to improve your ship.

Spend your rewards on upgrades, unlock new possibilities, and prepare for the next mission. Jump in for a few minutes or stay to perfect your build — there's always another upgrade, battle, or sector waiting for you.

► YOUR SHIP. YOUR ALLIANCE. YOUR GALAXY.

The hangar is ready. The next sector is waiting.

It's time to take your place among the stars.

it.name: State of Survival: Zombie War
it.d:
In this strategy war game,  fight to survive this doomsday world filled with zombies!! Everyone's gotta show what they're made of in the zombie survival showdown! You've got to survive and dodge the creeping dead army and infection. In this doomsday scenarios, facing the ultimate survival challenge, your task is to establish and manage your own shelter, join forces with mighty allies, and take on the zombie war together. You'll need to get smart with your strategy to power up your skills, blast through the zombie mobs, and keep the invaders at bay.

You are the doomsday survivor of your shelter, and you could even become the leader of an alliance in this post-apocalyptic world. Team up with mighty allies, bring in powerful heroes, and launch a defense against the wave of zombies. You've got to collect resources, strengthen your shelter's build and defense to make sure you and your team can survive this war.

Boost Your Base: To keep your city standing and survive until the very last minute in this total war, upgrading shelter is critical. Focus on upgrade buildings, train your troops, execute your strategy and research to enhance your defense capabilities. Gear up with craft Tempest Arms and Energy Conversion Units for extra protective edge, and enhance your gear to turn the looming threat of the catastrophic world into nothing. Plus, you’ll need to gather resources to fuel your base's growth and increase your odds of survival.

Allies and Enemies: In this dark doomsday scenario, you can recruit epic heroes, form alliances, establish an alliance and fight alongside a mighty ally to launch a defense of the capital. You can also join cross-server battles for a confrontation where only the dead are left behind, and fight for survival to the very end. Make and execute your own strategy to guard your shelter and build up your defense against the onslaught from zombies. You can overcome the dark and be the last survivor!

Epic Events: In Survival Royale, you'll be thrown into a survival game and find hope through this black survival. You must escape as the danger zone gradually expands, collect plunder, and equip yourself with a powerful arsenal for your defense against incoming attacks from other players, and become the last survivor of the war. In "Desert Survival," pick your side—human or monster—in a strategic battle survival game where the dark clashes with the light in an epic doomsday face-off. In Paw-some Puzzle Party, you just need to stay relaxed and enjoy the challenge with  a crew of skilled cats.

Style in the Apocalypse: join all kinds of survivor challenge events to snag HQ decorations, March Skins, Frames, Guardians, and a whole array of other cool stuff. Each player has their own Collection Hall, displaying a variety of exquisite skins. Even as the last days loom, you can survive in style!

Begin your journey from the last shelter now to change all these and allow everyone to escape from despair and the post-apocalyptic world! The world needs you to fight. Let's survive together in a war filled with doom. In this strategy war game. Are you ready?

it.name: States Builder: Trade Empire
it.d:
► ARE YOU RESOURCEFUL ENOUGH TO BUILD A WHOLE WORLD?

It’s all about supply chains in this fun idle world-building simulator game where the aim is to develop all of human civilization one hex at a time. Log, mine, craft and process raw materials to earn coins, then use them to upgrade your facilities and expand your profits so you can open up more land, unlocking entire continents and eventually the whole wide world.

If you’re looking for a fun builder game with some complex strategy elements and satisfying challenges, then download States Builder now and start building your worldwide business empire.

◾ GET LOGGING: It all starts with wood – you cut trees to sell at market, then soon you’ll be able to afford a logging mill and a board factory. As you progress through the game, you’ll open up all sorts of other resources that can be processed in a variety of different ways.

◾ FEED THE CHAIN: Processed resources take longer to produce, but also make you more money. Use strategy to work out the best way to maximize your profits in the game by building varied supply chains, then watch the coins come pouring in.

◾ IMMEDIATE RETURNS: Spend profit on upgrading facilities on the map to increase your income in your current level. Each mine and processing facility has six levels, each of which increases productivity and profit. Adapt your strategy to make profits as fast as possible and move on to the next level of the game.

◾ INVEST IN THE FUTURE: You can also buy upgrades for resource production speed and greater profit. Upgrades apply to all facilities producing one type of material, and also carry across levels in the game, so you get to keep the benefits.

◾ RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT: Divert resources to equip and launch exploration balloons that will scout out new lands. Each time a balloon is launched in the game, you get coin and crystal bonuses.

◾ DISCOVER NEW LANDS: Once you’ve opened every hex in an area, you’ll need to save up coins to unlock the next area. Who knows what resources you’ll find when you discover new lands?

◾ WE HAVE LIFT OFF: When you’ve unlocked every hex on a continent, you’ll find a rocket. Fuel it up with resources to complete the level, then blast off to a new virgin continent with new resources to mine and craft, and start building all over again.

► BUILDER, INDUSTRIALIST, TYCOON

From a small single settlement, through a developed town, to a fantastic industrial civilization with your own spaceship, in States Builder you get to build your way through human history and watch as your whole planet becomes a hive of industry. If you enjoy strategy games and would like the chance to build your own world, then install States Builder now.

it.name: Stealth Master: Assassin Ninja
it.d:
► SILENT BUT DEADLY
 
Looking for a way to spend a quite five minutes? If you mean really quiet and incredibly stealthy, then head into Stealth Master, the silent but deadly mobile game that celebrates all things sneaky, sly, underhand and devious. Prove your ninja credentials by infiltrating buildings, sliding through the shadows, and taking out bad guys at close quarters, doing your job from a distance with a sniper rifle, or pulling off incredible daredevil heists without being seen in this fun action game that boasts loads of cool mechanics, scores of your favorite characters, and a deadly sense of humor.
 
► DID YOU HEAR SOMETHING?
 
• One last job – take contracts to eliminate gangsters, executives and other ne’er-do-wells in increasingly difficult ninja assassination missions that require skill, speed, and loads of stealth to reach and take out the boss.

• Tons of guns – try out a whole host of weapons, from the traditional cold steel of the kunai and katana to every type of gun imaginable, including high-powered sniper rifles. Find your favorite form of lethal force and hone your particular skill or choose the right tool for each job and become a true weapons master.

• Adapt to your environment – whether it’s dodging flashlights and lasers, using hidden passages, shooting up explosives to take out multiple enemies, or pretending to be a pot plant, Stealth Master offers dozens of different ways to use the surroundings to your advantage with ingenious game mechanisms that put variation and excitement in every level.

• Steal the unstealable – once you’ve mastered assassination, try your hand at the ultimate stealth task of hi-tech robbery. Now you won’t have to attack anyone, just stay in the shadows, slip past the guards and sophisticated security equipment, and grab the juicy loot without anyone seeing you. New robbery missions offer a combination of traditional stealth moves and a variety of fun brainteasers.

• Work remotely – tired of getting your hands dirty? Now you can do your nefarious deeds at a distance with tricky sniper levels. Train your sights on the target, plan your strategy, keep your head down, and make sure you’ve got an escape route.

• An incredible cast – complete missions and earn cash to unlock dozens of cool, pop culture-inspired characters that you can level up and train to be the ultimate assassins. Choose between action stars, superheroes, supervillains and a super-sneaky imposter to find your favorite ninja.
 
► THAT WAS UNEXPECTED!

Now with a load of new features, new game modes, new missions, new weapons, and a new character, Stealth Master is even more fun and exciting than before. Looking for action of the stealthy, surreptitious kind? Got what it takes to be a true master ninja assassin? Download the game now and get stealthing.

it.name: Archers Online: PvP
it.d:
Get ready to master Archers Online, an epic PvP archery adventure game that puts you in the heat of archero duels, where only the best archer warrior wins!

Become the ultimate archer hero in a variety of PvP archer fights, facing off against shadow warriors and archery masters from around the world. Let's find out who has the strongest bow, the sharpest arrows, and the best aim in this challenging casual game!

Engage in exciting two-player online duels, in which you can either face strangers or challenge your friends in bowman war. Stick fight your way through each level, carefully judging the wind and angles to ensure your arrows always hit their mark. Whether you're battling in a shadow fight or facing off in a bright arena, you'll need all your skill to win these archery duels.

Show off your archery fighter prowess and conquer the bowman games with your powerful bows and diverse arrow arsenal. Whether you're slinging a bomb arrow, a burning arrowhead, or an armor-piercing cactus, you'll make your opponents quiver with fear. Every arrow game in this archers battle is a fresh and exciting challenge.

When you're not shooting, hit the anvil to upgrade your bow and shield, preparing your archer warrior for the next bow and arrow game. Your character's equipment can be the difference between victory and defeat, so make sure you're fully equipped before you enter the archery arena.

Victory in each archer fight brings spoils: coins and chests packed with resources. These can be used to upgrade your skins and equipment, making you an even more formidable archer fighter. Mastering these bowman games will reward you with even more bonuses, with daily quests and archery seasons offering a plethora of additional prizes.

As you progress in this captivating casual game, you'll move across the map and unlock new arenas. Each arena brings tougher opponents, so stay sharp and continue upgrading your bow master skills. And with a diverse range of beautiful landscapes – from atmospheric jungles to rainy city streets and ancient vine-covered ruins – you'll always have a new stunning location to enjoy as you level up.

Archers Online also features a training arena, where you can refine your skills before you step into the bowman war. Here you can experiment with different bow types, learn how to compensate for wind speed, and perfect your arrow aim.

But  Archers Online  isn't just about fighting - you can also chat with your opponents during the battles, exchange archery emoji, and even make friends. Just because you're in a bowman battle, doesn't mean you can't enjoy some friendly banter!

Your character can be customized with a variety of accessories, ensuring you always stand out in the crowd of archers games. Whether it's cool hats, flashy bow skins, or unique pennant stickers, there's plenty of ways to express your style.

Archers Online combines addictive gameplay, gorgeous graphics, and rewarding progression in one immersive shooter adventure. So, what are you waiting for? Dive into a world of endless multiplayer mayhem and bow-slinging fun, and show everyone who the true archer hero is!

Introducing Stone Age Survival, an addictive clicker and strategy game that will immerse you in the challenges of survival and progress! Prepare yourself for a relentless journey where every decision counts.

In this stone age survival simulator, you must build your strategy to thrive. There's no time to rest as you embark on a quest to master essential skills like mining, crafting, food extraction, and building. Each action plays a crucial role in your survival.

The game kicks off with a choice that sets your strategic path. Will you focus on crafting tools, mining for resources, building a shelter, or teaming up with fellow survivors? The choice is yours, and your decisions will shape the destiny of your tribe.

Build Your Survival Strategy: Formulate a plan to conquer the stone age challenges. Explore new territories, unlock hidden areas, gather resources, and construct vital structures for your tribe's survival.

Upgrade Mining, Crafting, and Building Skills: Adapt and evolve as the stone age progresses. This clicker game offers the opportunity to learn new tools, create more complex resources, and build advanced objects. Unleash your creativity and make strategic choices to ensure the tribe's progress.

Expand Your Base: The stone age is full of surprises and dangers. Expand your base by venturing into unexplored areas, uncovering valuable resources, and fortifying your defenses. Strengthen your tribe's resilience and ensure their survival in this hostile world.

Exciting Clicker Gameplay: Engage in addictive clicker mechanics that keep you engaged and motivated. Tap, gather, and progress as you watch your tribe grow and flourish. Experience the satisfaction of seeing your efforts yield results.

Stone Age Survival is the ultimate test of your survival instincts and strategic thinking. Can you lead your tribe to thrive in a world filled with peril and uncertainty? Only the most resilient and resourceful will prevail. Embrace the stone age challenge and embark on an unforgettable journey of survival and progress.

IDLE HERO SUMMON & GACHA ROSTER
Unlock the summoning portal to collect over 40 unique characters. Pull for common, rare, epic, and mythic heroes to build your ultimate squad. AFK MONSTER AUTO BATTLE
Leave the endless grinding behind. Set up your arena formation and let the auto battle system handle the heavy lifting. Place your roster carefully on the tactical grid to maximize their elemental damage and crowd control abilities. Freeze enemy waves, unleash fiery magic, and debuff powerful targets. Tweak your idle defense strategy and optimize your formations to overcome increasingly difficult challenges and enemy factions.

MYTHIC HEROES & EPIC BOSSES
Push the limits of your auto battle tactics by taking on colossal bosses and participating in special weekly events. Summon exclusive, limited-time mythic heroes to add to your collection. Climb the leaderboards, optimize your idle defense grid, and prove your squad-building strategy is the most effective in the game.

• Effortless Idle AFK Progression: Your squad auto-battles and collects offline loot constantly!
• Epic Gacha System: Experience the thrill of the idle hero summon to unlock powerful units.
• Strategic Auto Battle: Position your AFK monster army perfectly to unleash devastating combos.
• Deep RPG Progression: Level up, evolve, and ascend your mythic heroes to their maximum potential.
• Tactical Idle Defense: Upgrade spells, passive boosts, and placements to conquer elite boss encounters.

If you love the satisfying progression of a squad-building game, the thrill of gacha collecting, and deep strategy mechanics, your search ends here. Download Summoners Greed now and start building your ultimate team today!

it.name: Supermarket Village—Farm Town
it.d:
Ready to open a supermarket in a new town? Become a manager in a nice, pleasant village and sell homemade products!

Take the challenge and run your own farm to offer fresh food to the locals. Build your dream town while expanding your business, and be the most famous neighbor thanks to your hard work!

OPEN NEW MARKET SECTIONS: 

Harvest crops and feed animals, and produce enough feedstock to process different products for your clients. Improve your supermarket as you build new factories, expand your fields and farms, and handle online orders. Your village will need a bakery, dairy section, meat section, or even a produce department! Hire cashiers and stockers to replenish the racks with all kinds of tasty products!

BUILD YOUR VILLAGE: 

Expand your town with new buildings and farming areas! Open factories, create new crop fields, open a cowshed, a chicken coop, or a refinery. Don’t forget to supply your supermarket! Unlock a dairy factory, bread factory, meat plant, or beverage factory. Create your local brand, and put your village on the map!

ELABORATE YOUR PRODUCTS:

Plant and harvest different types of seeds such as wheat, corn, tomatoes, apples, or carrots. Take care of animals such as cows, chickens, hens, or pigs in your farmyards. Collect milk, meat, or eggs and manufacture a lot of products according to the demand. Adapt your strategy to your supermarket needs! 

MANAGE ONLINE ORDERS: 

Expand your business by taking advantage of new technologies! Meet the demand of clients nearby and receive their shopping lists. The more clients you have, the more your village will grow! Use your infrastructure to grow your business, and reinvest your profits to be the most loved supermarket manager. 

If you like farming and expanding your map, you will enjoy Supermarket Village! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to manage a supermarket with profitable results. Improve your status starting from a modest produce section and unlock visible progress in your premises. Transform your small business into the most friendly supermarket and make your village a happier place to be!


Main Features: 

Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
More detailed management system 
Dozens of objects to be unlocked and upgraded
Lots of characters and interactions
Funny 3d graphics and great animations 
Management of a successful business
A small living world in miniature

it.name: TDS - Tower Destiny Survive
it.d:
► KING OF THE CASTLE

Well technically it’s a tower, but still. It’s yours, as long as you can keep the zombies away from it in this tower defense strategy game. It appears the zombie apocalypse is upon us based on how many of them are roaming the streets, so keep your gun nearby as you work to build your tower and keep it moving despite the waves of zombies.

► CONSTRUCT AND DEFEND

To build your tower, you’ll need to collect different blocks as you travel, which you can then assemble to form your fortress. Within each of the levels you can add different weapons that will help keep you safe and on the go despite the masses of zombies that are trying to get in to eat your brains. Be careful, once your defenses are breached, you’re as good as dead so keep building and moving!

●  Ready, aim, fire – It’s a zombie tsunami! This RPG shooter will keep you busy blasting zombies as you work to build and protect your mobile castle. Wage war on the undead to avoid becoming one with them. Collect new and exciting weapons along the way, and make sure you upgrade them so that your shooter skills remain top notch.

●  Strategize – Use strategy to plow through your enemies as you roam in search of blocks to add to your tower. While there may be a lot of idle game play and zombie shooting, you will need to plan ahead and think about how and where you want to add weapons and more to your fortress. You’ll need all the guns and protection you can find as you advance through the levels and encounter more and more enemies!

●  Level up – Progress through levels in this tower defense RPG, and gain access to more exciting upgrades, weapons, tower parts, and more! The Earth is your oyster if you can remain a survivor and avoid becoming zombified, so fight for your life and keep exploring.

●  So lively – The graphics, not the zombies. Dive into this world of vibrant and cute characters and delightful animations that really bring everything to life. Who knew fighting off zombie waves could be so adorable? Even as you work to come up with the winning strategy you’ll be able to relax and have some fun thanks to the chill vibes.
 
► LAND OF THE LIVING DEAD

So come on then, survivor, build your tower and wage war on the zombies in this fun and engaging strategy shooter game! Use your tower to travel across the lands as you explore and take out enemies, and have fun customizing all the different levels with neat guns and other weapons that will help you in your fight against the undead. 

Download Tower Destiny Survive today to test your survival skills now!

"On an iPhone or iPad, the 2-D, side-scrolling block-based sandbox is a winning formula, and The Blockheads is the most well-executed, true-to-Minecraft game I've had the pleasure to experience on iOS." - TouchArcade (5 Stars)

"The Blockheads takes the Minecraft experience and shrinks it down in a way that just works on a touchscreen. There are shades of Lemmings here too, and they blend together to make a sweet game about discovery, exploration, and creation." - Pocket Gamer (Gold Award)

*****
Night is falling and your blockhead is freezing. You haven't yet made shelter and your campfire has gone out. All you have is a spade, some wood and a few sticks. You have only minutes before exhaustion hits. Do you create a bed, dig a cave or refuel your fire? What will you do?

The Blockheads is a huge exploration, creation and survival game where the possibilities are endless!

Play offline in single player, or easily create and join online worlds to play with friends and family, or explore thousands of unique worlds created and hosted by other players.

Start with almost nothing and explore, craft, build and trade your way to steam trains, electric elevators, and even jet packs, titanium swords and carbon fiber armor. 

- Explore an infinite number of worlds filled with oceans, caves, deserts, mountains, forests and floating sky islands
- Build massive structures with the materials you find
- Trade with other players in an ever changing global economy
- Battle other blockheads in PVP worlds
- Lay rail and create jumps for speedy rail hand cars or create a rail network for easy transport by train
- Create an array of solar panels to power your oil refinery, and craft carbon fiber and fuel for your jetpack to explore the skies
- With content always being added, The Blockheads is continuously evolving, and there is more to come

Warp your first blockhead through the portal and get exploring now in The Blockheads!

it.name: Hidden Objects - The Journey
it.d:
▶Calling All Keen-eyed Adventurers!
If you’re a fanatic for finding obscured objects, come put your skills to the test in this fantastic hidden object puzzle game: Hidden Objects: The Journey. We’ve upped the game with unique themed levels containing a plethora of objects to search for – don’t miss out! Along the way enjoy the various modes and lots of great unlockable content that will always have you coming back for more.


Fun Features:
●Lively Levels: Each level has a distinct theme, such as the four seasons, camping, and more. Within each of them, we’ve hidden objects that look like they might belong there so that you have a proper challenge – no picking out the snowshoe at the beach here! We’re also always working to add more levels so that you never run out of fun.

●Infinite Objects: We’ve packed each level with a huge variety of objects for you to find! Carefully sort through each part of the level to find the various things on your list as you play detective. Thanks to the unique themes of each level, you won’t find yourself having to find the same objects over and over again each time – we’ve made sure to stash tons of exciting items in each level.

●Many Modes: Sometimes you just want to slow down and take your time searching through the hidden pictures for items, while others you may want to test your speed-finding skills under pressure. Here you can have it all – alternate between timed, regular, and free modes to get the best experience and have fun while also taking a break. And don’t forget to turn up your volume if you’re in need of some extra relaxation, and make use of the hints and bonuses buttons in those dire times of need!

●Covert Content: To keep things really exciting you’ll be able to access all sorts of extra unlockable content, ranging from daily puzzles to quizzes and more, on top of the regular levels. Completing levels will also earn you coins, which can then be used to access hidden levels and new scenes. The more you play, the more you’ll have access to.

●Hidden Object Fanatics: Assemble!
So if you’re a fan of hidden object games and fancy an exciting challenge, download Hidden Objects: The Journey today to put your searching skills and brain to the test! Go over each unique themed level with a fine-tooth comb and check the found items off your list. Whether you’re aiming to relax or give your eyes a workout, you’re sure to find exactly what you’re looking for here.

it.name: The Walking Zombie 2: Shooter
it.d:
The world after the zombie apocalypse is a grim place. You were born into it, so you will have to struggle to survive and fight against many kinds of zombies, bandits and dangerous boss monsters. You will go on important story quests and many side quests, level up your skills and perks, sell and buy equipment, and communicate with the (un)lucky survivors.

SURVIVAL RPG AND FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER
Walking Zombie 2 is a good old FPS with story, with dozens of quests and a lot of shooting stuff with different weapons. Your main enemies are zombies who already control the world. They are everywhere, in many different kinds and - most importantly - in great numbers. You will be using guns with different ammo, grenades or melee weapons to finish them off. Meanwhile, you will be able to heal yourself with medkits and food. As you complete more and more quests, your character will become stronger with better equipment, enhanced skills and gained perks. Are you going to get more hit points, a better chance when lockpicking locks or a lower fuel consumption while driving across the world map?

FEATURES
• Good old single player post-apocalyptic FPS
• Attractive modern polygon graphics style
• Karma system - good and bad deeds create new options and encounters
• Dozens of story and side quests
• Many weapons, protective gear and other equipment
• Weapon skins
• A variety of enemies - zombie walkers, bandits, and huge boss mutants
• Traders in settlements
• Fun mini games and sniper missions

STORY OF THE CHOSEN ONE WITH A TRAGIC PAST
Can your story end happily after such a tragic beginning? Because of the circumstances surrounding your birth, you are the only one who can save the world. You are immune to the effects of the virus that turns people and animals into zombies. it.name: Rogue with the Dead: Idle RPG
it.d:
Rogue with the Dead is an original roguelike RPG where you command and power up troops on an endless, looping journey.
What kills you makes you stronger.

An innovative game from room6, the team that has brought you such successes as Unreal Life and Gen’ei AP.


◆Defeat the Demon Lord
Your mission is to lead an envoy of soldiers for 300 miles, in order to defeat the Demon Lord at the end.
Completing quests and killing monsters will earn you coins that you can use to make your troops stronger.
They fight automatically, and you can choose to either wait and watch them have at it or join the battle yourself.

Soldiers respawn after they’re killed, but you don’t. You’ll lose all soldiers, money, and items, except for artifacts, and you’ll have to start over.

To stand a chance against the powerful bosses impeding your progress, you’ll need to collect as many artifacts as you can. Defeating them, in turn, will grant you more artifacts.


◆Many different playstyles
・Power up soldiers, defeat monsters, and clear dungeons
・An endless loop of dungeons
・Hire healers, summoners, magicians, and more to fight for you
・Focus on knights for close-range attacks or upgrade your wizards to crush enemies long-range? The choice is yours
・Defend yourself from the incoming enemies in true tower defense fashion
・Power up quests to earn more coins automatically in idle mode
・No annoying controls required as most of the game can be played while idling
・Find even stronger soldiers to defeat tough bosses
・Collect many useful artifacts
・Gather ingredients to cook meals to enhance your soldiers’ powers
・Compete with other players in the online leaderboard
・Roguelite mechanics, making you stronger every time you start over

◆A beautiful pixel art world
Travel through a fantastic world and its story drawn in beautiful pixel art. Enjoy the journey to the Demon Lord’s castle together with your troops and your guide Elly.
Little by little, you’ll find out about what happened before your arrival, and Elly might know more than she lets on...

◆Watch the numbers grow
At first, you’ll deal 10 or 100 points of damage. As you progress with the upgrades, the numbers will grow in the millions, billions, trillions... Enjoy the exponential growth of your power.

◆A varied roster of soldiers
Swordsman
A basic warrior unit with high health who fights on the front line to protect other soldiers.

Ranger
An archer that can attack from afar. However, it is slower and has less health than warriors.

Pigmy
A tiny warrior with low health and weak attack, but very fast movement. It can quickly sneak close to enemies to attack them directly.

Sorcerer
A magician that deals high damage to enemies within an area. However, it is slow and rather fragile.

...and many more.

◆Artifacts that power you up

・Increase attack by 50%
・Protect magicians from 1 attack
・Increase all coins earned by 50%
・1% of all soldiers' attack is added to the tap attack
・Soldiers have a 1% probability of spawning at giant size
・Necromancers can summon 1 additional skeleton

...and many more

◆If you’re tired, just idle
If you want to take a break, just close the game. Quests will still continue even while you’re not playing the game. When you come back, you’ll have more coins to power up your soldiers and defeat that boss that has been giving you trouble.
You can play for a few minutes at a time, so it’s perfect to fill in those little pockets of time throughout the day.


◆You’ll probably like this game if...
・You like idle games
・You like “clicker” games
・You want something to do in your spare time
・You like strategy games
・You like RPGs
・You like pixel art
・You want the game to progress while you're afk
・You like tower defense games
・You like roguelike or roguelite games
・You like playing online
・You like endless dungeon exploration games
・You like seeing numbers grow exponentially
・You go hard

it.name: Tiny Warriors Rush - Idle TD
it.d:
►TOWER ABOVE THEM ALL

This tower defense game is like no other! With each battle you’ll need to choose which warriors and upgrades you’ll be using, and make adjustments each time as the level difficulty goes up. With its cool, casual style, this idle roguelike battle game is sure to please everyone, with no penalties for losing and tons of opportunities to try out different strategies to protect your kingdom and castle from the hordes of zombies.
 
►ADVANCE AND DEFEND

Each level consists of a battle between two towers – you’ll be both defending your own and attacking your enemies. Pick from a range of knights and other warriors, then as the battle advances, choose your bonuses and upgrades wisely to keep the advantage! Each win brings you gold and other goodies that you can use to expand your arsenal of fighters plus level them up, so get ready for the ultimate tower defense strategy game!
 
The best of the best:

• Ultimate upgradability – Basically everything in this tower defense masterpiece is upgradable – your castle, your heroes, your knights, their skills… the list goes on! That means that everything is ultra customizable. Enjoy leveling everything up to become the meanest knight around!

• Strategize to your heart’s content – In addition to all of the upgrades available, there’s also an element of chance to the game, meaning your planning will only get you so far. Enjoy more roguelike action thanks to randomized growth cards, while also having some control over how the battle goes by strategically choosing which warriors to send out when. If at first you don’t succeed, try, try again – this casual game doesn’t penalize you for losing. Plus, with endless waves of enemies, there’s always someone or something to try your new plan out on.

• Casual gameplay – To help get you in the mood for deep strategy, we’ve created the perfect environment: in addition to the lack of penalty for losing, sit back and enjoy the great graphics, accessible controls, idle-style gameplay, and short but sweet battles. No matter where you are you have time to squeeze in a game or two of tower defense!
 
►BATTLE IT OUT FOR TOP KINGDOM

Knights, prepare for battle: your castle is under attack by a wave of zombies! This idle roguelike tower defense game is a hit for young and old alike thanks to the simple mechanics and engaging gameplay. While the premise is simple (defend your tower while destroying the enemy’s castle), you’ll have endless options to upgrade your army and try out different strategies. Short bursts of battle are interrupted by chances to level up and improve, meaning there’s always something fun happening in Tiny Warriors Clash – come check it out today!

BUILD THE CITY
Transport goods, help different contractors,... isn't something missing in your tycoon experience? Foundation and legacy of your big business life? The game incorporates building city simulator sandbox! You will become mayor of the small city and you will expand it, buy new lands, build new buildings and roads for public transport, wherever you want. You will decorate your city, upgrade your company headquarters and give a little more depth to your basic railroad transport line simulator. You will expand your train station, build factories to process goods you acquired with your cargo fleet and dispatch trains, plains, trucks and ships to the whole world.

FEATURES

• Unique blend of goods transport: dispatch your vehicles from sea port, airport or train station to deliver goods
• Build, decorate and customize your city to make permanent mark on the world
• Create global railway empire with many amazing trains, be the ultimate train tycoon
• Collect trucks and become truck tycoon too!
• Own the skies and every airport city with your airplane fleet - after all, we live in the world of airports
• Travel to different regions to build the epic empire - from the desert to city island and frozen north! 
• Collect rare vehicles and upgrade them to deliver more cargo - from steam trains to futuristic planes
• Manage your dispatchers - use dependable transport manager to manage traffic and become true transit king and top tycoon



STRATEGY AND SIMULATION HEAVEN
You can have the best of both worlds! This is not only perfect mix of ship tycoon, railroad tycoon and plane tycoon with highly detailed models of every vehicle, you will be city tycoon builder and explore map full of cool places. As the game is situated in unnamed country, you will enjoy everything you like about american and euro truck simulator games, it will be both amazing euro train simulator and airport city manager with various planes at your disposal. Your sea port city will be full of huge cargo ships hauling goods across vast seas and rivers and you will have to do your best to prevail as the best port city ship tycoon in the world. With our epic introduction scenes for all vehicles, you will know how truckers of europe, american train conductors or airplane captains feel when working for you.

Welcome to the ultimate FNaF mashup, where you will once again be trapped alone in an office fending off killer animatronics! Mix and match any assortment of characters that you like, set their difficulty from 0-20, then jump right into the action! From your office desk, you will need to manage two side doors, two vents, as well as two air hoses, all of which lead directly into your office.

- Challenge menu including 16 themed challenges
- Voice acting from returning favorites as well as from new arrivals to the franchise
- Unlockable office skins
- Unlockable cutscenes

NOTE: Interface and audio in English. Subtitles in English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean.

it.name: Viking Hero TD: Roguelike RTS
it.d:
Every level is a new map, a new challenge, and a new set of roguelike perks. 
By day: build your base, set up defenses, grow your village. By night: take direct control of your Viking hero and lead your army into battle.

Each level is a new map to conquer. By day, gather resources, handle base building, and set up tower defense around your village and castle. When night falls, take direct control of your Viking hero and command your army in real-time strategy combat as enemy waves attack. Master both halves of the loop  (castle defense by day, hero-led battle by night) to push deeper into the Nine Realms.

What keeps every run fresh:
• Roguelike perks and temporary boosts reshape each level and each run. No two playthroughs are the same.
• Built as an offline game. Play the campaign without a connection.
• No forced ads, no interruptions mid-battle.

Unlock new heroes, weapons, and gear as you progress, each with unique abilities and its own playstyle.

The story: the Jotun (ancient giants and sworn enemies of the gods) have seized the Nine Realms. Rooted in Norse mythology, your quest is to rebuild your lands as a Viking commander and hold the line before Ragnarok arrives.

Key features

• Tower defense (TD) and base defense with tactical RTS control
• Base building. Grow and upgrade your village and castle
• Castle defense by day, direct hero control and army command by night
• Real-time strategy combat against waves of enemies
• Roguelike perk system for high replay value
• Unlock multiple heroes, plus weapons and gear with unique abilities
• Designed for offline play
• No forced ads
• A Norse mythology world: the Jotun, the Nine Realms, and Ragnarok

Quick questions:

Can I play offline? Yes, the campaign is designed for offline play.
Is it free? Yes, free to download, no forced ads interrupting your runs.
How many heroes? Unlock multiple heroes as you progress.
Is it tower defense or strategy? Both. Tower defense (or tower defence), base defense, and real-time strategy.

Defend your village, command your army, and survive the road to Ragnarok.

it.name: Wasteland Life: Survival Idle
it.d:
► IT'S A TOUGH WORLD OUT THERE

You’ve barely survived… As you look out across the post-apocalyptic desert landscape, you realize that your survival hinges on both resource management and strategic thinking skills if you want to master these harsh conditions. Construct buildings and cities from the ground up in this fun, idle-style game as you test various strategies to see which will get you the furthest.
 
► NO PLAN SURVIVES CONTACT WITH THE ENEMY

While you may not have to fight off roving packs of zombies or other classic enemies in this game, you will need to keep your wits about you as you navigate the deserted desert… Or is it deserted?
You may not be as alone as you think you are.

Hoovers at the ready – Boy this sand is everywhere! Locate a vacuum and get to cleaning. As you remove the sand, not only will you clear territory that will be useful for your future cities, but you’ll also uncover tons of forgotten junk and appliances. One man’s trash is another man’s treasure, so collect anything and everything you stumble across – it might be useful.

Let’s get crafty – Remember all that junk you collected? Use it to fix broken bridges, build houses, and more; the possibilities are practically endless! Even the sand can be collected and used to make things, so make sure you always keep a good stock of resources and never give up an opportunity to collect more.
Fun in the sun – Whether you have just a few minutes or a longer stretch of time to kill, you’ll always have time to hop in the game and make some solid progress. The benefit of this being an idle game is that you’ll be making progress even when you can’t be online so there’s no pressure. Just sit back, relax, and imagine how you’ll build your future empire.
Idle but energetic – While Wasteland Life is heavy on idle game play and resource collection, there’s plenty of excitement as well for players who are looking for something a little more engaging. Head out on expeditions to collect fabulous resources, as these are what will really make or break your ability to sustain your city. But be careful, you don’t know what all awaits you out in the wasteland…
 
► CAN YOU SURVIVE THE TEST OF TIME

This simulation game sure will test your survival instincts to the max, as you struggle to not only survive, but thrive in this deserted wasteland that was once our planet. Draw up your best strategy and get to work uncovering the land bit by bit, collecting valuable resources along the way that can be used to build houses, settlements, and even cities. Download Wasteland Life now to embark on a thrilling journey of survival and discovery!

it.name: Wizardry Variants Daphne
it.d:
The portal of despair opens again. The labyrinth calls you to destruction. Revel in the endless dangers, relish the risk, devour the rewards.

Savor the risk.

Wizardry Variants Daphne carries on the lineage of the classic RPG series, Wizardry. The portal to the labyrinth of despair, where even destruction is pleasure, has opened once again.

■ Story
Once every 100 years, the Abyss opens.

It is a curse of death that consumes the continent. A Warlock who coveted Death, devoured people and animals and enveloped the world in despair.

Inheriting the power to seal the Abyss over generations, kings have continued to protect the kingdom from its curse.

But now, the king has vanished, and the world is being consumed by death, moment by moment.

Resistance itself is meaningless.
There is naught but to perish.

■ Adventure with allies
Experience an adventure of your very own with unique allies based on combinations of classes and races.

■ Difficulty with a bite
Perilous traps and mighty foes await in the dungeon. Take on a high difficulty that only Wizardry can offer.

■ Intuitive Controls
Play a full 3D dungeon anytime, anywhere, with one hand on your upright smartphone.

■ Cadre of renowned creators
Main Character Design: Yusuke Kozaki
Manga artist and illustrator; in addition to writing manga, he also does design work for anime and games, and is well known for the fine touches in his character designs.

Boss Monster Design: Katsuya Terada
His work, centered on manga and illustration, includes character designs video games and movies, as well as poster for theater productions.

Sound: Hitoshi Sakimoto
Has composed for more than 130 game titles of all genres. With their rich sound and epic scale, his scores have received tremendous support not only in Japan, but also from overseas.

■ Magnificent cast brings the fully-voiced scenario to life
[English Voice Actors]
Lulunarde: Morgan Cambs
Pulgritte: Dev Joshi
Dylanhardt: Doug Cockle
Elmon: Laurence Bouvard
Vernant: Christopher Ragland
Pickerel: Alex Capon
Leaufonde: Garrick Hagon
Shagtis of Sorrow: Jay Rincon

- Other Voice Actors, etc. -
Beth Robb Adams, Mike Bodie, Sarah Borges, Davis Brooks, Shin-Fei Chen, Doug Cockle, Clare Corbett, Arlene Decker, Sarah Galbraith, Garrick Hagon, Arina Ii, Jules de Jongh, Dev Joshi, Samantha Kamras, Rae Lim,Elsie Lovelock, Meaghan Martin, Gianni Matragrano, Joseph May, Alexander McMorran, Eric Meyers, Sarah Pitard, Christopher Ragland, Matt Reeves, Jay Rincon, Cecily Bednar Schmidt, Kerry Shale, Martin T Sherman, Adam Sims, Ina Marie Smith, Colin Stinton, Alex Vincent, Alexandra Vincent, Glenn Wrage -- Other appearances (in alphabetical order)

[Japanese Voice Actors]
Lulunarde: Inori Minase
Pulgritte: Yui Ishikawa
Dylanhardt: Chikahiro Kobayashi
Elmon: Satomi Korogi
Vernant: Yoshimasa Hosoya
Pickerel: Junya Enoki
Leaufonde: Takaya Hashi
Shagtis of Sorrow: Takehito Koyasu

■What is Wizardry?
Wizardry is a computer role-playing game released in the United States in 1981 with elements such as party organizing, labyrinth exploration, monster fighting, and character development having such a tremendous impact on the various RPGs that followed, that it is often referred to as the origin of RPGs. Numerous sequels have been released, and nearly 40 years after its release, it remains a timeless masterpiece that enjoys strong popularity around the world.

it.name: Wordle!
it.d:
Are you a word games master? Whether you are a fan of classic crossword puzzles or are just hopping on viral new word game trends, Wordle! will get you thinking. Take on daily brain teasers and train your mind with our fun word games.  

With several unique game modes, Wordle! will Challenge your mind and spelling skills. Want a fun and viral challenge? Try Daily Puzzle mode, where you’ll have 6 guesses to solve the word of the day. Each time you get a letter correct, the tile will turn yellow if it is in the word or green if it is in the right spot. Can you solve it with one guess? Once you’ve figured it out, share your score with friends. It's just like the viral word game, but on your phone! 

Can’t get enough Wordle!? Play Unlimited Wordle! in Classic mode, and play as long as you want. No need to wait a whole day for the next puzzle. Getting stuck? Not to worry! Use a hint to get out of a sticky situation and unlock the solution!

Or take on a timed challenge in Word Fever mode, where you will test your speed and spelling skills. Spell the word before the timer runs out, each time you find the word, the timer will reset and you will have to think fast and solve the next word. How far can you go?

Want to test your mind for the duration? In Secret Word mode you will have 3 chances to guess each word with the letters and clue provided. Push your word association skills to the limit, and guess each word before moving on to the next. Guess wisely, 3 incorrect guesses and you will have to start over!  

Expand your adult mind and make your brain stronger with our free word games! It is like taking your brain to the gym!

Wordle! Together. Choose a word and challenge your friends to see if they can guess it in six tries or less. Take turns solving each other’s words and earn points for solving the least amount of guesses. Enter a random match or challenge your friends to the ultimate viral battle of wits! It’s a fun and all new way to Wordle!  

Game Features 
 
1. Fun Word Puzzles
Play the viral word game, or try one of our fun and creative game modes for a unique challenge like you’ve never seen before 

2. Unlimited Wordle! 
Solve as many Wordle! puzzles as you’d like In Classic mode. No need to wait a whole day for the next puzzle! 

3. Share Your Results
Try Daily Puzzle mode, where you can solve the Wordle! of the day, then share your results and compare stats with friends

4. Special Boosters 
Having trouble? Unlock special boosters like the Dart, which will remove letters or Hint to reveal a correct letter, or use a Skip to pass a level entirely or try again if you lose. 

5. Play at Your Own Pace:
Whether you enjoy the pressure of a timed challenge, or want to try to go the duration in Secret Word mode. Wordle! Has several games to play at your desired pace

6. Flex Your Brain Muscles
Ready for a tougher challenge? Test your skills in more challenging levels with longer words!  Will you be the Wordle! Champion?

Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!

From the Studio that brought you Mr. Bullet, Happy Glass, Ink Inc and Love Balls!

In a shattered world where the undead roam freely, only those with courage and wit can survive. Traverse vast, decaying environments filled with hidden dangers and secrets. Use your wits to climb obstacles, avoid zombie hordes, and uncover the mysteries of the apocalypse.

Unleash the power of your mechanical arms! Each arm spawns from your back and can wield a different weapon, allowing for dynamic and versatile combat. Equip your mech arms with an array of powerful weapons to adapt to any situation.

▼Backpack Mechanic▼
Your backpack is more than just storage; it’s your lifeline. Carry essential items, weapons, and tools to survive the harsh world. Manage your inventory wisely to ensure you’re always prepared for the unexpected.

▼Dynamic Combat▼
Engage in fast-paced battles with hordes of zombies. Use your environment to gain the upper hand, climb to safety, and launch surprise attacks. Strategy and reflexes are your keys to survival.

Will you brave the undead, explore the unknown, and reclaim your world? Download Z Survivor: Backpack Shooter now and prepare to survive the ultimate test.

Survival isn’t just about fighting—it's about exploring, adapting, and conquering. Are you ready to become the ultimate survivor?
