it.name: Zombie Fortress: Trap Defense
it.d:
BRAINSSS

The walking dead are on the move, and it’s your job to take them out in this zombie tower defense game that is chock full of collectible weapons and strategy. With each new zombie wave you’ll have a chance to merge weapons and move them around to find the best combos thanks to the simulator aspect of this zombie shooter game. Along the way, collect all sorts of exciting weapons, towers, equipment, and more to help you blast these zombies off the face of the earth.

THE BEST DEFENSE IS OFFENSE

This simulator strategy game will really get your gears turning! Each level will involve waves of zombies trying to attack your tower – your goal is to defend your tower and wipe these creatures out. Carefully pick your weapons, merge them to form powerful versions, and try moving them around with each new round to see how that affects the outcome.

Fantastic features:

- Top strategy – Usually simulators are more mundane, like hotels, but who says they can’t be about the zombie apocalypse? Face your foes in abandoned lots and strategically funnel them towards all of your carefully placed weapons, while also making sure to maintain a good defense of your home base! This zombie shooter also allows you to change up the weapon placement in between rounds, adding an extra layer of fun as you try different methods and see which will ensure your survival.

- Endless waves – What good is a simulator if you can’t actually test your great ideas! Thanks to the wave upon wave of walking dead, you’ll never run out of targets to practice on. Like all good zombie survival games you’ll have to make sure that you don’t end up as one the bad guys too, so make sure to shore up your tower defense.

- Collectible fun – weapons, clothing, equipment, towers, you name it – you can collect it, level it up, and use it to fight back in this zombie apocalypse shooter! Use your gold and coin wisely to level up during rounds, and make sure you check out your inventory afterwards to see what all you got and how you can best use it in this survival game.

THE ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE IS NOW

Grab your weapons, man the towers, and strike before they can bite! Combine survival games, strategy games, and tower defense games into one, add a hefty dose of zombies, and you’ve got Zombie Fortress! Collect weapons and try out various strategies as you fight off waves of the undead, and along the way enjoy building out your character and their tower. With great graphics and lots of customization, you won’t want to miss trying your hand at this game!

In "Zombie Streets," the undead roam the streets, and it's up to you and your battle squad to fend off the hordes and reclaim humanity's last bastions of safety. - Unlock Vehicles: Gain access to a variety of vehicles that allow you to traverse the wasteland with ease. Upgrade your rides for enhanced speed, durability, and firepower, granting you the freedom to explore distant locations beyond the reach of GPS.

- Rewards and Challenges: Take on missions that offer unique rewards, ranging from valuable loot to rare equipment.

- Unique Battle Features: Each soldier has a special skill which can be used during battles, like drones, turrets, mines, and grenades to unleash devastating attacks on the undead. Each soldier possesses unique attributes that unlock special qualities, making them indispensable assets on the battlefield. Explore a wide array of weapon types, like assault rifles, shotguns, pistols, snipers, and submachine guns. Each with its own characteristics and strategic advantages, to gain the upper hand against your undead adversaries.

Gear up, rally your squad, and prepare for the ultimate showdown against the zombie horde. The fate of humanity hangs in the balance, and only the strongest and most cunning will emerge victorious. Can you survive the "Zombie Streets"? Join the fight now!

Escape. Survive. Uncover the truth.

Zone X thrusts you into a post-apocalyptic nightmare inside a secret facility gone wrong. What was once a secure military base has become an abandoned maze of danger, darkness, and buried secrets. In this immersive blend of action-adventure and 3D survival RPG, you’ll explore, craft, and fight to stay alive — while uncovering the terrifying truth behind Project X.

Every corridor hides new threats. Every decision shapes your fate. Zone X captures the tension of top survival games 3D, combining intense combat, atmospheric exploration, and a gripping narrative. Whether you enjoy action games or offline RPG survival experiences, Zone X offers a challenge built for true survivors.

EXPLORE AND SURVIVE

Journey through two contrasting zones — one still crawling with active security drones and deadly traps, the other decayed and overrun by failed experiments. Each area reveals fragments of the facility’s downfall, making Zone X one of the most captivating apocalyptic games out there.

Collect resources, craft essential tools, and upgrade your gear. Fans of survival crafting games will find deep, rewarding progression as you adapt to an environment that never stops pushing back.

UNCOVER SECRETS

Search classified archives, decrypt terminals, and explore abandoned labs. The mystery of a scientific catastrophe unfolds piece by piece, merging the intrigue of wasteland survival games with a dark sci-fi story.

Take on mutated subjects, rogue machines, and lurking horrors. With fluid combat and exploration inspired by action-adventure and survival games, every encounter feels unpredictable and intense.

CONQUER THE WASTELAND

In a world where the rules of survival have collapsed, only those who adapt will endure. Whether you prefer post-apocalyptic tension or the tactical depth of RPG survival, Zone X challenges you to master both.

YOUR STORY. YOUR SURVIVAL.

Each step brings you closer to the truth. Each choice carves your path. From stealthy infiltrations to desperate firefights, Zone X redefines survival gameplay — proving that only the strongest escape alive.

Will you expose the truth behind Project X… or join the countless who never made it out?

Download Zone X now and begin your escape.

Join Alto and his friends as they embark on an endless snowboarding odyssey. Journey across the beautiful alpine hills of their native wilderness, through sleepy neighbouring villages, ancient woodlands, and long-abandoned ruins in a quest to uncover the Spirit of the Mountain.

• Universal app with iCloud support. Play on your iPhone, iPad and Mac devices. Your progress will always be in sync.

• NEW: Existing progress from the original Alto’s Adventure (2015) can be imported, allowing long term players to pick up right where they left off.

it.name: Castle Busters
it.d:
SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.

Build your defenses, choose your crew, and smash your opponent's hard work to pieces in Castle Busters, a turn-based online PvP battle game.

Just you, your rival, and two castles that won't both survive the match intact. And you'd only just finished decorating!

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target.

In fast 1v1 battles, every shot changes what happens next. Blast through walls to open new angles and collapse towers to expose enemy heroes. Win by taking out their entire crew or turning their castle into rubble.

With physics-based artillery and a battlefield that falls apart, you'll need to think on your feet. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match heroes whose abilities work together. Build around your favorites, discover powerful combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

YOUR CASTLE. YOUR DESIGN.

Build a castle worth showing off, then roll it into battle. Yes, it's on wheels.

Fortify your walls, position your heroes, and choose gadgets that suit your strategy. Test your setup in battle. Putting your plan together is almost as satisfying as watching theirs fall apart.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your heroes and unlock new faces for your crew. Each new arrival brings a different ability to play with and another reason to rethink your lineup.

Earn rewards from the Forge as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

CLIMB THE RANKS

Earn trophies and progress through the arenas on Trophy Road. Unlock Ranked mode and compete on the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Castle Busters is free to download and play. Some in-game items are available for purchase. A network connection is required. Suitable for players 13+.

it.name: Coin Master
it.d:
Join your Facebook friends and millions of players around the world for prize-winning spins as you build village after village on your journey to the top!

Do you have what it takes to be the next Coin Master?

Get ready to team up with friends for thrilling expeditions or join forces with a crew of fellow players. You’ll always find a new adventure with an ever-changing lineup of special events, packed with unique challenges and exciting surprises to keep you on your toes!

Spin and Attack!

Spin the wheel to discover your fortune- or attack friends' villages and steal their coins to help build your own! You can also win gold sacks to build magnificent villages throughout the game and advance through thousands of levels. Don't forget to win shields from the wheel too—you'll need them to guard your village from other players trying to attack you back! Become the Coin Master with the most impressive villages and the most incredible prizes!

Embark on Fun Expeditions with Friends!

Earning coins from the prize wheel isn’t the only way to gather resources—you can find them on exciting expeditions too! Team up with friends to journey to other villages and uncover treasures that will help you build and advance to the next level. You never know what wonders you'll find in the next world you explore!

Collect all the Cards!

It's not always about the coins; it's about the treasure too! Collecting cards completes sets and unlocks the next village in your grand adventure. With thousands of villages to create and build, each completed set is a step forward in your journey. With every village you master, your wins will be even greater.

Play and Create Teams with Friends!

Trade your cards with our online community to collect them all! Join our fast-growing interactive Facebook community to meet new friends, create your dream team, earn big rewards, and trade treasures to help each other build and progress faster!

it.name: Cypher 007
it.d:
"This is a 007 game made by 007 fans." - Connor Christie, Pocket Tactics

"A Triumph, without a doubt the best Bond Game we’ve had since 2010." - Calvin Dyson 

"The dialogue between the many familiar characters, the gadgets, the dramatic escapes, the aesthetic of the entire game... it all just screams James Bond." - Jared Nelson, Touch Arcade

From the developers of Space Marshals, PixelBite, in collaboration with Tilting Point, comes Cypher 007—a top-down action adventure game inspired by 60 years of Spycraft. As seen on CNN Entertainment, Cypher 007 will put players in the shoes of James Bond as you revisit some of his most iconic moments.

The criminal mastermind Blofeld and head of Spectre has once again hatched a plan to sabotage his archenemy James Bond. This time he has utilized brainwashing techniques known as 'The Mind Trap', holding Bond captive in a mental prison in an attempt to turn him into the ultimate double agent. Play as Agent 007 on his most challenging mission yet—escape the Mind Trap, defeat Blofeld, and put an end to the CYPHER program.

*Explore and Uncover Secrets* 
Immerse yourself in the James Bond universe in this modern twist of a spy adventure game!
Gather intel as you play through different environments with the help of characters from MI6 like Q, M, and Moneypenny!
Play through a number of immersive levels filled with obstacles, opponents, and objectives, increasing in difficulty as you progress!

*Complete Missions*
Use spycraft to overcome obstacles, take on enemies, and bring down Blofeld and Spectre once and for all!
Compete against other 007 agents around the world and prove you're the best spy of all time! 

*Earn Unique Rewards*
Unlock and upgrade EPIC gadgets, weapons, and gear to BUILD your resources and escape the Mind Trap!
Collect UNIQUE outfit linings and full character model outfits from the franchise as you play!

Agent 007, are you ready to take Blofeld down and end the Cypher program?

*TRY BEFORE YOU BUY* Play the opening portion for free. A one-time purchase unlocks the full game. DLC expansions are available as separate in-app purchases.

With 130,000+ reviews and a 96% Overwhelmingly Positive rating, Dave the Diver is coming to mobile. The mobile version is a full port of the original PC game. 

[An adventure, RPG, management hybrid]
Explore and unravel the mysteries in the depths of the Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.
It’s easy to get hooked on the satisfying gameplay loop!

[Casual combat and gathering gameplay with rogue-like elements]
Dive into the ever-changing Blue Hole and use a harpoon and other weapons to catch fish and various creatures.

Upgrade and forge equipment with collected resources and sushi restaurant profits to prepare for the dangers that lurk in the unknown.

Running out of oxygen means leaving collected items and fish behind!

[Eccentric characters with a lighthearted narrative]
Quirky but lovable characters and a story full of in-jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes provide an approachable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

[A beautiful sea environment with attractive 2D/3D Art]
A combination of pixel and 3D graphics provides a stunning art style that showcases breathtaking underwater scenery. This oceanic adventure is set in the real marine environment of a Blue Hole filled with over 200 kinds of sea creatures.

[Ample additional content to complement the main gameplay loop]
Minigames, side quests, and multiple storylines provide many hours of entertainment and varied gameplay.

it.name: DC Worlds Collide Strategy RPG
it.d:
The Crime Syndicate has invaded Earth! Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman charge into battle first, rallying a squad of DC Superheroes and DC Super-Villains in this fast-paced 3D RPG game. Recruit icons like Red Hood and Nightwing, coordinating stealth strikes, The Flash, blitzing through enemy lines, Raven, unleashing dark energies, and Constantine, outwitting the Crime Syndicate, while Krypto’s boundless courage lights the way for every hero.

Unleash Sinestro’s fear constructs, Lex Luthor’s high-tech weaponry, and Deathstroke’s lethal tactics to crush every foe! Collect, train, and upgrade your DC legends into an unstoppable force, trigger cinematic ultimates to shatter your enemies, and save Earth. Progress with idle rewards even when you’re offline and call in Elite Reinforcements, like the Batmobile, for a game-changing edge. 

COLLECT & ASSEMBLE YOUR DREAM TEAM
Build your dream squad by combining DC icons in new ways. Imagine pairing Superman’s heat vision with Lex Luthor’s powered armor for an unstoppable front line, or pairing Wonder Woman’s lasso mastery with Dr. Fate’s arcane shields for impenetrable defense. Train Batman in precision stealth tactics alongside Nightwing’s acrobatics to flank enemies, while Zatanna’s reality-bending magic complements Raven’s darkness manipulation. Assemble your super lineup wisely to overcome every challenge the Crime Syndicate throws at you.

TRAIN, UPGRADE & LEAD
Every victory brings points to train your heroes and unlock powerful gear. Equip Flash with speed-enhancing boots, level up Constantine’s mystical artifacts, and upgrade Red Hood’s deadly arsenal. As you engage inside quests or the core story campaign, each upgrade deepens your strategy, pushes your squad toward victory, and lets you flex your leadership: will you lead with brute force, or outthink your foes with subtle synergies?

EPIC STRATEGY IN 5V5 BATTLES
In DC Worlds Collide, strategy is your superpower. Watch The Flash zip past enemy lines to apply pressure while Nightwing sets up devastating combos; and counter enemy teams by dispatching Sinestro with precise attacks or suppressing Raven’s shadows with Wonder Woman’s divine light. Every 5v5 battle demands careful team composition: match heroes and villains whose skills complement one another, exploiting weaknesses to earn the upper hand and secure decisive wins.

EXPLORE MULTIPLE GAME MODES
From a gripping solo campaign to intense PvP arenas led by Batman’s stealth and Superman’s unstoppable might, there’s always a new way to engage and earn epic rewards. Dive into timed events hosted by Lex Luthor’s advanced schemes or join Storm Trials where Zatanna’s reality-bending magic reshapes the battlefield. Global raids, challenges, and seasonal leaderboards ensure fresh rewards for every squad. Compete in ranked arenas, climb leaderboards, and show off your masterful strategy to the entire DC Universe.

BREATHTAKING 3D COMBAT & CINEMATIC ULTIMATES
Immerse yourself in hand-painted visuals and 3D-rendered characters. Watch The Flash and Kid Flash dash past defenses with lightning speed, witness Sinestro’s fear constructs obliterate foes in chilling detail, and see Dr. Fate’s mystic shields shimmer as he commands arcane forces. Every battle is a spectacle you won’t want to miss. 

SAVE EARTH & SHAPE THE DC UNIVERSE
Your decisions drive the story. Will Constantine’s cunning gambits unravel the Crime Syndicate’s plots, or will Red Hood’s precision strikes tip the balance in your favor? Lead your squad through challenging missions that test your strategic mind; from infiltrating Syndicate strongholds to battling in genre-defining Boss fights. Earn exclusive rewards, unlock new characters, and collect vital resources to keep your heroes and villains at peak performance. 

Download DC Worlds Collide now to assemble your heroes, train your squad, engage in epic battles, and lead the fight to save earth from the Crime Syndicate today!

desc:
12 YEARS. 80+ STORIES. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED. NOW ON YOUR WRIST.

it.name: Delight Games Premium Library
it.d:
12 YEARS. 80+ STORIES. 100% HUMAN-AUTHORED. NOW ON YOUR WRIST.

Dive into 80+ interactive novels where your choices actually matter. No "pay-to-win" decisions. No algorithms. Just deep, hand-crafted storytelling from a lifelong D&D nerd... now on iPhone AND Apple Watch, because apparently your phone wasn't close enough to your face.

For over a decade, Delight Games has been building a universe. This is a massive collection of 1 million+ words across 80+ volumes. Every branching path, every stat-check, and every secret ending was written and balanced by a human hand to ensure a rewarding RPG experience.

THE DELIGHT GAMES DIFFERENCE:
 • 80+ Interactive Volumes: High Fantasy, Noir Mystery, Gritty Horror, Sci-Fi, and more.
 • 100% Human-Authored: Every twist and every dungeon crawl was written and balanced by a human hand. No AI-generated filler.
 • Choices are ALWAYS Free: Unlike other games, we never charge you gems or diamonds to make a specific choice. Your decisions are based on strategy and character, not your wallet.
 • RPG Mechanics: Manage your Life, Mana, Sanity, and Cool. One wrong decision in a dark dungeon could be your last.
 • Play Anywhere: No wifi? No problem. It's light on your storage and easy on your battery.
 • Fully Accessible: Fully VoiceOver compatible for blind and low-vision players.

YOUR WRIST JUST BECAME A DUNGEON. The full Delight Games experience is now on Apple Watch: Standalone or paired with your iPhone. Either way, your story goes wherever you go.
 • Read & Play Full Stories: The whole experience, miniaturized. Make choices, manage stats, and try not to die... all from your wrist.
 • Built-In Speed Reader: A fully customizable RSVP speed reader delivers words one at a time, right to your eyeballs. No scrolling or squinting, just dial in your words-per-minute and let the story come to you.
 • Quick Decisions, Companion Mode: Let your Watch handle the choices while your phone handles... whatever phones do when you're not looking.
 • Track Your Stats: Life. Mana. Sanity. Cool. Watch them fluctuate in real time as you make increasingly questionable decisions.
 • Never Lose Your Place: Your Watch will remind you that there's a dragon waiting and you left it at a cliffhanger.

TRULY FREE TO PLAY We believe in the "play well, play for free" model.
 • Earn Your Way: Hunt down those achievements, get the high ranks, and choose to watch the rewarded videos as they become available. Not that I don't appreciate your monetary support and I'm confident that you will find it well worth it, but know that you do not have to.
 • The "Luck" System: Use your earned Luck to rewind time and fix fatal mistakes.
 • The Premium Option: Want to skip the grind? A one-time purchase unlocks ALL current and future content forever. No ads, no coins, no gates… just the ultimate library.

ABOUT DELIGHT GAMES If you're new to Delight Games you might say "Interactive novels? But I don't like to read." You might even say this in a whiny voice (although we hope not).
Well, even for you book haters, now reading is addictive because with Delight Games interactive novels you make the choices for the main character, alter the story, alter your stats, and try to stay alive. Can you make it to the end? If so, what kind of score and rank can you get?

If you like interactive fiction or just want to try something different from the typical soul-sucking mobile games, this is the ULTIMATE download for you!

it.name: Lost Prison - Shelter Survival
it.d:
► WALKING IN A WASTELAND WONDERLAND

That’s how the song goes, right? Well, now it does, seeing as how the apocalypse has come and gone and the last remaining survivors, yourself included, are left to rebuild society, starting with the local jail! Unexpected, yes, but just because the world got laid to waste doesn’t mean that all crime stopped. Craft, build, and defend your prison hub as you rehabilitate inmates while also building a shelter and trying to survive in this idle prison RPG.
 
► THEY’RE IN THE JAILHOUSE NOW

This game combines all the fun of idle games, where you’ll craft buildings, workbenches, and more that will collect resources for you in the background, with the fun of RPGs as you work to clean up the area, manage and expand the prison, and become an all-around jail tycoon. Along the way you’ll also have a chance to help rebuild your world, one reformed criminal and beautified spot at a time. Don’t go soft yet through: you’ve still got to defend your territory and survive!

We think you’ll love:

● Crafting: Simple items can turn into deadly tools and crazy weapons in your hands, all it takes is a bit of skill and a touch of forward thinking. Collect all manner of items as you clean up the last dregs of chaos, and then use these to help build new prison wings, weapons, and gear. Your survival depends on it!

● Upgrading: Once you have your base items, don’t sit back on your laurels! Upgrade them to the max so no matter what the wasteland throws at your shelter you’ll be prepared. In addition to weapons and gear you’ll also need to ensure your survival by constructing buildings and then setting up defenses and protecting them. Who knows what’s out there!

● Exploring: As your need for resources grows, you’ll have to travel further and further afield to collect items to keep your prison running and ensure your survival. Enjoy the opportunity to see a whole new world post-apocalypse and explore all manner of mysterious places as you roam. Don’t be afraid of a little danger though, that’s usually where  you’ll find the best loot stashed.

● Growing: Grow your jail, your world, and even your character! The more you progress, the more skills will be unlocked, thus boosting your little guy and helping you survive.

● Playing: Your survival might be on the line, but this is still a game! You can enjoy this idle wasteland exploration game anytime, anywhere, as no internet connection is required. Squeeze in a little world building and jail building no matter what the situation.
 
► SURVIVAL OF THE SMARTEST

Test your post-apocalypse survival skills now in this fun and exciting idle game, where as one of the last survivors you’ll need to build a prison to rehabilitate the bad guys, maintain it, and make the world a little better in the process. Along the way build both your world and your character, explore exciting new landscapes, and move from surviving, to thriving. 

Download Lost Prison today to show that you’ve got what it takes!

Step into the world of professional formula racing with Formula Ride, a high-intensity racing simulator built for true motorsport enthusiasts
This isn’t arcade racing.

•	Authentic grid lineups

•	Points-based season standings
Every race contributes to the championship table. Every point matters.
Realistic Race Control & Incident System
Formula Ride introduces advanced race management mechanics:
•	Minor collisions cause aerodynamic damage
•	Front wing damage impacts speed and handling
•	Tire wear affects grip and braking
•	Major crashes can lead to disqualification
•	Severe incidents trigger Safety Car deployment
•	Extreme accidents may result in race suspension and restart
Under Safety Car conditions:
•	Cars regroup behind the leader
•	Overtaking is restricted
•	Strategic pit stops become crucial
Drive aggressively and risk penalties. Drive smart and fight for the title.
This mode rewards precision, patience, and race intelligence.

Career Mode – From Rookie to World Champion
Your journey begins with basic formula machinery and limited resources.
Climb through multiple tiers of professional racing:
•	Entry-level developmental leagues
•	Intermediate professional championships
•	Elite advanced formula series
Earn reputation, unlock advanced vehicles, improve performance systems, and gain access to more technical circuits.
As you progress:
•	Competition becomes tougher
•	AI drivers become more strategic
•	Mistakes become more costly
Build your racing legacy step by step. Every victory builds your career. Every podium builds your reputation.
Only the most disciplined drivers will reach the top.

Quick Race Mode – Instant Competitive Action
Want immediate racing intensity?
Quick Race Mode lets you:
•	Select track conditions
•	Choose car setups
•	Set race length
•	Customize difficulty
Experience full simulation physics without committing to a full championship season.
Perfect for short sessions — but still serious racing.
Same rules. Same realism. Faster access.

Classic Mode – The Golden Era of Formula Racing
Step back into the historic era of formula motorsport.
Drive legendary-style classic machines inspired by older racing generations:
•	Minimal driver assists
•	Raw engine power
•	Mechanical grip challenges
•	Vintage track environments
Classic cars demand skill over technology.
No modern stability systems. No advanced aerodynamics.
Pure control. Pure precision. Pure racing heritage.
Relive the era where bravery and skill defined champions.

Realistic Driving & Physics System
Formula Ride delivers:
•	Dynamic tire wear simulation
•	Realistic braking physics
•	Downforce-based cornering mechanics
•	Aerodynamic slipstream effects
•	Precision steering balance
•	High-speed stability management
Every corner requires technique.
Every braking zone requires timing.
Every overtake requires confidence.

Competitive Features
•	Global Leaderboards – Compete worldwide
•	Achievement System – Unlock performance milestones
•	Daily Rewards – Boost your career progression
•	Free Bonus Rewards – Accelerate your upgrades
•	Progress Tracking & Driver Stats
Climb rankings. Earn recognition. Build your racing identity.

Built for True Motorsport Fans
Formula Ride is designed for players who want realism, strategy, and competitive intensity.
It rewards:
•	Clean racing
•	Smart overtakes
•	Tactical decision-making
•	Consistent performance
Every race feels meaningful.
Every championship feels earned.
Every mistake has consequences.

Start from the back of the grid.
Survive the chaos.
Master the strategy.
Dominate the season.

it.name: Go Escape! - Casual Ball Games
it.d:
Go Escape is a wickedly addictive mobile game that amps up the classic ball game vibe with a killer twist. You're not just rolling a ball here: you're mastering the art of precision and strategy. The whole game is a mind-bending journey of making that epic ball jump, bounce, and dodge its way from one rad platform to the next, with each level cranking up the heat.

The star of the show? It's a ball that's not just any old sphere. This thing is sleek, responsive, and handles like a dream. Thanks to the game's top-notch physics engine, it's all about that tactile feel, where every bounce and leap off a platform feels exceptionally real.

Levels in the game are like a boss rush of brain teasers. You've got one shot, one path to victory, and it's littered with obstacles that'll test your reflexes. These aren't your garden-variety hurdles either. We're talking devious blocks and tricky movers that'll have you plotting your moves like a grandmaster.

Platforms are the game's backbone – they come in all shapes and sizes, from rock-steady to those sneaky vanishing ones. It isn't just a test of skill: it's also a visual feast with eye-popping colors that'll keep your eyeballs glued to the screen.

As you level up, the game throws down the gauntlet with even crazier challenges. It's a perfect blend of skill, strategy, and speed. You have to stay sharp, think fast, and adapt. And the satisfaction of nailing that perfect run? Unbeatable.

Controls in this ball jumping game are slick and intuitive. You won't be fumbling around: it's all smooth sailing so that you can focus on the action. What about audio? The game's tunes and sound effects are on point, keeping you pumped as you blaze through the levels.

In a nutshell, Go Escape is a beast of a ball game. It's packed with mind-blowing levels, heart-pounding challenges, and straight-up eye candy visuals. This game is your next obsession if you're all about that high-octane, brain-twisting, platform-hopping action. Get ready to bounce your way to glory!

it.name: Gotchi Galaxy: Pixel Pet
it.d:
Hatch an egg, raise a pixel pet, and watch it grow into someone all its own.

Gotchi Galaxy is a cosy pocket pet for every age. Feed it, play with it, tuck it in at night, and give it a hug when it calls. How you care for it decides who it grows up to be: every pet has its own temper, its own favourite food and game, and things it loves to do.

GROW A FAMILY
Pair two grown pets in the Love Lab and see the baby's odds before you choose. Pets carry real genes for ears, eyes, tails, wings, colours and tempers, some hidden, some rare and shiny. Every egg remembers its parents and grandparents in a family tree.

EXPLORE PLANETS
Send a pet on a trip into space. Peek through the porthole while it walks a faraway world, then welcome it home with souvenirs, eggs and stories. Chart new planets, find new species, and catch the week's comet.

DRESS UP AND DECORATE
Hats, outfits and accessories for every pet. Furnish your rooms and garden with cosy sets, wallpapers and floors, and grow flowers outside.

PLAY TOGETHER
Walk the town square and meet the residents. Make friends with other players, visit each other's rooms, send gifts, and play games together. Families are only ever made between friends.

LITTLE GAMES FOR LITTLE ONES
A Family corner with gentle games for young children: counting snacks, making ten, adding berries, copying a dance, hide and seek, and planning a rocket's path. No way to lose: every round ends on a happy card. More games for older players too, from memory and jumping to digging a mine.

KIND BY DESIGN
- No ads, ever.
- No account and no login: just a name for your pet's island.
- Pets never die. A pet can retire with a last wish, or find a new home in the Adoption Lounge.
- Away for a while? Holiday mode keeps your pets safe until you are back.
- Grown-up settings: a daily play limit, quiet hours, school hours, Friends only, and what the game may share.

MORE TO FIND
Seasonal festivals with their own food, outfits and rooms. Hobbies like painting, gardening and stargazing. A collection of more than fifty species and their many looks. A crafting bench, a gallery of your pet's creations, a classic green screen mode, and a whole wardrobe of toy-like device shells.

Your pocket pet is waiting. Hatch your egg today.

Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.

From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Vice City, a huge urban sprawl ranging from the beach to the swamps and the glitz to the ghetto, was one of the most varied, complete and alive digital cities ever created. Combining open-world gameplay with a character driven narrative, you arrive in a town brimming with delights and degradation and given the opportunity to take it over as you choose. 

To celebrate its 10 year anniversary, Rockstar Games brings Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to mobile devices with high-resolution graphics, updated controls and a host of new features including: 

• Beautifully updated graphics, character models and lighting effects 
• New, precisely tailored firing and targeting options 
• Custom controls with a fully customizable layout 
• iCloud save game support 
• Massive campaign with countless hours of gameplay 
• Support for Retina display devices 
• Custom iTunes Playlist* 

*To listen to your custom playlist, simply create a playlist titled “VICECITY”, launch the game, and select the radio station “Tape Deck” 

Universal App:
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is supported on iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPhone 5, all iPad models and 4th and 5th generation iPod Touch.

For optimal performance, we recommend re-booting your device after downloading and closing other applications when playing Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. 

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Korean, Russian, and Japanese.

it.name: Grand Theft Auto V: The Manual
it.d:
GTAV: The Manual is the official manual app for Grand Theft Auto V. Contains over 100 pages covering everything from Game Controls, and Features to a tour through the local neighborhoods and activities across Los Santos and Blaine County - plus a special interactive version of the game map to zoom in and explore.

Developed by series creators Rockstar North, Grand Theft Auto V is available worldwide for PlayStation®4, PlayStation®3, Xbox One®, Xbox 360® and PC.

Set in the biggest, most dynamic and most diverse open world ever created, Grand Theft Auto V blends storytelling and gameplay in new ways as players repeatedly jump in and out of the lives of the game’s three lead characters.

When a young street hustler, a retired bank robber and a terrifying psychopath find themselves entangled with some of the most frightening and deranged elements of the criminal underworld, the U.S. government and the entertainment industry, they must pull off a series of dangerous heists to survive in a ruthless city in which they can trust nobody, least of all each other.

All the classic hallmarks of the groundbreaking series return, including incredible attention to detail and Grand Theft Auto’s darkly humorous take on modern culture.

Grand Theft Auto V also comes with Grand Theft Auto Online, the dynamic and ever-evolving Grand Theft Auto universe for multiple players. With the expansive game world and fluid mechanics of Grand Theft Auto V as a foundation, Grand Theft Auto Online expands and evolves with regular content updates created by Rockstar Games and the Grand Theft Auto community.

With assistance from characters from the story of Grand Theft Auto V, players rise through the criminal ranks by banding together with friends to complete Jobs for cash, purchase properties, vehicles and character upgrades, compete in traditional competitive modes such as Deathmatches or Races by land, air or sea, or create your own content to play and share with the Grand Theft Auto community.

To find out more about GTAV, visit http://www.rockstargames.com/V

Watch GTAV trailers, gameplay videos and more at: http://www.rockstargames.com/V/videos

Who caused this disaster? And on this path to solve the riddle of MO's existence, what sorts of trials and tribulations lie ahead?

MO has an exquisite pixel art that is both adorable yet dark, giving the game a full-bodied sci-fi atmosphere. Besides fitting the storyline perfectly, the amazing aesthetic effects are a constant visual feast for players as they adventure onward.

The game's theme song has been carefully crafted to express the story of MO's adventure, while the background music and sound effects for each quest fit perfectly with each environment.

▶Collaborating to create a moving masterpiece
An exceptional masterpiece, developed by Archpray Inc. and produced by Rayark Inc.

Now she must survive.

Explore mysterious islands, break objects, gather valuable resources, and use everything you find to stay alive. Upgrade Riley’s tools to destroy tougher obstacles and unlock new resources, then craft and improve powerful weapons to face the dangerous enemies lurking across the islands.

But survival is only the beginning.

Build and upgrade your raft to travel between islands and search for a way out of the Triangle. The journey won’t be easy — hostile rafts patrol the waters, and enemy crews will attack when you try to reach new islands. Defeat them in combat and keep moving forward to discover what lies beyond the next horizon.

As Riley’s adventure starts, she encounters traces of an ancient tribe, a mysterious Long Fire, and a secret that has kept these islands isolated from the outside world for generations.

Gather resources. Upgrade your tools. Craft powerful weapons. Defeat enemies. Explore this adventure game!

Can Riley survive the Bermuda Triangle and find a way home?

it.name: Pirates Fight
it.d:
Онлайн-бои парусных кораблей. Залпы с борта, абордаж, штурм фортов и захват бухт. Бесплатно, с живыми капитанами и ботами.

БОЙ ПО-МОРСКОМУ
Пушки стоят на бортах: заходите боком, ловите ветер, бейте залпом. Каждая пушка стреляет по своей траектории, автоприцел кладёт залп на корпус цели или на форт. Книпели рвут паруса, зажигательные жгут, тяжёлые ядра пробивают. Борт о борт решают сабли: абордаж берёт корабль без пушек. Ремонт раз за бой, мины за корму, ядра на выбор прямо в бою.

ТРИ РЕЖИМА И ШЕСТЬ КАРТ
Потопить всех, захватить бухту за 25 секунд или снести форты противника. Каждая карта со своим характером: пролив с башней на островке, две крепости, серые вершины, забытый маяк. Для новичков учебная бухта: штурвал, камера, пушки и цель за пару минут.

ВЕРФЬ И ПОРТ
Дерево из 21 корабля: лёгкие, средние, рейдеры, тяжёлые, от шаланды и люггера до фрегата и линкора. Опыт копится на корабле, на котором воевали, и открывает следующий в линии. В порту модули корпуса, пушек, парусов и штурвала, запас ядер и снарядов. Пробные корабли недели, первая победа дня даёт двойной опыт.

МЕДАЛИ И РЕЙТИНГ
Двадцать медалей за подвиги: первая кровь, серии побед, штурм фортов, чистые бои. Рейтинг против живых капитанов, ежедневные задания, профиль с историей боёв.

ЧЕСТНО И ПЛАВНО
Бой считает сервер: позиции, баллистика, попадания, абордаж. Читы не работают, команды делятся по скрытому рейтингу, боты добирают стороны до размера карты. 120 кадров в секунду на поддерживаемых экранах.

Аккаунт можно привязать к Apple, Google, Telegram или почте и продолжить на любом устройстве. Удалить аккаунт можно в профиле в любой момент.

"App Store Best of 2016"!

Experience the future of illicit hydrojet racing, where armored riders kick out death-defying stunts over massive waterfalls, dodge cops through public waterways, and boost at breakneck speeds across surging waves.

You are a hydrojet rider, framed and cast out from the Riptide GP league, forced to race illegally through city waterways, flooded ruins, and churning factory machinery in an effort to reclaim your reputation and your title.  Play through the single player career to unlock new vehicles, playable characters, and customization features as you take down bosses and build your crew.  

Then, take your skills online for the ultimate test as you battle opponents around the world in 8-player online matches.  Challenge your friends for leaderboard supremacy in the ghost-racing challenge mode.

Featuring thrill-ride race tracks packed with shortcuts, secrets, and interactive obstacles, Riptide GP: Renegade is the action-arcade water racer for a new generation.


"Riptide GP Renegade delivers one of the best arcade racing experiences on iOS whether it’s on land, air, or sea making it a must have. " - AppleNApps (4.5/5)

"Riptide GP Renegade is a really fast, fun, and robust racing game." - 148 Apps (4.5/5)



• • FEATURES

• Thrill-Ride Environments - Blast across floating factory platforms, brave hurricane-strength waves, and infiltrate a military base in the midst of battle.  Every race track is packed with interactive set pieces, dynamic obstacles and secret shortcuts.

• Deep Career Mode - Battle your way through a variety of races and boss fights to reach the top of the underground hydro jet racing circuit.  Earn cash and experience to upgrade and customize your hydro jet, unlock new stunts, and increase your rider's performance.

• Online Multiplayer - Compete online in thrilling 8 player matchups against the best players from around the world.

• Challenge Mode - Take command of the leaderboards and test your skills against ghost recordings of your friends' best performances.

• Transforming Vehicles - Collect and upgrade a garage full of blisteringly fast hydro jets that transform while you ride them. Win money to upgrade and customize each one.

• State of the Art Water Racing - Riptide GP: Renegade brings dynamic water racing to a new level of excitement with breathtaking water physics, splash-tastic spray effects, and more!   Every race is different because the surface you race on is always changing.  

• GameCenter and iCloud - Compete with your Game Center friends on leaderboards and unlock challenging achievements.  Plus keep your game going from device to device with iCloud data syncing.


• • CUSTOMER SUPPORT

If you encounter a problem running the game, please visit:  www.vectorunit.com/support 

Be sure to include the device you're using, OS version, and a detailed description of your problem.

Command your goddesses in a strategic Anime Tower Defense RPG - the long-awaited sequel to Shiba Wars TD!

◆ The Ultimate Anime Tower Defense RPG ◆
This is a true TD game with beautiful artwork and multiple ways to clear each stage. You can bring your favorite (even non-meta) goddesses and still succeed in endgame content if you execute your strategy correctly. It's the classic tower defense style you love without any of the annoying mobile gimmicks.

◆ Goddess Collection ◆
Build your team of maidens in any order you want using Direct Recruitment!  
・Unlock any character you want just by playing (no gacha)
・Use stage sweep to automatically earn loot (no grinding)
・Earn amazing daily rewards just by logging in (player friendly)
New characters are released each patch, so you can casually expand your collection and build your account.

Join forces with the Bunny Goddess Lily to stop your deranged pet Shiba Inu from destroying the world. It might be the only anime game where you don’t have amnesia - it’s just a fun story where you get to tag along with clumsy goddesses.
The story is fully voiced in Japanese and uses animated Live2D artwork.

・Level Up

・Skill Enhancement  
・Soul Sync
All upgrade materials are earned for free by clearing stages, playing in events, and logging in.

・Stage sweep for easy material farming (no tedious auto-battles)

・New characters and events every patch
If you love cute goddess collectors, strategic anime tower defense, or high-quality Japanese-style RPGs, Shiba Wars 2: Tower Defense TD is the game for you.

Welcome to Ship Simulator: Boat Game, a game in which you need to build a nuclear power plant in a deep province using ships. There is no transport infrastructure, only swamps and rivers around! At your disposal is an impressive list of ships recreated according to real drawings. Complete routes of varying difficulty and earn money to replenish your fleet with new ships. Modify ships to cope with difficult routes and earn more money. Discover the entire fleet of vehicles: from an old tugboat to the most famous ships of the twentieth century!

- Advanced ship management
- Advanced ship improvement system
- Many interesting routes

- Addictive gameplay
- Stylized 2D graphics

On your way, you will conquer the elements and infrastructure problems in a wide variety of locations: swamps, plains, forests, mountains and much more are waiting for you!

it.name: Stone Grass: Lawn Mower Game
it.d:
Enjoy making things look nice and neat? Then you’ll be blown away by Stone Grass—the most satisfying lawn mower game where your main goal is to cut grass to make lawns look perfect! Only three things matter in this grass-cutting game: you, a neat lawn, and the grass that stands between. Take your lawnmower for a ride, cut grass, and become the master of the grass-cutting craft in one of the best lawn mower games. Let’s get mowing! 

BECOME A TYCOON

Stone Grass isn’t just another relaxing grass-cutting game—it’s one of the best idle tycoon games! In it, you can build a whole empire just by mowing grass. The rules of this lawn mower simulator are simple: you make green by mowing green. Be the one to create the most thriving harvest business in the history of all idle tycoon games! 

UPGRADE YOUR STATS

Stone Grass follows the logic of upgrade games, meaning that to get the most fun out of this idle game, you’ll need to constantly improve your skills and stats. Upgrade your equipment, increase your speed and capacity, and most importantly, cut grass—and you’ll soon start reaping the harvest of your grass-cutting craft!

DISCOVER NEW LANDS

In this ultimate lawn mower simulator, plenty of lawns desperately need to be mowed. Travel between islands, guide your lawnmower through the bushy fields, and mow the lawns until not even a blade of grass is left. Nothing can stop you or your trusty grass cutter in this mowing simulator! 

No doubt you haven’t seen an upgrade game like this one before. Still not convinced this mowing simulator is the best? Here’s what you’re bound to love about this mowing game:
– Unique mechanics 
– Beautiful landscapes 
– Crisp and bright graphics
– A fun and addictive grass-cutting game
– Relaxing gameplay
– Constant profit and amazing rewards
– The ability to craft and customize

Who said that mowing games couldn’t be fun? Stone Grass is nothing like the other idle games you’ve played. This lawn mower game will prove to you that mowing grass can be fun and addictive! Download Stone Grass—one of the best mowing games out there. The greatest adventure of your life is waiting for you in this mowing simulator!

it.name: Tower War - Tactical Conquest
it.d:
► BEAUTIFULLY SYMMETRICAL WARFARE!

Turn the tide and win the war in this elegantly simple casual tactics game that’s guaranteed to appeal to all armchair commanders and pocket Napoleons. Head into battle with a single swipe and watch your little warriors celiminate the enemy, allocating your cute little forces with skill and precision to maintain your position and overcome the opposing armies. 

Tap into your military genius and tap onto the next tower to continue your campaign of conquest and come out on top in this fast, fun, and occasionally infuriating strategy game that towers above the competition.

► COLORFUL WARFARE!

• Aww, war! Don’t be fooled by cute appearances, in this compact and colorful wargame it still takes nerves of steel, a will of iron, and ice-cold calculation to beat the enemy and conquer all before you. Real strategy and tactical thinking are required to win each battle, and every level can turn on a single lightning decision. Keep your wits about you, keep an eye on the enemy, and keep swiping fast to ensure victory.

• Don’t let defeat get you down – you can relive past battles again and again, and you’ll want to keep on trying in this deceptively simple but fiendishly challenging game of military strategy and conquest that brings you fierce warfare and tactical intrigue in satisfying bite-size pieces.

• Hours of towers! Use your tactical cunning to progress through the levels of tower-defense and unlock new types of towers, including artillery posts and tank factories. Other game mechanisms including multiple enemies, barriers, blockades, and mines mean the war is never over and there’s always a new challenge to spice up the already massively addictive gameplay.

• Towering achievements – keep finding the elegant tactical solutions to win each battle so that you can unlock new areas and continue your reign of conquest in new climes, with beautiful backdrops adding to the game’s already supremely elegant (and cute) design.

► ALL YOUR TOWERS ARE OURS!

Looking for a mobile strategy game that’s both serious fun and offers a genuinely sophisticated tactical challenge?  

Tower War takes tower-defense to a new level of entertainment and ingenuity, with intuitive gameplay and exceptionally smart game design that will keep you coming back to the battlefield for more and more wildly entertaining wargames. Raise your colors, stiffen your swiping finger and summon the fun of war by downloading  Tower War now and charging head-first into battle!

● Unlimited creativity: Design and build the metropolis of your dreams!
● Engaging match-3 puzzles: Complete fun levels to earn rewards and boost your progress!

● Stunning graphics and charming animations

it.name: War Regions - Tactical Game
it.d:
► LET THE BATTLE GAMES BEGIN 

Geometric warfare: Maneuver your troops around the game board’s hexagons to attack the enemy or reinforce your positions. Can you reach your target from your current positions? You’ll have to draw the line to see.

Strategic waiting: Depending on your strategy and the state of the battle, you can choose to attack immediately or wait for your resources to regenerate over time and then launch a more powerful attack. But remember, your enemy’s resources are always expanding too.

Full-spectrum warfare: Fight with tanks, artillery and helicopters, learning how best to deploy your troops for the fastest and most effective takeover of the board.

There’s a twist: Each time you send troops to reinforce a position, you leave the position you’re moving them from unguarded and an easy target for takeover by the enemy. Can you regenerate forces fast enough to protect it?

Fight on all fronts: As the game progresses and the board gets bigger, you’ll need all your wits about you to keep track of every position and optimize your battle strategy. Don’t forget to scroll up and down to see what’s going on in every corner of the battlefield.

Combined attack: Employ more effective tactics to conquer your enemy and achieve a fast takeover by launching multiple maneuvers with a single swipe of your finger. Engage the enemy on several fronts by drawing through your and their bases, then watch how your strategy works out.

Spoils of war: Earn gold each time you win and use it on extra difficult levels to draw down airstrikes on your enemy and turn the course of battle.

No surrender: If at first you don’t succeed in your plan for world domination, you can always try again. In this game, there’s no penalty for losing, so adjust your strategy, amass your troops and head straight back into the fight.

Good visibility: Stylish graphics and precise level design help make War Regions a fun and satisfying war game that you’ll want to come back to again and again.

 ►TIME FOR A TAKEOVER 
Ready for a casual tactical battle game that’s fun to play but also offers increasing strategic challenges as you progress through the levels? Looking for a new addiction that’s great to play whether you have just five minutes or several hours to fill? Then download War Regions now and get ready to conquer every region on the map.

it.name: Weekend Warriors MMA
it.d:
The engine behind the biggest wrestling game on mobiles now brings the revolution to MMA - featuring 300 fighters spread across 5 promotions and 5 weight classes! Immerse yourself in the sport however you choose - from a career as a ranked fighter to booking cards in the first ever fully playable "Promoter" mode. With a revamped control system tailor-made for MMA, every move is at your fingertips as you use your mind as much as your body to win this game of human chess!

Upgrade to "Pro" to enjoy each career mode at its best with no limitations - starting with anyone, anywhere. There is also a further "Backstage Pass" for those who want to save their changes to all 300 fighters and pit them against each other in dream bouts. With every rule at your discretion, you can either be a purist for 1-on-1 fights or blow off steam in ridiculous contests featuring up to 10 fighters!

CONTROLS
The game features an interactive tutorial that you are advised to play through, but the basic controls are as follows:
CURSORS = Movement (double-tap to run or dash)
S = Strike (with a direction to aim high or low and left or right)
S + any other button = One of 3 powerful attacks
G = Grapple / Transitions / Counters
B = Block / Moves / Escapes
T = Taunt / Pin / Referee duties
BLOCK + TAUNT = Pick-Up / Drop nearby objects
EYE = Change focus (if necessary)
HEALTH METER = Switch character (wherever possible)
CLOCK = Pause / Quit / Camera options

Please note that this game depicts a fictitious universe and is not affiliated with any real fighters or promotions.
